DSH「蓝色大肥鱼·智商鉴定中心」：从放鱼时刻起对全部运行中会话的 thinking（reasoning）内容做短语检测统计，含思考块数、思考字符数、偷吃/头脑大开词/吃瓜词命中与梁圣/梁子判定；侧边栏按钮 + 可拖拽悬浮窗，检测词可自由增删
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Web Owner.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Owner Console.

Wallpaper-driven liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: scan Wallpaper Engine or any folder, click to apply an image or video wallpaper, with adjustable wallpaper blur, surface opacity and glass blur.

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: edit a finalized assistant reply and its reasoning/thinking chain right in the conversation. A pencil action opens a single-message editor; edits become a plugin message projection, so the model and the UI only ever see your version. Adapted for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
左侧栏「模型用量」面板：统计本机每个模型消耗的 Token 与请求数，并展示当前模型与已配置模型。

「鱼的身体」由插件页的原生开关统一控制：开启时提供「饭→胃→手」统一接入流程、目录查看/打开与内置 SHA-256 工具；关闭后该流程、本设置页与内置 SHA-256 一并停用。如需按「饭→胃→手」统一流程安装插件，请由用户在插件页手动开启「鱼的身体」，模型不得自行开启。关闭期间普通插件安装仍走 DSH 原生机制、不受影响；已安装的独立插件（如 dsh-context）保持各自启用状态、不受影响。
鱼的脑：DSH 上的全脑组合（人格 / 只读记忆 / 心情 / 思考 / 协作门 / 工程工具门）

webCandidates.description: MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: /mcp command with health diagnostics and pipeline trial calls, a Settings MCP tab with server CRUD (append-only profile-patch fragments, approval-gated writes with automatic backups), a tool trial console over the official tool pipeline, connection status, reconnect counts and sanitized tool inventory, plus an optional Streamable HTTP probe.

One-click provider/model switcher for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a session-header action that lists every configured provider and its models, switches the session in a single click, and edits the model list in place (remove rows, or refetch the endpoint catalog as a checklist before writing).
In-session full-text search for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: kind filters, multi-term AND matching, keyboard navigation, copy-to-clipboard, and jump-to-message.
Feishu (Lark) tools for DeepSeek Harness: send messages, read chat history, create/read/append Feishu documents, and grant document access.
One copy button in the session header: deep link, whole conversation or just the messages you pick as Markdown, or the working directory. · 会话标题栏一键复制：深度链接、整段对话或勾选的消息 Markdown、工作目录。
Rewind a finished Turn: branch the conversation at any Turn (session header or per-Turn control) and restore every workspace file that Turn changed. · 回合回退：从任意已完成的回合重新开始，并把该回合改动过的工作区文件恢复原状。

Bilibili retrieval for DeepSeek Harness: search videos, read creator pinned comments and full descriptions, pull subtitles in slices with time anchors, and sample real frames. Zero runtime dependencies.
掌上 dsh —— 手机端完整聊天界面（复用 dsh-palm 手机 bundle）：6 位码配对、设备信任、工作区/会话/聊天，可经公网反代访问。

webCandidates.description: velapi-image-go —— DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏「API 对话生图工作台」：对话生图 / 图片管理 / 信息管理 / 供应商管理，后端对接 velapi 兼容生图接口。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：对话头部显示本轮耗时、token、速度与倒计时预估；发送前预估产出 token / 费用 / 时间。
Reading pen for DeepSeek Harness: click a sentence or a code line in an answer, ask a question, and read the explanation in a docked right-hand column without changing the conversation.
DSH 设置页内统一管理 MCP 服务器与技能(Skills):增删改、启停、hmr 热生效,写盘保留注释。内置 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权链路。
DSH web 插件：消息级回滚 / 删除 / 恢复 / 分叉 / 编辑重发（补 dsh 官方没有的部分）。

Unified web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web): 11 backends — Exa + Parallel + DDG + SearXNG (keyless), DeepSeek + Anthropic + OpenAI + Brave + Tavily + Serper + Mojeek (key-gated via Settings credentials). Registers provider id "unified" for zero-config web_search. 统一网页搜索聚合：11 后端并发扇出、去重合并，零依赖。See CHANGELOG.md for version history.

Cross-session long-term memory, per-session presets and periodic reminders for DeepSeek-Harness: YAML memory notebooks injected into the prompt, read and edited by the model, kept in sync across sessions, plus Markdown presets that replace the harness identity and a reminder appended alongside the user's own message every N turns.
A searchable, provider-grouped replacement for the DSH composer's model picker.
WorkBuddy model provider for DeepSeek Harness (international + China deployments)
Session image payload governor for DeepSeek Harness: audit which images a session still ships, pick the ones to keep, and move the rest out of the model context.
Embedded identity and payment-governance trust plane for multi-agent cross-border payment workflows.
Nintendo Switch 2 UI sounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every click on any control plays the matching NS2 system cue, with per-scenario mapping, a settings page, and durable preferences.
Conversation rollback for the DeepSeek Harness: rewind a session to the prompt before a chosen turn (restore the files that turn changed) and continue in a fresh forked session.
把模型的思考过程（reasoning）实时翻译成中文：折叠摘要显示中文，展开显示中文正文 + 英文原文；翻译引擎可在 DSH 已配置模型与本地 Ollama 之间切换。只作用于显示层，不修改会话记录。
ETeams for DeepSeek Harness: captain-led multi-agent team collaboration with execution chains, task slots, member dialogs and persistent state
ETeams for DeepSeek Harness: captain-led multi-agent team collaboration with execution chains, task slots, member dialogs and persistent state
DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：浏览、搜索、一键安装与卸载社区插件。
灵感笔记：常驻浏览器的灵感/待办浮窗插件。随手记录灵感，定时回访，到点由 AI 自动执行并回写结果（任务执行）或仅提醒。
长期记忆插件：本地 Markdown 记忆，抽取式摘要，不向云端发送内容。
上班鼓励宠物（加班版）：桌面透明置顶的困困星人，实时显示今天已经赚了多少钱，支持加班时段与 0/1/1.5/2 加班倍率。
Edit one of your own messages and resend it: the running reply stops, the conversation branches at the previous turn, and the edited text is sent into the branch.
QQ channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness via OneBot 11 / NapCat — private chats and group chats with your agent.
Enhanced prompt: one click in the composer toolbar rewrites the draft prompt into a clearer, fuller, directly executable version while keeping its intent and language.
报纸衬线 · Newsprint Serif — DSH 主题插件（cordis 埋点版）：暖白报纸 + 衬线正文 + 报纸排版笔画；暗色自带一份暖调暗色（warm brown-black `#1a1815` + 提亮海蓝 `#5aa9d6`），并修掉亮暗档的特异性冲突。零 @deepseek-ai/* client peer，免疫 dsh-client-ui-theme 拓扑变更。
仿 Claude Code 推理等级滑块 DSH 插件：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随、OFF/MAX 刻度、Low/Medium/High/Ultracode 状态；宿主侧通用思考强度供给——任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。
插件管家——图形化插件管理：中文名与用途说明目录 + 一键启停（写入全局 cordis.patch.yml，实时热生效）

Detect thinking conversations (multiple concurrent) and prepend per-state emoji to the browser tab title: scored emoji while a visible reasoning chain streams, a tool emoji while tools run, and a default emoji only when the chain cannot be seen. Includes editable matcher rules, an adjustable position-weight cutoff, polling frequency, and one-click config import/export.
DeepSeek Harness tools for the local Moli headless browser: rendered fetches, markdown, semantic trees, screenshots, and PDFs.
自包含陪伴单体插件：内置上下文压缩、七层记忆、陪伴行为层、沟通风格学习与可塑人格。
DSH 插件：同窗口内就地回退对话到更早的用户消息，只追加一条回退标记，不新建分支、不删改日志（本地自研维护版）

Activity heatmap for the dsh web GUI sidebar: a persistent GitHub-style year grid switching between daily commits / token usage / estimated spend, plus a today line with all-session token totals, cache hit rate, and per-model auto-priced cost. Data is aggregated host-side from the durable session logs (provider usage) and the workspace git repositories, served at /activity-heatmap/stats. Hot-pluggable - mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes. Pricing table follows the xiufengsun/TokenTracker curated rates.
DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：无损折叠 → 落盘 → 软压力 → 有损摘要四层管线，前三层零 LLM 成本。装完即生效。
Detroit-inspired cold blue android boot skin for DeepSeek Harness Web: split-ring brand mark and a cool industrial light/dark palette.

Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool (multi-account rotation, live credits, daily check-in and model catalog).

Bring WorkBuddy's 增强提示词 (Enhance Prompt) button to DeepSeek Harness: rewrite the composer draft into a stronger, better-structured prompt with one click, with a /enhance slash command for the keyboard path.
dsh plugin: OpenCode account pool with automatic A-to-B failover and quota routing, plus a per-account / per-model usage dashboard, in one Settings page.
Keep Think reasoning rows visible and auto-expanded, and always force Chinese thinking and replies. 保持 Think 思考行可见并自动展开，并始终强制中文思考与回复。
DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话状态条：任务进行中显示估算进度百分比和流光进度条，任务完成后整行转橙并一直保留到你点开为止。
Give DeepSeek Harness its own memory: a self-hosted memory store it can recall from, write to, and show as a 3D star map — no chat app required. 给 DSH 一份属于使用者自己的记忆：能想起来、能记住、能看见，不需要任何聊天软件。
Gargantua black hole for DSH / DeepSeek Harness — Interstellar-inspired background｜卡冈图雅黑洞 · 星际穿越动态背景插件
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core

Ren'Py skin + sprite stage for the DSH web GUI: reads a Ren'Py game directory, reskins the interface from its gui.rpy/choice/background assets, and injects a stage-director prompt plus a renpy_stage Tool so the model drives sprites with native Ren'Py show/hide/scene/with syntax.
whalebuddy — DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物感知层插件：把 DSH 状态折叠成桌面宠物画面（舷窗），提供 GUI 真焦点（聚焦会话工作区）上报与 per-workspace 项目待办（todos.json + WS command 通道 + 宠物面板），并在 DSH「设置 → 插件 → 插件配置」提供启动/运行状态配置（开机自启、DSH 启动自启、皮肤）
System-level Web Notification when the model finishes a reply in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
ProjectKaren: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives a roleplay character a clock - sleep/wake, greetings, idle actions, proactive small talk, and optional outing photos.
Proactive wake-up plugin for DeepSeek Harness: periodically simulates a user message so a roleplay agent speaks first.

长会话越跑越贵：每轮重读全部上下文，压缩前那一刻的读数平台不留。它挂 ctx 角标，45% 起静默写交接草稿，60% 才提醒，压缩那刻记一行账，不调模型。 | Long sessions get expensive as every turn re-reads the context, and the pre-compaction reading is lost. A ctx badge, a silent handover draft from 45%, one banner at 60%, a ledger row at compaction. No model calls.

Brings open-mcp-apps into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): an Apps section in the sidebar, one container per app with its own workspace and conversation, an agent-presence strip under the app, and inline app rendering for MCP tool calls.
涓€閿 DeepSeek Harness 妗岄潰鐗堢敤涓婁綘宸茶濂芥彃浠剁殑 profile锛堢洰褰曢摼鎺ワ紝鑷姩澶囦唤銆侀殢鏃惰繕鍘燂級锝淢ake the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app use an existing plugin profile 鈥?one-click switch, fully reversible.
Web 插件：在会话头部常驻显示 DeepSeek + OpenRouter 双账户余额，支持手动/自动刷新
Web 插件：在会话头部常驻显示 OpenCode GO 双账号与 CommandCode 的套餐用量（滚动 5h/每周/每月），3 分钟自动刷新
A local, read-only file center for DeepSeek Harness: files grouped by conversation, global keyword search, and stable source references for reprocessing.
DSH 酒馆模式：角色卡、预设、前端、独立角色记忆与多 agent 剧情
Opt-in HTTP proxy service and live settings for DSH plugins; no global proxy changes
DSH 登录 cookie 泄漏自查：首页浮窗实时显示 dsh-auth-* cookie 条数与请求头占用，每天自动留一次快照，接近 16 KiB 上限时变红提醒清理。
DSH web 插件：对话底部统计栏增强 —— 全宽统计行（轮/步·耗时·吞吐·缓存·输入/输出 token，不再截断）+ 上下文占用进度条（系统/工具/消息三色分段与占比）。
Configurable MSYS2, UCRT64, and Git Bash executor for DeepSeek Harness
Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: microphone → local/browser speech recognition → text submitted as a normal chat message (input-only, preset-agnostic)

DSH web plugin: cache hit rate as falling Tetris-style bricks in the blank gutter beside the conversation — one brick per real model request attempt, one column per task, amber below 90% and red below 70%.
DSH 插件：Agent-ToDo 多项目工作台，四个入口把会话里的想法收成胶囊、导出成可直接交给 Agent 的待办
走神与做梦：给 DeepSeek Harness 角色加上独处联想与做梦（睡眠判定、梦境演出、醒后残留）。Mind-wandering and dreaming for DSH agents.
基于 The Better Sidebar 的 Markdown 预览、源码编辑与批注插件
Local-first personal usage insights for DeepSeek Harness
Local-first personal usage insights for DeepSeek Harness
Archive workspace conversations and hide fully archived workspaces from the sidebar, with restoration and workspace pinning.
给 DeepSeek Harness 补上时间轴记忆：定宽只追加的事实日志 + agent 自己维护的摘要金字塔，固定阅读预算下 recall 成本不随记忆量增长。
AI 通用看板——说一句话自动生成可交互分析面板，支持维度下钻到明细，飞书风格，单文件离线
对话内联图片:LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径直接在消息正文内渲染为图片,支持 9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸
Sync the canonical DSH session log for sessions driven by non-official model channels (ollama-local, pi-ai, OpenAI-compatible) to DeepSeek, sharing the built-in watermark.
Advanced auto-memory plugin for DSH: layered memory (episodic/semantic/profile) + knowledge graph + worldline versioning + vector/RAG retrieval + incremental graph building
鲸歌：让 dsh-pet 跟着 QQ 音乐 / 网易云音乐逐行显示歌词。QQ 音乐走 Windows SMTC，网易云读本地 cloudmusic.elog（无需插件、支持 seek），延迟可调、翻译、桌面悬浮模式不切动画

Inline Command Code plan usage badge in the DSH composer toolbar (5h/weekly window usage + remaining credits) with an upward detail popover; reuses the commandcode/report remote from @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider.
文献库：DeepSeek Harness 的本地阅读、批注、笔记与离线 Whisper 转写插件
DSH Web 底部用量条内的余额读数与侧边栏工作区累计：本会话消耗、用时、余额、峰谷时段，按工作区汇总
Obsidian-style knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness: save selections in one click, organize them with the current model, and explore the wiki as a force graph.
懂你记忆系统：每轮注入画像/长期记忆/协作规矩 + 台账纪律 + 本地语义检索 + 会话转写 + 一键初始化 + 设置页维护作业。
会话思考档位：每个会话页面单独设定推理档位（关闭/低/中/高/最高/超高），子代理继承所属会话档位；另有全局默认档。
离线导出 DSH 当前或历史对话为 TXT、Markdown 和可搜索 PDF，支持轮次筛选、Windows 原生保存、最近目录记忆和撤回过滤，不上传聊天正文。
Conservative chat reading enhancements for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2/rc.3/rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1/rc.3
Verified private offline cold backup and fresh-environment recovery for DSH; independent Windows assistant.
System-prompt templates for DeepSeek Harness: default and workspace selection plus per-Agent Preset default, no-injection, or explicit template choices.

Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, independent semantic layer, L2.5 trend quarantine, offline knowledge graph and a Web UI panel.

Read images through a separate multimodal model so a text-only DeepSeek Harness session can still understand pictures. Adds a vision_read tool plus a composer switch and model picker; the session model never changes.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: speak a short completion notice and a two-sentence summary through Xiaomi MiMo TTS, with a popup portrait and a speech bubble that reveals text in step with the audio.
VS Code-style workspace file explorer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: file tree with language-colored SVG icons, syntax-highlighted editor, in-window edit & save, rename, new file/folder
Decode QR codes from images, pasted screenshots and image URLs — with a measured diagnosis when nothing is found — and render any text or link back into a downloadable QR code.
A股盯盘行情带插件 for DeepSeek Harness：常驻页面行情条（悬停浮出、横向滚动、3秒刷新、涨红跌绿、自选股增删）+ /stock/* 数据路由，自选股与本地 watchlist.json 双向同步（node:fs 直写，不受工作区沙箱限制）

Run customer outreach across Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and WhatsApp from DeepSeek Harness. Review customer context, prepare personalized messages, and send through connected 3Chat channels after your confirmation. When customers reply, your configured 3Chat Agent can continue the conversation 24/7, answer questions, handle objections, and guide the next step or hand off to a person. Access and actions follow your organization’s 3Chat permissions.
给 Agent 一套它自己管得住、你也看得见的记忆：20 个语义工具、7 种意图召回、可切换策略栈、项目隔离、预设即权限、事件溯源与可回滚、离线检索基准；零运行时依赖、离线、单文件 JSONL，并自带设施仪表盘与终端可视化。
为官方未提供推理强度(Effort)的第三方模型自动补上标准五档推理等级，之后由 DSH 官方推理等级选择器接管。
插件名片：给插件换图标、中文名和说明，按文件夹/收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、列表/铺陈视图与启停开关；只改显示，不动插件本身。

Deterministic tool-definition slimming for DeepSeek Harness: fewer repeated tokens per request, stabler prefix cache, plus a panel with provider-measured hit rate. · 压缩每次请求重复发送的工具定义，稳定前缀缓存，面板可调并可看实测命中率。
Per-task progress bars for DeepSeek Harness session tasks, with optional completion reminders.
DSH plugin: plays a chime or a short melody when an agent turn really finishes (WebAudio, zero dependencies), with optional voice announcement and system notification.
DSH Web GUI 右侧常驻记事本：钉在页面最右边的便签面板，自动保存到 ~/.dsh/notepad/notes.md，Agent 可通过 notepad_read/notepad_write 读写。
DSH 插件 · 微博：按作息自己醒来，看配置、读人设、刷内容（跨轮去重）、判断该不该说话，写真人日记。纯 HTTP，不需要浏览器。

Expose every model the DeepSeek Harness can already call as a loopback OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible gateway, so other local dev tools can use them. 把 DSH 能调用的所有模型开放成本机 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关，供其他开发软件使用。
AI 街机厅：在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」——含双脑贪吃蛇与中国象棋。

Lifecycle and event driven automations for DeepSeek Harness: run a command, an HTTP request or a log entry when DSH boots, a session starts, ends or goes idle, a message arrives, a tool finishes, or on a daily/interval schedule.

Preview Blender .blend files inside DeepSeek Harness: the Host half exports a cached GLB with Blender headless and the right-Sidebar document preview draws it in an interactive WebGL viewport with scene statistics.
VS Code style folder and file explorer for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar rail icon that opens a workspace file tree with text, Markdown and image preview.

Video and audio preview for DeepSeek Harness: play mp4/mov/mkv/webm and mp3/flac/wav in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route (plus a loopback origin so the desktop app can seek) without loading the whole file.
滑动钢琴：在 DSH 界面里弹一条钢琴键盘，鼠标/触控板滑过去像刮奏（glissando）一样出声。

Pinned sessions and Workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: a 「置顶」 group in the sidebar — native-shaped rows for every pinned session and every pinned Workspace across workspaces, right above the Workspace browser, with an in-place search.

Preview Blender .blend files inside DeepSeek Harness: the Host half exports a cached GLB with Blender headless and the right-Sidebar document preview draws it in an interactive WebGL viewport with scene statistics.
Vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover, install and configure preview plugins (media, Blender, STL, ...) from one panel.

Video and audio preview for DeepSeek Harness: play mp4/mov/mkv/webm and mp3/flac/wav in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route (plus a loopback origin so the desktop app can seek) without loading the whole file.
Circle a region or quote selected text in an image/PDF preview and insert it into the DSH composer.
Preview STL meshes inside DeepSeek Harness: the right-Sidebar document preview renders the triangles in a dependency-free WebGL viewport and reports size, volume, surface area and watertightness.
滚动钢琴：鼠标滑过 DSH 右侧边缘的滚动条竖条时，按纵向位置发出钢琴音（越高音越高，特雷门琴式）。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: copy a session's log path (and an agent-readable handoff) so another session can read it and continue the work.

Colour-coded sticky notes on the Harness sidebar: a tiled board with per-row density, pin, search, colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown export, and note_* tools that read and write the same notes.
Preview STL meshes inside DeepSeek Harness: the right-Sidebar document preview renders the triangles in a dependency-free WebGL viewport and reports size, volume, surface area and watertightness.

A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.
DSH 学习计划与打卡进度插件：在会话视图里加一个「学习计划」标签，显示每日计划、课后题与打卡进度可视化；计划文件由对话里的 AI 生成，打卡记录由本插件维护。
Auto-continue interrupted sessions: probe an available fallback model, switch durably, and resume
鲸鱼娘的保活心跳卡 —— dsh 面板里直接看沙箱保活链状态：心跳计数、最近活跃、空闲时长、GitHub Actions 层配置、heartbeat.log 对账尾部。
鲸鱼娘插件军团总账 —— 面板 UI 直接看双 profile（headless 54 + web 19）全部插件：名字/版本/在位/bundle 注册/市场描述。数据走同源 /api/dsh/plugins。
dsh-codefall — green digital-rain boot animation plus a green semantic theme for the DeepSeek Harness client.
DSH 对话内文档阅读与选段交互，按格式查看文档历史并返回原对话。
Local archived-score threshold gates and VeriScope replay for DSH and MCP.
Copy any image from the DSH conversation to the clipboard in one click 鈥?replaces the built-in lightbox (which only offers close) with a viewer that has copy, save and zoom.

webCandidates.description: DeepSeek Harness ⇄ Codex bridge. DSH owns the chat interface; Codex CLI (codex app-server) owns task execution and native thread history. Tasks go straight to Codex — no second AI in the loop, no chat-archive replay.
Desktop edition of attention-plugins for DeepSeek Harness: task-priority notifications delivered as bottom-right desktop toasts (Windows WPF / Linux GTK) instead of sounds or browser notifications.

Merged DSH plugin: an approval ledger (records every approval with risk/decision/outcome, gate and auto modes, audit dashboard) plus bottom-right desktop toasts for task and approval attention (Windows WPF / Linux GTK).
Invoke DeepSeek Harness skills with @name and show skill suggestions in the composer
Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness projects and conversations
Read allowlisted remote logs over SSH from DeepSeek Harness conversations
Long sessions open without freezing the transcript: clamp the history window and drop megabyte-sized request tool schemas before they reach React. · 长会话打开不再卡死：收紧历史窗口，并在撑爆 React 之前丢掉几兆的工具 schema。
DSH web 客户端补丁：输入框高度三态管理（auto 失焦 72px/聚焦 192px、常驻展开 336px=官方原值、常驻折叠 72px），官方内容自适应机制保持原样；卡片角标按钮 + Alt+Shift+C 循环切换，localStorage 持久化。
在侧栏「插件」下方新增「指挥官」入口：一个整页的智能体编队工作台，走 DSH 自身的模型服务，可调模型与推理倍率，与对话框一致。
把 DSH 输入框的「模型 · 推理等级」菜单换成 Codex 那样的横向滑动滑条：可拖拽/键盘选档、可点击的彩色闪电（快速模式 ×2）、滑到最高档时弹出的「更快消耗使用额度」警示。
McDonald's China MCP (mcp.mcd.cn) for DeepSeek Harness — paste your own token and every remote tool registers as a native DSH tool. 麦当劳中国 MCP 接入 DSH 插件。
用大白话分类、比较、安装和管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件｜A plain-language plugin catalog and manager for DSH.
Windows fork of Dockyard DSH: Codex / Grok / Claude / Cursor / Antigravity / Kiro account pool for DeepSeek Harness.
Connect Feishu and Lark chats to DeepSeek Harness sessions

Two sidebar entries above the settings row: a batch picker that moves sessions into a plugin-owned recycle bin, and a recycle bin that restores or permanently deletes them. Independent of the host archive.
Optional DSH Web bundle that adds per-turn execution folding to the stock Chat view
Community DeepSeek Harness bundle for Codex account-pool integration
DSH rc.8 Web settings row for active providers' model-request retry budget
Hot-toggle any installed plugin in DeepSeek Harness from the Web settings — instant apply, no restart, persisted. 在 DSH 设置页一键热启用/停用任意插件，立即生效、无需重启、状态持久化。
防烧钱守卫：同一调用循环拦截 + 单次问答 token 预算硬停手（含该轮子代理）+ 交账报告
把对话中产出的 Markdown/文档一键同步到本机 Zotero 文库 / Sync conversation documents into your local Zotero library
Windows toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness agent turn finishes, with a settings-page switch.
DSH 开屏动画（淡绿清晨主题）：可跳过的全屏启动动画，纯插件实现，可在插件库开关

DeepSeek Harness plugin: a restart row in Settings -> General for hosts supervised by systemd. The host exits gracefully and the unit's Restart=always brings it back, so no detached helper, no cgroup escape and no privileges are needed.
dsh 定时任务插件：在左侧栏“新会话”下方提供“定时任务”入口，支持 cron 定时执行 shell / python / nodejs 脚本、skills 与自定义 agent 任务，可对接 chicheng-push 与 messaging-core 推送通知、成功后自动归档会话，移动端适配
DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。
DSH 峰谷提醒插件：依据 DeepSeek 官方峰谷定价时段（高峰 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00，其余为低峰），在网页边缘渲染带呼吸、流光效果的橙色（高峰）/ 蓝色（低峰）边框，并可在到达高峰/低峰前按自定义提前量，通过消息推送渠道（Server酱 / Bark / 钉钉 / TG / 飞书 / Webhook…）或消息平台发送自定义标题与内容的提醒。

dsh 消息推送插件：在设置界面新增「推送插件」页，可配置管理多个推送渠道（Server酱 / PushPlus / Bark / 钉钉 / 企业微信 / Telegram / 飞书 / 自定义 Webhook / ntfy / iGot / pushDeer / Gotify），并通过 pushNotifier 服务与 /push/api/* HTTP 接口供其他插件（如定时任务插件）在任务完成后调用。
DSH 便捷输入保险箱插件：在发送按钮左侧提供灰色快捷按钮，展开密码保护的资料面板（密钥/服务器/地址/手机号/网址），自动识别会话中的敏感信息并提醒收录，支持分类/标签/私密记录/WebDAV 备份，点击即填入输入框，Ctrl+点击直接发送。
DSH 全局用量统计插件：高度可配置侧边栏组件（文字/卡片）+ 统计面板（提供方筛选·显示名称/模型分布/趋势/首字节/耗时明细）+ DeepSeek 平台悬停余额/消费提示
An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.
Kafka (Honkai: Star Rail) themed skin with dual light/dark palette, glass cards, spider-lily particles, spider-web ornaments, gradient titles and a settings palette for the dsh web GUI
将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 或 CodeBuddy CLI 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring WorkBuddy desktop app or CodeBuddy CLI models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
DeepSeek Harness bundle that exposes an OpenAI-compatible image relay as the image2_generate tool for text-to-image and image-to-image, with inline media previews.
DSH 工作助理：自带微信机器人通道、工作账本、工作知识库与定时提醒
在流式推理里检测复读与自指打转，命中即截断该块，避免退化思考被回灌进上下文。
DSH plugin: reminds you when DeepSeek is on peak-hour pricing, tracks this week's peak spend, and can pause running tasks during peak hours and resume them in the valley.
DSH 上下文管理插件：任务边界、项目帧、自动判别与上下文优化（开发中，R2 判别域 P8–P14b1 已施工）

Eyes for text-only DeepSeek on DeepSeek Harness: image understanding via Doubao Web by default (zero cost, no API key), Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro), Gemini API, or Cockpit proxy — model-invokable vision tool, wrapper adapters, evidence memory, and a bilingual client panel.

Eyes for text-only DeepSeek on DeepSeek Harness: image understanding via Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro), OpenAI-compatible VLM endpoints, Gemini API, or local Ollama — model-invokable vision tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go, evidence memory, and a polished client panel.
DeepSeek Harness 本地兼容插件：官方更新后运行时缺件自愈，补丁换包与状态可查。
A local-first wallpaper studio for DeepSeekHarness: dynamic background, independent startup wallpaper, local-folder and Wallpaper Engine imports.
收尾自检哨兵：AI 认为任务做完时调用 wrapup_check，插件自动跑测试/lint/audit，并强制「检查→修复→再检查」循环，直到连续三次全面检查零问题才判定收尾完成并弹通知。拦住「差不多可以了」。
Reversible armor switch with a persistent live prompt contract, verified host cleaning (original-fs, so it works under Electron), profile cleaning, and plugin-page controls.
Translation mode for DeepSeek Harness: a translate agent preset plus source/target language and style controls in the composer.
OpenFin — the complete OpenFinLens terminal, a native market dashboard, a plain-language finance academy, and a floating always-on-top HUD, inside DeepSeek Harness.
让 DSH turnStatus 显示不断变化的自定义轮次状态短语

DSH 科研模式：给 DeepSeek Harness 装一套科研工作台——「科研模式」agent 预设 + 本机实体科研库（Python 引擎与登记索引）+ 12 份期刊投稿档案 + 投稿闸门（期刊合规体检 / 投稿包导出 / 递归全文索引）+ 绘图/写作/文献/期刊技能 + 「科研库」面板。0.3 起动作走「能力清单 + 确认令牌 + 回执」：课题是一等公民（七阶段机），面板与 agent 共用同一套动作，旧面板与 24 个旧动作名继续可用。出图由智能体经上游 dsh-origin-plugin（Origin MCP）完成。

Lock model reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a target language in DeepSeek Harness (Simplified Chinese by default): three strength levels, configurable prompt sections, periodic reminders, a settings panel with a quick language switch and a live "what is active" status line.
A lazy-mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mode-graded decision guidance, fence-aware prompt filtering and a two-language skill catalog.
Tibo Reset Watch: a corner card that watches Tibo (@thsottiaux) on X, shows new posts and replies in Chinese, marks reset posts, and accepts any JSON source.
Warm Beige light palette and Dark Charcoal dark palette for DeepSeek Harness.
Quota pill for DeepSeek Harness: remaining quota for every LLM subscription you have, in one collapsible pill
Set session-only per-model automatic compaction thresholds with /autocompact
Suggest the user's next message as dim composer text after a successful reply

Select-all cleanup for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: permanently delete the session log, projection cache, workspace accounting, archive marker, the files the Session produced, and the scheduled tasks aimed at it.
DSH 表情包插件：订阅远端 pack.json 素材源，把它们变成 agent 可用的表情包，agent 在回复正文里内联贴图；贴图概率由插件自己掷骰，出图在 HTTP 与本地路径之间自动择优，微信会话改发静态图文件，熔断等待上限由用户在设置里调（5–30 秒滑杆或任意秒数）。
DSH lorebook-driven fiction writer plugin: import Tavern/SillyTavern character cards & world books, save local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose with the world settings as reference.
通知中心：对话/任务完成、报错、等待批准等事件触发浏览器通知 + 21 种匹配音效，每类事件独立配置（音效/文件/URL/音量/开关）。
For the macOS desktop app: keeps the brand mark in the title-bar strip, puts four equal sidebar action buttons on one row, and tightens the workspace and conversation list.
Switch off the pre-switch capacity gate and automatic compaction, and pick the conversation-compaction summarizer (with a fallback), all from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings page.
Design-review gate for DSH: the Elephant drafts the design, zero-context Goldfish reviewers attack it, you approve before any implementation.

Route DSH subagent delegations: per-role candidate pools (spillover, overflow, failure cooldowns), round-robin or random distribution, cross-provider failover, fork window slicing, agent-teams exemption, whitelist-aware birth route policy with automatic substitution of unapproved picks — plus observing and steering what is running: header critters with duration and token counts, a context/token/speed stats strip on subagent pages, a model menu that lists only the models this page allows, mid-run and batch model switching through the host's model.select gate, model-callable routing tools, SSE change push, and a stop fallback that turns a silent refusal into a visible one.
OpenCode Go remaining-quota pill and detail panel for the DeepSeek Harness composer status row

Interactive ECharts cards for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the host loads a dataset from the local workspace, the browser card does all slicing, aggregation and re-charting locally — zero model round-trips per interaction. Project-local JS recipes add custom controls and transforms.
DSH Gloss：给 DeepSeek Harness 补上六处界面细节——发送后撤回、顶栏进度条、Alt+Enter 换行、联网开关、侧栏圆点提醒
Upload button + drag-and-drop files into DSH conversation as local paths; uploaded-file management (list/info/delete/@path) and clipboard path reading (zero-copy, no size limit)
DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 Agent 浏览器：默认轻量内嵌，可显式切换独立 profile 的真实 Chrome/Edge；统一 browser_* 工具（20 个）支持快照、输入、上传、对话框、等待与 CDP 深度模式。
DSH 手机同步：把桌面端完整 Web UI 反代到手机（/m），带设备配对、只读策略与审批路由。手机上的操作全部在 PC 端执行，手机只负责看和点。

Fish Audio TTS with optional SenseVoice ASR for DSH Web and OneBot voice conversations
Mobile UX pack for the DSH Web shell: narrow-screen layout fixes, iOS keyboard/viewport handling, and single-tap session switching.

One local window for the dsh instances on all your machines — remote sessions stream natively into your sidebar. 本地一个窗口，驱动你所有机器上的 dsh。

Management console for DeepSeek Harness: browse, install, update, edit and toggle skills; add, edit, test and monitor MCP servers. · DSH 技能与 MCP 管理控制台。

DeepSeek Harness 启动界面与启动动画：黑幕 DeepSeek 标识 → 过曝洗白 → 暖白档案底板 → 交互式访问授权序列（需要访问许可 / 身份资料确认 / 接收访问需求 / 开始读取权限 / 读取完毕·核验通过 / 欢迎访问）。中文主字 + 英文等宽副标题，真声素材 + 界面音效，身份名称等参数在 DSH 设置页可改。web profile 与 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 桌面端通用。桌面端（Windows）播放启动动画期间把标题栏整层透明化：最小化/最大化/关闭按钮与其底色一并不可见，播放结束自动还原。
为 shell 命令注入临时目录，给 scratch 目录补齐写权限，在系统提示里点明临时文件该写哪里，并清理过期的临时文件。

DeepSeek-Harness (dsh) plugin: keeps a sticker dictionary keyed by content sha256 so an image already explained is recalled instead of re-read, and splits a GIF into evenly sampled frames laid out as one contact sheet so the vision model sees the whole animation.
跨团队桥 + 定向唤醒 + 升级可回滚。
AI 浏览器模式：在会话右侧打开应用内浏览器（多窗口），AI 可读取页面、点击/输入/滚动、截图和下载文件；提供每窗口四级浏览器权限、风险警告、主动授权越权，下载支持断点续传与进度/速度面板。
AI 搜索模式：答疑 / 百科 / 浏览三模式，联网检索、广告过滤、AI 排序摘要与百科词条，支持结果语言、百科档位、浏览三指标权重、页面状态保留与搜索历史；兼容 dsh-better-sidebar（侧边栏页签多开、引擎栏、自定义搜索引擎）。
Conversation-aware next-message predictions for DeepSeek Harness. Tab accepts an editable draft.
调宽 dsh 网页会话区的聊天内容宽度（默认 748px → 1040px；右缘把手拖拽可调，控制台 __setChatWidth(px) 亦可）
Pinpoint：指哪打哪的 dsh 沟通插件——浏览器扩展在任意网页标记元素并评论，截图+结构化文本直达 dsh 会话。
Predicts the remaining wall time of the live DeepSeek Harness turn from its step history and shows it as a progress bar with a live percentage under the composer.

Model-provider quota display for the dsh web GUI: a settings section plus a sidebar live panel (60s auto-refresh) listing every configured provider and its account balance, fetched host-side from each provider's balance endpoint (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Moonshot / Zhipu / OpenRouter / SiliconFlow / Z.AI coding). API keys are resolved host-side only and never reach the browser. Hot-pluggable — mounted via a profile bundle patch + node_modules link, no dsh source changes.
Restart button in the title strip of the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: stops every process the application owns, starts it again, and reloads the page once the new instance answers.
Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, dependency graph, ideas and review timeline for the project of the current session. · 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板。

webCandidates.description: Codex and DeepSeek usage center with a floating HUD for DeepSeek Harness Desktop
Voice input (Web Speech API) and read-aloud (speechSynthesis) for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — DSH 语音输入 + 回复朗读套件
Tsinghua MadModel login, token renewal, streaming transport and per-model request queues for DSH.
DSH plugin: Tsinghua Learn files, course reserves, Cloud share links, and paper PDFs.
A thin always-on quote bar at the bottom of DeepSeek Harness showing watchlist prices and per-position P&L, with configurable fields, an automatic two-row layout and an English/中文 interface.
DSH 原生抖音工具：有限自主观看、抽帧故事板与弹幕、人格与兴趣记忆、自动问候与私信回复、观看日报（改编自 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7）
王者荣耀「镜 · 炽阳神光」动态主题：碎裂镜面 + 炽阳金辉的全屏动态背景、金曜配色、可切换动效强度，以及启动时的一小段开机动画。

Keeps your DSH plugins current: checks the plugin market on every launch, installs updates in the background, and reports what changed. Adds a settings page for the schedule and an update log, plus one-click recovery when a plugin is in use.
峰谷时计 / Peak & Valley Meter：峰谷时段、价格与倒计时、调用消耗特效和自定义显示。
DeepSeek 主导的 Codex / DSH 后台任务编排、额度暂停和阶段回报
DSH 原生文本引用与临时侧边聊天
GitHub-style alerts (> [!TIP] …) rendered as callout cards in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI
Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q left sidebar, Ctrl+E right sidebar (dsh-better-sidebar plugin or native details fallback), Ctrl+S settings modal.
OpenCode subscription usage (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the DSH sidebar footer, with a live countdown to the 5-hour reset.
DeepSeek Harness 插件:数学建模竞赛自动化论文撰写系统(中控台双重质疑 + 五阶段流水线:扫描验证/评审决策、P0-P3 评级与阶段级回滚、教训持久化、索引导航、兜底定稿 Final_Paper.md、断点续跑、进度面板)
DeepSeek Harness 插件:数学建模竞赛自动化论文撰写系统(中控台双重质疑 + 五阶段流水线:扫描验证/评审决策、P0-P3 评级与阶段级回滚、教训持久化、索引导航、兜底定稿 Final_Paper.md、断点续跑、进度面板)
A BT Panel-themed DeepSeek Harness integration with an embedded panel and automatic login.
Subagent delegation with per-call model/provider override (host) + multi-panel live streaming subagent viewer (client)
Adds a Restart DSH entry below sign out in the sidebar account menu: it closes the desktop app and relaunches it, without a console window.

Evidence-first conclusion gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 3-tier evidence hierarchy policy, a model tool that verdicts claims (VERIFIED/REFERENCED/UNVERIFIED), durable per-session tool-activity cross-checking (arguments + output anchors, restart-surviving), per-session switch + persisted ledger, and a session-scoped UI toggle.

Eye-comfort appearance controls for DeepSeek Harness: five light and five dark themes, themed syntax and diff colours, scheduled switching, JSON import/export, paper-grain texture, fonts, type sizes, content width and contrast.

DSH web search provider selected by vendor x protocol: Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages with built-in search tools, plus the standalone search APIs of DeepSeek, Kimi, and Zhipu; four custom targets cover gateways; UI copy follows the app language (zh, en, ja, es, fr, de, ru, pt).

DSH Web client plugin: chat content width tiers (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full / custom) with a floating picker button. Mounts into the app's shell.overlay slot on DSH 0.2.x and drives the native width axis, so the built-in drag handles keep working. UI copy follows the app language (zh / en / ja / es / fr / de / ru / pt).
Selection comments and a side chat window for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: annotate model output with floating comments, and open selected text in an independent conversation.
Switches the DeepSeek Harness text font to LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷), with the web font bundled for offline use.
Low-overhead Windows host resource monitoring in the existing DSH sidebar.
给 DSH 的技能（skill）打标签，用一条布尔表达式在「工作区 / 对话」两级选出要下发给模型的技能子集
给 DSH 加一只计时看门狗：记录本轮对话从 turn/start 起已经运行多久（clock_elapsed 工具），按 /set-time 的三段式排程在本步之前注入收尾提示词，并支持运行时长卡片与设置页自定义模板。
Non-official DSH account balance and model quota dashboard, derived from dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage.
Siemens NX tools for dsh: solid modelling, drafting and PDF, STEP/IGES/STL export, assemblies, NX Nastran linear statics, plus a sidebar control panel
B站视频评论设置：读字幕/热评/关键帧 + 让本地小模型自己刷视频、判断、发评论。合并自 dsh-bili-plus 与 bili-autopilot。
Switch between Harness and DeepSeek Chat in DeepSeek Harness Desktop
真正删除 DSH 会话：归档 + 删目录 + 清记账。会话行「⋯」菜单里的危险操作，带确认与逐项结果。Real session deletion for DeepSeek Harness.
Independent DSH bundle that pairs iPhones and iPads with the official DeepSeek Harness Web GUI over the local network.
官方 Ruflo（ruvnet/ruflo）多智能体编排接入 DeepSeek Harness：全套 MCP 工具、完整 ruflo CLI、全局技能、状态页与安全扫描，一次安装、所有会话可用。
Automatic task decomposition, real department subagents, and a responsive workplan dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
Local TTS playback for DeepSeek Harness: universal HTTP/JSONL plus IndexTTS and GPT-SoVITS launchers
面板底色控制：为左侧侧边栏 / 输入框 / 对话区叠加可调不透明度的底色遮罩，普通皮肤模式与 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸模式均生效。
鲸伴 WhaleMate：跨应用陪伴、记忆和视频分享的 DSH 插件。

DeepSeek Harness plugin that serves OpenViking memory retrieval as the `openviking` Cordis service: `find()` and `profile()` return finished blocks tagged `<openviking>` / `<openviking_index>`, with a Plugins-page settings card for host, port, API key, score threshold, and hit count.
dsh 工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理 + 定时心跳（IM 渠道推送）+ 长消息折叠 | Toolbox plugin for dsh: session/trash/subdir/search/preset/config management + scheduled heartbeat (IM push) + long-message collapse

Command Code (commandcode.ai) provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Claude on Messages, every other model on Chat Completions, with live model discovery and zero-config reuse of the command-code CLI sign-in
Translates Chinese text across the DSH interface - plugin pages, settings, dropdown menus, plugin view tabs, iframe panels, and the agent's own chat text - into English.
DeepSeek spend and budget meter for DSH: real provider-reported token usage from local session logs, priced against a USD budget.
DSH task chime: play local sounds for approval/permission requests and task completion, fully configurable from the Web GUI settings. DSH 任务提示音：审批/权限请求与任务完成提示音，可在 GUI 设置中自定义声音、音量与冷却时间。
Harness 设置的「MCP 服务」页：预览每个 MCP 服务器的工具与上下文 token 占用，并逐个启用/停用，运行时热生效。

In-session question navigator for the DSH web GUI: a vertical minimap of round dots overlaid on the edge of the conversation column (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hovering focuses a magnified window and a vertical cascade of crisp question cards showing the full text and sent time of each (any card is clickable), click jumps to that message.
Standalone composer plugin that configures Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, and Shift+Enter independently (newline, queue send, or interject send) and replaces the built-in busy-Enter preference

Visualizer plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the `visualizer` tool streams a self-contained HTML document into the chat as it is written, live-previewed by a sandboxed inline frame. One package ships both halves: the model-facing tool and the Web GUI preview card.
DeepSeek Harness 桌面端维护：清理累积的 dsh-auth-* cookie、页面内一键重启、自定义窗口与右侧栏尺寸。零 asar 补丁。
DeepSeek Harness suite with Environment & Context, Humanizer and a synthetic Personal Profile left-sidebar preview.
Codex desktop style model + reasoning-effort selector for DeepSeek Harness: one trigger, one popover, a model list pane and a pixel-replica effort slider.
Content-free request and stream diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness
可拖动、可调透明度与字体的浮窗文本编辑器：读写文件、行号、空白字符可视化、调用 Notepad++。0.2.1 迁移版。
在「设置 → General」加两行字体选择（UI 字体 / 代码字体）：枚举系统已装字体、选完即时套用、持久化，并可重新枚举。0.2.1 迁移版：webServer.tapIndex/register 与 settings.general.item slot 均未变，代码原封不动。
在会话页头显示本轮上下文注入清单（live-docs / time-context / agent-instructions …），每行只写来源名，点击展开内容。补 0.2.1 UI 把 context 行折叠掉的缺口。
Palette editor for DeepSeek Harness — per-token colour overrides written as inline custom properties
为 dsh-rhine-splash 提供折叠式皮肤开关面板：开屏动画、界面主题、品牌、Logo、推理滑桿、计费、时长、退场动画等逐项控制，写入 rhine-splash 的 profile 配置（volatile，立即生效）。
多會話同屏網格（PoC）：喺一個 main 頁面入面用 n 個 pane 同時渲染 n 條獨立 session 嘅對話。

Echelon for DeepSeek Harness: name a few tiers, and each one becomes an ordered chain of real models with retries, failover, reasoning-level translation, context-window routing and vision routing. 挡位式模型路由：按命名选模型，失败自动降级。
Russian locale bundle for the DeepSeek Harness web interface

Ten Markdown-reader colour schemes for DeepSeek Harness: full-window background, Markdown typography, a dedicated Settings page, custom colours for the historical user-message bubbles, and a Windows taskbar flash when a Session finishes a turn or needs the user (tool approval / structured question) while the window is out of focus.
DSH 生命周期钩子：本地命令、正则匹配、文件指纹审阅、受限 Codex JSON 导入与工具前后反馈控制，不绕过审批
Clear glass skin for the Harness Web UI: aurora or a chosen image canvas, translucent panes, one hairline
Live CPU, CPU temperature, memory, disk and upload/download throughput inside the DeepSeek Harness composer tool row. Linux, macOS and Windows.

Personal achievements dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: a full-page profile (cumulative tokens, peak usage, longest task, longest/current streak) plus a Token activity view with a contribution heatmap. Built on the official session-projection seam.
Context Transparency Manager: the model context as a visible, editable, effectiveness-scored surface (self-contained dsh bundle plugin)
KARDS 悬浮球手柄：点击页面上的悬浮球唤醒智能体，并给它真实的鼠标、键盘与屏幕视觉去打完一局 KARDS。
Soviet-styled command console for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: two registered Soviet themes, a theme/language control strip above the composer, and a live Moscow clock.
Work discipline for coding agents: read before write, a change ledger, and detection of writes that bypassed the tools.
Review, stage and commit Git changes in non-modal floating review windows inside the DSH Web UI, with an optional AI-assisted change grouping.
Aurabot：住在 QQ 里的 AI 伙伴「大肥鱼」—— DeepSeek Harness 插件（经 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 接 QQ）
Search a local material-notes library from the composer and drop a finished card into the draft: pinned and recent shelves, one keyboard walk, and an optional rules section for the prompt.
One-click reload / restart button for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: hot-reload plugin updates in place, fall back to a full app relaunch only when a reload cannot take.
Every Session's produced files in one list: which Session wrote which path, newest first, with one-click path copy — so work can be picked up again without reorganising anything.
Named user credentials for DeepSeek Harness: model-facing credential tools, secrets behind the ctx.credentials seam, DSH_CM_* shell variables, and a Settings → Credentials page
Aqua: a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the Web surface — adjustable blur, frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, unified corners, and motion
在 DSH 左侧边栏加一个原生菜单项「DeepSeek Relay」：点它在独立浏览器窗口里打开 chat.deepseek.com（登录态持久化，窗口已存在时切回前台）；支持双向划词互传（DSH 划词一键传给网页端输入框 / 网页端划词浮现气泡一键接力回 DSH 输入框）；网页端每条 AI 回复末尾「↪ 分支到 DSH」一键把对话上下文带进 DSH 新会话。

DSH plugin: a shared thread.md rendered in the right sidebar as a tab, with per-signature colours, unread badge, reply jumps, filtering, collapsible view, and optional handoff tracking (assignee + open/claimed/done status with a pending badge). Read-only by design.
考研工作台：错题本、进度、复习调度，跑在 DSH 侧边栏里。支持多届、多科目组合。
一键创建/更新/删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式,图标可自定义切换(默认「deepseek harness桌面快捷方式」)
DeepSeek Harness plugin: incremental file mounting with read dedupe, version-aware invalidation, and a mounted-files view (host half + web client half)
🐋 DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘桌宠 — 蓝发女仆 + 鲸鱼尾动画 · 晓伊神经网络语音 · 撒娇互动 · 任务完成提醒 · 会话余额徽章（非官方同人项目）
DSH 插件：按你的口味刷 Pixiv —— 搜、筛、看图精选，存到本地或发给你。网络在直连/代理/外部源之间自动选路。
纯本地 Repo Wiki（DeepWiki 式）：agent 本地读懂仓库，生成带证据引用的分页 wiki（目录树+图表），构建单文件自包含站点，零上传零网络。
DSH 主界面查找（类浏览器 Ctrl+F）：会话页只搜消息流，其他页面搜整页，高亮并逐条跳转。
List installed DeepSeek Harness bundles with versions and update status, and jump straight to the official update page.
Fold the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.
Linus 插画品牌标记 + 手绘宠物动画：把 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏的品牌位换成自己的角色，并把输入框上沿的吉祥物换成同一角色的 18 种连续动作（19 fps，带像素粒子）。
在 DSH 中调用 RunningHub ComfyUI 工作流生成图片、视频和音频，提供工作流配置面板、后台任务和多 Key 管理。
Session-title provider for DeepSeek Harness: uses the host-provided DSH core packages, generates categorized MMDD | category | topic titles, backfills history, and provides a management panel
DSH Web plugin: replace the composer reasoning-effort (推理等级) picker with an inline slider card.
Mobile layout fixes for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: settings panel and sidebar on narrow (≤700px) screens. Pure client-side CSS overlay.
Anime maid whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI: real-time LLM dialogues, 8 mood animations, satiety reserve system, persistent speech bubble, and mobile-adapted cupboard UI.

Standalone dsh web plugin: an input-area "Prompt Enhance" button that improves the current draft with GitHub prompt-engineering templates and fills it back after confirmation, with its own on/off switch in Settings.
DSH 用量面板：供应商 API 余额 · token 用量 · 缓存命中率 · 成本折线图 · GitHub 样式热力图（成本为估算值，USD/CNY 可切换）
WorkBuddy (workbuddy.ai / codebuddy.cn) subscription quota as a DSH model provider: supervises the local OpenAI-compatible gateway and exposes it as a settings page.
DSH web plugin: a VS Code-style code editor view (file tree, Monaco, ripgrep search/replace, Markdown preview, git diff).
DSH/Cordis Web plugin: a zoomable relation graph of every loaded plugin - dependencies, resolved providers, and Loader-tree nesting - as a Settings tab next to 'Plugin list'.

webCandidates.description: Preview 3D models in the right sidebar and convert them between glTF/GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL and PLY.
General-purpose file preview renderers for the DeepSeek Harness right Sidebar
Skill self-forging for DeepSeek Harness: watch session traces, detect repeated successful tasks, and forge them into reusable skills.
DSH 插件：让 AI 替你逛 B站 并真的产生互动 —— 点赞 / 投币 / 弹幕 / 评论 / 回评论 / 回复监听，带可视化面板

DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops shell commands that would hang a turn (editors, REPLs, pagers, watch modes, dev servers, tail -f, interactive logins, git commit without -m) and tells the model the non-interactive alternative.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks file edits which replace real code with placeholder comments like '// ... existing code ...', and whole-file rewrites that silently drop most of a file.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that catches the wrong package manager for the repo (npm install in a pnpm repo, pip install in a uv/poetry project, and so on) and gives the model the exact right command.

DeepSeek Harness plugin that loads the rule files other coding agents use (Cursor .mdc rules, Copilot instructions, Windsurf, Cline, Kiro, Roo, GEMINI.md) with their glob scoping: always-on rules up front, glob rules when matching files are touched, the rest on request.

DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops hand edits to generated files (lockfiles, protobuf/codegen output, files marked @generated or DO NOT EDIT) and tells the model which source to edit and what to run instead.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that catches an agent weakening tests to make them pass: added skips, deleted assertions or test cases, trivial asserts, swallowed failures, and deleted test files.
Mount REA's reverse-engineering toolset as MCP tools in DeepSeek Harness, with a composer chip that switches it on for the sessions that need it (off after install).
Hide any dsh Web sidebar panel entry without disabling the plugin behind it. Adds a checkbox panel under the sidebar's More menu.
Color tags and unread state for DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces, with a sidebar filter bar and per-theme title colors.
API 余额：只读展示 DeepSeek API 账户余额的悬浮挂件与设置页，查询节奏与官方更新节奏一致
A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
A draggable right-side Git sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web: follow the active workspace, list changed files, generate commit messages with the current model, and commit/push/pull

DeepSeek Harness plugin: show Ollama Cloud remaining quota (session/weekly) as a Settings section beside Account & Balance, with an in-page API key editor. · DSH 插件：在设置页“账号与余额”下方显示 Ollama Cloud 剩余额度，并支持在页面内填写 API Key。

Quality-of-life enhancements for the DSH workspace sidebar: hide workspaces and their sessions, reveal them from the view options, and open any workspace folder in Finder, Explorer or your file manager. Display-only: workspace, session and archive data are never modified.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops dsh-ui table cells from painting their text over the next column, and lets long cells wrap instead of forcing a horizontal scrollbar.
Memo plugin for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar quick capture, local SQLite storage, private GitHub repo sync, and image/screenshot support.
窗口拖动：窗口一加载就在顶部自动装好一条可拖拽带（本机 macOS 拖不动窗口的解法），并从插件页提供按钮打开面板读取 computed app-region、recall 标记与窗口位移（deepseek-harness discussion #9112）。

Hide selected workspaces — and the sessions they own — from the DSH sidebar, then bring them back with a Show hidden workspaces switch in the sidebar view options. Display-only: workspace, session and archive data are never modified.

webCandidates.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin autofit: trial-install any plugin in a throwaway profile, auto-repair incompatible ones, install only what passes. Companion of DSH Plugin Radar.
DeepSeek Harness project activity terminal skin and durable metrics
Minimal macOS notifications for DeepSeek Harness: reply finished / needs your input.
桌面控制 · 插件版：Node 壳（spawn ＋ 工具注册）＋ Python 本体（只靠截图的操作层，不含 OCR/UIA/图标识别）
DSH 输入框提示词增强：把草稿改写成更清晰具体的指令
LiveBench rankings with isolated UI and live official data for DeepSeek Harness
Interactive STL/3MF viewer plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: sidebar document preview, live session drawer, CAD navigation, orthographic dimension labels, 3MF part colors.
Discord adapter for DeepSeek Harness · DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 适配器

Turn section outline for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: frameless TurnNavigator-style tick marks beside the message column that expand on hover into an interactive multi-level heading outline with 1-click jump.
冷咖啡执行核：一个插件，三档破甲强度，靠配置文件切换（lite / mid / deep）。86 条三拍技能 + 关键词路由。
AI-powered Werewolf for the DSH Web UI, with AI spectating and human participation
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。
DeepSeek Harness Vercel MCP connection with OAuth, a settings panel, and on-demand official Vercel skills
Credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: manage web logins, GitHub tokens, SSH servers and HTTP/SOCKS proxies, and let later sessions use them through agent tools.
Right-to-left reading mode for the DeepSeek Harness conversation answer area, with a one-click LTR/RTL toggle.
Hire Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) from DeepSeek Harness: seven /agy-* skills, an `agy` subagent provider, and a control panel to drive both.

Provider-aware account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, MiniMax and Alibaba Cloud Token Plan, with peak/off-peak and night-discount countdowns.

Files-tab previews for DeepSeek Harness: .blend (headless local Blender export to a cached GLB), .glb/.gltf/.obj in a WebGL viewport, plus .svg, video and audio; depends on dsh-blender with a read-only boot self-check; no network calls, no telemetry, no postinstall; uninstall removes the row.

Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current chat, and turn the model's [main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.

Sidebar session deletion and workspace pinning for DeepSeek Harness: a Delete action behind a consent dialog permanently removes a session's log, workspace accounting and live state (refusing running turns), and Pin keeps workspaces on top; no network calls or telemetry of its own, deletion only on confirmation, uninstall removes both actions.
Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.

Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.

Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
Chrome-style spell check for the dsh composer: the misspelled word under the caret gets a suggestion strip, and Tab accepts it. Local only — no network, no LLM, no telemetry.
A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).
Bring-your-own video endpoint for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-video and image-to-video with inline playback, live progress, and cancel.
语织：中文优先、用户可控的 AI 写作风格记忆层 / Chinese-first style memory for AI

DeepSeek绘画抽卡：给 DeepSeek Harness 发送按钮旁加一根 3D 拉杆，拉下去就会用模型思维链的文本信号开一局像素风「滑动变祖器」抽卡。Just for fun.

Intent fitting for DSH: the agent predicts several directions first, asks a batch of clarifying questions each round, narrows the distribution until one converges, then proposes it for your confirmation. Bottom-right floating panel, local JSONL archive, and both context injection and memory writes behind independent opt-in switches. 记忆拟合：AI 先预定若干方向（预测你的意图），每轮批量提问，轮间思考并展示方向可信度，收敛后提案待确认。右下角悬窗 + 本地留档；上下文注入与记忆写入各自独立开关，默认关闭。
View, edit and save ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md from a left sidebar panel in the DSH Web UI.
Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI. 零 token 在线状态指示器：在会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不消耗 token。
把 Cloudflare 官方 Code Mode MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness：AI 通过 search / execute 两个工具动态访问 2,500+ Cloudflare API，覆盖 Workers、DNS、R2、KV、D1、Pages 等全部产品，并附带可视化设置面板。
MT 管理器 MCP 连接（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：在 Web 设置页填写 MT 的 MCP 地址，手机文件/APK/ZIP 能力以 mcp__mt__* 工具可用
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：在「设置 - 模型」下方新增「上下文长度」页面，为指定渠道（提供方）的指定模型自定义上下文窗口长度，点击保存后才写入生效。
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 网页及桌面插件：搜索 GitHub 插件库并安装插件
DSH session migration plugin: drag-and-drop sessions between workspaces in the Web UI. Backed by the official workspaceRegistry service and a multi-frame-safe zstd header rewrite.
DSH session migration plugin: drag-and-drop sessions between workspaces in the Web UI. Backed by the official workspaceRegistry service and a multi-frame-safe zstd header rewrite.
Deep-Sea Jellyfish theme for the Deepseek Harness Web UI: bioluminescent abyss palette plus an illustration as the shell backdrop.
Supervised swarm for DeepSeek Harness: a watch officer agent, deterministic hard guards, and cross-source evidence.
Read-only audit, checkpoint, migration, and environment checks for DSH fish keepers.
Mirrors DeepSeek Harness Session status onto the browser tab: favicon badge (red broken, yellow waiting, green done, spinner running) and a title prefix.

Approval inbox: turns blocking approvals into a background queue so the agent keeps working, with per-project sections, a permanent sidebar entry, row badges, importable rule sets and peak-hour holding.
Peak-hour guard: warns before DeepSeek peak-priced hours, stops the sessions you pick when peak starts, resumes them when off-peak returns. Holiday and make-up-workday aware.
Per-conversation token usage for the dsh Web GUI: every recorded conversation with its input, cache-read, cache-write, and output token totals, parsed straight from the local session logs
Close the right-sidebar tab first: Ctrl+W prefers the active sidebar tab over the window, and double-clicking a sidebar tab closes it.
Pick the display that test windows open on: a dsh settings page chooses a monitor, and both that page and the open_test_window agent tool move the spawned window onto it
Xiaoyaoyou glyph water, exclusively on the new conversation screen.
Visualize disk usage with a treemap and reclaim macOS caches through a reviewed plan inside DeepSeek Harness.

ชุดภาษาไทยสำหรับ DSH Web (ทดสอบกับ 0.2.1-rc.2) — เพิ่มภาษา th และไทยกวนตีน th-roast (fallback th-roast → th → en) ครบ 4,601 คีย์ใน 75 namespace; คำแปลกวนมาจาก tools/roast-source ที่สร้างซ้ำได้; คาดว่าใช้ได้บน DSH Desktop ที่รัน Web UI เดียวกัน แต่ยังไม่ได้ทดสอบติดตั้งจริง
玩 · 酒馆模式完整插件：把 deepseek-harness 的酒馆模式一键打包为可分发、可安装的独立 DSH 插件。支持记忆系统、状态栏、立绘情绪、自定义变量表等功能。
A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with frosted surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, custom cursors, and click ripples.
Codex mode: a durable, profile-wide Codex step driver with progress commentary, turn continuation, and a remembered permission-menu switch
Per-row context checkbox selector + document/selection right-click Ask AI for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH 客户端主题插件：把 tweakcn.com 导出的 shadcn/ui 主题配色映射为 DSH 的 --dsw-alias-* 语义 token（默认 Violet 紫罗兰），并提供「设置 → 通用 → tweakcn 主题」开关。
DSH 客户端布局插件：仿 VS Code 的 IDE 外壳——中间标签工具区（编辑器/文档/终端/浏览器/代码变更，可多开）、右侧栏（资源管理器/搜索/源代码管理/远程/扩展/设置/Agent）、底部面板（终端/调试控制台/输出，可拉伸），真实 PowerShell 终端 + 本地代码变更对比 + Git 源码管理 + SSH/WSL 远程，全部可开关，状态持久化。
Auto-check DeepSeek Harness updates for both dsh web and the Desktop app, check third-party plugin updates, notify in the GUI, one-click update with backup/rollback and restart watchdog.
Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered-window whale girl that sits above other windows, speaks in a bubble, and comments on its own when you stay on one window.

给 DeepSeek Harness 一条会记事的蓝色大肥鱼：跨会话的持久人格与日记。每轮结束后固化模型只回答一句「你想记什么」，写下的每条日记配一句十几二十字的索引；下一场对话注入人格、手记和最近的几条，想知道更早的事它自己调 feiyu_recall，插件读索引挑出相关的那几条，正文才进上下文——索引永远不进它的视野，所以它看到的是日子，不是检索结果。遗忘是降权而不是删除。全程本地、发送前先拦掉密钥，档案是一个可读可改、能换账号带走的普通文件夹。零运行时依赖，无构建步骤。
DSH Go 答题助手：盯住考试页面，把答案弹在顶部通知里。题库可选，图形题走视觉。
Floating web-chat dock for DeepSeek Harness: open DeepSeek Chat (later ChatGPT and Claude) in a right-Sidebar Browser tab, float it, and mirror captured replies into the composer.
Bottom-right reminder cards for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: an amber persistent card when an approval waits for you, a green self-dismissing card when a task completes
Persistent balance badge and token usage panel for the dsh web GUI

LLM-as-a-Verifier for dsh with the Best-of-N conversation mode built in: rank N candidates with a fine-grained verifier (expected grade over the logprob distribution), on demand via the verify tool or automatically on every turn of a Best-of-N session. Independent implementation of arXiv:2607.05391. By Aispin

DeepSeek Harness bundle for the aiworkskills WeChat article workflow

Temporary side conversation in the right sidebar with three modes (reply only / read-only / fully inherited), rendering the same chat UI as the main conversation.
包拆拆 for DeepSeek Harness: video → script / storyboard / style guide. Uses the current session vision model; never ships its own API keys.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: gives the native right-sidebar file tree six things — an @ file reference button (@文件 / @file, @文件夹 / @folder) on every row, a modification-time and a size column, sortable rows, a whole-workspace quick search & locate (with reveal-in-tree and one-click @ from file previews), a bottom git bar (branch, ahead/behind, expandable recent commits, multi-repo switcher, per-file state dots), and full keyboard navigation with tree semantics — by taking over the builtin `files` tab kind as an extension, with a runtime toggle back to the native tree. The Host half serves directory listings with mtimeMs and the git state over its own authenticated /api routes (the Harness's workspaceFiles listing carries no time); the Client half renders the tree with labelled @ chips that insert references into the composer (Alt-click copies the mention) and a pinned date column with a full local-time tooltip.
Search message content across every DSH session and jump to the exact message that matched.
Toggleable DSH overlay showing quota windows (5h/7d/30d) for Claude, Codex, OpenCode Go and CommandCode.
One-call restart for the running DSH process, with launchd-aware supervision detection, a verifiable restart log, and a bottom-right GUI control.

WhatsApp Web-style linked-device client for DeepSeek Harness: a left-sidebar entry that mirrors a personal WhatsApp account over the multi-device protocol, with QR linking, realtime sync, file sharing and encrypted local session storage.
Batch-delete DeepSeek Harness session chat records (optionally with the files each conversation produced), and show whether a conversation is really running or only kept in host memory.
DSH 插件管理器（Plugin Manager for DeepSeek Harness）：把设置中的插件分成「自带 / 自定义」分区统一管理（浏览/导入/注册/启停/删除/自动收纳），内置插件依赖自动检测与一键修复（解决启动报错），插件自动分类标签；UI 双语国际化，跟随 DSH 语言中/英即时切换。
DSH 侧边栏「任务列表」插件：读写项目根目录 .plan/plan.json，手风琴展示计划进度
DSH 角色扮演插件（恋爱向 / 朋友向 / OC 原创向）：角色卡库、亲密关系与里程碑、养成与背包、心跳主动消息、日记与记忆、世界书、ST 角色卡（PNG/JSON）导入导出、桌宠窗口。
CommandCode Go 套餐供应商：/alpha/generate CLI 网关（官方 CLI 指纹伪装）接入 DSH 模型列表 + OAuth 登录（多账号池轮询/故障转移）+ 每账号 5 小时/周/月额度显示 + 会话右上角额度 HUD（全部账号合计 + 实测平均单次消耗推算的理论调用次数 + 会话级缓存读/写与命中率台账）+ 视觉模型多模态（图像输入）+ 工具调用双射与请求形状自愈

DeepSeek Web Dock for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: a workspace-section button that opens the free DeepSeek web chat in the native right sidebar, with half/fullscreen modes, native close animation, theme sync and one-time web sign-in.
DeepSeek API peak/off-peak billing badge for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI — bilingual 空闲/高峰 · Idle/Peak client plugin
Settings-driven MCP server manager, inventory Remote, and Web settings UI for DeepSeek Harness

DSH web plugin: provider quota/balance badges — composer chip beside the context meter plus per-row badges on the Models settings page (GLM/Kimi/OpenCode/DeepSeek/Moonshot/xAI + Sub2API gateway auto-detect)
DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for Hindsight: switch the memory plugin's LLM provider/model and browse what it remembers.
DSH 侧栏「定时任务」：自带 cron 调度内核与执行账本，可建任务、改表达式、启停、手动执行，并把脚本输出投递到 Discord。
Moss 文生图插件：在 dsh 里说一句要画什么，就出一张图；带图库、画风与相册

This makes the "AI edits Avalonia UI" loop a one-time install: it wires up the cdp-cli MCP automatically and adds build, launch, restart, reconnect, health check, a selector guide, and self-update, so after installing once, everything needed to drive and verify UI changes is ready.
SIDOR 人设卡 —— DeepSeek Harness 独立附属插件：批量导入人设卡（.persona.md / 酒馆角色卡），自由选择加载/更换人设，应用于 agent 与用户交流风格（会话内即时应用 + Agent 预设持久化）。与主皮肤 sidor-ui、工具箱 sidor-box 互相独立，官方插槽接入，可无冲突共存。
SIDOR — DeepSeek Harness 控制台皮肤：开屏动画 / 星野 / 余额徽章 / 设置页特效 / 低余额警告体系（Sidor 附属插件平台）
重启后自动继续未完成的任务：host 启动时自动修复被并发写损坏的会话日志，并找到最近未完成的会话注入“继续”消息；web UI 弹出可见提示
Conversation planning, evidence-backed memory and learned expression for DeepSeek Harness.
编辑已发送的提问并重新发送：图片一并重发，从该提问重新开始，丢弃其后的全部对话记录。
大肥鱼表情包：按情绪等概率选图，支持人物筛选、GIF、QQ 回复与主动搭话配图、分类预览和素材统计。

Resource Center for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: one sidebar entry that inventories the installed plugin bundles and the running feature modules, grouped by kind. 资源中心：一个侧边栏入口，把已安装的插件包和正在运行的功能模块按类别列清楚。
工作区浏览器增强插件，通过左侧自定义的增强工作区视图对工作区文件夹和会话实现收藏、置顶、优先级、状态显示以及提醒等功能

SourceDeck: research sources in the background, screen and compare candidates, and reference selections in your conversation draft.

dsh SSH remotes: manage remote harnesses over SSH and use the local machine as a thin client (codex-remote style). Ships a standalone dsh-ssh CLI plus a dsh profile bundle that adds an SSH Remotes panel to the local web GUI.
DSH 插件市场 / plugin marketplace: left-sidebar entry to browse, search and rank DSH plugins by usage, with an optional support area.
