webCandidates.description: DSH Style Studio (风格工坊): a built-in conversation-style window. Describe the voice you want, and it becomes a live system-prompt preference. | DSH 内置的对话风格窗口：用对话调整 DSH 的说话方式。
About section for dsh: shows the version, checks for updates, and can auto-update + restart

Common Word Box (常用词盒子) — DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: a persistent slide-up word/phrase panel next to the composer input, with global/current-project buckets and one-click insert. Works in every workspace.
冻结 DSH 聊天区的滚动位置：新回答出现时视口不再自动贴到底部，停在你最后停留的地方。
Runs compute-heavy work on remote SSH servers: one tool that starts background jobs over SSH, reads their logs, kills them, and moves files both ways.
工作进度面板：在输入框下方的带区常驻显示当前会话的任务清单完成度与运行状态，展开可见任务明细、轮次步骤、模型/工具耗时与上下文占用。
Searchable model selector for DeepSeek Harness composer — search models by name instead of scrolling.
dsh plugin: rewrite your draft into a better prompt with the LLM, and put the result back into the input box for review. Optimization directions live in an editable skill.
桌宠插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面右下角悬浮一只可拖拽、会眨眼摇尾、能陪你摸鱼的小猫。A cute floating desktop pet (cat) for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — draggable, animated, and full of personality.
Live host memory and heap-ceiling meter for DeepSeek Harness.

Unofficial community plugin that patch-builds the MIT-licensed official @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace browser bundle into a three-section DSH sidebar workspace list (Active / Session tasks / Inactive) with manual pins, an activity threshold and a one-click switch back to the shipped list. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
DSH web plugin: Cursor-like Settings pages (AGENTS.md Rules, Skills, MCP servers, import) plus a pinned 'latest input' chat bar with a backward walk
Image understanding, OCR, and persistent visual evidence for text-only DeepSeek Harness models
Hong Kong Traditional Chinese wording for DeepSeek Harness (會話 → 對話, 設置 → 設定, …)
手机 ↔ 电脑互通（SakuraFrp 隧道 + dsh-mobile 移动网关）的图形化管理插件
dsh-dream-skin 的附属插件：在「设置 → 外观」里按图片记忆调整壁纸位移（X/Y 像素微调）
dsh-whale-widget 的附属插件：任意图片自动抠图替换小鲸鱼 + 会话头部「重启 dsh」按钮 + 浏览器心跳 + 可选挂件补丁
DSH 审批弹窗 AI 注释器：在模型请求权限外操作时，用模型自己的推理生成「这段代码做什么 / 想达成什么 / 风险评估 / 两个选项各自意味着什么」，让用户带着依据做决定，而不是瞪着一行代码点按钮。

Read, search, and export NTQQ chat history (groups and private chats) as text, CSV, JSON, Markdown, HTML, or SQLite on Windows and Linux — a DeepSeek Harness bundle with model tools and a local web UI at http://127.0.0.1:46728/ (port configurable).
Agent & Skill management UI for DeepSeek Harness: list agent presets and skills from Settings.
Arkme account, records, chat and interwoven-moments integration for DeepSeek Harness
酒馆模式：角色扮演 Agent 预设 + 跟随单段对话保存的自定义 System Prompt
备份同步 —— 可视化备份/恢复 DSH 资产（技能、插件、配置、记忆、待办、对话），并支持带基线的增量导入
Deterministic DeepSeek Harness Web client plugin that explains the Windows-sandbox `spawn EPERM` failure as a distinct Conversation Node.
Review-first request-dialect preflight for custom DeepSeek Harness providers.
将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
Better workspace file manager for DeepSeek Harness: upload, multi-select, ZIP download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat, and in-place text editing for the Files tab and file previews.
Prepare a compaction of a long session while the user is idle, before the provider KV cache expires, and apply it with one click and no new model call.
Quick-select model list for the DSH model selector: choose and order models from the model menu settings icon, drag vertically to switch between them
Rewrite the composer draft into a clearer, agent-ready prompt in one click, with Revert and Retry. 一键把输入框草稿改写为更清晰、更贴 Agent 执行的提示词。
把 QQ 接到 DSH Agent 的插件（社区化维护）：经 NapCat / OneBot 11 收发消息，每个 QQ 会话一个 DSH Agent。

Codex-style "Allow for this task": turn-scoped, in-memory danger-full-access grants for DeepSeek Harness approvals. Ephemeral by design — nothing is persisted; grants die at turn/end, session/agent dispose, or restart. Client half shadows the official approval card via the conversation.composer slot — zero official-bundle changes.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: scheduled collection tasks that each file a timestamped report.
把 DSH 变成随时可用的多设备 Agent 工作台：将远程机器添加为本地 DSH 的执行节点，像操作本地内容一样使用远程的会话、文件与终端；支持多个 DSH 实例间同步数据，云服务器部署时 Web 端支持登录认证。已支持 DSH 桌面端。
在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取和继续 MonkeyAI 会话：查看完整对话历史、下发新指令，无缝接续之前在 MonkeyAI 客户端上的工作
DSH 插件：看清本机每个软件在连哪些 host——实时读取 lsof 与本地代理连接表，按软件/连接/域名/监听浏览，带秒级首次与最近时间，并注册 net_connections 工具
会话 token 用量与费用速览：每轮结束显示本轮 token/费用 chip，输入条上方显示会话累计费用。价格自动拉取（LiteLLM 价格表，host 侧缓存）+ 按模型手动覆盖 + 汇率换算。纯 UI 展示，不进入模型上下文。

A dsh web plugin: a model/provider configuration page that works over insecure HTTPS (non-loopback browsers) — providers, models, context windows, API keys, per-provider API-error retry/backoff tuning for dsh-llm-retry, and the default Agent model.
为 DSH 加一个「公网访问」面板：一键启停 Cloudflare 隧道、复制带 token 的公网链接与二维码，并内置局域网桥（Host 改写 / 剥 Origin / WebSocket 透传）。cloudflared 缺失时自动下载。
鲸聊：一只会说话的鲸鱼桌宠（dsh-pet 二次创作）。陪你聊天、有人设、会自己随机上网逛一圈再把见闻带回来告诉你。
Managed, isolated DeepSeek Harness runtimes over OpenSSH with a native Web control surface.
Task-focused coding, specialist teams, and durable task memory with directory and declarative presets for DeepSeek Harness.
Feishu/Lark surface plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one topic per session, SOUL persona sync, streaming process cards, /status and /doctor.

DSH 插件：统一管理 Skills 与 MCP —— 设置菜单与主界面左侧栏双入口，支持从 Git/URL 获取与更新 skills（可配置 Git 代理），对任意 Skill 与 MCP 服务器做热加载启用/停用，支持需要 OAuth 的 MCP 服务器，并可在面板内检查与一键更新插件自身。Unified Skills + MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness with hot-reload toggles, Git-based skill install/update, an optional Git proxy, OAuth for MCP servers and one-click self-update.
Балансы провайдеров и расходы за день для DeepSeek Harness с пересчётом в рубли по курсу ЦБ РФ и русским интерфейсом плагина. Неофициальный форк @pipilu123566/dsh-balance.

DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost pill for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): official peak/off-peak token pricing, web search/fetch per-request fees, subagent sessions included, per-model breakdown, no credentials stored.

A real browser for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI right sidebar: CDP-driven Chrome, not an iframe, with element picking into context and 7 agent tools. Unlike the Browser that ships with DSH — a sandboxed iframe that is off by default in Web profiles — this one is built for the Web UI.
Live monitor of the local Strata model server inside the DeepSeek Harness GUI: state, token rate, VRAM and last request next to the message composer.
Read, annotate and discuss files and webpages in DeepSeek Harness. Includes sidebar chat and batch annotation sending in one plugin.

Real-time DeepSeek account balance and per-session token usage for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: per-currency quota card with availability badge and refresh, plus current-session input/output/cache token breakdown, as an installable Settings section.
Annotatable file editor for the DSH right sidebar: lazy file tree, cross-file annotations, Markdown preview, and composer-draft handoff.
Persistent version badge for DeepSeek Harness: always shows the installed version in the sidebar footer; lights a red dot with an update panel when npm latest is newer.
MCP 管理界面 + tool search：可视化配置/启停/刷新 MCP 服务器与工具勾选，按需检索（tool search）热注入；工具列表稳定命中缓存、不撑爆上下文。DeepSeek Harness plugin: MCP management UI + tool search — stable tool list, cache-friendly, no context bloat.
DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：事实卡 L1 + 证据时间线 L2 + 对话流水 L3 + 区间摘要 L4，21 个 MCP 工具，每轮自动注入/入库，本地嵌入与 AES-256-GCM 字段加密。

Dual-pipeline compaction for DeepSeek Harness: official server-side Responses compaction v2 for OpenAI-routed targets, with a deterministic VCC-style local compiler (zero model calls) as the default fallback and for every other provider.

Outbound LLM request modification for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) at the fetch transport layer: injects client-identity header presets (Codex / Claude Code / opencode), strips X-Stainless fingerprints, rewrites URLs and patches Anthropic bodies inline in the request — provider-agnostic and host-allowlisted.

Rust-core retrieval and construction governance for DeepSeek Harness: forge-core sidecar (fuzzy search, read, governed edit with CAS/tickets/ledger, file ops, symbols), thin TS shell (resident 5 + govern pack). Supersedes dsh-forge (benchmarked in tools/ng-compare).

GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via the ```dsh-ui fence — layout, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model. Ships the fence-teaching host plugin, the browser renderer (client half), and the genui skill.

Aggregate and natively control DeepSeek Harness sessions across multiple remote dsh web servers from one pane: server registry, merged session list, history, prompt, cancel, rename, fork, model selection and approval/question answering.
通过 QQ 消息远程控制 DeepSeek Harness：命令执行(/exec)、任务派发(/ask)、阶段进度汇报、屏幕截图发送(/screenshot)、AI 聊天(/chat)与聊天特化会话(/chatbind)、会话标题化管理(/newsession /title /session)。OneBot 11(NapCat/Lagrange/go-cqhttp)，零 npm 依赖。
Animated thinking-effort slider for the DSH composer model seat

Graph Monitor plugin for DeepSeek Harness: define and customize GRAPH workflows, then visualize each node live as it executes — Waku-agent style topology chart with animated node/edge status, clickable node details, and a desktop trajectory-like monitor view.
Local SKILL browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness: discovers local skills with live filesystem updates and surfaces them in the web UI with a Use button that explains how to invoke each skill.
Export the current DSH Session trajectory as a Markdown file from the Session header.
DSH 官方侧边栏浏览器：结构化观察、原生输入、页面开发诊断与操作后复核。
DSH 待办清单：左侧导航、Agent 工具与可置顶的独立窗口。
Reversible conversation deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a session's log and list cache move to a 30-day trash with undo, restore and permanent purge.

每会话上下文预算：超过预算触发比例时自动剪枝并压缩最早历史，输入框右侧滑杆分级选择，档位与触发比例随配置下发。 / Per-session context budget: prunes and compacts the oldest history at a configurable trigger ratio, with a tiered composer slider whose tiers and trigger ratio follow the host config.
Local-first, file-based two-tier memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: auditable Markdown memories with verified trust, core injection and on-demand search
DSH Web UI 多語言插件：新增繁體中文/日本語/한국어/Français/Deutsch/Español 語言選項，官方介面字串逐條精譯，英文內容保持英文
macOS 版抖音 DSH 插件：Chrome 专用窗口、扫码/短信登录、人格记忆、自主观看与日报
Weixin iLink channel for DeepSeek Harness — text, media, persona modes, settings page (QR login, allowlist), companion pacing and proactive messages.
Partial compaction for DSH: condense a chosen region of the conversation into one editable checkpoint.
给 DSH 对话输入框加一个 ♂harden 按钮：一键把草稿锻造成硬邦邦、雷霆炫酷、肌肉团队味的提示词。A hard-boiled prompt rewriter for the DeepSeek Harness composer.
MCP 全局管理：扫描已知工具的 MCP 配置（28 个内置源与自定义源），一键刷新同步差异，双向导入/写回，并在 DSH 侧栏直接增删改 MCP 服务器。
Local sticker library for DeepSeek Harness: searchable captions, markdown delivery, optional QQ channel, zero dependencies.
Unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired UI theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and the official desktop client
Telegram channel for DeepSeek Harness — real Telegram markdown, and answer the agent's questions and approvals straight from chat

Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: one-click provider setup with per-model reasoning-effort control, a self-updating model catalog from the configured endpoint, and account usage in the Models page and sidebar.
DSH Web GUI 插件：给所有 Tool 调用加缩进，并在 设置→工具调用外观 里调 Tool/思考摘要的缩进、灰度与行间距
DeepSeek Harness 心智插件（dsh-mood 的精简 fork）：33 种心情各有数值，每 3~6 小时自动判定，用户消息小幅累积加减分，达到余量才切换，支持混合心情；附带加密心情日记、跨会话可检索的硬盘记忆、跨会话审美品味库、可选的主动开口。各模块可独立开关，数据可迁移到任意盘。
DSH desktop plugin: routes every subagent to the best available local model — free-first, quota-aware, capability-matched — and adds a control panel next to the session model bar.
对话内联图片/视频:LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径直接在消息正文内渲染为图片,视频以可点击播放链接呈现。支持图片URL自动修正与刷新持久化,兼容反向代理部署。
Minimal DeepSeek balance + session spend pill for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a click-to-open today ledger.
Delete a session from the sidebar context menu: moves its log directory and projection cache to the Windows Recycle Bin.
Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and read its explanation in place — meaning, purpose, usage — with the token cost of that answer shown. · 选中对话里的术语就地解释（基本含义 / 用途 / 用法），并显示本次 token 用量。
Copy dsh assistant output as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources and code fences.
把对话输入栏的主发送按钮图标替换为 DeepSeek 官方鲸鱼 logo（CSS mask 覆盖，亮暗主题自适应，不改发送行为）
在设置页检查 npm 上 @deepseek-ai/dsh 官方最新版本，并与本地安装版本对比（host: webServer API + node fetch；client: settings.section 设置页）
Kiokuko plugin for DeepSeek Harness
Git Graph tab for the DSH web right sidebar: repository detection plus a drawn commit graph
canvas-design-harness as a dual-spec package: a Codex/Claude skill under .agents/skills/ AND a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that registers it via ctx.skills.register.
Auditable memory for DeepSeek Harness: 4-state trust machine + verbatim evidence chains + recall funnel + 4-layer evals. Plain Markdown, zero servers, zero embeddings.
Millisecond System-1 judgement for every tool call in DeepSeek Harness: Jev-powered risk classification and evidence-gated auto-approval, fail-closed by construction.
Long-session performance companion for DeepSeek Harness: bounded history window, compact-page toggle with session-scoped auto-compaction, settings page, optional wire caps.
Add configurable thinking-strength (reasoning effort) levels to custom llm-pi-ai providers in DeepSeek Harness

Zenless Zone Zero Fairy skin for the DSH Web UI: H.D.D boot animation, animated eye core with a usage bubble (balance, today's spend, peak/valley pricing), time-of-day greeting line, idle blink and glitch, thinking eyelid, plus optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
Floating overlay with OpenCode Go rolling (5-hour), weekly and monthly usage.
Owned native changed-files card, review tab and delivery cards that preview changed images instead of the binary placeholder.
Owned native Tasks page and reminder catalogs that keep each catalog read until a schedule change or reconnect.
Native terminal with selection excerpts for the composer
DSH Local Monitor — a floating sensor dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: GPU-Z sensors (temperature, clock, dedicated VRAM) on the left, CPU temperature/clock and system memory on the right.
Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI — registers the `ru` language (73 namespaces, 3477 strings)
DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。零依赖，装上即用。

Show the USTC campus LLM gateway's remaining quota (3h/12h/24h rolling budgets, RPM/concurrency/TPM limits) inside DSH: a settings page plus a host service that reads the LiteLLM-compatible /key/info and /user/info endpoints.

猫娘日记 + 好感度：每天把当天全部对话写成四栏日记，次日自动注入速读卡；好感度子插件每轮自动判定，侧边栏可视化。Catgirl diary + affinity score for DeepSeek Harness: a four-section daily journal with auto-injected brief, plus a per-turn affinity sub-plugin with a sidebar panel.
Power actions for the DSH Web UI: a header button that restarts or quits DSH, each behind its own confirmation dialog.
Hide unused panels from the left sidebar of DeepSeek Harness, grouped by origin. The rail's More button expands every panel and folds them back.

AGENTS & Skills Studio — edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs in DSH.
Drain-aware supervised restart, Web status countdown, and same-session continuation for DeepSeek Harness.

Literature search for DeepSeek Harness over the official PubMed NCBI E-utilities API (esearch/esummary/efetch/elink) and Google Scholar (SerpApi engine, or direct HTML parsing because Google publishes no Scholar API). Zero runtime dependencies.

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: OpenCode GO plan quota widget in the sidebar, dsh-opencode-go current-account quota source with built-in-provider fallback, a Plugins-panel settings page, a same-origin usage proxy, and a /opencode-go chat command (DSH 0.1.7+ and 0.2.0 compatible)
macOS floating card for DeepSeek Harness: answer questions, approve tool calls and jump back to DSH from an always-on-top window.
Voice practice mode for the DSH web app: bilingual (中文 / English) conversation output plus read-aloud (TTS) and speech input (STT). Adds a 语音交流 dialog-mode toggle to the composer.
Deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness
while — a global DSH assistant with chat, goals, ideas and Session coordination.

Push notifications for DeepSeek Harness: reply summaries, approval requests, and user questions via Bark plus Gotify, ntfy, PushDeer, Server酱, PushPlus, extra Bark servers, and generic webhooks, with per-workspace and per-session mute.
Native Agent preset editor for DeepSeek Harness: edit/add built-in presets from a sidebar page, compose personas and plugin rows, layer per-preset tool filters, with automatic backups and rollback.

Custom background image for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with adjustable opacity and blur.
Sidebar message-history preview for DeepSeek Harness web UI: lists the current session's sent messages with previews; click to jump the chat to that message.
Agent Switch: Codex delegation cards and docked CLI output for DeepSeek Harness
Virtual-desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness: the agent sees a live snapshot in the right sidebar and its mouse acts on a virtual pointer overlay, so your real desktop and cursor stay yours.
Find, restore and delete archived DSH conversations. · 集中查找、恢复和删除已归档的 DSH 对话。
Give DSH agents on-demand tools to find and read conversations, manage workspaces, move sessions and inspect PR checks. · 让 DSH Agent 按需查找和读取对话、管理工作区、移动会话并查询 PR 检查结果。
Open local file paths from DSH conversations and rename recent chats with a double click. · 从 DSH 对话打开本地文件路径，并通过双击重命名最近对话。
Hide the new-chat button at the top of the DSH sidebar for a simpler navigation area. · 隐藏 DSH 侧栏顶部的新会话按钮，精简导航区域。
Show conversation activity beside collapsed DSH project headings. · 在折叠的 DSH 项目标题旁显示对话运行状态。
Start DSH conversations outside a workspace and configure their default working directory. · 新建不绑定工作区的 DSH 对话，并配置默认工作目录。
Remember the last DSH reasoning-effort setting for each provider and model. · 按提供商和模型记住 DSH 上次使用的思考强度。
Quote selected text, add annotations and browse a quote list in DSH, with optional side-chat integration. · 在 DSH 中选中文字添加引用和批注，汇总引用清单，并联动侧边对话。
Open independent DSH side conversations with inherited context, optional history hiding and conversion to standalone chats. · 在 DSH 右侧开启继承主对话上下文的独立侧边对话，支持隐藏历史显示与转为独立会话。

Codex-inspired plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): quotes, side chats, Git worktrees and code review. 18 independently switchable features. · 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）补齐 Codex 风格体验：选中引用、侧边对话、工作树环境与代码审查，18 项功能独立启停。
DSH web plugin: schema-driven advanced model settings page (settings.section 'model-advanced').
DSH web plugin: VSCode-style Ctrl+P quick open — search workspace files with a fuzzy matcher, open them in the native right Sidebar, or drop a file reference into the conversation draft.
DSH 语音插件：每条助手回复的操作条里加一个朗读按钮，用 DeepSeek 官方 TTS 念出来（默认女声 stella / 男声 tide）。A DSH plugin that reads assistant replies aloud with DeepSeek's official TTS.

长思考进度旁白插件：模型长时间只思考不出声时，注入一段提示词让它自己用正文说清进展（不结束当前任务），并把这段原文显示在对话区左下角浮窗；附带以分钟为单位的图形设置卡。(Progress narrator for DeepSeek Harness: inject a reminder so the model narrates its own progress when silent too long, without ending the turn; mirrors that text in a lower-left overlay; ships a minutes-based settings card.)

Git commit graph chip plus a better-sidebar repository tab (SVG lane canvas, zoom, pinned commit card) that discovers the Git repositories up to three levels below the workspace directory and bootstraps a Git conventions document for each one and checks commit compliance against it; a conventions document is inherited by the repositories nested in it, conflicting and duplicated documents are reported to the agent, which reads them in full with its own file tools and writes the merged document itself, following the backup and inheritance-pointer rules the injected prompt carries - the plugin ships no merger. Users can also save, edit and delete their own convention templates from a settings page opened by the tab toolbar's gear; those templates live under the DSH home as one JSON store and appear after the seven built-in frameworks in the picker, while the built-ins stay read-only. The tab also lists linked worktrees as a read-only projection: it offers jumps and a status hand-off but never creates or removes one, so the single model-facing surface is a `git_worktree` fallback tool that creates, lists and removes managed worktrees and registers a new one as a workspace, and initializes a repository by writing the conventions document for it and installing a strict document's commit-msg hook so a bare `git commit` is checked too. Prose documents that state commit rules (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, CONTRIBUTING.md) next to the workspace or the repository are read with the same rule reader, so rules living outside the conventions document still reach the conflict report; those files are never rewritten. The same tab can also open as an opt-in, closable page in the conversation's main area, beside the shipped views.

邻座 NextSeat：同一 Wi-Fi 下的临时分享房间（文件 / 提示词卡片 / 技能包），带就近自动发现。
Turkish (tr) language pack for DeepSeek Harness web UI
DSH plugin: shows the DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the composer bottom bar.
DSH plugin: restyles the conversation scrollbar to match the Visual Studio Code editor and adds a VS Code-style minimap preview column with a hover slider.
A skill gallery panel under Automation in the DSH sidebar: fixed-workflow project skills as cards, one click to call them in a new session.
Retrace · 回溯 — Recall, edit-and-resend, regenerate, and conversation/artifact versioning (timeline, rollback, fork graph) for DeepSeek Harness — Web and Desktop
DeepSeek Harness 插件：写作档位（T1–T4 风格 × L1–L5 严谨）、项目记忆（.mem 三区 + 守卫）、去 AI 味后处理（whale_polish）——双半体（host 工具/注入 + 浏览器快捷条/工具卡）。

dsh-3301 — LAN gate for a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: keeps DSH loopback-only, exposes a password-protected entry (HTTP + WebSocket) with a settings card, and stores the password only as a scrypt verifier. Ships as a DSH plugin and as a standalone CLI.
DSH 插件管理系统（host + client profile 插件）：插件清单、更新检测、升级/回滚、备份、跨 agent 迁移。一期功能 1-5 交付（v0.1.0）。

Record & Replay for the dsh web GUI: (1) replay every automatically recorded session as a readable timeline, export/import shareable replay packs, re-run a recorded conversation; (2) Codex-style screen recording -> skill generation - record a computer-use session in the browser (getDisplayMedia -> webm + sampled frames), replay it, and have an agent analyze the frames and install a generated SKILL.md into ~/.dsh/skills. Hot-pluggable - mounted via the profile patch layer, no dsh source changes.
DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
Minimal DeepSeek balance & usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness（极简的 DeepSeek 余额/用量面板）
四川大学校园服务：在 DeepSeek Harness 中登录并只读查询成绩、课表和电费。
SSH tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persisted SSH connections, workspace-bound defaults, and the ssh_exec model tool
DSH 全局中文模式：输入框「中文」按钮展开语言面板，回复、思考、工具说明三项语言独立开关，配置随 profile 持久化。

Blue Archive style click effect and cursor trail (ba-click-fx v1.3.1) as a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin. Adds the game-style click/touch effect and mouse trail to the DSH web GUI, configured from its own page in the DSH Settings dialog.
Blue Archive (蔚蓝档案) click effect and cursor trail for DeepSeek Harness — vertical sidebar entry opening a settings dialog. Powered by ba-click-fx.
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 动态壁纸插件：把本地视频/图片变成全屏动态壁纸，支持效果调节、壁纸切换与 Wallpaper Engine 工坊导入，设置自动保存永久生效。

Runtime network switch for DeepSeek Harness: flip Harness's own outbound traffic between a local Clash Verge proxy and direct/LAN without restarting, from a status chip in the session header, the network_mode agent tool and the /net command.
Minimalist window transparency for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar button and a slider set the whole window's opacity (0-90%). Nothing else changes.

DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a local llama.cpp (llama-server) into a first-class model provider: process & router management, model catalog sync with mmproj vision pairing, auto-start on demand, stop-then-load model switching, and a sidebar terminal-output monitor panel.
Sidebar-footer balance and usage widget for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's tokens and estimated spend, a per-conversation breakdown, and the current peak/idle pricing window.

Clean orphaned DSH workspace snapshots from the system temp folder. Scans dsh-workspace-changes-* directories, applies five safety checks, writes a deletion manifest, and requires a dry run plus explicit confirmation before deleting anything.
Delete a conversation from the DSH sidebar: removes the durable session log, detaches it from the workspace registry, and drops the row from every connected client.

Permanently delete a DSH session from the sidebar session row menu (danger-styled), or delete every session of a workspace from the workspace row '...' menu, with a confirm modal and a seven-stage, independently-degrading deletion pipeline (validate → running guard → workspace ledger → archive set → on-disk logs → in-memory drop → broadcast).
思源笔记直送：把 DSH 对话中生成的 Markdown 文档直接送进自建的思源笔记（SiYuan）。交付文件卡片上的「思源」按钮、侧边栏文档工具栏按钮，以及一个同能力的 Agent 工具。

Ark Plan API plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-configures Volcengine Ark Agent Plan / Coding Plan / 后付费 providers on the native pi-ai adapter so they appear in the model picker. Default wire protocol is the Anthropic Messages API; the user only supplies an API key.
Everything-backed @file completion for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: instant path search through es.exe, with the agent workspace as the ranking root
Ultra mode for DeepSeek Harness: a per-session effort tier that pins reasoning to max and activates an orchestration policy section, with a composer ULTRA chip and rainbow border in the web UI
DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for LiteLLM models, MCP servers, skills, and spend.
DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for TeamAI skills, MCP, and prompts.
A DeepSeek Harness Plugin for Previewing Mermaid Diagram by Images in Chat Sessions. View on GitHub (https://github.com/baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview).
Edit the user-global AGENTS.md ($DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md) from the web settings panel.
Leafy — an eye-friendly green skin that folds the DSH Web GUI's --dsw-* palette into leafy greens (light + dark).
OpenCode Go usage stats for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: compact bottom-left sidebar button with a hover detail card

DeepSeek Harness plugin: render GeoJSON/vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map and let agents operate the live map (layers, styles, view, GeoLibre algorithms and Whitebox WASM tools) through agent tools.
DSH Web 插件：会话标题栏悬浮显示多个 AI 平台的账户余额与用量（余额 / 用量双 tab）
Hover the blame gutter in a right-sidebar file preview to see each line's git blame.
文件操作功能扩展：为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏文件条目补全 Trae 风格操作（在文件管理器中显示、添加到对话、另存为、复制路径、重命名、回收站删除），并与电脑其他位置双向复制粘贴文件和文件夹
Codex 风格的推理等级滑条：把 DSH 输入框工具行的推理等级档位换成一条可拖动的连续滑条 / A Codex-style reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness
Generate images from a text prompt through an OpenAI-compatible relay and attach them to the conversation.

Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control for DeepSeek Harness: writes the proxy into the user-level .env so the launcher and the first requests are proxied, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.
洛天依桌宠：住在 DSH 里的虚拟歌姬，可拖动、可互动；台词支持预设/AI 两种模式，内置 token 用量与费用统计栏，支持换图 + AI 自动抠图（快/标准/精细三档）与预览微调。
Screenshot the desktop with a hotkey, recognise its text, and drop it into the DeepSeek Harness message box.

Free WorkBuddy (wb-asr) cloud speech recognition for dsh: a hold-to-talk composer microphone that types into the input box as you speak, and wb_transcribe for batch transcription of long audio and video (free: WorkBuddy does not bill speech input)
Highlights the sessions that want your attention, and promotes their workspaces to the top of the dsh Web GUI sidebar.
在右侧边栏的 HTML 预览里直接圈选元素、写批注，再把整批批注一次性发进会话，让模型按批注修改页面。
录屏时聚焦当前会话，以不可交互的占位条遮蔽其他会话。
DSH web-ui plugin: '/' glyph on the composer command-menu button plus a '+' attach button with separated image/document/other uploads.

Six-tier web search provider for the ctx.web seam: free local scraping with a billing-guarded official fallback (allowOfficial, default off), a tier-capable web_search_deep tool a preset cannot shadow, and a settings card.

OCR via OpenAI/Anthropic vision APIs for dsh: ocr_recognize tool (percent coords + two-diagonal-point boxes, auto region re-read on low confidence), a collapsible settings card in Settings → Plugins (API format / URL / Key / Model, fetch model list, test connection). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Custom wallpaper engine for the dsh web GUI: upload an image (client-side WebP/JPEG compression), frosted-glass blur, pane opacity, and auto font-color linkage.
本地插件开发管理面板：主动登记通过 file:/link: 安装的真实路径项目，并通过带风险确认的工作区会话协助开发与发布。
更好的右键：为 DeepSeek Harness 应用封装端提供原生风格的完整上下文菜单。
Customizable, hierarchical settings navigation for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness Web 顶部按钮管理器：检查并开关插件添加的顶部工具栏按钮。
A2UI interactive cards for the dsh web UI: the agent renders clickable interfaces (quizzes, forms, product cards) via @ant-design/x-card, and user interactions flow back to the agent as answers.
Show the model your mind: mark up an answer like in Word (highlight / underline / strike / comment / rewrite / source / move) and your markup reaches DeepSeek Harness as context on the next turn.
Shows each Session's own agent-preset mode beside the session row in the left sidebar.
Evidence-backed engineering Mission governance for DeepSeek Harness
Evidence-backed application-security assurance for DeepSeek Harness
哌甲酯（dsh-pipem）：DSH 插件。把犯过的错记成可检索的 guard，动手前查、报完成前绑证据；工具失败时自动提醒；长上下文下检测复读；内置 bash 工具与一颗心（宪章 + 心事本）。可替代 dsh-ops、dsh-scar、dsh-heart、dsh-gitbash-shell。

Lightweight Codex-shaped coding tools for DeepSeek Harness: exec_command/write_stdin, apply_patch, view_image, OpenAI model routes, DSH-native collaboration tools, and a Codex-shaped 创造模式 (cordis) preset.
为 opencode go 设计的 API 池:根据余额热管理切换不同 API key,官方用量/余额查询 + 设置页图形化管理。
工程级会话鲁棒：官方有限次 API 重试耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流等瞬时失败继续重试直到成功或取消，会话不因瞬时 API 故障中断。

DSH web plugin: two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second archives; archive is no longer buried in the ⋮ menu. · 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档不再藏在 ⋮ 菜单里。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: fork a workspace row into a git worktree, or delete the workspace folder
DSH-native settings panel for the DSH-DREAM Python package.

Command history for the DeepSeek Harness GUI composer: press Up/Down to cycle through your previously sent instructions, and reach the oldest draft again at the end of the history. Works in both the official desktop app and the web profile. 在 DSH 输入框中用上下方向键浏览此前发送的指令，回到历史末尾时恢复切换前的草稿；官方桌面端与 Web profile 均可用。

Detects DSH plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed/pending plugins, duplicate config row ids) at startup, auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI. DSH 启动时检测插件冲突，自动停用/恢复冲突插件，并在 Web 界面弹出冲突报告。

Customizable brand area for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: replace the whale logo and the DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text — double-click to change, right-click to reset. 自定义 DSH 左上角品牌区：logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑。

Galgame generator for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): give it a script document plus character/background/BGM/animation assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/, img_cg/, optional img_ui/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with a customizable title screen, configurable save slots, speaker-following multi-pose sprites, [表情]/[位置]/[退场] stage control, opening/ending/CG animations, BGM control and if-line branching. DSH Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档 + 立绘/背景/音乐/动画素材（img_human/、img_bg/、audio/、img_cg/，可选开始界面素材 img_ui/）即可生成可玩视觉小说（可自定义开始界面、可配置存档、多表情立绘、站位/退场控制、动画、BGM、if 条件线）。

Multi-channel message bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): route WeChat (ClawBot/iLink), QQ, and Feishu (Lark) chat messages to a DSH agent and relay its replies back. 多通道桥接：微信 ClawBot / QQ / 飞书消息接入 DSH agent 并回传回复。

Drag sessions to another workspace in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI: grab a session row in the sidebar and drop it onto another workspace header to move it (clone with full history + archive the original). DSH 侧边栏会话直拖：把会话行拖到其他工作区标题行即可移动（完整历史克隆 + 原会话归档）。

Speech-to-text voice input for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI: click the mic button in the composer to turn speech into text in the input box. Supports the browser's built-in Web Speech API (zero-config, Chrome/Edge) and OpenAI-compatible Whisper endpoints (OpenAI / Groq) with the STT model selectable in Settings → 语音输入. DSH 语音输入插件：点击输入框旁的麦克风按钮，把语音转成文字填入输入框；支持浏览器本地识别与 OpenAI 兼容 Whisper API，模型可在设置中选择。
DSH Web 会话增强插件：全局折叠 AI 思考链/工具链、一键导出 Markdown、AI 头像与手动折叠（思考链+工具链三态折叠）、设置弹窗。
DSH Web 中继插件：右侧内置浏览器（relay 反向代理同源嵌入外部 AI 站点）+ 输入框闪电按钮（提示词优化 / 与外部 AI 协作优化：压缩上下文→初优化→外发→收回回复→终优化→写入输入框）。
MCP 服务器与 SKILL 的统一管理页：查看、安装、启停、删除 MCP，浏览技能并用本地模型翻译摘要。
在 DSH 里安装并运行静态 Web 应用：左侧「应用」入口、内置套件（创作/工具/复古游戏）、上传 zip、主区内嵌。
Expose DeepSeek Harness sessions, agents, and tools to any other agent harness over the Model Context Protocol.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin: the assistant answers with native UI cards — metrics, tables, charts, timelines and clickable next steps — instead of Markdown.
Web group chat for local and woven DeepSeek Harness sessions.
ChatGPT-powered coding, image generation and web search for DeepSeek Harness, with account and usage settings.
Secure LAN, Tailnet, and remote connectivity for DeepSeek Harness.
Persistent, auditable uni-browser profiles for DeepSeek Harness.
A private, peer-to-peer weave protocol for connecting DeepSeek Harness nodes across machines.
给小朋友的编程学习启蒙插件：一个包 = 一张 🐵「小教室·跑代码」卡片（真跑 Python/海龟画图）+ 五个模型工具（kid_run / kid_explain / kid_practice / kid_review / kid_steps），零第三方依赖、无构建步骤。
给小朋友的内存启蒙插件：一个包 = 一张 🦉「记忆小管家·电脑的工作台」卡片 + 四个模型工具（mem_now / mem_pressure / mem_workbench / mem_top），零第三方依赖、无构建步骤。
给小朋友的网络启蒙插件：一个包 = 一张 🕊️「信鸽邮局」卡片 + 五个模型工具（net_my_identity / net_trace_trip / net_test_speed / net_who_is_home / net_dns），零第三方依赖、无构建步骤。
给小朋友的进程启蒙插件：一个包 = 一张 🐝 工人点名卡片 + 四个模型工具（proc_count / proc_busiest / proc_family / proc_badge），零第三方依赖、无构建步骤。
给小朋友的「电脑安全 / 城堡守卫」启蒙插件：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录五个模型工具，外加一张常驻输入条上方的 🐕 卡片（DeepSeek Harness / Cordis bundle）。
给小朋友的「存储 / 大仓库」启蒙插件：分区全景 + 主目录占用榜 + 大件行李榜三个模型工具，外加一张常驻输入条上方的 🐿️ 卡片（DeepSeek Harness / Cordis）。
给小朋友的「电脑体检 / 资源监控」启蒙插件：一个包 = 一张 🐻「小熊体检」卡片 + 一个 system_status 工具，查 CPU/内存/磁盘/网络/电池/负载/Top 进程的真实数据（免 sudo，零第三方依赖，无构建）。
任务遗漏审核：提交前扫描当前工作空间未提交改动 + 读设计文档，派 DSH 默认模型做「设计文档承诺 vs 实际实现」的差集比对，输出遗漏清单，并提供独立可视化视图（独立插件，装在 ~/.dsh，升级核心不覆盖）
A clarity button in the composer: restates what you meant, asks two or three questions with clickable options, then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. It never sends for you.
MEB construction-cost workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness
A DSH multi-platform connector plugin, starting with WeChat Claw/iLink and expanding to QQ and WeCom.
Lightweight, independently installable Godot preview plugin for DeepSeek Harness

In-page terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness: real PTY terminals in the sidebar — PowerShell 7 / Windows PowerShell / cmd / Git Bash, starting in your home directory — plus a settings panel and nine switchable terminal_* tools for the agent. DSH 网页内的终端面板插件。

DSH Settings plugin that imports local ZCode conversations as native DeepSeek Harness sessions — browse ZCode workspaces, pick chats, import a subset or a whole workspace. DSH 会话导入插件：把本地 ZCode 的会话导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持按工作区浏览、勾选导入。
Lightweight DSH upload bridge: images and common documents become workspace paths so a text-only DeepSeek model can read them with Qwen-MM-Plugins vision tools.
HTTP proxy preference in General Settings: direct, follow the Windows/macOS system proxy, or a custom proxy URL, applied to Harness egress immediately without restarting.
Long-term failure memory for DeepSeek Harness: captures tool failures, folds them into reusable lessons with session/daily/weekly summaries, and injects a briefing into later sessions.
Doro-themed hot-pluggable skin for the dsh web GUI: pink-and-orange accent theme with orange-motif placeholder art. Personal-use fan theme — swap in your own Doro artwork via src/client/art.ts.

webCandidates.description: DSH Web 主题工坊：自定义背景色与透明度、背景图、字体颜色、输入框颜色、边栏颜色，实时生效并保存在本地
桌面通知外部插件：任务完成 / 需要用户操作 / 任务异常终止时，通过 notify-send 发送桌面原生通知（经独立 TS 脚本，不显示浏览器来源地址）。
侧边栏模式外部插件：紧凑模式 + 右侧边栏 + 收起窄条（对话/Trajectory 竖排），三态持久化，收起/展开动画右锚定无漂移。
DSH 字体设置插件：自由更换界面字体和字号，使用系统已安装字体，无需联网加载
DSH plugin: permanently delete cold sessions from a Settings page (设置 -> 会话管理).
TTS 语音播放插件:为 DSH 聊天界面添加语音朗读功能,支持配置本地 TTS 服务,每条助手消息可朗读,AI 可调用 tts-speak 工具发送语音。
带薪拉屎：悬浮按钮记录每次时长，按月薪与工作制算出本次获利，含每日/每月统计与提醒。Paid poop timer: floating button, per-break earnings from your salary and work schedule, daily/monthly stats and reminders.
macOS share receiver for DeepSeek Harness: files, images, text and links shared from Finder or any app land in the current session draft. Requires the DSHShare.app share target.
LiteLLM provider for DeepSeek Harness
禁止渲染删除线：GFM 的单波浪号删除线会把 3~5 这样的区间号吞掉并划一横，本插件在 GUI 与会话文档预览里取消删除线并还原 ~ 字符。
发送键与停止键分离，并带一道注入闸门：锁定期间后台任务、子代理汇报、定时提醒全被扣住，直到你发消息时一起送进模型。
原生子代理总开关：关掉后关于子代理的提示词整块消失、插件页里的「子智能体」卡片也不再显示。
Keeps the workspace picker dropdown at four visible rows and scrolls the rest.
Russian language pack for DeepSeek Harness: the whole web interface plus the desktop shell (menu, tray, dialogs, sign-in window)
dsDragPasteALL：拖拽任意文件/粘贴非图片文件到 DSH 页面（纯图片粘贴交给原生成图），后台静默反查文件真实路径（Spotlight + find + 首尾哈希校验），命中后把路径直接插入对话框输入框；找不到原文件则内容缓存兜底。
Connect BambooRoute to the DeepSeek Harness model picker

DSH plugin: password gate for remote (non-loopback) /api access (passwordless by default), unblock the loopback-pinned privileged endpoints, restore everything on uninstall, and give the local 127.0.0.1 user the native OS folder picker for workspace selection. Zero residue by design. TypeScript source, compiled output.
DSH plugin: auto-detect and configure model capabilities (reasoningEfforts + capacities) for llm-pi-ai. Vision (input) is managed by the official UI. Successor to dsh-reasoning-efforts.
GitHub integration for DSH: official device-flow sign-in, repository creation, cloning, pull, commit and push. Security first.

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web UI plugin: adds collapsible per-provider group headers to the model selector. Collapsed state is remembered per provider in localStorage; newly imported providers start expanded. Re-implements the official ModelSelect view while reusing the official model directory data layer. Archive manager for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: browse archived Session logs and delete them permanently, without patching the harness core (桌面端归档管理器：浏览并永久删除已归档的会话，无需修改 harness 核心).

DSH 侧边栏文件活动插件：按 LRU 记录文件读取/新增/修改事件（最近访问），按绝对路径树形统计（文件统计），点击文件浮窗预览（代码高亮/Markdown/图片/PDF）。DSH web plugin: file activity tracker — LRU recent-access list plus per-file read/create/modify counts in a folder tree, with floating preview.

DSH 对话渲染插件（合并原 dsh-think-zh-expand + dsh-mermaid-render）：对话里的围栏块**全部由插件自己的渲染器产出**（不再调用官方 MarkdownText / CodeBlock）—— text 家族与「确证无语言且内容确实是 markdown 文档」的块按 markdown 渲染，其余（含无语言但内容是代码 / 日志的块、识别失败）渲染为「真实语言名 banner + 复制 + 自动换行 + highlight.js 高亮」的代码块（语言位留空不编造），mermaid/mmd 渲染为图表卡片；另有上下文注入块渲染、整段复制、统一 MarkdownView 导出、非标准表格容错、思考块默认展开（DOM 派发官方点击，外观零改动）。解析层 marked 与高亮层 highlight.js 走 assets 懒加载，不进 client bundle。DSH web plugin: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin's own renderer (marked + highlight.js loaded lazily from assets), never by the host MarkdownText / CodeBlock; untagged fences are routed by content (markdown doc vs code) and get an inferred language (content heuristics, then the project main language from build marker files) shown with an inferred badge, mermaid fences become diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy, a MarkdownView export, table tolerance and default-expanded thinking rows.

DSH 上下文透镜 + 成本治理插件：token 用量可视化（每次请求的上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率）+ 每轮/每会话预算控制（超限提醒/拦截）。DSH web plugin: context lens (token usage visualization, KV cache hit rate) + cost governance (per-turn / per-session budget with warn/deny).
DSH 插件治理守护：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动后热挂载——成功转正、失败自动禁用、连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板。DSH web plugin: staged plugin loading with auto-disable on failure, freeze, safe mode and a sidebar panel.
DSH 记忆插件：全局/项目两级记忆持久化，会话开始时注入系统提示词，设置页可视化面板（新增/修改/删除需用户确认），memory_query 只读查询工具。DSH web plugin: global/project memory with system-prompt injection, settings panel and a read-only query tool.
DSH 通知提醒插件：会话结束/agent 询问/等待审批时弹浏览器通知+提示音，点击跳转会话，支持远程 webhook 触发。DSH web plugin: browser notification + beep on session end / ask / approval, click-to-focus, remote trigger hook.

DSH 可观测性 + Git 工程工具插件：事件审计（agent 行为记录，跨会话持久化 + 查询 API）、资源看门狗面板、结构化 Git 提交（Conventional Commits）、增量 diff 审查（提交前审查）。DSH web plugin: persistent event audit log with query API, resource watchdog panel, structured git commits, pre-commit incremental diff review.

DSH 远程控制插件：ask/approval/end 事件下发到外部通道（手机/IM webhook），远程回答 ask、批准 approval、查询状态、继续会话；适配器接口可扩展微信/QQ/飞书机器人。DSH web plugin: push ask/approval/end events to external channels, remote answer + approve with token auth and audited commands.

DSH skill 管理：全量 skill 列表 + 全局/项目双作用域启停 + 搜索筛选排序 + 详情与 SKILL.md 预览 + 批量启停 + 扫描诊断。禁用即不注入会话。DSH web plugin: full skill catalog with global/project scoped toggles, search/filter/sort, detail preview, batch actions and scan diagnostics.

DSH 任务可靠性保障插件：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、思考重复干预、休眠重启后任务恢复、锁屏/休眠唤醒自动恢复、ask 超时自动继续、自主决策模式、远程触发、/task 斜杠命令。DSH web plugin: auto-retry, auto-continue, verification agent, repeat detection, resume after restart, stall watchdog, ask timeout, autopilot, remote trigger, /task command.

Learns your coding taste from explicit instructions and corrections, stores it as confidence-scored rules in editable markdown, and injects them into every session.

Plane-powered project management for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Prompt-polish button beside the composer model seat for DSH, porting linshenkx/prompt-optimizer's optimizationMode axis, mustache template engine, template registry and variable extraction.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 WebDAV / 本地挂载把会话、附件、Skills、Profile 加密同步到 NAS，支持分块断点续传、冲突管理与设置页面板
浮窗工作区目录树插件：拖拽路径、懒加载、搜索。Floating workspace directory-tree with drag-drop paths.
24私助（24PA）: Feishu-backed personal assistant as a dsh workspace bundle.
DeepSeek Harness plugin for organizing AI discussions into research topics, traceable knowledge cards, and reusable research materials on an interactive graph
DeepSeek Harness plugin for organizing AI discussions into research topics, traceable knowledge cards, and reusable research materials on an interactive graph
在 DSH 对话框模型选择框左侧显示当前 DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4 Flash 的 codexradar IQ，每 5 分钟刷新

昔涟（Cyrene）主题：粉白渐变毛玻璃 UI + 侧边栏可编辑的人格设定 + 表情包 / 背景图 / 长期记忆 / 世界书管理 | A Cyrene (Honkai: Star Rail) theme for DeepSeek Harness
把本机外部 CLI（Codex、Pi、Qoder、OpenCode、CodeBuddy 等）注册成 dsh 子代理，带运行面板、内置子代理观测与后端管理；dsh-subagent 的社区增强分支。
DSH 工具/思考音效：agent 思考氛围音 + 全工具分类音效 + 音效文件夹直替（wav/mp3 自动转换）
在 DSH 里统一查看、检查并同步更新已安装的技能（skills）与插件（plugins/bundles）。

Codex-style message-bar navigation rail for the DSH dialog: a vertical rail of short horizontal lines (one per user message) at the sidebar's right outer edge, vertically centered; hover highlights and floats the sent content (first 30 字, 15 字 per line); click jumps to the message.

Project mode for the DSH web GUI: sidebar entry, full-screen project manager, live per-project context injection (instructions + refreshable memory + auto project briefing distilled from recent sessions), workspace auto-assign by cwd, token meters, new-session-in-project with instant assignment, session badge.
Collect WeChat Official Account articles in DSH and hand source cards to ContentStudio.
昔涟桌面桌宠（DeepSeek Harness 版）：Live2D 立绘、透明置顶窗口、拖拽贴边、点击穿透、气泡台词、DeepSeek 余额、系统状态面板、右键菜单，并接管对话提问 / 风险审批 / 任务进程；也可以切成无立绘的卡片模式

Hierarchical session tree for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: native subagent trees plus an optional HR/organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters, orphan/cycle defense, and search-to-expand.
在 DSH 网页端按供应商和密钥配置选择模型，并为同一供应商的不同密钥分别设置模型和 API 协议。支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。
把 magpie 原版 Web UI 嵌进 DSH 侧边栏；缺 magpie 时自动下载，缺网关时自动启动
「DSH·缓存账单」：上下文圆环弹层里实时算账——当前步/当前轮/会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，峰谷自动计价，第三方中转照常记账，专治『缓存命中率 100% 却越用越贵』
「DSH·古法编程」：在 DSH Web UI 右侧栏用 Monaco 编辑器打开工作区代码文件
「DSH·质量 diff」：接管 edit/write 及 extraTools 配置的其他工具卡片：行级去重与行内高亮，消除相同内容在删除与新增两区的重复；兼容 PTC 模式，标准可安装的 dsh 客户端插件
「DSH·实时 Token 统计·溺水检测」：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表，在 composer 下方实时渲染 token 状态带，显示流式 TPS、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比上次 step 的估算与实际偏差；纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码
「DSH·手机适配」：窄屏下把侧栏收起为可拖动的悬浮小方块，点会话自动收起，压掉切会话时的自动聚焦，并在输入框补一排手机键盘上没有的按键。
「DSH·通知叮咚」：在 DSH 等待回复或一轮对话跑完时弹出系统通知。标准可安装的 dsh 客户端插件。
「DSH·暂停」：agent 完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次模型请求之前暂停，保持 composer 输入框可用，人类以回车/发送放行并可携带补充文字；此暂停不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文始终完整、无感知。纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码。

「DSH·禁止梁文峰」：拦截官方 DeepSeek API 请求：北京时间工作日高峰时段 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，中国法定节假日全天谷价不拦截，自动拦截发往官方 provider `deepseek-official` 与 `deepseek-account` 的模型请求，可切换到第三方中转或预留的本机转 API 端口，未配置则阻止并把未发出的消息放回输入框；非高峰不拦、正常走官方，避开高峰双倍计价。标准可安装 dsh 插件，host 与浏览器双半身，设置经 cordis 配置文件注入。

「DSH·远程文件系统」：提供模型可见的远程文件工具 read_remote、write_remote、edit_remote，经 ssh 读写远程主机文件；并在 Web 右侧栏以 remote tab 预览远程文本，补上内置查看器只认本地文件的缺口。write_remote 只允许新建，绝无覆写分支；文件后端 RemoteFileSystem 不继承 FileSystem，仅借用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs 的类型词表与 FsError。标准可安装的 dsh host 与 client 插件。
「DSH·工具结果自动展开」：在 DSH web 界面自动展开工具调用卡片，支持侧边栏开关。标准可安装的 dsh 客户端插件。
「DSH·写入规则守卫」：禁止在 edit/write 写入内容中使用匹配正则的字符，extraTools 可额外配置拦截更多工具。可在设置页逐条开关规则，也可在会话视图的「写入规则」页只给当前会话关掉条目。
Composer-dock quota strip: Command Code 5h/weekly/monthly windows with fill bars and percentages, plus DeepSeek's peak/off-peak period.
Threshold-triggered session handoff for DSH: summarize the current session and open a brand-new one, leaving the old log intact as a searchable archive.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to the TM IM network (Agent Takeover webhook + REST).
Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
把 Super Agent 群聊（本机 workbench）接入 dsh：agent 工具 + 群聊板面侧栏

Persona presets: a set of custom agent presets, one editable character card each, edited from the settings page
克莱恩猫 —— DSH 网页端三状态动态宠物：黄水晶占卜 / 打瞌睡 / 喝甜冰茶

Browser tab status indicator: paints the document favicon from the ui-session status snapshot (blue running / amber waiting / green done, spinning while work executes) so a backgrounded dsh web tab still shows task state
Star the GitHub repositories behind your installed plugins without leaving DeepSeek Harness.
OpenList 文件同步插件（含设置面板）：自动把 DSH 对话交付文件上传到 OpenList 挂载目录，并提供该目录的完整读写工具集。

Git preflight check for vibecoding sessions in DeepSeek Harness: detects whether the project is a Git repository, compares the local branch with its upstream, pulls remote commits for the AI to review, and asks you to confirm pushing local commits.
Hierarchical memory-tree compaction provider for DeepSeek Harness (in development; may be unstable)
Windows XP Luna skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a full Settings page for wallpaper and window material (wallpaper stored on the Host, not bundled).
AITP research desk for DeepSeek Harness: research.md tools, a write-placement guard, a plan editor and a file-manager-style topic browser.
当任一会话出现需要点击批准的权限申请或需要回答的问题时，右下角弹出常驻系统气泡（点击前往对应会话）+ Web 提醒卡。随 dsh web profile 自动挂载，长期生效。

A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for DSH: changed files, tick-to-stage, Summary + Description, Commit and Commit and Push, discard-to-trash, and diff preview, in the built-in right sidebar.
轻量系统级桌宠：原生进程逐像素透明渲染，工作正文/等待确认/完成提示与余额查询联动，点击穿透

Publishes the DSH Web GUI on your tailnet whenever DSH runs, so a phone anywhere can connect, and removes the route on exit. Every remote page is the lite plugin set by default (about 1.1 MB gzip instead of about 5.3 MB) and the full page only happens when you press the switch icon once (the choice is never remembered) — the desktop app never sees any of it (this plugin registers nothing there) and startup cost is zero because the WebSocket compression patch is armed lazily on the first handshake. The phone link lives in Settings -> General -> Phone access with one-click copy and key rotation: rotating revokes the old link and every session signed with it. The same link is in the loginUrl field of ~/.dsh/tailscale-remote.json. A remote page can also turn on status notifications (a bell beside the lite/full switch): the Host watches the session log and browser-notifies that device when a session finishes (🟢), waits for your approval or a question (🟡), or breaks (🔴); a master switch in the same settings row turns the whole feature off.
DeepSeek Harness 本地 llama.cpp 管理器：多套启动模板、服务启停、实时日志与 token 速度、模型库，并可把本地 GGUF 暴露到 DSH 顶部模型选择器。

DSH Web 客户端插件：在输入框原版模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供商名称。

DeepSeek Harness Skill 管理插件：全局启用/禁用 skill、按工作区设置新对话默认加载的 skill、对话中随时调整当前会话的 skill、删除用户 skill。A Skill Manager for DeepSeek Harness: globally enable/disable skills, pick per-workspace skill defaults for new conversations, adjust the active conversation's skill set any time, and delete user skills.

HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: securely access your DSH Web UI from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only listener, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.

Run !-prefixed commands directly from the DeepSeek Harness Web composer without sending them to the model.
DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: press Escape in the composer to stop the active task

DSH plugin: right-side whole-disk file browser panel with name/size/mtime sorting and drag-into-chat

Host half spawns and supervises the processes (tree-kill on Windows, ring-buffered output); browser half mounts through the official slot system — no DSH source changes.

Mounts via the official dsh plugin system — no DSH source changes.

Reforge a rough draft into a precise prompt inside the DSH composer, with one-click revert.
词元工坊插件：访问 USTC 模型与校内站点时走 ustc-iwan，其余流量保持原样，与 Clash TUN / WireGuard / Panabit iWAN 共存。
DSH Web GUI plugin control center: card list of all installed plugins with name, version, description, and online enable/disable switches.
An agent audio studio for DeepSeek Harness: compose, narrate, add effects, mix, fine-tune every track on a timeline.
Native, lightweight element and region comments inside the built-in DSH Browser — live attribute edits and numbered hoverable tags, no screenshots or provider replacement.

Resident Evil: The Hive theme for DeepSeek Harness — a black-and-crimson control room with the film's underground Hive turning as a live 3D model: decks widening toward the crown, a long bore up to the surface hatch, and a rail terminus at the base whose narrow bore runs out into the dark.

Bilibili companion widget docked to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI.
A switchable Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness.
Codebase knowledge graphs for DeepSeek Harness: build, query, and browse a project's graph through seven graphify_* Agent tools, a /graphify command, and a Graphify page in the Web UI.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: sign in with ChatGPT to use GPT models through DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex route, and see that account's quota.
DeepSeek Harness trading workbench: AI decision chain with a per-day round archive, Demo execution and risk views over a local Python trading service.

Agent control for DeepSeek Harness's built-in right-Sidebar Browser: snapshot refs, click/type/press/select/scroll, screenshots, multi-tab, plus query-scoped reads and change diffs that keep long pages cheap.
小鲸鱼余额挂件：常驻 DSH 界面右下角，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，QQ 弹弹、拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画

轻量微信桥接 DSH：扫码绑定官方 ClawBot（iLink），私聊驱动会话（文本/审批/模型/人格）
DSH plugin: mirror all-session status onto the browser tab (Firefox / Chrome / Edge). Leave long-running tasks and still see yellow / green / blue on the tab.

Import MCP servers, rules, and hooks from Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor into DeepSeek Harness — the missing /import for DSH.

Enforce configurable git commit / push / PR conventions for DeepSeek Harness agents
山海系列 DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：总量徽章、每日走势柱状图、GitHub 风格热力图、按模型/提供商分组明细
A now-playing dock for the DSH sidebar: sync playlists from QQ Music and NetEase Cloud Music, show synced lyrics when idle and transport controls on hover.

Export a DSH session tree (lead + subagent fleet) to two Markdown files from one frozen snapshot: a readable narrative summary and a complete raw archive. / 把一次会话及其整个智能体编队从同一份冻结快照导出为两份 Markdown：可读的叙事摘要与完整的原始存档。

DSH skill manager: register, inspect, export/import zip packages, content-addressed version history with diff and rollback, per-skill enable/disable. Zero runtime dependencies. / DSH 技能管理插件：技能注册、介绍、导出导入 zip、版本跟踪（快照/对比/回滚）、停用启用。

Connect to Linux servers over SSH, manage files, firewall rules, apt software sources, Docker registry mirrors, developer tool installation/upgrades, and Docker containers from the Harness Web UI.
Two-step permanent delete for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions.
Colored tags for DeepSeek Harness sessions, shown in the sidebar row and the conversation header, editable with preset colors, hover-remove, and drag-to-reorder.
会话归位：把游离（未分组）会话按 canonical cwd 重新归属到匹配的工作区，只修 workspace 归属记录，不动会话文件。
Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness — the agent writes TSX, dsh web renders it live, inline in chat and in a canvas panel
CodeAct agent loop for the DeepSeek Harness: a persistent IPython session as the model's action space, with harness tools bridged in as a virtual `__dsh__.tools` module.

Split New Session into 日常 (a lightweight chat agent with web, questions and local file read/write) and 工作 (the shipped coding agent), with a daily-chat session list in the sidebar.

星火 OS 切片层 (graft-slice): physical handoff for long sessions: slice a closed log at its last turn/end into a zero-inheritance, cold-resumable session. No fork, no lossy compaction, crash-safe transaction journal. Can carry memory context into the new session.

星火 OS 记忆层 (memory): capability memory for long sessions. Consumes the handoff ledger, extracts four cognitive layers (facts with seq pointers, experiences, negative paths, structured SKILL.md skills) from finished sessions, filters retrieval with a cheap LLM relevance pass, and never imports the slicing plugin. Supports hybrid lexical+semantic recall and an optional node:sqlite inverted index.
星火 OS 副脑 (observer): a companion session bound to a main session, co-transferring by pointer, never sliced. Watches for stuck loops and can inject a corrective interruption.

It is not limited to development work — research, documentation, presentations and video production all fit. No cloud service is involved: everything is managed locally. Single-user and multi-user both work, with Git synchronisation, and every action is on record. The control panel summarises in-flight, overdue and stalled work with weekly trends.

Per-step token cost ledger with peak/off-peak pricing and weekday-selected peak windows for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (cache hit / miss / output, per 1M tokens, ¥ or $)
Daily journal and calendar for DeepSeek Harness: the journal_record tool appends one JSON file per day, and the right sidebar draws it as a calendar.

多端会话同步助手：DSH multi-device session sync through a user-owned private Gitee or GitHub repository, with per-user/per-device folders, a shared latest revision, consent gate, optional AES-256-GCM packages, sidebar workspace registration, import/export and deletion.
峰谷时间提醒悬浮窗（DSH 插件）：按 settings.yaml 配置的峰时/谷时区间，用状态点颜色和文字提醒当前时段
Update entry before each DSH plugin card switch: pick a version and read its release notes without opening the detail page.
Unified Editor runtime for DeepSeek Harness, powered by MCP Apps
Unified Editor runtime for DeepSeek Harness, powered by MCP Apps
Signpost experience files left by earlier agent sessions, so a new DeepSeek Harness session knows what already exists.
在工作提示词之外，为 DeepSeek Harness 的助手汇报提供人格化转述，原文随时可查。
HydroOJ operations and site-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: SSH install/upgrade, monitoring, Caddy/MongoDB/Judge, embedded Hydro pages, and AI-assisted problem/contest/community workflows.

Reasoning effort slider for DeepSeek Harness — a client (web) bundle that injects a per-session slider into the conversation input, shown when the selected model declares reasoning effort levels. Works with any provider that has reasoning efforts (Bailian, DeepSeek official, OpenAI o-series, etc.)
Voice-feedback plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a speak tool, readReplies narration, an LLM verbalizer pass, per-session voices, chimes, a monitoring panel, and a native macOS floating pet. zh/en i18n.
Native macOS notifications and configurable sounds for DeepSeek Harness
Drag and paste files and folders into DeepSeek Harness, on the web and in the desktop app, with one preview rail; file references are added when you send.
Renders images, video, audio, PDF and Office documents inline in the DeepSeek Harness web UI and desktop app through a display_file tool, streaming bytes over a signed HTTP route with range support.
DeepSeek Harness 社区插件中心：浏览、搜索并安装社区插件

Mobile experience suite for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — responsive reading layout, composable glass skinning, download affordances for the built-in 0.1.5 files sidebar, and session-state healing. Zero package dependencies.
DSH 插件：会话步数到上限时，在轮末自动开新会话、投递本地拼装的交接摘要，并按开关归档/延迟归档旧会话、决定是否跳转到新会话（按工作区配置上限，零模型调用）。
微信官方 ilink 机器人网关绑定+通知+监听+上报（ClawBot）：扫码绑定、微信在线/断线状态、自动通知开关、批准/选择提醒、微信消息监听并自动处理、webhook 上报
分支流程面板：按规范从 production6 切分支、AI 生成分支名与提交信息、一键提交推送并合并到 stage。
Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) language pack for the DSH Web GUI
Read and rename the current session title with DSH's native title rules, and manage DSH native session-title generation
Shows the active model provider's remaining balance or coding-plan quota in DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
dsh web 任意入口访问增强：注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill 并放行 0.0.0.0/私网/隧道域名的 privileged API
Split-screen panel for the DeepSeek Harness web client: parallel sessions side by side, four columns per page with wheel paging, resizable dividers and a progress-only view.
Workspace Only switch for DeepSeek Harness: confine file access of every sandbox mode to the session workspace

DSH web plugin: one-click full process restart of the harness from the sidebar — terminates the current `dsh web` process and relaunches the identical command via a startup guard (no daemon required), with automatic page recovery and an agent-callable restart tool. DSH Web 插件：侧边栏一键完整重启 harness —— 结束当前 `dsh web` 进程并以相同命令经启动守卫重新拉起（无需守护进程），页面自动恢复，并提供 agent 可调用工具。

Arknights-flavoured startup animation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a PRTS terminal boot, sonar scan, hologram lock-on and an operator file ending in a deep-sea lockup, about 4.6 seconds, with four selectable original score presets (or sound off), skippable and configurable.
小鲸鲸陪伴面板 v0.5：专注计时（番茄钟/正计时/自定义倒计时）、待办便签、喝水/久坐提醒、课程讲解、作业辅导；本地功能 0 token，模型功能标注花费。桌宠显示由桌宠插件自己管理。
Jev 决策模型路由插件：默认只调思考强度（缓存安全），可选自动模型路由（默认关闭 + 缓存代价硬门禁）· DeepSeek Harness plugin
SSH 远程工作区插件（多机并行版）：管理多台服务器、同时保持多个 SSH 连接，在每台上选择远程工作区，Agent 用 rw_* 工具直接查看/修改/执行远程文件。基于 dsh-remote (MIT) 改造，支持多池并行连接。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 DSH 里管理 CLIProxyAPI 的账号 —— 余额、签到、任务、切换账号，并让 CPA 随 DSH 启停。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：给子智能体和智能体团队队友逐个指定模型，点一下就换。
Click or drag to annotate pages in the existing DeepSeek Harness Browser and ask the current agent.

Four terse levels in the conversation header — less thinking, no web search, shorter answers — plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, mirrored in Settings. Changes apply immediately.
dsh 项目桥接：自动导入 .claude/.agents/.trae skills，桥接 MCP 服务器（HTTP/SSE + stdio），GUI 开关面板。
Live-process blocks for the Chat transcript: reasoning and tool rows open while running, fold when settled, and carry configurable block styling from a Settings page.
毛泽东思想工作方法论：全局提示词注入 + 原文检索 + 矛盾分析等工具
Dual-engine PDF translation for DeepSeek Harness: pdf2zh-next / BabelDOC and vision OCR with LaTeX
Garmin Connect 运动健康 AI 教练插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 同步活动/健康/HRV 数据 + AI 训练建议 + 训练计划 + 训练日记
One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a title-bar button that restarts the desktop app so freshly installed plugins take effect.

为 DeepSeek Harness 带来分层记忆（全局 / 用户 / 项目 / GIT 分支 / 每日）与自我进化（经验沉淀 + 技能自动创建）和技能管理、待办管理、CLI 调度（kimi/codex/grok/hermes 等外部 AI 统一调度）、临时信息便签，带 WebUI 管理界面。Hermes-style long-term memory, self-evolution, skills, todos and external CLI agent dispatch for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
DSH Web 热键自定义：发送 / 换行 / 自定义答案提交（可录制、可扩展）
瞬镜开放平台（solmirror）MCP 工具桥 + dsh 配置页：设置里粘贴 API 密钥、服务器地址，保存后用「测试连接」验证
Gearbox for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning-effort presets for third-party models (Effort Studio) plus an image-generation lane with prompt-enhancer roles (Image Lane). 模型变速箱：第三方模型思考档位预设 + 图像生成通道。
Local Supertonic text-to-speech plugin for deepseek-harness. Automatically reads assistant replies aloud. No cloud services or API keys required.

自动模式 Auto Mode: an AI pre-judgment layer for DeepSeek Harness — a flash-model router that picks the best agent preset (standard/code/minimal/cordis) for each new session and lets the user confirm before execution.
Work Buddy style prompt-polish button in the DSH composer; the polish call uses the model of the conversation it sits in.

CubeAI 应用中心：一个多应用聚合 DSH 插件。目前收录有神农问诊、智慧家庭、云上温室、咖啡工坊、计算器、贪吃蛇等应用。 CubeAI App Hub: A multi-application aggregation DSH plugin. It currently includes applications such as Shennong Wenzhenon, Smart Home controller, Cloud Greenhouse, Coffee Workshop, Calculator, Snake, and more.
DSH飞书频道 — 将飞书机器人应用接入本机 DeepSeek Harness。
DSH飞书客户端：1）用户（人）通过本插件提供UI访问远端智能体；2）本地DSH通过调用本插件提供工具访问远端智能体。支持的远端智能体包括且不限于：DSH、OpenClaw、WorkBuddy、Weknora等等。
智慧家庭模拟器：在可拖动、可缩放的悬浮面板中演示空调、灯光、窗帘和空气净化器的状态，并允许大模型通过工具实时调节它们。 A floating smart-home simulator panel with an agent-callable control tool.

Idle-based automatic session archiving for DeepSeek Harness: archive sessions nobody has touched for N hours, with cooldown, dry-run, pinned/subagent protection and a persisted per-session audit trail.
Dual-protocol DIT.ai provider and first-run onboarding for DeepSeek Harness
Camofox-browser-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)
LLM-assisted auto approval with timeout fallback for DeepSeek Harness
A DSH web client bundle: conversation question index for the DSH Web UI — list every question you asked in a session and jump straight to it. 对话问题索引插件：列出会话中你提过的所有问题，点击一键定位。
把 DeepSeek Harness 的界面换成微信（WeChat）风格：灰白配色、绿色气泡、微信字体与布局。
Adds a 删除会话 action to the session context menu that archives the session and moves the session directory plus the Markdown files that session wrote into a recoverable trash.
Session overview dock for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: N-day session list, cross-session unread and running status, one-click jump, and a completion chime.
Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.
Aemeath desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a pixel-art companion that idles, works, waits, and reacts alongside the agent.

DSH plugin: automatic SSH port-forward tunnel to a remote LLM/vLLM server (ping gate, any SSH client - OpenSSH ssh or PuTTY plink - with automatic password, health monitor) plus provider registration for subagent model selection. No plink required: OpenSSH ssh with password (SSH_ASKPASS/sshpass) or key auth works out of the box. DSH Desktop: settings sidebar sub-page for remote IP/port/user/credentials, SSH client path override, tunnel start/stop, and status.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: a small dot left of the model name in the composer tool row — yellow for DeepSeek peak hours, green for off-peak (half price). Rendered only when the session's model provider is DeepSeek.
Turn DeepSeek Harness conversations into user-curated quiz questions.
MMPL (Memory Palace) memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness — configurable MCP endpoint, local-server supervisor, and auto memory capture via the Rust DuckDB vector-memory MCP server.
DSH Desktop 会话看板：悬浮球展示所有工作区的活跃会话，实时思考预览、上下文用量圆环、点击跳转会话、近5小时请求/token 统计

webCandidates.description: Browser studio for DeepSeek Harness: Chrome-style device toolbar and Cursor-style element picking inside the built-in browser, one click into the session.
DSH slash command /rea: hand a reverse-engineering request to the reverse-engineer-anything skill and the REA MCP tools, with a titled and glyphed / menu row
DSH 远程访问控制面 + 手机三屏外壳：公网隧道部署、配对、状态，手机第三屏直接就是桌面右栏面板。
Share one right-sidebar layout across every session in the same DSH workspace, and drop the focused tab (file, browser URL, terminal screen) straight into the composer.
Real-time session cost meter for the DeepSeek Harness: estimated CNY model cost below the composer.
DSH plugin: electrical & electronics problem solving
DSH plugin: a deterministic calculation engine - values, formulas, dimensional analysis and a step-by-step record
通用 AI 项目索引助手：增量扫描代码库，产出受 token 预算约束的项目快照、契约风险面板，并在交付后用原生问答卡片做交互式复盘。
DSH 指令权威性清洗一体化插件：运行时提示词注入 + 宿主补丁 + 预设 + 演练台。合并自 dsh-purge-community 1.6.55 与 dsh-unrestricted 0.2.4。
Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sidebar page with focus/short-break/long-break cycles plus a countdown pill beside the composer. · DSH Web 番茄钟：侧栏整页（专注/短休息/长休息）+ 输入框旁倒计时胶囊。
Unofficial DSH plugin: use chat.deepseek.com web models as a DSH LLM provider (browser login capture + PoW solving + SSE streaming + prompting-based tool calls), provider route deepseek-web
数字地球：在三维地球上叠加 3D Tiles / 3DGS 图层，与对话同屏；Agent 可读写场景、标注、量测、空间分析与视觉特效，支持 /earth 命令、问 Agent 场景注入与 HTML/Markdown 报告导出，内置数据体检、多期场景恢复与双语界面。
Bilingual, evidence-linked paper reading matrix for DeepSeek Harness
快速问答：课堂小测速答 —— 桌面快捷栏 + 框选题目 + 绑定工作区资料，15 秒后提示等待、最长等待 90 秒

webCandidates.description: Enhanced fork of dsh-better-sidebar: VSCode-like right sidebar (explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser) plus image annotation. Registers tabs/file viewers through the same betterSidebar service.
DSH conversation annotator: select transcript text, attach a note in a popup, then send the compiled quote+note pair through the composer.
DSH composer plugin: ↑/↓ prompt-history navigation — browse the current session's sent prompts right in the input box, with a "历史 x/y" badge.

DSH Cordis plugin: turn arbitrary source text or images with text, diagrams, and tables into an AI-generated knowledge graph (facts / inferences / concepts / definitions / examples / counter-examples / rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text, plus evidence-grounded verification, questioning, one-click fixes and an audit log.
将 AStudio 应用中已登录的模型复用到 DeepSeek Harness — bring AStudio app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
DSH 远程访问插件：局域网直连（二维码）、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp + 自有服务器反代（含登录门户）
给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：规则钉住、按证据召回、事实键去重、明文可读，带管理页。
聊天组件一键收缩：输入框工具行加一枚收缩按钮，收起后角落浮出恢复球，点击即还原。纯浏览器侧，零 DSH 源码改动。
DSH 仓库技能市场管理器:按 仓库地址+分支+稀疏路径 拉取插件/技能,安装进 ~/.dsh/skills,在设置页以插件维度管理
DSH 仓库技能市场管理器:按 仓库地址+分支+稀疏路径 拉取插件/技能,安装进 ~/.dsh/skills,在设置页以插件维度管理
Range 分片并发 + 断点续传的下载插件：给 AI Agent 一条比 curl 单连接快数倍的高速下载通道，跨平台
侧边栏一键重启 DSH：点一下、确认一次，DSH 自动关闭并重新启动。One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-purge fork（cxkctrl24-lgtm/dsh-purge-021）：DeepSeek Harness 破甲 + 网络安全红队评测插件。基座 = 上游 Apache-2.0 的 1.1.82，逐项并入 fork 增量（宿主退出诊断 F1、asar 改名失败兜底 F2、注入正文覆盖判定修复、装配性能四项、可见性探针）。默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」；换模型可换提示词。Jailbreak + red-team eval for DeepSeek Harness (community fork of YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge).
Sidebar Overflow — choose which left-sidebar entries stay visible and collect the rest into a More menu.
每 N 步自动停下汇报一次进度（正在做什么 / 已完成什么 / 接下来做什么 / 卡点），说完立刻继续，不占额外回合、不等你回复。(DeepSeek Harness plugin: periodic in-chat progress checkpoints that never block the turn.)
Community skill marketplace for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, and one-click install skills from awesome-skills-cn and the wider Claude Code / OpenClaw skill ecosystem.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：查找、读取和新建独立会话，向一个或多个会话发送消息，并在授权范围内协作。
在对话里把本地文件夹授权给 AI：浏览、读取并编辑其中的文件，授权后模型立刻知道。
Ambient internet radio for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI

DeepSeek Harness plugin: an in-workspace file tree, a peer view tab that previews text and image files (single-click auto-switches to the tab, double-click opens straight in edit mode), drag-to-composer file paths, create/delete file and folder operations with DSH-native dialogs and smooth DSH-token animations.
DSH 插件：在输入框工具行实时显示当前模型所属 DeepSeek 账户的余额与峰谷计费时段（支持平台账号与 API Key 路由），点击展开明细与用量/充值入口。
Live2D pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a characterful agent companion — follows session state, switchable personas, bring-your-own models
把 DSH 接到 QQ 官方机器人：跑完了、要你回答、出错了都推到你手机，引用那条消息回复就等于接着聊。默认零上传、不需要账号。

DSH 服务面板：查看由哪个对话（Agent 会话）启动了哪些服务——PEB 环境块读取 DSH_SESSION_ID 归属（含分离进程），三态健康探测 + HTTP 码，支持礼貌停止、日志实时查看与启动参数重放。Host scans agent-started services with session attribution; client renders a fullscreen table panel with tri-state health, graceful stop, live logs and restart replay.

Open-source plugin market for the DSH web GUI: card grid with GitHub stars, last-commit freshness, and one-click install/uninstall. The catalog is this repo's own data/plugins.json — anyone can add a plugin via pull request. · 开源 DSH 插件市场：卡片式排布、星数、最近提交、一键安装；目录就是本仓库的 data/plugins.json，任何人都能通过 PR 上架插件。
DeepSeek Harness plugin that compacts long chats by rendering history into compact bitmap frames a vision model can read, with exact head/tail text and a bounded exact-token index.
In-layout fast terminal for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated PTY websocket, no frame acknowledgement
RSS reading and model tools for DeepSeek Harness
Adds a download button to files presented in DSH conversations, so web users can save generated files locally without digging through server paths.
dsh-cost-meter 的 fork:会话费用/Token 缓存统计 + 统一额度看板(DeepSeek 余额 / OpenCode GO / Kimi For Coding / GLM Coding Plan / 火山方舟)。Fork of dsh-cost-meter with a unified multi-provider quota dashboard.
DSH web plugin: 为自定义模型（OpenAI-compatible pi-ai provider）增加思考强度（reasoning effort）配置 —— 设置页新增「思考强度」分区，按模型配置思考级别与线格式、按 provider 配置默认思考强度，直接写入 llm-pi-ai 设置，composer 模型选择器随即生效。
Auto skill butler for DeepSeek Harness: model-assisted need detection, full-directory security review, a cached skill index, and installed-skill management in a Web panel.
LX Music 增强控制插件：内置音源引擎（SDK 搜索 + 音源脚本隔离子进程）、侧边栏迷你播放卡（音量调节 + 播放模式切换）、滚动歌词（逐字卡拉OK，五平台歌词 + 音源脚本 lyric）、系统媒体控件（SMTC）元数据与媒体键、细粒度 LLM 音乐工具集、设置窗口音源管理。（实验性音乐画像默认关闭；安装/更新后请彻底退出并重启 DSH 才会生效，已知问题下个大版本修复）
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 与 Windows 风格界面、主题配色、壁纸和字体设置，以及可独立开关的蓝鲸桌宠。

DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages local inference engines (llama.cpp, NInfer, Hyper-Qwen, Strata): configure, size, launch, and publish a local engine as a DSH model. Installable bundle that mounts the localInfer service, engine providers, model-facing tools, and the Web UI as one profile layer.

DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Markdown vaults (Obsidian-style) into shared agent memory: vector recall over Milvus-Lite, human-editable memory notes, and the five memory_read/search/write/dream/audit tools with lifecycle-hooked automatic recall. Installable bundle that mounts the obsidianMem service, host routes, tools, and lifecycle events as one profile layer.

Status-first workspace board for the DSH sidebar: sorts workspaces and their tasks by needs-input, running, then done, with search, same-status drag ordering, task archive/restore, and three distinct status markers.

Pops the DSH side chat into a frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop window that can sit over any other application, with its own 悬浮窗 settings page (appearance light / dark / follow-DSH / follow-Windows, always-on-top, remembered geometry, default size, opacity, close-window-ends-the-thread, session title in the title bar, Esc to close) and a cache-and-log cleanup card. This root manifest is the distribution package: it exposes plugin/ as the entry points and ships window/ alongside, so a GitHub install carries everything the window process needs.
Double-click one of your own messages in DeepSeek Harness to edit it and restart the conversation from that point.

给大肥鱼会话用的 QQ 群/私聊工具（只支持 SnowLuma，其他 OneBot 实现包括 NapCat 都不支持）：列群、看群记录、发群消息（可引用/@）、发表情、收藏表情（SnowLuma 收藏夹）、好友/私聊记录、发私聊消息、私聊唤醒、群成员、戳一戳感知/戳回去、更改头像、好友管理（资料/备注/分组/删好友/名片赞/好友申请）、QQ 空间说说（列表/详情/发表/评论/点赞/权限）、挂载会话选择。11 个工具组加 1 个设置组件，可在插件页逐个开关。
Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for J-Link debugging: manager + tools + device patches + visualization. 原生 J-Link 调试插件（管理器+工具+补丁注册+可视化）。
Custom DSH appearance: wallpaper, translucent surfaces, accent color, radius, and custom CSS
DSH web plugin: delete sessions from the sidebar's native session menu, plus a batch picker in a shell overlay. No bundle patching.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin: toggle any plugin on/off from the GUI, live, without restarting the server.
DSH-protect-eyes-skin — an eye-friendly green (豆沙绿护眼) theme for DeepSeek Harness: a full --dsw-* design-token reskin for both light and dark modes that reduces blue-light strain.
A mode dropdown in the composer that commits through the Host's own model selection — Plan, Act, and any number of user-defined modes — plus two optional automatic switches.
在 DSH Web UI 新增「四六级刷题」面板：导入题库、在线练习、交卷自动判分并回顾错题。
在「插件」页新增插件市场标签页：浏览、搜索社区 DeepSeek Harness 插件并一键安装。

全局语料库：内容放在一个可整体搬走的根目录，插件按工作区/会话/路径授权，提供检索、按行读取、文档导入、内置小代理结构化、仓库/会话总结接口、后台重建、Web GUI 面板与右栏权限管理。
DSH 插件：提示词工具，规范模型的思维链与回答内容，提供 Web UI 编辑 module.yml 与 AGENTS.md，并随包分发内置技能。
DSH 会话隔离的输入历史导航插件（纯 client 双面）：对话输入框中按 ↑/↓ 方向键遍历当前会话发送过的消息（shell history 式交互），浏览中编辑或发送即退出。与全局历史插件的区别是历史严格限定在当前会话内。
Control how the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI is reachable: local only, Tailscale, all local networks, or off.
DSH 会话隔离的输入历史导航插件（纯 client 双面）：对话输入框中按 ↑/↓ 方向键遍历当前会话发送过的消息（shell history 式交互），浏览中编辑或发送即退出。与全局历史插件的区别是历史严格限定在当前会话内。
DeepSeek Harness Plugin Hub tools and native Settings marketplace
