DSH peer link — point-to-point messaging between dsh agents and other local agent sessions (e.g. Claude Code) over unix sockets. Independent plugin: register as a peer, receive messages into agent context, reply with peer_send, list peers with peer_list.
Database context, verified memory and isolated experiments for DeepSeek Harness
TokenShare provider 请求节流：每分钟上限、上游 5xx 后等待重放，设置页滑块调节 · Per-minute throttle and retry-after-wait for the TokenShare provider route
SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar, with lightweight/full modes and selective Skill sync

DeepSeek Harness session manager: browse/search, size detail, archive, trash/permanent delete with selectable files, official format migration, DeepSeek share-link import into a chosen workspace, compact/full export with workspace files, and import as new sessions.

DSH web plugin: unified manager for profile bundles and MCP integrations (Settings → Plugins → 管理). Toggles write managed disable overrides into the profile cordis.patch.yml and take effect through config hot-reload.
DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
右侧栏 HTML 批注预览：点选元素或框选区域写批注，直接发进当前会话让 AI 改
Restart DeepSeek Harness from the conversation header 閳?plus an optional, version-pinned patch that adds a tray menu entry and a graceful relaunch route.
实时海洋皮肤 · Realtime ocean theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web
渡劫飞升：仙逆·王林修炼伙伴。监控会话状态驱动动画，随使用修炼升境，境界越高皮肤越华丽。
Theme, colour-token, typography and geometry customisation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with presets and a live editor.
CSDN 风格的 DSH Web 主题：CSDN 品牌色与博文正文排版（加粗/下划线/引用/表格/代码等）双层接入，浅色与深色各一套。

DSH Web 插件：在工作区标题行的搜索按钮右侧提供「定位当前会话」按钮（⇧⌘D）、在会话行菜单里提供「复制会话 ID」（⇧⌘C，复制完有提示）、把 http/https/mailto/tel 链接交给系统默认程序打开（含 Electron 壳会留在内置窗口里的 localhost）、为对话正文里的行内代码提供「打开 / 复制」右键菜单并把 ~/… 家目录路径展开后在侧栏打开、在「已编辑 N 个文件」卡片的文件行上右键用你本机装的 IDE 打开、在文件管理器中显示或复制该文件的绝对路径（目录则列出全部已装应用，含终端与文件管理器），还可把输入框的 Enter 与 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 对调（Enter 换行、Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 发送），并在草稿为空时用 ↑/↓ 在当前对话发过的消息之间切换（图片附件一并粘回草稿），还把当前工作区名显示在标题行「打开」按钮的图标左边（写进那颗官方按钮自己，点名字和点图标一样），并在那颗按钮的下拉菜单里加一行 Otty（点击用 Otty 打开当前工作区目录），右侧栏页签支持中键关闭、右键关闭其他/左侧/右侧/全部；设置里的「心流」页分别开关这些功能。
【已停止维护】官方 DSH 侧栏已内置「工作区没有可见会话就不渲染该行」，本插件的自动隐藏是重复实现。历史功能：最后一个未归档会话被归档时隐藏该工作区行，另在工作区行「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」并配官方 Modal 恢复入口；只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区注册与会话数据。

Workspace-free free chat for DeepSeek Harness — a sidebar entry that opens a shared scratchpad workspace (~/.dsh/scratchpad), keeps every tool available, and auto-promotes sessions that produce real files into isolated sibling workspaces (~/.dsh/projects/<date>-<slug>) with a new-session handoff. Maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad.
DSH 搜索增强插件：在新建会话的工作区选择器内提供内联搜索，支持中文拼音全拼/首字母、英文分隔符无关子串与子序列模糊匹配。
DSH Web 侧边栏助手：⌘⇧K 弹出未读与待决策总览，⌘⇧J / ⌘⇧I 顺序定位未读与等待处理，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；底部六项会话状态读数（运行中 / 未读 / 待处理 / 闲置 / 未归档 / 已归档）每个图标可点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；host 半边的跨重启会话账本——上次中途退出的会话重启后依然未读，账本未读也画在会话行上，启动时还会弹一次续跑清单。
DSH Web 插件：侧边栏底部显示运行中/未读/待处理/闲置/未归档/已归档的会话计数，可在设置页逐项开关。
openwiki 知识库：DSH 内嵌代码库 Wiki 生成与阅读（复用 DSH 模型、运行时托管、生成/更新任务、知识卡片）。
First-class Open Terminal integration for DeepSeek Harness: global tools, settings, file browser, and interactive terminal
A real browser in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar вЂ” one per chat, driven by agent tools
MVP dsh bundle plugin: proves it loaded by registering a /plugin-manager web route, logging, writing a marker file, and adding a sidebar '插件' button whose modal lists the user-installed plugins
A low-interruption Big Fat Fish companion plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web workspace
Hide the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the “新版本” pill beside the account button). Pure CSS + label-based hiding; update checking itself keeps working. | 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的「新版本」更新角标，不改变更新检查行为。
DSH 插件：把拖入/粘贴进输入框的图片当「文件」处理 —— 光标处插 @路径 胶囊（不占附件栏），悬停即可看原图。Images become @path chips at the caret with a hover preview.

Visual conversation map for DeepSeek Harness: an infinite whiteboard where every session is a card — drag to arrange, double-click to start a chat in place, draw an edge to fork a new session with injected context. Built for ADHD-friendly spatial memory. · DSH 可视化对话地图：会话即卡片，双击即聊，连线分叉带上下文的新对话。
Peak/off-peak billing strip and account balance above the DSH composer, with today, 7-day and 30-day spend per model.
DeepSeek Harness 每日/每周任务插件（启动弹窗提醒、横屏滚动条、圆圈完成、周日 AI 周总结）+ DeepSeek API 用量/余额侧边栏小部件
DeepSeek Harness 主题中心 · Theme Center for dsh web UI：精选主题画廊（浅色/深色分组）、一键切换、自定义壁纸、dsh-theme 导入导出
hds-interlude (time-aware, persistent narrative chat framework) ported to DeepSeek Harness. 幕间系统：聊天在幕前发生，生活在幕间继续。
Save prompts once, reuse them in DSH with keyboard search, variable fill forms, and one-click insertion. Includes categories, favorites, AI rewrite comparison, version history, and local backups.
AgentTeams dashboard for the DSH Web UI: a «Команды» sidebar section with team cards, token spend by range, USD/RUB cost, work time and an archive of older teams.
In-chat preview modal for local files, images, PDFs, Office documents and website links in the DSH Web UI.
Replace the DeepSeek Harness sidebar brand with the Action Formula (言动方程) logo; the rest of the interface stays unchanged.
System panel for DeepSeek Harness: machine, runtime, working repositories and Kubernetes cluster health
System panel for DeepSeek Harness: machine, runtime, working repositories and Kubernetes cluster health
DSH plugin: compile, run, crash-analyse and debug C++ with a bundled green MinGW-w64 GCC toolchain (g++ + gdb) — no system compiler, no installer, no PATH surgery.
Discover, preview, apply, restore, and revert themes in DeepSeek Harness
DSH 多窗口墙：在官方 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里以多窗口网格并排运行、监控多个对话实例，一屏盯住所有 Agent 的实时进度；内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。
本地长期记忆：在上下文压力升高时归档较早的整轮原文，压缩后可读回；支持 identity / user 板块 / rules / memories 四板块分级注入、项目档案与项目热记忆、记忆家族与根转移、手动注入、20K 长文分段、tag 关联检索。数据都保存在当前工作区，不依赖外部记忆服务。
DSH 原生抖音工具：有限自主观看、抽帧故事板与弹幕、人格与兴趣记忆、自动问候与私信回复、观看日报
DeepSeek Harness plugin for sidebar masking, display aliases, and local screenshot editing. No session isolation.

A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers. (daha1216 fork: reading-view display support for dsh-retrace — shadowed-row hiding, markers, and edit references)
Customize the DeepSeek Harness Web UI fonts: UI font family, code font family, and content font size. Settings persist on the host, with local-font detection and full local font scanning.
把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。
Retrace · 回溯 — Recall, edit-and-resend, regenerate, and conversation/artifact versioning (timeline, rollback, fork map) for DeepSeek Harness — Web and Desktop
Visual Skills Manager for DeepSeek Harness: Inspect, create, edit local skills, and configure model/user invocation policies in Settings.
One-click & background update checker for DeepSeek Harness third-party plugins: upstream detection, changelog diffs, sidebar reminders, and safe AI-assisted updates.
Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics
华为云 CodeArts CLI 的 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）集成插件：PTY 终端托管、目标监督续跑、模型配置界面、HTTP 管理 API
Optional workspace selection + workspace-free temporary sessions for DeepSeek Harness Web (dsh).
Side conversation for DSH Desktop: a persisted forked child session embedded in the right sidebar.
Hot-reload changed DeepSeek Harness plugins and optionally restart the desktop client, without opening and closing DSH by hand.
会话回收站：侧边栏删除会话进入回收站，可查看预览、还原或彻底删除 · Session trash for DeepSeek Harness.
队长来电（captain-call）：AgentTeams 队员完成任务时，桌面助手 GINKA 替 Daisy 队长接听来电，语音汇报'是谁、是否按要求准时完成'；点语音回复即直接申请麦克风，与真实队员语音办公对话。

DSH 桌面宠物的今日 token 额度气泡：按用量分轻度/中度/重度三档，档位只用一个彩色圆点表示，没有进度条也没有百分比。 / Today's token quota bubble for the DSH desktop pet: three usage tiers shown as one coloured dot, with no progress bar and no percentage.
DSH web plugin: a star button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer prompt, combining PromptForge rule diagnosis with the session's own default model.

DSH plugin: Sisyphus agent orchestration — star topology, single-line blocking, 7 specialist sub-agents (Hermes/Explore/Librarian/Looker/Hephaestus/Prometheus/Oracle) with per-type model binding, go_work/continue/need_help/forward communication tools, Web UI tree panel and settings.
Back up every installed plugin and all profile settings into one portable file, then restore them on a new computer in one click. · 把已安装的插件和全部设置保存成一个文件，换电脑后一键恢复。
双击 Control 说话，文字落进 DSH 输入框；中文/德语/英文自动换引擎，不用切输入法
DSH web plugin: open .docx/.xlsx/.pptx from the sidebar file manager in an embedded OnlyOffice editor (static SDK, no Document Server).
Local music player for DSH with audio-reactive spectrum bars and customizable shortcuts.
Local / GitHub / curated-list skill source with a composer picker entry for the DeepSeek Harness
A chibi Frieren desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: install with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:dakeshui123/dsh-pet-frieren`
Per-turn model and reasoning-effort routing for DeepSeek Harness: classify what the turn asks, switch provider/model/reasoningEffort, show the tier in the composer, and re-route mid-turn.
DSH 会话 Bark 通知插件：会话头部按钮切换「会通知」状态（持久化，服务重启后保持），回合停止时经 Bark 推送到手机——正常结束推送最后一条文本消息，异常停止推送完整错误原因与必要信息；用户主动点停止不推送。插件管理页本插件详情页配置 Bark server/key，并提供 ping→push→register 三步连通测试（dsh 0.1.5–0.2.2 适配）。

Third-party provider reasoning-effort AND input-modality settings for DeepSeek Harness: thinking levels and image-input support declared per model, auto-adapted from a model knowledge base + wire-protocol inference, edited right inside the official Models page card.
DSH browser agent: a dynamic operation+target decision loop. TypeSafe picks the action, this plugin executes it over CDP against the user's own Chrome. DSH 浏览器 Agent 子插件。

Sync your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) configuration between machines over a private git or WebDAV channel: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and provider credentials. DSH 配置远程同步插件（私有通道，明文自用）。
DSH desktop agent: a native-vision decision loop that drives the host desktop through the Cua Driver tools. DSH 桌面 Agent 子插件。

DSH Web内目前最无感的消息撤回、重编辑插件，原版体验，兼容性强，功能简单可开关，设置丰富，现代化轻量ui框架。The most seamless message recall & re-edit plugin for DSH Web — native experience, strong compatibility, simple toggles, rich settings, modern lightweight UI. DSH Web で最もシームレスなメッセージ撤回・再編集プラグイン——ネイティブ体験、高い互換性、シンプルなトグル、充実した設定、モダンで軽量な UI。

DSH LAN access: serve the Web UI on one configurable port reachable from the LAN and from 127.0.0.1, with either the plugin's own password or no authentication at all, and no profile patch edits. DSH 局域网访问子插件。

macOS-native theme for DeepSeek Harness: a floating translucent workbench window on a sky-blue gradient desktop, with the macOS light and dark palettes. Pure UI plugin — the browser half stacks a token override layer on the active theme and injects the structural CSS the token layer cannot express.
DSH magpie image: image generation and reference-image editing through magpie's image MCP, as native mcp__magpie__* tools. The only image plugin since dsh-imagegen was removed. DSH magpie 生图子插件。
DSH Modal H3: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA video generation on Modal as native mcp__modal_h3__* tools, with a multi-account pool kept in a credential. DSH Modal H3 视频生成子插件。
DSH SSH: run commands and move files on configured SSH hosts from the agent, addressing hosts by alias, with passwords kept in the credential store. DSH SSH 子插件。
DSH Stitch designer: Google Stitch AI UI generation as native mcp__stitch__* tools, plus the design conventions that keep one code project bound to one Stitch project. DSH Stitch 界面设计子插件。

Git-worktree sessions for dsh: pick 'work on the main checkout', an existing linked worktree, or 'new worktree' right beside the composer's workspace picker. Picking a worktree moves a new conversation's working directory into it on its first message, so its tools run in that checkout while the conversation stays in its Workspace and no second Workspace is minted for a checkout that already exists. A new worktree is created the same way, named after the task by one auxiliary model call. The host half owns the git plumbing (branch, worktree add, .gitignore entry); the browser half registers the picker and the sidebar row icon.
AI 女友助手（Digital-Sweet-Heart）：把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面改造成微信风格的虚拟女友聊天应用（好友列表 / 对话 / 人设设定 / AI 肖像 / 发图发视频 / 照片分析），支持自定义对话、视觉、文生图、文生视频四组 OpenAI 兼容 API

Factory (Droid) Pro subscription as native DSH LLM providers — authenticates with your own Factory API key through a loopback gateway, with a settings page for status, quota, key switching, and diagnostics. · 把 Factory Droid 订阅额度接入 DSH：API key + 回环网关 + 设置页（连接状态/多 key 切换/订阅额度/路由模型/配置/诊断日志）。
SSH for DSH agents: run commands and move files over SSH while private keys stay inside the Host process. ssh2 transport with an optional system-OpenSSH backend.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: let text-only models receive pasted images, and analyze them with a built-in OpenAI-compatible vision tool
Drive the Windows DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser through playwright-cli, with a per-session page identity.
The front page for a session you left running: what happened, what broke, and what is waiting on you — computed from the durable event log, never generated by a model.
Reorder queued messages inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI queue dock: grip-and-drag plus move buttons, without taking over the official dock.
DSH five-agent dungeon party orchestration plugin
Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
Switch every Bot in a DS Bot team to one model at once, or set each Bot individually. Writes through DS Bot's own update-bot channel instead of racing the running engine over state.json.
DSH plugin switchboard: a Settings → Plugins tab that lists every loaded plugin with its package.json description, fuzzy search, and runtime start/stop toggles (does not rewrite config files).

Edit any message in DeepSeek Harness in place: a prompt is replaced where it stands; a model reply block (answer text or reasoning) is patched through a plugin record and a message projection, so the turn stays where it is, later turns are untouched and the log grows by one small record. Falls back to the replay splice on hosts without the projection API. The append-only session log is never rewritten.

Trim idle DeepSeek Harness session logs at startup: keep the last N windows, cut the ones the model can no longer see, and verify the result with the host's own format, session and projection validators before writing. 把 Obsidian 知识库放进 DSH 右侧栏：目录树、全库搜索、Obsidian 排版风格的笔记页、笔记大纲、笔记属性与反向链接、==高亮== 与 callout 折叠；对话交给应用自己的对话面板在中间打开 / An Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: vault tree, full-vault search, Obsidian-styled note pages, a note outline, note properties and backlinks, highlights and callout folding; the vault conversation opens in the app's own centre panel.
Minimal Chinese voice input plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
DSH Web clock: shows the current date & time in the bottom status bar (composer dock), with user-configurable format.
CollaborationBoard — Stationen, Workflows und Vorhaben als gemeinsame Fläche im DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek account balance: /balance command plus a composer-dock readout in the web GUI
Per-model temperature for hand-declared llm-pi-ai providers: a settings page plus an agent/request listener that puts the configured temperature on the wire.
dsh 原生 UI 设计优化插件：在 dsh 本土设计语言之上做观感与交互打磨（双层阴影、28px 七档渐隐、状态光晕、排版光学、四档弹簧、可选合成音效），并泛用适配第三方插件界面；不改变框架与品牌视觉。
Local image and looping-video wallpapers for the DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web UI
Replace Todo in long-running sessions with task trees, a live progress bar, and timed reports

A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.
Harness UI enhancement with usage summary, project files, and Git diff previews
WeChat-style in-app screenshot button for DeepSeek Harness: drag to capture a screen region, PNG saved with auto-numbering, marker [Shot N HH:mm] written into the composer.
OFM Addition — Our Free Model 的附属插件。两项能力：①回答因达到输出 token 上限被截断时自动替你发送「继续」（连续次数可设上限或「不限」，并在接近上下文窗口时自动停下）；②每个 Our Free Model 路由的请求参数表——思考档位、输出上限、温度与停止序列，可逐模型调整、一键顶配，或让一个模型按各模型声明的能力填写。

Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness — disabled models disappear from the model picker, custom names replace the built-in ones. · DSH 全体模型管理：逐模型启用/停用与自定义显示名，支持按提供商分组、搜索、筛选与批量操作，改完立即生效（不用刷新页面、不用重启 DSH）。
DSH 模型提供商一键开关：在「设置 → 模型」每个提供商行（「编辑」左侧）放一个开关，关掉后该提供商从主界面模型选择栏里消失，重新打开即恢复。

Agent-mode floating window for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): switch a session's system prompt between the harness's own prompt and 13 archived coding-agent CLI prompts (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi, MiniMax, opencode, Pi…) from a draggable Web-UI panel. Cordis bundle, log-safe via the official /agent command.

Local File Share / 本地文件共享 — let the dsh agent list, read and write files on the machine that runs your browser, through a private WebSocket relay and the File System Access API. Zero data copied onto the dsh host.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: tells the model its real, host-measured context occupancy every turn — and keeps compaction summaries from carrying false "context is nearly exhausted" claims.

DSH plugin: dispatch tasks from a local session to a remote DSH over SSH (dsh headless --json), stream the remote agent's run events (thinking, tool calls, results, final answer) back to the local session, and continue the same remote conversation with follow-up messages.

DeepSeek Harness real-time output speed meter: host half taps every streaming model call via llm/stream, counts text/reasoning/tool-call deltas live, self-calibrates chars→tokens per model from the final usage chunk, and exposes an SSE endpoint; the web client half renders a live tok/s pill under the composer and a per-call exact rate after finish.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a DSH NEXT sidebar entry that embeds the dsh-superagent management panel in a same-origin iframe and starts/stops/restarts one or more services.
Context capacity and compaction policy manager: global defaults, per provider/model overrides, and per-session control with compression charts.
Left-sidebar console manager: long-press drag to reorder panel entries (order is pinned against plugin updates), one unified manager with per-item hide/show, and a collapsible hidden-items section.
dsh-superagent research prototype, Windows adaptation (upstream + windows-compat + worker TLS fixes)
Desktop alerts for DeepSeek agent states: browser Windows notifications plus PowerShell sounds.
Chat branch tree plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mind-map of conversation branches, plus a project kanban home for session management.
DeepSeek Harness model selector upgrade: one-level model & reasoning-effort picker with 5 Liang tiers, custom model aliases, and peak/off-peak price countdown.

User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, hover for message preview, click to jump. · DSH Web 用户消息跳转条：对话区右缘 minimap 式横杠，悬停预览、点击跳转。
Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash from the session menu, restore or purge them in settings.
Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Exa, Tavily, Keenable — with automatic fallback, time filtering, and platform search
Provider-backed automatic approval review for DeepSeek Harness.

Maintainer PR review queue board for DeepSeek Harness: five-state tracking (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), sidebar counters, fullscreen kanban, polling, and back-to-you transition toasts. · 维护者 PR 看板：五状态跟踪（等我行动 / 等作者行动 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 新 PR 待分诊），侧边栏计数 + 全屏看板 + 轮询 + 回到你手上的迁移提醒。

Click any card to jump back into that session. · DSH 会话动态面板:host 端扫描会话流,为每个会话提取「目标 + 一句话现状」,自动发现做到一半/问了没回/近期在推进的事,点卡片直接跳回会话——一个不用手动维护的待办看板。
Role management, per-role models and skills for native DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams.
Session-scoped Standard / Fast tier for a configured Responses-to-Codex route in DeepSeek Harness
Manage reusable roles, per-role models, fallback chains, tools, and skills for native DSH Agent Teams.
Switch DSH sessions between Standard and Fast tiers and adjust model reasoning effort.
Send DSH approval alerts and task summaries to Feishu, with recipient and quiet-hour settings.
Show pinned DSH conversations from multiple workspaces together in the sidebar.
Load plugin tools on demand and organize prompts into system, fixed-user, and changing-state sections in DSH PTC sessions.
在 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）会话头部展示模型厂商余额/用量徽标的插件：内置 DeepSeek 余额、MiniMax Token Plan 与智谱 GLM Coding Plan 配额，适配器架构支持接入更多厂商；host 侧按轮次取数，经 SSE 同步到浏览器。
DSH 个人工作台：日历 + 层级任务 + AI 澄清/拆解/执行/复盘 + AI 智能排序/日报周报 + 桌面提醒
⭐ 支持拖拽上传文件/文件夹到 DSH 窗口任意位置；支持远程上传，字节直传服务器会话工作区——部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。
🚀 告别繁琐 SCP！远程部署 DSH 一键下载修改后的文件与图片预览交付插件

DSH web plugin that renders Mermaid diagrams in chat messages as inline SVG images
DSH 主动通知插件：按类型区分通知文案，审批通知等页面弹窗就位后才弹出
Tailscale-based remote access host plugin for DeepSeek Harness (fork of ds-harness-remote).
DeepSeek Harness sidebar disk cleaner: the model ranks what occupies your drives, you tick and clean. Browsers and toolchains are discovered by structure, not by a hard-coded list.
心灵鸡汤 — 在「探索未至之境」标题下方显示一句鼓励，每次新建对话都换一句，一轮之内不重复；设置里可开关显示并把内置的 40 句换成自己的句库。 Encouragement under the New Session headline, drawn from a persisted shuffled deck so consecutive sessions never repeat.
OpenDesign agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: senior product-designer persona, 85 functional skills, 152 open-source design-system skills, a settings panel, and a local OpenDesign MCP bridge.
MeetClip for DeepSeek Harness: capture live streams, videos and meetings, transcribe them, take timestamped notes and search the local library.

webCandidates.description: Skin Studio for the DSH Web UI: a wallpaper-style color gallery in Settings that swaps the whole interface palette with one click (light & dark variants, persisted).
Restart button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: one row in Settings → General plus an entry in the sidebar account menu, restarting the Host through its systemd user service when detected.
Right-click menu for file links in the DeepSeek Harness chat: open with, save as, copy path, copy content, reveal in Finder or Explorer.
Hot-pluggable dark-gothic skin for the dsh web GUI: pitch-black backdrop, blood-red & molten-gold accents, bone-white text, frosted translucent panes
把「AI 智能日历」嵌进 DeepSeek Harness：侧栏面板 + 可拖拽定时任务浮窗 + Agent 日历工具（查询 / 新增 / 修改 / 删除日志与任务），AI 直接走 Harness 已配置的 DeepSeek。
DeepSeek Harness 桌面端划词追问，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时解释文字与代码。

Live two-column card board of the current session's main and sub agents in DeepSeek Harness: the main agent on top, sub agents by creation time below it, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost, and runtime on every card.
FreePi for DeepSeek Harness: free AI models, paid for by ads shown above the composer
Git source-control tab for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — changes, history, branches, merge, stash and worktrees for a workspace's repository
Memory capture and inspection for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — a /remember command that writes into the AGENTS.md hierarchy, and a tab showing which instruction files the loader actually kept
Durable plans for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — captures every exit_plan_mode plan to <workspace>/.dsh/plans as markdown, opens a review window when one is presented, and keeps the history
Themes, accents and font pairings for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — ten curated palettes as ctx.theme override layers, with live whole-app preview in Settings
Weather bar for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — current conditions at the bottom of the web UI via Open-Meteo, rendered into shell.overlay
Dafeiyu voice chat for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek speech recognition, speech synthesis and image understanding behind a draggable floating panel.

Polymarket Proxy for DeepSeek Harness: a local portfolio, cash and deposit-address panel with an auto-refreshing market radar, live betting and instant position closes — for when the official Polymarket site blocks deposits or trading. Follows the Harness language (English unless the interface is Chinese).
在 DSH Desktop 标题栏（与最小化/还原/关闭同栏）的「编辑」右侧新增蓝底白字伪 3D 的「刷新」按钮，按下即重新加载 DSH Desktop 页面；有对话运行时按钮禁用并弹警告，全静默才允许刷新。
Time & Timer for DeepSeek Harness: a synced clock with lunar date, China holidays, and a 15-minute timer.
Attach the current Chrome tab to a DeepSeek Harness draft: one pick screenshots the page (degrading to a macOS window shot) and writes its title + URL as one text line.
Privacy defaults for DeepSeek Harness: disable official feedback exports, session-log upload, package inventory and desktop analytics; not a network firewall.
A DSH plugin that adds /new: open a blank session in the current workspace and carry the old session's permission preset and agent preset over to it.
知识银河 — DeepSeek Harness 知识收录看板插件：学习 / 学术 / 日常三种模式，对话收录与定时收录，分组看板与时间轴，单星系星图与跨模式知识联系。

Human-directed selective compaction for DeepSeek Harness: fold an explicitly requested span of earlier turns (recent or arbitrary) into one summary, with a mandatory approval prompt and a fold-shaped summary template.
Set one HTTP proxy for plugin and package installs, with a switch and an editable address in the DSH Web UI.
情感陪伴向的 DSH 记忆插件：分层记忆 + 人格注入 + 学说话语料库，附「她的记忆」面板（记忆/人格/表情包/主动消息/B站/贴吧/QQ/学说话/服务）。后端是独立的 Python 服务（SQLite）。
在设置中添加按地址安装插件（可选 web/desktop profile）、第三方插件管理（启用/停用/卸载/版本检测更新）并一键重启 Desktop 的界面
Updates and plugin management for the DeepSeek Harness Windows desktop app: a sidebar entry beside Settings and a Settings section, driven by the app's native bridge.
LifeCode Skill-Compiler: compila el conocimiento reutilizable de una tarea en una skill propuesta, ligada a su proyecto y fuera de todo repositorio.
Clean-room DSH plugin: use Claude and ChatGPT (Codex) subscriptions as LLM provider routes with OAuth login, streaming, and subscription usage display.
Ultracode session mode for DeepSeek Harness: a three-position composer control that arms automatic multi-agent workflow orchestration by injecting an arming banner ahead of the user's own message.
Audio the agent can hear: speech transcription with timestamps, tempo/beat grid/downbeat, key & chords, song structure, loudness and cut-on-beat — local ffmpeg + DSP, no cloud required.
Weed image annotation assistant for DSH: the plugin owns the data contract, storage, visual review and export; the agent decides how images are annotated.
Obsidian Memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness — persistent memory via local Markdown vault

DeepSeek Harness plugin: run open-weight LLMs on your own GPU virtual machine on Hugging Face (a Space), started when you send a message and paused when idle, with live progress and cost in the Harness interface.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: lasting bots with their own name, photo, persona, memory, voice and model, configured by talking to them, each with a hidden brain that follows the conversation and prepares what will help.
RouterAI credit balance and period spend in the harness sidebar.
RouterAI price table for the profile's models with the active one highlighted.
Plays a system sound when the AI finishes responding or a pending approval appears in DeepSeek Harness.
Billing season and account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI composer: a native-looking pill after the cache-hit stat, with a panel on click. DeepSeek Harness 计费时段与余额插件
File Explorer for DeepSeek Harness: right-side resizable file tree (expand/collapse, search, syntax-highlighted preview, in-panel editing) with one-click VS Code / system file manager open
Active sessions bell for DeepSeek Harness with running task indicators and recent session filters
Return from Plugins, Schedules and Context Insights to the current chat
Review file notes above the composer and send them with your message
Select text in a DSH reply: a floating toolbar that quotes it into the composer draft or opens a side chat about it.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: export a session as human-readable Markdown or a self-contained HTML page — full / handoff / readable / audit presets, one-click download from the Session Header.
Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work
Mark DSH sidebar conversations with a tinted background, a colored dot at the row's end, and a per-conversation title size.
Compact or tile sidebar shortcuts with per-entry visibility and native mode
Add a Restart DSH button to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI. The button stops the dsh web process; an external supervisor (e.g. macOS launchd LaunchAgent) restarts it automatically so the UI comes back.

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for Jenkins: AI-invocable jenkins_* tools (build trigger/status/log/history/artifacts, job ops), panel on the dsh official right-sidebar (triggered-build overview, multi-level job tree, build log & artifacts viewer), connection & token settings card, and automatic build-failure analysis pushed back into the triggering session.

DSH sandbox extension: configurable trusted writable roots outside the workspace, read restrictions, and capability-based command allow-listing for sandboxed CLI commands. 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加「沙箱授权目录」「禁读规则」与按能力类判定的「命令放行」规则。
Browser tabs for DeepSeek Harness, including a remote browser bridge so DSH can drive a browser that is not on the same machine
Local file manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: browse, preview, download, upload, edit, rename and delete host files from the browser, over the same authenticated DSH web server
给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话列表加安全的会话删除入口：删除会话前先完整备份到本地、校验通过后再删，支持子代理会话级联处理与自定义备份位置。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt with your own configured model, and can restore the draft it replaced.

DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。含红队模式、无限制模式、无限制模式·子任务；三套预设。rc2.12 加结构性推脱判定（不依赖措辞）、重试前历史净化与采样回暖、surface 按 aiBase 判定，继续加强破甲。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 本版为 0.2.2-rc.3 / rc.1 适配分支（满血）。
Right-click selected text in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI to translate it in place, and restore the original with one more right-click.
DSH 会话回收站：/recycle 斜杠命令 + 侧边栏 GUI（删除/恢复/彻底清除，删除即时摘除侧栏行）；v1.4.0 起定时任务（自动化任务）同样纳入回收站语义（删除可恢复，/recycle sched 与面板页签）；v1.4.1 修复面板按钮点不动（弹层 portal 到 body，脱离侧边栏层叠上下文）
Agent Teams route selection: choose a teammate provider, model, and reasoning effort at spawn time, with a model catalog tool, a Settings page, and follow-parent or fixed-route policy.
Cross-tool session migration plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): high-fidelity ingest, continue, knowledge extraction, bidirectional export, privacy redaction.
Cross-tool session migration plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): high-fidelity ingest, continue, knowledge extraction, bidirectional export, privacy redaction.

Re-enable the loopback-only privileged surface (settings page, durable settings persistence) for a dsh Web profile served to a non-loopback origin, for the authorities the deployment declares — the deliberate exception the self-hosted image used to carry as a build-time patch

侧边栏面板菜单的布局与排序：按钮行/列表切换、按钮行行数上限、拖动排序，溢出项收进「更多」，并把左下角「更多」里的设置/意见反馈/登录并入面板菜单。Choose a button-row or list layout for the sidebar panel menu, cap the rows, drag to reorder, fold overflow into More, and absorb Settings / Feedback / Sign in from the bottom-left launcher.

Local DeepSeek Harness models with SSH remote folders and file tools
克制的奶蛙 Harness 主题：半头背景、抱腹大笑标题标记、发送与完成音效。
DSH conversation branches and context editing
DeepSeek Harness plugin: set a photo as the harness background, name and paginate a library of them, and tint, blur or fade the interface on top.
左上角「文件清理」按钮：选「所有工作区」或「DSH_HOME」，二次确认后只删白名单内的垃圾文件，绝不越过所选范围。
标题栏「个性化外观」入口：次级菜单里切换主题（Codex / Claude Code，含思考中的鲸尾图标）、圆角风格、毛玻璃与动效，即时生效。
右键删除侧边栏会话：连同会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账一起清干净，不影响其它会话。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Git commit-graph view with lanes, refs, and worktree management, beside the chat input
DSH Web GUI plugin: a polished-gold rendition of the sidebar brand lockup (whale mark, deepseek wordmark and HARNESS plate) built from the original vectors.
Turns the words you type into the composer into a well-formed prompt before the model ever sees them, using a cheap side call on the same route.

极简：给 DSH 装一个 B 站分身，让 agent 按自己规划的作息运营 B 站 —— 什么时候活跃、什么时候歇着都它自己排（schedule；没排时宿主按兑底节拍问「现在想干嘛」）；刷视频、看懂、写日记、想评论就先写草稿给主人看、批准后才发，真喜欢就点赞 / 关注 / 投币，有人 @ 它 / 回它也想回也先给主人看草稿（与主人共用账号）。写额度 / 判重 / 风控熔断 / 计划上限写死在工具里。
内置 zk 的 DSH 知识库 / 日记插件：装好即用 —— 自动装 zk、建笔记本，给 agent 一组 zk_* 工具（搜索、读写、日记、双链），设置页里管路径、索引与自检。
Star models in the DeepSeek Harness composer model menu and pick them from a Favourites block.

Free-channel console for DSH: one settings section, three tabs. Account lanes (CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, mounted by this plugin; the host accountPool is reused when present), local service lanes (OpenCode free tier, FreeLLMAPI gateway, Ollama) with HTTP probes, and 21 bring-your-own-key / keyless channels (OpenRouter free, Groq, Cerebras, Google AI Studio, Cloudflare, Mistral, DashScope, ModelScope, Zhipu, Moonshot, Qianfan, Volcano, SiliconFlow, StepFun, Spark, Hunyuan, MiniMax, NVIDIA NIM, Together, SambaNova, Pollinations). Own-key lanes can be filled in, tested and cleared right on the page (11-way probe classification) and a saved key mounts the lane immediately. Channel data is a three-layer catalog (shipped <- remote JSON <- local override) so new channels arrive without a release; a version check covers plugin upgrades. Every channel carries a readiness state and an actionable reason instead of a button that always fails.
两级模型调度：先在模型层选最优模型，再在渠道层选该模型的最佳渠道；失败先换渠道再换模型。新会话第一条消息就按调度结果调用模型，可选「自动选择」让官方选择器只作展示，偏好模式下锁定一个模型、用尽所有渠道后才降级并提醒；实时显示额度、健康与用量。

网易云音乐浮窗播放器（ncm-player5）：完整继承 ncm-player4（歌单/歌词/歌词翻译/播放队列/账号登录，适配皮肤主题；点击播放窗口外即收起为迷你条；迷你条无操作 3 秒自动退出为右下角音符按钮；播放中该按钮随音乐节奏（低频鼓点）跳动；右下角图标支持左键长按拖动），新增：遇到因下架/无版权而无法播放的歌曲时自动跳过，播放下一首

A living plan for DeepSeek Harness sessions: one Markdown file per session, versioned, editable by you, posted into the conversation and re-posted after every compaction with the user's own words, so long sessions keep to what the user wants now
Usage-driven tuning advice for DeepSeek Harness: reads your own sessions, recommends per-module settings, and writes per-model compaction thresholds in one click

Per-turn skill audit for DeepSeek Harness, plus an in-app skill manager: a resident panel showing which skills each turn invoked, an install sheet that adds, replaces and removes skills without leaving the app, and per-skill provenance so an installed skill can be checked for and pulled up to its author's latest revision. Fork of dsh-echocat-skill-panel with the composer strip removed.

DSH plugin: manages the Windows llama-server.exe model lifecycle (start / stop / switch / recover) behind a stable OpenAI-compatible gateway, with graceful Ctrl+C shutdown that actually frees VRAM.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：语音 + 通知出口——agent 通过云端 TTS（火山 seed-tts / 小米 MiMo V2.5，失败自动回退 SAPI）/ 桌面通知 / 提示音主动联系用户。融合 dsh-plugin-notify 的 DSH 原生深度集成与 agent-voice-mcp-minus 的云端 TTS 调优，零 Python 依赖，Windows 原生。
Scan and fix Low integrity labels, non-inherited S-1-4 sandbox ACEs, and related Everyone deny ACEs in DSH workspaces on Windows, with verification and one rollback record per workspace.
GarbageMaster: a Linux disk-space scanner, rule-based explainer, and guarded cleanup console for the DSH Web UI.
Real-time session cost meter for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: folds provider token usage into a per-session cost projection and displays it live under the composer.

Stop and really remove subagents and Agent Teams teammates: retire their catalog/roster records in the parent session log (seq-preserving tombstones) and move their session directories to a recoverable trash — or delete them outright with purge. Shows the running plugin version in the panel. | 子代理/团队成员管理：停止运行实例、从子代理目录与团队花名册中真正移除，会话文件进可恢复回收站，也可选彻底删除。
归档对话面板：点开侧边栏图标即可看到全部已归档的对话，批量选中后一起取消归档或永久删除。
每日语音便签 DSH web 插件：轻量浮动便签（勾选完成可取消/可编辑/可添加/可删除）+ JSON 按日日志 + 周/月数量环比统计。保留 AI 语音抽取闭环，去掉番茄钟。
任务提示音：DSH 需要你确认或一轮结束时播放 Windows 提示音，音效可在设置页里挑选并试听。

DSH sidebar footer quota & balance monitor with a Settings section (设置→插件管理): always-on DeepSeek Rage (¥), plus per-provider status rows — OpenCode Go HP/MP/SP (monthly/weekly/5h) and SCNet (国家超算) Credits remaining estimated locally from DSH session logs. Provider selectable (auto/opencode/scnet), meters toggleable.
划词批注与引用锚点：划词 → 批注（自动编号）→ 引用；引用块在输入框和已发送消息里始终可见（最多 3 行、位置行隐藏），点一下跳回原文并高亮；模型按「Annotation N：」逐条回应，回复里的标签可悬浮看原文与评语。纯客户端，锚点存本地 localStorage。
DSH 侧边栏置顶区：把常用的工作区与会话钉在「工作区」上方，会话行同步官方状态（运行中转圈 / 完成绿点 / 等待处理黄点）。
Shell-style prompt history in the DeepSeek Harness composer: ArrowUp walks back through the messages you already sent, ArrowDown walks forward and restores your draft.
Shell-style prompt history in the DeepSeek Harness composer: ArrowUp walks back through the messages you already sent, ArrowDown walks forward and restores your draft.
Predicts your next instruction from the current conversation and shows it as the composer placeholder; press Tab to turn it into an editable draft.
Shows each provider's brand mark beside the model name in the DeepSeek Harness composer model selector.
A usage panel for provider plans: shows how much of each quota window is left (GLM Coding Plan and OpenCode Zen) as a compact chip next to the model selector, with a detail popover.
Predicts your next instruction from the current conversation and shows it as the composer placeholder; press Tab to turn it into an editable draft.
Shows each provider's brand mark beside the model name in the DeepSeek Harness composer model selector.
DwGuard-Dsh-Hmos — DSH 侧的鸿蒙双 Agent 编排与外部审计插件：任务包、对抗预审、派发、四维验收、返工与知识沉淀，外加设计参考库/范式包推荐、审计门禁、包级反馈与推荐基准。

img2img-studio 的 GUI 插件（一个包两个面）：① 输入框里的图片编辑器（编号标记 / 移除背景 / 涂抹擦除 / 调整大小，支持键盘操作与裁切遮罩预览）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（供应商目录选择 + 脚本扫描标注、账号库驱动 chatgpt-web 通道、每行测试/试跑/复制命令、保存前预览、余额探测；中/英双语），保存即写回两个 skill 的 scripts/.env
Search field for the DSH Web Settings panel: independent candidate list over the content column, click to navigate to the owning section and focus the setting
Todo-backed turn-stop gate and prompt plugin for DeepSeek Harness: blocks stop on unfinished work and prompts on no-todo or stale-todo streaks, configurable in the settings page.

webCandidates.description: DeepSeek Harness 原生批量任务插件：选择 Agent、独立任务目录、SDK 会话投递与停止管理
NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.

Aliyun DashScope (Bailian) model provider for DeepSeek Harness: registers an `aliyun` route whose model list comes from the configured endpoint itself, with a shipped fallback catalog for capacities and offline use.

Restart DeepSeek Harness and update its plugins from the sidebar: pick which updates to apply, keep a blacklist for the ones you never want, uninstall from the same list, and reopen the window where it was. · 侧栏一键更新插件与重启 Harness：逐项勾选要更新的插件、维护更新黑名单、直接卸载插件，重启后窗口回到原来的位置。
混合架构大模型记忆：KV 权威层 + 向量派生索引 + 艾宾浩斯衰减 + 可选 Jev 判别

Cross-session message forwarding for DeepSeek Harness: extract a user message, a model reply, or a multi-selected batch from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery.
Native, local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: ingest local documents, retrieve with Chinese n-gram/BM25, and answer with citations

TRAE-style conversation rollback for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn checkpoints, file restore + in-place conversation truncation, a /rollback command, and a Web rollback button with an affected-file preview
Model and reasoning-effort switcher: composer seat with an Off/Max effort slider over session.models / session.selectModel
OLED burn-in care for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: true-black nap screensaver, pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming with an idle/focus ladder, and slow accent-hue rotation.
Add support for specialized agents and subagents to DeepSeek Harness. Features 100% Google Antigravity compatibility.
Native Google Antigravity rules loader and runtime enforcement engine for DeepSeek Harness
Native DSH plugin for context-mode: SQLite FTS5 indexing, bounded execution, and context window protection
Native DSH plugin for persistent message history navigation via arrow keys
Lucky — a draggable 3D parrot desk pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
Diagnose DeepSeek Harness session integrity failures and continue from safe recovery boundaries
DeepSeek Harness 审批提醒插件：需要用户审批时在桌面右下角弹出系统级通知（显示所属工作区名称，点击跳转到对应工作区）并播放提示音。Cross-platform approval alert: native OS notification with workspace name, click-to-jump and chime.

Jupyter notebook support for the dsh-better-sidebar editor: .ipynb opens inline as a runnable notebook viewer with IDEA/PyCharm-style run mode (Ctrl+Enter / Shift+Enter / run-all shortcuts, IDEA toolbar, gutter run icons, In/Out labels, execution duration, collapsible tracebacks), a lazy-start Python kernel (jupyter_client + ipykernel via python/bridge.py), background execution and save-back. Registers the ipynb file viewer through the ctx.betterSidebar service.
dsh-better-sidebar 的运行配置插件：模仿 IntelliJ IDEA 运行/调试配置，支持 npm/springboot/python/custom 命令执行、历史保存、快捷启动、实时日志查看，单 Tab 内分栏布局（左配置树 + 右日志流）
dsh-better-sidebar 的终端增强插件：内嵌 Nerd Font 图标字体、修复 xterm 负字距半边图标、底部面板遮挡对话框兜底与自动终端抑制、切换工作空间不重载终端、终端复制/粘贴/中断快捷键

MCPHub 桥接插件（DSH Web GUI）：把 MCPHub（默认本地 http://localhost:3000，@samanhappy/mcphub）聚合暴露的全部 MCP server 工具桥接进 DSH。宿主侧以 MCP Streamable HTTP 客户端连接 MCPHub 聚合端点 /mcp（或 /mcp/<group> 分组端点），把发现到的工具以 mcp__mcphub__<server>-<tool> 形式注册为 agent 原生工具；提供 mcphub_status / mcphub_resync 两个 agent 工具，/api/dsh-mcphub/status 与 /api/dsh-mcphub/connection 两条宿主路由（与 dsh /api 网关同一条信任线，环回与 trustedHosts 均放行）。地址默认本地但可在插件详情页直接编辑：保存后写入 ~/.dsh/dsh-mcphub/config.json 并立即重连，重启 dsh 后依然生效。断线自动指数退避重连、工具集热同步（tools/list_changed），无需改 dsh 源码。

opencode Go 套餐余额查看插件（DSH Web GUI）：侧边栏直接显示 rolling(5小时)/weekly(周)/monthly(余额) 三档用量进度条、百分比与重置时间，60s 自动刷新，无需点击；点击打开详情面板（倒计时、状态徽章、端点/密钥信息）；agent 工具 opencode_go_balance 可直接回答套餐用量。密钥默认取 llm-pi-ai 的 opencode-go 路由 apiKeyEnv（OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，官方 opencode 模型专用密钥）并经 credentials 服务解析，端点默认 https://opencode.ai，无需二次配置。零构建依赖、纯 JS 即装即用：`dsh plugin --profile web add @dong-victor/dsh-opencodego-usage`。
Model-facing dsh_debug_web tool: run JavaScript inside the live Harness page and read its captured console output, riding the existing Cordis Host-to-Client inspect channel.
Edit, create, rename, copy, delete and paste workspace files in the DSH web GUI: an editable document renderer, a file-tree sidebar tool with its own clipboard, and six trusted host routes.

Resize the DSH Web settings dialog (default 800x800), group its controls on a dedicated Settings -> Advanced page (three tabs: UI / Host / Agent), and add Host controls: restart / restart-when-idle, last start time, a dsh version / update check with dist-tag channel switching and an update arrow next to the logo, a machine name that takes over the sidebar brand area (falling back to a line under the logo), a scheduled-restart badge next to the logo, a read-only provider / model / thinking-level cell added beside the official composer performance-and-usage pills, and a Host-side toggle for whether the three restart tools are exposed to agents (register/unregister at runtime, no restart needed).
Sidebar-foot dock that lists the sessions currently in progress.
Adds a Restart row to the DSH sidebar foot beside Settings: the desktop app restarts itself out-of-process, then the tab reloads so a freshly installed plugin bundle is actually picked up.
DSH 多平台 AI 客服工作台插件：Chrome 扩展接管已登录的电商网页（闲鱼/抖音），本地 WS 桥 + AI 自动回复（带闸门与审计）+ 资料库（知识库）
Plays video and audio inside the DSH right sidebar, including the dsh-better-sidebar file tree, with byte-range seeking when the server supports it.
Command center for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: which project to pick up next, laptop health, memory backups and fleet status, in a panel that opens on startup.
A film-ready oil car versus EV ownership cost demo for DSH Better Sidebar.
DeepSeek Harness bundle: open the harness home's AGENTS.md from Settings -> General.
Adds an Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, plus a switch for it in DSH general settings.
A macOS-style find bar for searching the current DeepSeek Harness conversation.
DeepSeek Harness 长会话守卫：检测思考循环和输出复读，按本地日志建议何时交接，并生成无需额外模型调用的交接文档
基元律动费用中心（个人维护版）：账户余额与限时额度、模型价格卡、近 30 天用量热力日历、连通检测与密钥管理。仅保留基元律动（tokenrhythm）一家渠道。凭据只存本机 host。
Per-session extra working directories for DSH: an option inside the session-settings page plus a runtime-context reminder that tells the model which extra directories this session may use.
Per-session settings infrastructure for DSH: a native right-sidebar settings page plus a host-side store and API that other plugins register their options into.
DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 系列兼容的提示词与宿主补丁插件：管理注入、规则集与 Skill，支持补丁应用/还原、密封 asar 自愈、会话回退和网络范围白名单。基于 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge 上游维护。

DSH bundle：图片生成面板（generate_image 工具 + 侧边栏图库/提示词库）、Token 用量/成本/活跃度面板，模型连接与速度测试面板（支持整批 / 整组 / 组内单个模型）、通知面板（会话完成 / 需要权限 / 模型失败 / 子智能体等 16 类事件，支持系统级通知）、MCP server 与 Skill 管理面板（增删改查 / 启停 / 连接测试 / frontmatter 校验），以及剪贴板面板（超长粘贴自动落盘，输入框只留 @ 引用）。
Move a workspace to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar once, from its menu. No favorites, pins, stars, or automatic reordering. No runtime dependencies, no saved state.
过程精简：把 DSH Web GUI 里的 Think / 工具调用等技术过程行折叠成友好摘要，面向文字工作者的非技术呈现。Collapses technical process rows in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI into a friendly summary pill.
DSH plugin: reorganize the current session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and table of contents — as a model tool, a composer button, and a Web endpoint.
多目录任务范围：让一个会话在多个任意目录间共享检索范围（DSH 插件，含 GUI 菜单与系统提示注入）。
DSH WebUI 控制台：一键检查更新、一键执行更新（核心 npm + 插件 pnpm）、一键重启。
DeepSeek Harness plugin for lightweight LAN access to the current Web UI from phones, tablets, and other computers.

AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、认知视图（价值卡、变更账本、开发须知、认知地图、健康时间线、资产清单）、单仓库索引与治理状态、绑定诊断、索引文件管控（aoci.txt / aoci.meta.txt / aoci.code.txt 的可视化编辑、结构校验、备份与恢复）、快捷动作与提示词，并为未接入的项目提供单仓库与批量引导式初始化；内置 AOCI 接入工具（aoci_bind_status / aoci_bind_repair / aoci_project_init / aoci_doctor，合并自 dsh-aoci-bind），用于发现、诊断、修复 MCP 绑定并初始化未接入的仓库。
AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval gates and a task panel.
Keep a running list of work items in a panel, copy any ISO week out as a weekly report, and let the configured model tidy the wording — 2 agent tools, no API key.
Pixel Office: a digital/pixel-art workspace theme for the DSH web GUI — six top-down desks, a sticky-note planning board, an archive drawer, and the real conversation embedded in a CRT monitor
DeepSeek Harness plugin: back up skills, plugins, MCP config, AGENTS.md and optional encrypted credentials to any WebDAV server
DSH 插件「速度监控」：侧栏入口点开右侧面板，用 DSH 的模型清单测中转流式速度；每个模型独立配置间隔/每轮次数/任务，曲线可切首字节/总耗时/吞吐，失败样本不入图。
Chat panel for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry that embeds chat.deepseek.com, keeps the page alive across panel switches, remembers the last conversation and restores the login snapshot.
提问引导（dsh-HelpMe-To-Ask）— 在模型动手前先问清楚目标、交付物与验收标准，整理成任务说明 / Ask before it builds: turn vague requests into a clear task sheet for DeepSeek Harness.
Token 账本：按本地日期监控 DSH 的每日 token 消耗（未缓存输入/缓存读取/输出），带设置页卡片、输入框徽标、/tokens 命令与 token_usage 模型工具。
大肥鱼工作室：让 DSH 里的 agent 在 B 站自学、整理自己的声音、把内容做成动态和视频，草稿经人点头才发。

Sweep the dsh web conversation list: a standalone page lists stored sessions by workspace, batch-archives the ungrouped test ones through the official workspace registry (stops running work first), and restores them anytime. 会话清扫器：按分组列出对话，一键归档未分组的测试对话（走官方注册表、先停运行任务），随时恢复。

Per-model failure-retry policy for DeepSeek Harness: retry count (0 = unlimited, counted per step) and fixed or incremental cooldowns, plus transient-error retries for direct model calls such as auto review. · 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型的重试次数与冷却时间策略，并补齐自动审查等直接模型调用的瞬时错误重试。
DSH Web 界面增强：QQ 聊天模式（气泡+联系人侧栏）、RGB 调色、Tool 卡片折叠、输入区状态条（含 token 估算）
DeepSeek Harness API 余额守卫：底部状态栏实时显示 API 余额（¥），低于自定义阈值时暂停模型输出并引导跳转充值页。
Shutup · 打断提示：模型思考/输出时按下快捷键立即打断当前生成并弹出输入框，载入你的修正提示（steer 注入当前回合），像 Claude Code 的 Tell Claude。快捷键可在 设置 → 通用 中录制修改。
Skill and MCP visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: the global layer sets a default, and each workspace can override any name both ways, with a sidebar panel and an input-card entry.
在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 DOTV 无限画布：读画布、加节点、跑生成。
Control the session header's Open with menu: choose, order, and remove applications, pin a default, and add applications installed on this machine (macOS and Windows).
DeepSeek Harness MCP connector panel: browse a connector catalog, connect MCP servers, manage credentials, and import mcpServers JSON.
Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for Flow2Spec

Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): auto-recall relevant memories before answering, auto-save key facts after answering, full CRUD/search tools, and a visual settings page for memory management.
Live per-session cost badge in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header (top-right), with peak/off-peak (峰谷分时) pricing.
在 DSH 右侧文档预览头部加一个「复制文件」按钮：把正在预览的文件放进 Windows 剪贴板，可直接粘贴到任意文件夹。
为 DSH「插件」页的已安装插件设置别名：卡片标题显示「别名（原包名）」
Drive an already-running Chromium browser from DSH over CDP — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc, Thorium: one approval per connection, no new tools, no runtime dependencies.

A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin: the active provider's account balance or subscription usage (DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, Kimi Coding, OpenCode, MiniMax, plus Claude Code and Codex OAuth tokens), provider-id mappings for third-party provider plugins, OAuth token fields for Claude Code and Codex, and per-token unit prices for models whose provider has a built-in price snapshot — including DeepSeek's peak/off-peak schedule — in a Chinese/English UI.

DSH Web plugin: a Delete button on every session row. Stops running work, releases the session, removes the log (plus subagent logs) and lets you tick which files the session created should be deleted too.
Side questions for DeepSeek Harness: /btw answers without interrupting the running turn, using the session's own model and conversation.
Read-side approval gate for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted reads, per-session read modes, and a merged read/write permission control

Fold and expand the dsh web chat window automatically: event-cycle checkpoints (every 25 session events, from N=75) fold older loaded pages beyond the recent 50 rows when the viewport sits at the bottom; scrolling to the very top appends up to 50 earlier messages with the viewport kept in place, repeated until no more history. Per-session isolated; window stays below ~75 rows (low-end friendly); system "Load earlier" button hidden; optional maxExpandPages memory guard. Verified against DSH 0.1.2-rc.1. Configurable via row config (foldThreshold=50, foldCheckEvery=25, maxExpandPages=0). A DSH web profile bundle.
D友の酒 · Dyou Wine: fixed-rhythm page bounce, a flying whale-girl pet and bundled BGM for DeepSeek Harness.
Local, verifiable delivery evidence reports for coding-agent work.
《战双帕弥什》赛琳娜陪你使用 DeepSeek Harness：任务进行时换上花嫁表情，完成后用她的声音和字幕回应；可以摸摸头、拖一拖，自选表情、语音和台词，喝水久坐也会提醒你。支持 Windows 10/11 x64 本机 Harness；首次需下载约 345 MiB 完整程序。
B站 400+ 收藏的守岸人桌宠，现在来陪你了。《鸣潮》的守岸人陪你工作，也陪你等待。任务中换表情，完成后用熟悉的语音回应；支持摸头互动、自选表情与语音台词。适用于 Windows x64 本机 DeepSeek Harness，首次下载约 229 MiB 完整程序。
Model picker starring: star models and pin them into one global group at the top of the menu, across providers.

Plugin updater and uninstaller for DeepSeek Harness profiles. Backs up the profile, updates or removes plugins, re-derives dsh.profile.bundles, verifies composition and a real boot, and rolls back on failure. 深度求索 Harness 插件更新/卸载器:先备份,再更新或卸载,对账 bundles,组合校验加真实启动验证,失败自动回滚。

Volcengine Ark (火山方舟) Agent Plan and Coding Plan model routes for DeepSeek Harness: two ready provider profiles declared on the shipped llm-pi-ai adapter, a session-header pill showing each plan's remaining allowance and when it next refreshes, and a Settings page that enables or disables individual models in the model selector.
DeepSeek Harness 对话折叠：让思考行与工具行可以单独收起，并在回合结束后自动折叠中间过程。官方 Chat 的紧凑折叠在「回合未结束」或「历史未全部加载」时完全不生效，长回合于是铺满几十条过程行；本插件补上这层，不改写任何官方节点。

Connect locally signed-in Trae models to DeepSeek Harness, plus a read-only usage/credits summary. (Hardened fork: a Trae shim that is missing or not yet listening can no longer abort harness startup.)
OpenCode Go model provider for DeepSeek Harness with live model discovery, connection status, and compatibility with the 0.1.6, 0.1.7, and 0.2 release trains.
Archived-session cleanup for the dsh web client: per-row delete and delete-all over the real session logs

Harness token-usage report: provider-reported tokens folded out of this harness's session logs across dsh 0.1.6/0.1.7 session-format generations, backed by a grow-only per-session ledger so deleting a session no longer deletes its usage

Wallhaven wallpapers for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: search wallhaven.cc from a settings page, wear any result as the shell background (with opacity/blur/scrim controls), and download the original to disk. The host half fetches everything, so the browser never has to reach wallhaven — which matters behind a proxy or a poisoned DNS.

Wallpaper Engine Steam Workshop browser for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: search the workshop without logging into Steam, and see at a glance whether this machine has a Steam session. Wallpapers are the ones Wallpaper Engine itself uses — subscribe from the opened page to wear them on the desktop.
DSH web 错误哨兵：加载页注入 + errorTell 端点 + 设置页「错误哨兵」分区（读取插件/手动禁用恢复）
换台电脑，接着聊。同步会话、附件、设置和项目文件。
换台电脑，接着聊。同步会话、附件、设置和项目文件。
Sidebar chip showing DeepSeek's current price period, the selected model's per-million-token prices, the account balance and today's spend.
哈基金 —— DSH 的散户场外基金助手插件：基金池、指标评分、偏好推荐与模拟盘复盘（只给建议和操作步骤，不接触账户、不下单）。
Dracula color theme for DeepSeek Harness: a token-level reskin of the whole Web GUI, switchable in Settings → General.
Set the default initial directory of dsh's workspace directory picker (native + browse backends), with a GUI settings card. 设置 dsh「添加工作区」目录选择器的默认初始目录（含 GUI 设置卡片）。

Right-sidebar console for DeepSeek Harness: detects Maven modules with a Spring Boot main class and Vite frontends, starts and stops them (batch and detached mode), packages with Maven or pnpm, uploads artifacts over SSH/SFTP to named deploy environments with progress and per-environment remote dirs, restarts the docker container and checks its status.
OpenCode Zen 免费模型 —— 为 DSH 注入免 key 的 OpenCode Zen 免费档模型：设置页一键同步官方 free 模型、逐个启停、手动补模型，并可一键写入 llm-pi-ai provider 配置。
把多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型池：多账号轮转、手动签到、积分自动化、模型/积分包到期提醒与可选模型配置页面。
把本机所有 WorkBuddy 登录账号聚合成一个模型池：账号自动发现、签到、积分与到期、临期提醒、自动签到、模型与倍率，并可在输入框下方切换账号与查看剩余总积分。
按会话可见性裁剪 Tool / MCP 工具 / Skill 的宿主+浏览器双半插件。Phase 0 只做确定性状态、纯函数可见性解析、Fail Open 与可执行门禁。
Polish (Polski) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — a community DSH client plugin that adds pl to Settings → General → Language.

Encrypted credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: secrets and master password are typed only in a user popup, commands run with {{placeholder}} substitution after approval, output is redacted — nothing secret reaches the agent context.
Move a DSH workspace folder to a new path, give every new session its own output folder under sessions/, and restart the desktop app from the header.

webCandidates.description: DSH × Univer integration with a bundled collaboration Gateway and Viewer: inline previews, live floating Worktree windows, and session-end review actions in DeepSeek Harness.
DSH × Univer integration with a bundled collaboration Gateway and Viewer: inline previews, live floating Worktree windows, and session-end review actions in DeepSeek Harness.
Cursor subscription provider plus read_image vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness in one plugin

Full session management for the DSH web UI: delete (with trash/restore/purge), restore archived sessions, activity stats, continue/pause, fork to a new chat, unread markers, and open log folders. Plus a global context compaction threshold. No harness changes.
Cross-platform (macOS + Windows) DeepSeek Harness plugin that syncs DSH config — skills, profile settings, AGENTS.md — with a private dsh-config repository.
DSH 周报复盘：/weekly 命令 + 5 工具 + 13 路由 + 五 Tab 可视化洞察页；内置确定性流水线与分析技能（8 色语义色板 / Gauge·Radar·Treemap·StackedArea / 可滚动 / 提示气泡 / 全文本对比度 ≥4.5 / i18n）
DeepSeek Harness Intelligent UI: generative, interactive UI in the chat (declarative component catalog + sandboxed streaming HTML widgets), inspired by CopilotKit OpenIntelligentUI.
Inkfall theme for the DSH Web GUI: an ink-wash skin with rice-paper grain, gold hairlines, a corner astrolabe and serif typesetting.
Codex-style right-click menus for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: copy/cut/paste/select-all on text, copy path and reveal in the file manager for file chips, copy or open for links.
右栏的 Markdown 标签类型：渲染工作区里的 .md/.markdown 文件并可原地编辑保存（保存走 Host 半的一条窄路由，版本守卫用内核自己的 FsVersion），公式与代码高亮复用内核客户端已有的 KaTeX/Shiki，自己不带渲染依赖。

The panel item registry and the pane that shows it: items are data (id, kind, title, source, order) with a closed kind set, the projection is a pure function that returns the sorted visible items plus every refused item by name, one read-only GET route serves both readings, and the browser half draws them in a right-rail pane (kind pane) beside the note ledger, where one note at a time can be written through /api/dsh-link-notes/add. No persistence, no registry write surface.
按会话启用的上下文管理（v3 单引擎）：原始历史全部可存、命中按需回注、观察面只读
DeepSeek Harness 多模态视觉桥：贴图自动转文字描述（llm/stream 代理）+ view_image/ocr_image 主动视觉工具 + 原生多模态路由自动跳过（rc.7 适配），让 text-only 的 DeepSeek 模型看见图片
Multi-key, multi-provider web search and fetch (Tavily + Exa) for DeepSeek Harness
A dedicated DeepSeek Web Chat window for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with structured, deduplicated and reversible handoffs into the Harness composer.
浏览归档会话并删除会话的 DSH 插件
DeepSeek Harness 的三合一能力台：提示词定制（按名称屏蔽 / 替换 / 注入 / 排序，按会话阶段与 agent 预设分层）+ 技能集合管理（导入 / 分组 / 开关）+ MCP Server 接入（分层遮蔽与工具级启停）。纯插件注入，不动官方源码。

多彩Harness — 22 light-only palettes (Pantone / Chinese traditional / Morandi), 14 composable surface effects, 12-shichen clock rotation, workspace binding, per-session colour marks and an optional account row for DeepSeek Harness.
按工作区控制 MCP 服务器的可见性与加载方式：连接时机、工具过滤、按 pack 分组。
按工作区为新建会话指定模型与子智能体档位路由，组合成可命名的 pack。
按工作区停用 DSH 插件：把插件的工具与提示词段从模型可见范围里摘掉，按 pack 分组管理。
按工作区控制 DSH skill 的可用性：工作区绑定一个 pack，pack 是具名的开关表。
DeepSeek Harness Latin American Spanish language pack (Español Latinoamérica - es-419)

Cut the input-token cost of long Harness sessions: structure-aware tool-output compression, three measured elision depths for how hard a long result is cut, per-agent tool-catalogue visibility, a graded composer panel that turns each saving on or off, a statistics page that reports what was saved, and a per-workspace session memory that is matched before the transcript is re-read.
DeepSeek Harness 桌宠插件：内置 Coopanion 鲸鱼娘分层精灵，随模型峰谷计价自动更换女仆装发带颜色，并常驻显示时段倒计时
DeepSeek Harness 永久插件：实时读取当前使用的 LLM API，在设置页呈现当前用量、分对话用量，并可扫描会话日志读取历史用量。

MCP Center: a settings-driven MCP server manager for the DeepSeek Harness. Register Streamable HTTP (no-auth / Bearer token / custom headers) or local stdio MCP servers from a dedicated Settings page; their tools publish as mcp__<name>__<tool> to the model. Self-contained MCP client, no external MCP SDK dependency.
A Nachoneko (甘城猫猫) themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, featuring the artist's artwork as the wallpaper background.
Let an agent send the user a native desktop notification (macOS Notification Center, Windows toast, Linux desktop alert) raised by the DeepSeek Harness itself.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：对话式游戏本地化，把 tav2（TranslateAgent v2）翻译流水线接入 dsh。引擎适配器架构，首发支持 Ren'Py。
Codex-style thinking summaries for DeepSeek Harness: condense each reasoning step into 1-3 bullet points inline, keep the full chain one click away.
System-level turn-finished alerts for DeepSeek Harness: native notification, app-icon badge and title dot on Windows and macOS.
Copy selected DSH conversation content as Markdown source
兔子皮肤：把 DSH 的窗口换成木屋里的白兔，体重五档可调。
统一管理 DSH 里的所有模型：设置页「模型开关」列出全部 provider 与模型（含插件动态注册的，内置 Models 页看不见的那批），支持逐模型与整组开关；关闭后模型会从所有模型选择器中消失。另提供 list_models 工具做只读查看。
AI 写小说，关键剧情由你拍板。右栏「拍板台」按章看全书决策：改选前先看会删多少字、作废几段、撤回哪些设定、重开哪些决策，确认后安全回退，旧正文留档可查。默认关闭，不写正文。

想用 AI 写几十万字、上百万字的长篇小说，却总担心 AI 忘记前面的剧情、人物和伏笔？每次都把大量旧章节塞进上下文，不仅费钱，还会挤占真正用于创作的空间。「褪色」让 AI 拥有一套会逐渐淡化的长篇记忆：最近的剧情记得清楚，久远的故事保留重点，重要人物和事件随时可以找回。写完一章自动整理记忆、保存原文，不必反复携带整部小说。减少不必要的 Token 消耗，把更多上下文和预算留给后续创作，让 AI 陪你把故事写得更长。
把原著导入，就能拥有一套专属的同人创作资料库。人物关系、剧情经历、世界规则，随时查阅；你想改写的人物命运、关系和剧情，也能按本作设定记录下来。写作时帮你理清人物知情、时间线和场景细节，写完还能检查人物 OOC、设定冲突和剧情前后矛盾。原著只是参考，你的故事由你决定。
导入你喜欢的小说与自己的旧稿，在本地提炼成可解释、可回滚的风格档案；写前编译 600 字简报，写后把 AI 味定位到句子，只改命中那一句。默认关闭，不打分，不训练模型。
DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: a mouse-following WebGL particle background recreated from antigravity.google, with a Settings toggle and light/dark palettes.
DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 IM 通道：扫码创建专属飞书应用，推送任务进展与审批请求，并可在飞书中直接指挥 DSH。

Windows: when a new workspace folder is added, ask once whether to trust it, then grant the NTFS rights DSH's workspace-write sandbox needs. When the folder is owned by another machine's account, the repair asks Windows for one approved UAC elevation instead of failing. Also shows a permission check in the composer when the current workspace is unusable, and lists every workspace in Settings.

DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: capture meeting system audio, transcribe with local SenseVoice, let DSH's LLM correct domain wording and optionally translate, keep a live summary, and answer questions from the meeting with web lookup. Windows 10/11 x64 only.

Windows DeepSeek Harness bundle that routes the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 (or forces Windows PowerShell 5.1), always redirects Remove-Item deletions to the Recycle Bin, with a Settings page (install status, self-check, route switch, installation picker for multiple detected PowerShell 7 installations, uninstall, system migration), system installation and upgrades through the official installer resolved from the release manifest (in-place MSI, then MSIX, then the MSIX bundle), a Web setup dialog with live download progress, and a sandbox-aware executor.
DeepSeek Harness 的 VRM 3D 桌宠：任务状态联动、独立悬浮窗、模型动作与 AI 碎碎念。
DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: manually zoom the whole interface on high-DPI displays, with Ctrl+wheel and Session-header controls.
Per-model default reasoning effort and image handoff for text-only models.
Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable scrim/border/blur.
DSH Web GUI 技能速查：在输入框工具行加一个按钮，用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的、什么时候用；点击任意一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。备注存在一个普通 JSON 文件里，随技能自动增补，可手改也可让 agent 补写。
Thinking-effort rheostat for the composer: a slider over the model adapter's own reasoning-effort levels.
Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace, Left/Right switch workspaces.

DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, WSL or Niubash on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.
A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render the session brief — the todo list (the `todos` projection board), the artifact list (a live produced-files feed, codeplan artifacts marked), a reference pane (skills / session recall / resident slots with a Details menu that deep-links into dsh-prime-memory's library) and an echo section fed by dsh-spirit's `spiritEcho` projection — as a summary tab in the right sidebar, and shadow the official composer-band todo panel so the board is the single visible carrier. Read-only.

dsh-browser-cdp: visible agent browser for DSH — drives the vendored ego-compatible Chromium over CDP, and can also attach to a running Chrome/Edge/Brave or route through egolite, Tabbit and Lightpanda backends. 35 structured bcdp_* tools; only bcdp_status stays resident by default (lazy injection, −91.9% schema per turn for non-browser sessions). Realtime watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picks quoted into the composer, human-verification notices; non-CDP channels sync frames by 3s polling. Web shell: floating watch ball without dsh-better-sidebar, sidebar tab with it. Headless/TUI hosts: tools-only. [DSH 0.1.0-rc.2 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1: declarative settings via Config .volatile() fields on 0.1.7+; imperative installSection / module-level registration + describe/mutate bridge on 0.1.0 ~ 0.1.5 (experimental, pending farm). Client peers stay optional so gen-1 hosts without dsh-client-store still load; for a production install on the current line use the 0.17.x line]
DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer) for the DSH 0.2.0 line: render Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` reports as a structured page in the right sidebar. Static parse only — no code execution.

Fixes the 'desktop welcome: Web authentication failed' (HTTP 431) launch failure caused by dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up in the desktop client's Chromium cookie store (random port per launch, ~70 entries overflow the 16KB header cap). Reports leftover entries with the estimated request-header occupancy and how much room is left before 431, and ships a standalone command that purges them once the client is fully closed (backup + atomic transaction, credentials/sessions/plugin config untouched); the settings panel audits your profile's cordis.patch.yml and one-click fixes connection.cookieMaxAgeDays (cookie lifetime, revertible). See README for usage.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render .docx documents as a readable structured view in the right sidebar — headings, paragraphs, lists, real tables, inline images — with a circuit breaker so no document can freeze the tab. Reading view, not a layout reproduction.
Union IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness 鈥?clean-room merge of dsh-im and dsh-im-connect capabilities, compatible across 0.1.2-rc.1 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 hosts.

Busy-time input queue for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: three-tier (now/next/later) planning, queue editing with drag-to-reorder and concurrency protection, interject (steer) and interrupt, batch clear with confirm, session freeze - a cordis client plugin, no dsh source changes, no PR required
DSH Web 插件：会话管理台 —— 统一管理活跃与归档会话（列表/筛选/收藏/归档与取消归档/批量清理/删除），外加四门会话体检。侧栏入口优先落在顶部工具槽位（插件行之后），宿主无该槽位时回落底栏。不维护索引、不依赖 DRS；搜索能力由 dsh-search-index 提供。（原名 dsh-session-steward，2.0.0 起搜索能力拆回 dsh-search-index）

dsh-mcp-registry: DSH plugin — a governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio / streamable-http). Multi-level fail-closed authorization (global switch → per-connector permission mode → per-tool grants → live server-annotation evidence), mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args loudly instead of silently dropping them, honest probe status with failure codes, credential redaction on every output boundary, and an agent bridge tool whose review-all default refuses rather than fakes approval. Learnings distilled from dsh-mcp-connector, dsh-mcp-panel and openhanako's core/mcp.

Media evidence lens + provider router for DeepSeek Harness: media_read_video / media_read_audio / media_read_image turn local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / regions) via host-registered multimodal models first, configured OpenAI-compatible endpoints second, and local ffmpeg/CLI fallbacks last. Every fallback is recorded in meta.attempts — a fallback is never silent.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks as a structured, sortable, filterable table in the right sidebar — with sheet tabs and a circuit breaker (rows/cols/cells plus the two zip-container gates) so no input can freeze the browser.
dsh-paste-dock — DeepSeek Harness 插件:大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留最小徽标。

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move, targeting the DSH 0.2.0 line (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render .pptx decks as a readable structured view in the right sidebar — slide list (in deck order, not filename order), text with bullet levels, speaker notes, inline pictures — with a circuit breaker so no deck can freeze the tab. Reading view, not a slide reproduction.

Preset doctor for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects broken agent presets (legacy format, renamed packages, stale config keys) and mechanically repairs them to the current 0.1.7+ syntax, with backup, atomic writes and idempotence. Also validates preset prompt injections (dsh-preset-studio `注入/*.md`) exactly the way the injector reads them.
L0~L3 分层蒸馏记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：自动捕获对话（L0）、抽取原子记忆（L1）、整合场景块（L2）、蒸馏核心画像/团队方法论（L3），并在模型步骤前自动召回注入。移植自 MemoryCore (TencentDB Agent Memory) 的管线设计。
DSH Web 插件：会话原文投影同步器（DRS）——只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions 会话日志，解码后投影进自有 SQLite（segments/replaces/FTS5），经 /api/dsh-reference-session-collector 提供 surface 标记、召回对账与内容检索面。绝不写会话文件。
DSH 会话检索插件：标题 / 内容双模式 FTS5 检索（内容检索硬依赖 dsh-reference-session-collector 投影库，按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段并支持命中定位），自带独立索引（增量同步、非破坏性整理、深度同步自愈、快照导入导出）。入口双形态：宿主 ≥0.1.7 走「插件页式」主栏整页，<0.1.7 走侧栏弹窗。
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
DSH 会话检索插件：标题 / 内容双模式 FTS5 检索（内容检索硬依赖 dsh-reference-session-collector 投影库，按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段并支持命中定位），自带独立索引（增量同步、非破坏性整理、深度同步自愈、快照导入导出）。入口双形态：宿主 ≥0.1.7 走「插件页式」主栏整页，<0.1.7 走侧栏弹窗。

Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28×28 square toggle collapses them to that single header line and expands them back. The fold state persists per window, kept-visible rows are picked from the live sidebar, and the managed rows' icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right.

Paste an article link and get a mind map, bolded key points, a section-by-section reading and a critique, plus draggable sticky notes for the sentences worth keeping. · 贴一个链接，读成结构导图、加粗要点、逐段精读与读后评论，还能把好句子收成便签。
Glassmorphism theme layer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
ChatGPT-style text quote for DSH web: select a sentence in a message, click 引用, and a faint quote line appears above the composer.
Run button for shell code blocks in DSH replies: executes the snippet through the host shell service and streams its output to a bottom-right dock, or to a bottom-panel tab per run.
Summon a ghost from the residual logs of a terminated subagent. It can only answer from the fragments it left behind. Not a debugger, not an observability panel—just listen before you delete.
Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the DSH model selector
Microsoft Web IQ search provider and configuration card for DeepSeek Harness
在会话菜单里删除一个对话，并按需带走它产出的文件、读过的文件、子代理对话与附件；删除先进回收站，可整组或单文件恢复，并可设保留天数与容量上限；侧边栏右下角的回收站入口可在插件页开关。· Delete a conversation together with what it produced, behind a restorable recycle bin.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the agent control SideFX Houdini
dsh-workbuddy 账号呵护：dsh-connect-workbuddy 的配套辅助插件。按 WorkBuddy 官方接口字段与安装包文件名解析出的版本号（取高者）与本地基线比对，不一致就提示并停用 dsh-connect-workbuddy、软结束正在用它的会话，并在界面顶部挂持久水印；同时自动升级 dsh-connect-workbuddy 自身。
Cordis Host integration for Engram persistent memory in DeepSeek Harness
DSH 跨会话任务状态悬浮球：扇形分色、完成会话收纳与状态突变提醒。

VSCode-style file/folder icon theme for the DSH right-Sidebar explorer: registers the whole theme through dsh-better-sidebar's public registerFileIcon API, and falls back to a pure DOM overlay (unload-safe) on a host without that service.

One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.

Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.

One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.

Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.

One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
Screenshot in, working UI out: several agents rebuild the same reference interface in parallel, and you pick the live result you like best.

Upload local files into the DeepSeek Harness session workspace: a 📎 button in the web composer, raw bytes saved under .uploads/<sessionId>/, the absolute path appended to the draft so the agent can read it (pair with dsh-word-docs for document workflows)
一键导出 / 还原 DSH 已安装插件（JSON 快照，浏览器设置页面板）
Push-to-talk dictation for DeepSeek Harness: hold a single key in the composer, release, and the transcript is inserted into your draft.

Generic idea manager for the DSH Web GUI: Host-authoritative /api/ideas ledger, capture, 4-column kanban (open / under review / archived / declined), one-click execution launch (mirrored TaskBoard card or a direct session), optional TaskBoard mirror; mounted without DSH source changes.
Searchable model picker for the DSH chat composer — adds a search/filter box to the model selection menu.
DSH 开发工具箱：按 Alt 悬浮查看界面元素归属、把踩过的坑记进随插件分发的经验库、开发模式下自动注入动手前的自检清单。
把 QQ / 微信等 IM 接成 DSH 的对话入口：手机上给机器人发消息，电脑上的 agent 干活（QQ 与微信可收发并接 agent，企微 / 飞书 / 钉钉目前只能收）。
给 DSH 的本地优先跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀 + 空闲自动整理 + 按需注入。重点是注入纪律（压缩后补回、不重复注入、敏感内容不注入、删改走审批）。数据全部存在本地 SQLite，不联网、不上传。
DSH git 自动提交推送插件——统一函数入口架构（规则/审计/git/自身/侧边栏/评分/豁免/上下文/HTTP/测试十大总入口）
会话级模型路由插件：dsh 里只注册一个虚拟模型，真实模型按会话映射转发（合法接入优先，配置型驱动）

DSH session management: panel with archive/trash/delete/undo, automatic rename and interrupted-session resume, six-way session-log repair (structure, zstd frames, seq gaps, EIO blocks, dual-format conflict, tool arguments), value analysis, full-text search, plan/closing template injection, and AI team tooling (per-member model and permission switching, member execution traces, cross-session messaging, memory recall, context usage).

DSH session management: panel with archive/trash/delete/undo, automatic rename and interrupted-session resume, six-way session-log repair (structure, zstd frames, seq gaps, EIO blocks, dual-format conflict, tool arguments), value analysis, full-text search, plan/closing template injection, and AI team tooling (per-member model and permission switching, member execution traces, cross-session messaging, memory recall, context usage).
DSH 会话迁移插件：扫描 .dsh/session.old/ 下的旧版本会话（v0 等），按实例实际会话版本契约投放并改写 cwd 绑定工作区，由 DSH 在打开会话时自动完成版本迁移；设置侧边栏提供导入 / 列表 / 工作区选择 / 转换四项 UI，外置多语言。
DSH skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数；设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理），Skill 排行固定按会话去重降序并分页（两种次数同时显示），会话榜按去重 skill 数排列并显示持久化会话标题；skill 工具与 read 直接读 skill 文件均记分；agent/pre-step 注入记分榜与 skill 实际路径；导入导出记分 JSON。
媒体景观主题 —— 动态媒体背景：立绘壁纸 + 霓虹配色 + 开屏动画 + 萤火粒子 + 背景音乐
插件宣传台 for DSH：输入插件名，在本机出 28 秒真机界面宣传片与封面。自带逐帧渲染器（本机 Chrome，运动模糊 + 硬切保护），npm 装完即可出片，不需要 Onetake 运行时。
Pomodoro focus timer for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: tracking, settings, phase-change signals, and agent tools.
基于 dsh-cost-meter 的 DSH 侧栏增强插件：侧栏底部「费用面板 ▾/▸」折叠 dsh-cost-meter 的费用卡片、侧栏「更多 → 编辑侧栏…」、设置页「归档会话清理」（归档会话移入 Windows 回收站）。

Codex Pets integration for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a transparent draggable desktop pet fully compatible with the codex-pets package format (V1/V2 spritesheet pets), following the current session's working state, plus a settings section to pick pets from the local pets directory
Drive external ACP agent CLIs (omp / opencode / command-code / ...) as DSH root agents. Engines are data rows, not code.

DSH web plugin: a left-sidebar panel that turns every session into a task timeline — one row per task stretch, the turns behind it, the files each turn produced, and a click straight into the right sidebar preview.
DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that shows the API balance beside Settings in the sidebar.
Smooth think-row preview + bottom-follow glide for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI: a pure DOM client plugin, no bundle changes
Connectome: an interactive, hardware-accelerated canvas map of a DSH workspace's files, folders and references (imports, links, asset paths), rendered with d3-force inside the Web UI.
