webCandidates.description: Prism Theme Studio: 24 hand-tuned light/dark palettes, six moods, scheme control, custom accents, favorites and a surprise shuffle for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
本地生图工作台,零订阅费:开自己的 API 生图(任意 OpenAI 兼容接口,零订阅),画布排版+修图/擦除/去背景/OCR/转矢量,可编辑 PSD/AI 交付,Photoshop/Illustrator 图层级双向桥接
Unified auto-continue + model failover for DeepSeek Harness: ordered fallback chain with circuit breaking plus automatic continuation of failed turns, one bilingual (RU/EN) settings card.
Session health insight projection (sessionInsight) plus a read-only dock card for the DeepSeek Harness: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated calls and failure rate.
Trello boards, lists, cards and comments as native DeepSeek Harness tools. API key + token authentication; no OAuth, no MCP, no public hostname.

DeepSeek Harness opens every new Session in a default Workspace that it pins to <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace — on Windows the system drive — and never relocates. This plugin inspects, repairs, and relocates that Workspace at runtime: it rewrites the Workspace record in the running Host, optionally moves the directory contents, and relocates or re-frames stored Session logs that still point at the old path.
本地 AI agent 请求日志面板：聚合 atomcode / codebuddy / workbuddy / claude / codex / codearts / gemini / cursor / kimi / dsh 等本地日志，看每轮耗时、token、缓存、上下文与工具调用
把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness —— 内置 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 的模型。
Zero-Leak Honey-Token Guard for DeepSeek Harness — 出站把本地密钥替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值,还原走显式工具,日志与统计全程值安全。
Windows commit-memory watchdog for DSH Desktop: attribution, configurable thresholds, a restart gate, read-only pagefile advice, a crash timeline and opt-in restart / crash-resume.
Context surgery for DeepSeek Harness: compare two answers in the same session, and drop chosen turns from every later model request.
WorkBuddy 主题 for DSH Web GUI — 薄荷绿品牌色、灰阶侧栏、24px 输入框、无框助手消息
Pre-update compatibility gate for dsh: tells you whether your installed plugins still work on the next dsh release, before you update.

Smart routing (智能分流), self-contained and zero-config rule-splitting proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness: subscription-based routing (domestic direct / international via ss/trojan/vless/vmess/hysteria2/socks5/http nodes) confined to the harness process tree, with a native Web GUI management page — no external Clash/mihomo dependency
Pick a Git branch — or let the plugin name one for you — on the DeepSeek Harness New Session screen and start the conversation inside an automatically created worktree.
Live Godot game view inside DeepSeek Harness: native rendering streamed as MJPEG into a DSH panel, plus input injection and agent tools. No Web export, no export templates.

MiniMax open-platform models for DeepSeek Harness: paste the API key in Settings → MiniMax, get MiniMax-M3.1-Flash / M3 in the model picker, and see M Plan quota windows. Keeps several API keys with your own remark names and switches which one is in use.
Switch model and reasoning effort across every DeepSeek Harness session at once — one control, all conversations, effort included.
DeepSeek Harness 的分层提示词管理器：全局、工作区、会话级提示词档案，内置段落与上下文的禁用/覆盖，子代理作用域，以及完整的 Web 管理界面。
ComfyUI 一站式套件：工作流库（图工作流提取 / 加载区 / 技能包）+ 本地出图修图（draw / inpaint / outpaint / character / upscale，9 步 turbo9）+ 服务启停 + 作品库/风格库/提示词衣柜，14 个工具一个设置页；面板标题栏带实时进度条（WebSocket 驱动：正在生成 / 步数 / ETA / 队列深度）。
Read-only context sidekick for DeepSeek Harness: ask questions about the current session without writing to it.
Find in a DeepSeek Harness chat by meaning (TypeSafe Jev via Vercel AI Gateway) or by text with Cmd/Ctrl+F, across the whole session history.
Fourteen community translations for the DeepSeek Harness web interface: one bundle, many languages
本地记忆层：按预算注入、情绪优先、可审计、不联网。给 DeepSeek Harness 用。

Browser audio alert for human-attention events: approval requests, ask-user questions, and finished turns, with per-trigger sounds configurable through the audio-alert settings namespace
DSH 侧边栏品牌插件：用已登录账号头像或上传图片替换品牌标志，支持纯圆/圆角矩形、自定义名称与官方 Harness 徽标开关。

DSH Cordis plugin: hooks the core model-request seam (agent/pre-step + agent/request) to force-compact a session's context and disable thinking per the "强制压缩配置" settings namespace (disableThinking, autoThresholdTokens, retainLatestTokens, turnEndForceCompactionEnabled). When the threshold fires (or /force-compact queues while busy), the latest `retainLatestTokens` of the conversation's surface tokens are KEPT VERBATIM and everything before that cutoff is COMPACTED INTO A SINGLE SUMMARY NODE in one LLM call (original span entries become shadowed/skipped). Also compacts at each turn/end and at each session/flush durability checkpoint. Host half is a pure listener; a web client half registers a settings.section (强制压缩 / Force Compact) that reads and writes the same settings namespace.

DSH Cordis plugin: announces the moment an agent finishes (turns idle) by pushing a 'done' signal from the Host half into the falling-ts-web-ding settings namespace, which the browser client half mirrors live and answers with a synthesized 'ding' tone via the Web Audio API. The tone is played ENTIRELY by front-end JS in the browser — the Host/node backend never emits audio and no Windows/system notification is used.

dsh calendar plugin: Synology Calendar via CalDAV (8 tools, ported from OpenClaw synology-calendar).
dsh webhook plugin: HTTP webhook -> fixed session delivery (async queue), for bank SMS auto-bookkeeping etc. Bearer token auth, per-hook workspace/session mapping.
Scan and display locally registered MCP tools in the DeepSeek Harness settings page.

Adds a Projects board to the left sidebar. One goal, many parallel tasks: a coordinator splits the work, workers run each task in the project folder, and you review the results.
dsh plugin: during long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.

给 DSH 设置页的模型供应商列表加上 CC Switch 式拖拽排序与隐藏。按住卡片上的手柄上下拖动，其他卡片实时让位，松手顺序立即生效并写回 cordis.patch.yml；每张卡片可一键隐藏，隐藏的供应商集中到「已隐藏」分组，同时从聊天框的模型选择器里移除。
J.A.R.V.I.S.-style arc-reactor boot animation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: HUD rings, boot log, progress gate, a shutter-split reveal, and an optional red/gold inner skin.
DeepSeek Harness 任务完成通知插件（适配 DSH 0.2.x）：飞书式置顶卡片（主题/强调色/位置/时长/字体可配）+ 可选提示音（苹果三全音等，含音量调节）+ 等待输入/审批提醒 + 应用内 toast + 完整设置页。

Moves DeepSeek Harness view tabs onto the Windows caption row and stacks header utilities in a compact right rail, with a centred session title, fullscreen control and transient background-status bubbles.

Liquid-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness (web GUI and desktop app): SVG edge refraction on the composer, bubbles, dock, menus and sidebar; translucent token overrides driven by live sliders; custom or built-in animated wallpapers; and desktop chrome extras such as the session bar merged into the system title bar and a fullscreen button.

webCandidates.description: Lets text-only models receive images: the image reaches the chat, a describe_image tool sends it to a local vision LLM (LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible), and the description returns to the chat.
模型速选器（Model Quick Picker）：在会话窗口右下角模型下拉的左侧添加一个小按钮，点击弹出全量模型选择窗口（提供商分组、搜索、提供商筛选、真实 input 能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮），选择后实时回写模型下拉框并立即生效。
在 VS Code 中打开当前工作区的 DSH 插件：修复内置 open-in-app 因 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 泄漏导致「用 VS Code 打开」失效的问题。Open current workspace in VS Code; fixes the built-in open-in-app ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE leak.
DSH 一键备份按钮 - 浮动按钮备份 DSH 数据到 GitHub Gist

Agent-office dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a 6-column sprite office visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents — with built-in Agent Mail, Feishu/Lark message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts and an office log tab. One screen to see what every agent is doing, plus your mail, messages & meetings. 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「办公室」插件：工作区/会话/token/子代理/Agent邮箱/飞书消息/会议日程/妙记逐字稿/办公室日志一屏总览，一眼看穿每个 Agent 在忙什么。

Per-workspace custom system prompts for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): set one active prompt per workspace, captured into a session at creation time, editable from a session-header dialog. 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「工作区自定义提示词」插件：每个工作区一条生效提示词，新建会话时固化注入，会话头部弹窗增删改查。

Attach extra repositories to one DSH workspace: a prompt section, a workspace_roots tool, a cross-root file finder, a sidebar dialog and a settings section. Additive only - it never replaces ctx.fs or ctx.sandbox, so a broken install cannot take DSH down.

拾光笺 · DSH 生活时间管理插件（待办/提醒/倒计时/日历/专注/热力图）
A resident DeepSeek balance pill for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: see your account balance at a glance. · DSH 常驻余额胶囊：右下角一眼看到 DeepSeek 账户余额

Session archive for the DeepSeek Harness: CRUD over historical sessions, plus a PDCA alchemy loop that mines them into measurable context and tool-layer patches (tool-layer recursive self-improvement), with a management panel.

One plugin, two surfaces of health checks — DeepSeek Harness skills, plus agent configuration (instruction files, subagent definitions, agent presets), scored on one shared S~E 18-bucket grade scale, with a four-axis classification (role/kind/scope/state, plus a meta-skill layer for skills), a snapshot-first sidebar panel, four dsh360_* tools, backups and undo. 一个插件两面体检：技能 + agent 说明书/子代理/预设，统一 S~E 18 档等级制，四轴分类 + 元技能层级，单面板双 tab 秒开，写入有备份可撤销。
GitHub project manager for the DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel for repositories, branches, issues and pull requests, plus github_* agent tools.
dsh-im-companion：以助理和家的概念增强 dsh-im——哪个工作区有助理在管、在不在线尽收眼底，搬家拖一下就行。

One-shot Codex subagent provider over the official app-server protocol
One-shot Pi subagent provider and true-gateway over the Pi RPC protocol
Read literature and capture notes into one Word knowledge base, with a bearing-steel RCF review sidecar.
Real-time cost of your DeepSeek Harness sessions, drawn as a candlestick chart · 在 DSH 里实时看到花费，画成股票 K 线
dsh-purge 的非官方分支（fork）：适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2、破甲内核 v3。让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model.
权限差集审计：把插件/预设「声明要什么能力」和会话日志「实际用了什么」摆在一起，列出声明外调用与可收窄的未使用权限（只读本机，不联网）
深鲸能力清单：静态扫描代码，列出执行命令/网络/写文件/读凭据等能力分布与高风险文件
从 git 提交生成对外可发的版本说明：按约定式提交归类新增/修复/其他，自动过滤 chore/docs/ci/test/merge，支持中文润色映射与幂等写入 CHANGELOG
中文公文排版：按 GB/T 9704-2012 生成 .docx / .pdf / .txt，附输出自检。不含字体文件，字体由用户自备。
一份能交出去的自查表、整改说明和合规证明
深鲸合同体检：扫描合同文本，检查 10 项必备条款（主体/标的/价款/期限/违约/争议/保密/知识产权/不可抗力/解除）是否缺失
软著工坊：从代码仓库生成软件著作权登记材料草稿 —— 源程序文档（每页 50 行，超过 60 页取前 30 + 后 30）、说明书骨架、界面截图、申请表字段草稿。全部本机生成、不联网；辅助起草，不构成法律意见。
定时任务守卫：一条命令查清本机 launchd / cron 任务是不是已经悄悄停摆——多久没成功、上次退出码、日志有没有留下证据
深鲸表格对比：两份 CSV 按关键列比较，列出新增、删除、修改的行
深鲸交付包：把产出物打成一个可核对、可追溯的交付物（zip + 文件清单 + SHA256 校验）
深鲸交付验收包：按 MANIFEST.json 与 SHA256 校验交付包是否完整、是否被改动
深鲸工序 · 设计插件线：PS / AutoCAD / 3ds Max / Blender 四条完整工序流水线（意图→工序→落盘审阅→执行→校验→回执），也是框架 —— 写一个适配器就能接入新软件
深鲸文档批量处理：Word / Excel / PDF 一次处理整目录（替换、提取、合并、拆分、压缩、水印、导出）
文档/合同比对：把两份 Word / Markdown / 文本按段落比对成「改前 → 改后」的人能读报告，单独提示标题层级与表格行数变化，可出 Markdown 报告与 JSON
深鲸文档结构：检查 Markdown 标题层级跳跃、重复标题、空标题与无结构文档
深鲸文档质检：交付前把占位符残留、重复段落、超长段落、连续空行、半角标点混用、编号断档挑出来
Word 批量替换 / 合并 / 提取文本 / 页眉页脚 / 转 Markdown，一次处理整目录
深鲸生态雷达：把本机雷达快照做成插件面板 —— 近 7 天新增、行业空位榜、每日增量报告，一眼看清 DSH 插件生态的供给分布
深鲸文件整理：按类型/年月归档、同名自动加序号、找重复、清空目录——默认只看不动
深鲸批量改名：按替换/前缀/后缀/编号规则批量重命名文件，先预览再执行，不覆盖
深鲸行业合规体检：一个面板管七个行业（医疗/财税/招聘/制造/房产/档案/工程），按法规出处出命中与修复建议
深鲸密钥箱：本机保存你自带的多个 API Key（只显示掩码、0600 权限、不上传）
深鲸引用核验：抽出文书里的《法名》第 N 条、法释文号、案号，核验是否引用已废止旧法、条号越界或需人工核验
深鲸损害赔偿计算器：人身损害、劳动争议（N/2N/加班费/年假/二倍工资）、借款利息（可分段）、违约金（含 30% 调减提示）四类表单计算，每项给出公式与代入值，可手算复核
深鲸法律台：一个面板集中打开合同体检、引用核验、合规文书、中文排版，并直达法律技能库与文书脱敏 App。
深鲸诉讼可视化：把案情与证据 JSON 画成时间轴、法律关系图、证据矩阵、争点对照，输出可打印的单文件 HTML。
深鲸记忆：跨会话热记忆（每轮注入 MEMORY/USER + memory 工具读写）+ 记忆体检、瘦身归档、记忆包、诊断报告、文档只读。本地明文、零依赖、不上传数据。
深鲸办公台：一个面板看全办公/交付/行业合规插件，复制安装命令、直达文档
检查并更新第三方 DSH 插件：对比 npm 最新版本，精确升级（绕过 pnpm 新版本观察期）。入口在「插件页 → 插件更新」标签页。
深鲸 QQ 桥接：把 QQ 接进 DSH —— QQ 官方机器人 WebSocket（AppID/AppSecret）或 OneBot v11 二选一；侧栏收发、入站入队、全量审计；v0.3 自动回复（关键词规则 + 模板 + 防刷，默认关）
发版前一条命令回答「这个项目现在能不能发版、还差什么」：版本一致性、tag、变更说明、站点版本号、流水线硬编码；只读本机 git，默认不联网
深鲸远程门禁：上线前扫描监听地址、鉴权开关、CORS、默认口令等远程暴露风险
把一段文字变成能发的视频。贴一段稿子、选几张素材，点一下出横竖双版成片；稿子、素材、成片都在你自己的电脑上，不上传、不联网。免费版即可用，授权后去水印。
深鲸侧栏收纳：给侧栏插件列表限高 + 内部滚动，插件多了也不挤掉会话区（纯 CSS，不加入口）
站点体检：上线前一次查清内部链接 4xx、图片过大、SEO 缺件、robots/sitemap、混合内容与重定向链，出三档可读报告
深鲸 SSH 控制台：侧栏面板里列 ~/.ssh/config 的主机、执行远程命令、全量审计留痕；危险命令必须显式确认，只走密钥（不落密码）
DeepWhale Teardown Studio: upload a pre-separated 3D model, render a teardown video locally.
深鲸术语统一：扫描文档中同一概念的多种写法（如 深鲸/DeepWhale），按文件列出出现次数
深鲸 Token 花费：读取本机 DSH 会话日志里的 token 用量，按 DeepSeek 官方定价估算今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 本月花费、缓存命中节省、模型与会话排行、预算进度，可导出 CSV/JSON（本机估算，非官方账单）
深鲸周报：从 git 提交记录自动生成按天分组的周报 Markdown 骨架
在侧栏账号入口上方常驻显示 DeepSeek 充值余额
让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作浏览器与电脑：以插件形式装配 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp，并提供一键依赖安装、系统权限引导与连接自检
Butler as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: extension discovery (butler.json), process hosting bound to the DSH App lifecycle, run observation, and the Butler pages inside DSH
Codex 风格：简洁交付与过程展示，保留原生文件变更卡
Search and filter the DSH plugin inventory using the official plugin manager service

Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins from GitHub topic:dsh-plugin — usage categories, trust score, official peer compatibility; one-click install through the official installer (disabled by default)
替换输入框下方统计栏：Token、上下文、缓存、模型与工具耗时、轮次、步数，明细悬浮显示
账号用量：sub2api 额度窗口、重置时间与今日统计
让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作浏览器与电脑：以插件形式装配 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp，并提供一键依赖安装、系统权限引导与连接自检
Deep View: interactive views (charts, tables, inputs, answers) in any DeepSeek Harness chat
DS Bot: a team of long-lived Bots for DeepSeek Harness, with Main Bots, Bot-to-Bot messages and group chats

Local-first DeepSeek Harness control center for balance monitoring, usage accounting, time-aware custom third-party API pricing, a 365-day local token ledger, Z.ai Coding Plan quotas, official pricing sync, encrypted multi-account switching, reminders, recharge, and host-gated session controls.

Local-first DeepSeek Harness control center for balance monitoring, usage accounting, time-aware custom third-party API pricing, a 365-day local token ledger, Z.ai Coding Plan quotas, official pricing sync, encrypted multi-account switching, reminders, recharge, and host-gated session controls.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：发送前用提示词工程 playbook 自动改写用户输入为更优 prompt。官方 bundle 插件，dsh plugin --profile web add
Inline annotation for DeepSeek Harness: highlight replies and sidebar documents, comment right next to the text, and send the annotated excerpts to the agent.
非凡人生个人版 for DSH：复用当前 Obsidian 插件的界面与业务逻辑，数据独立存储。
Edit Markdown files directly in the sidebar preview: block-level editing on the rendered view, without switching to a code mode.
Search DeepSeek Harness skills by their Chinese name in the / menu (adds a second search source with Chinese labels).
Two global skins for DeepSeek Harness (ink charcoal and warm paper) with a Settings → General switcher. Colours only, no feature changes.

Unread badge for DeepSeek Harness: a Dock number badge for replies you have not opened yet, plus a coloured dot on Workspace rows so a collapsed group still tells you something finished there. · 未读角标：Dock 数字角标 + 工作区折叠时的彩色提醒点。

Annotate a selection in the DeepSeek Harness right-sidebar document preview or in any message of the conversation — text, Excel cell ranges, Word/PDF pages — and send the quote plus your note into the current chat. Adds a right-click file tree menu (send content, send path, copy path, open with the default application) and folds sent quotes into a capsule in the transcript.
dsh-better-sidebar 好用，唯一短板是播不了音视频——这是它的「插件中的插件」，只补这一件事
Structured output for DSH: no-label title card first, then tables/lists/steps; per-session switch and style.md override. 让 DSH 的每条实质回复默认结构化。

Terminal-style prompt history & fast completion for the DSH web composer: Alt+Up/Down recall (bare Up/Down on single-line drafts), prefix-aware cycling (zsh up-line-or-search), Ctrl+R fuzzy history search with reverse-i-search continuation, and gray ghost autosuggestion accepted with Tab or Right arrow.
Mini games box for the DSH right sidebar: Gomoku human vs AI with three difficulties, a WeChat-style sky battle and an underwater chubby-fish flappy game, with sounds and a victory celebration.
Shows the DeepSeek account balance (recharge + bonus) below the composer in DeepSeek Harness and keeps it up to date.
Replaces the DSH composer send/stop button with the DeepSeek blue whale, animated while the agent is running.
Accent colors for DeepSeek Harness: colorize result headings, bold text, inline code, thinking, questions and tool rows, with a settings panel for picking each color.

DSH Macintosh 复古主题插件：System 7 像素语汇（ChiKareGo/Fusion Pixel 字体、桌面噪点画布、Finder 侧栏、月牙深浅切换、mcfx 闪烁、Kit 检视页），零构建 loader 格式常驻 bundle

Fixed five-member dev team for DeepSeek Harness driven by the spec-superflow state machine: captain + spec-writer/architect/engineer/reviewer/docs, phase-tagged tasks with dependencies, auto phase advancement with a human build gate, and a workflow stepper in the web GUI
External dsh Web GUI plugin: a Git tab (changes, staging, commits, diffs, history, branches, remotes) registered as a Conversation View, packaged as a dsh profile bundle
R4 Coder (r4.codes) account card for DeepSeek Harness: plan balance, wallet, today's spend and 7-day usage in Settings → R4 Coder.

DeepSeek Harness 一键 GitHub 同步：把插件清单、插件启用状态、插件配置、本地设置、Skills、Skill 的 refs/脚本、看板/用量账本、设置导航顺序偏好、壁纸引擎整机配置快照（$DSH_HOME/FISH.json）、免费模型插件配置与用量账本采集进你自己的私有 git 仓库并推送，换机可一键还原；采集前自动 fetch 远端并合并，密钥永不搬运。0.2.5 起不再同步 agent 预设 / 桌宠存档 / 工作区映射，0.2.6 起不再同步归档台账，0.2.7 起纳入 skill-refs，0.3.0 起支持额外扫描根，0.3.1 起纳入免费模型插件（our-free-model）配置面，0.3.2 起补上字体集与吉祥物，0.3.3 起壁纸引擎四条收敛为一条整机快照（还原后需在壁纸引擎面板点「导入预设…」才生效），0.4.0 起新增「导出凭据文件」：只把 $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml 纯本机复制到用户指定目录（默认桌面）下的「DSH凭据导出」文件夹，不生成 README、不碰 git、不发网络请求、不把凭据内容读进日志。仓库目录与导出目录在「设置 → Git 同步」里改。

Skill Lens（Fish 版）：在 DSH Web GUI 的会话页签里浏览本机全部 Agent Skill——同时识别目录式 <名称>/SKILL.md 与扁平 <名称>.md，解析技能对共享资源（skill-refs/）的引用并画成依赖图，另有概览、文件浏览/编辑、新建/导入/删除。基于 x-feichen/dsh-skill-lens（MIT）改造。

Our Free Model（上游 Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model 的社区改版，非原创）—— 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型，桌面端另有 EAC 协付渠道；2.0 起接入 CodeArts、CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、LobsterAI、Qoder、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon、MiniMax、ZCode、Gemini 十三个账号渠道（原有匿名免费通道保留）（登录、账号池、积分领取、本地 OpenAI 网关与局域网转发、数据看板与运行日志），六页毛玻璃界面统一呈现。
吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼，赖在 DeepSeek Harness 里不走了。平时爱玩魔方、爱吃各种零食、偶尔打个盹，闲不住就在桌面上溜达两圈，被你拖来甩去也照旧赖着；你忙起来它跟着忙前忙后，也会帮你打理余额钱包，闲下来爱碎碎念，还乐意陪你唠两句。

Memory Tree bridge for DeepSeek Harness — search/persist memory, manage the memory tree, and drive the local/cloud extraction backends. · 记忆树桥接：检索/落盘记忆、管理记忆树、本地/云端提取开关。

Audit DeepSeek Harness disk usage (sessions, attachments, rebuildable caches), classify it by risk, and move anything you choose to delete into the plugin's own recoverable trash. The model can query, never delete.
会话谷时开关 + 按提供方配置的多段谷时窗口
在 Settings 面板中为自定义 pi-ai 模型编辑推理等级（reasoningEfforts），支持多选、拖拽、复制粘贴，自动保存。
Persistent DSH model tools for Bing and SearXNG web search plus bounded webpage fetching.
Native DSH http_request tool with configurable credential whitelist and usage skill.
Relationship notebook for DeepSeek Harness: import chats, score every day from message-level evidence, and track how a relationship develops. All data stays on the local device.

webCandidates.description: Right-sidebar workbench for DeepSeek Harness: read/write your Obsidian notes, SOP lookup, glossary, recordings with live transcription and annotations, global search, optional usage badges.
简洁直观的轨迹视图 — 按用户消息分组，显示 Token 消耗，差异化展示用户/模型/工具，支持加载更早记录和内容搜索，适配所有主题
DSH 资料库：本地 Markdown 知识库。Host 半边以 node:fs 读写 $DSH_HOME/knowledge-base 下的 Markdown 资料，并注册会话可按需调用的检索工具；Browser 半边提供侧边栏「资料库」面板，支持目录树、全文搜索、Markdown 阅读与在线编辑。
提供 git 分支与 worktree 管理：输入框工具栏显示当前分支、可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区，并管理其创建与删除。
dsh 的 CLI 子代理编排：把任务按类型派发给 codex cli / claude cli / grok cli（headless），取回执行结果回填主会话；配置页管理路由表、每个 CLI 的权限与模型，以及 CLI 本身的安装/更新/卸载。
在官方「模型」页为第三方模型补上思考等级、图片输入与生图，并支持一个供应商多把密钥、按模型分流与失败自动换密钥重试、按路由自定义请求头、余额展示与自动继续。
DSH web plugin: token 用量统计看板 + 单会话（主智能体 + 子智能体）用量统计。提供今日/近3天/近7天/近1月/近3月/自定义筛选、六个汇总卡片、活跃热力图、缓存命中率折线与分模型柱状图、按模型/按供应商 Top5 列表。
用 WebDAV 在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的配置：模型供应商与模型、已安装插件、其余 profile 配置、附加目录与 API 密钥。整个备份在离开本机前用口令加密（AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2），以分片三方合并的方式在服务端保留一个加密文件。

DSH plugin: connect DSH/dwsh to GitHub — OAuth device-flow login plus github_* tools (repos, issues, PRs, files, search) and a config-page auth card. / 连接 DSH 与 GitHub 的插件：OAuth 登录认证 + github_* 工具（仓库、issues、PR、文件、搜索）与配置页认证卡片。
P2P-based, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi, and other workspaces from web and mobile clients.
DSH sidebar usage meter for OpenCode GO, MiniMax, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and Moonshot, with usage windows, balances and a Plugins-panel settings page (DSH 0.1.7+ and 0.2.x).
P2P-based, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi, and other workspaces from web and mobile clients.
The ChatGPT-style unread badge, for DeepSeek Harness: a red count on the tab icon and taskbar button, plus one chime per finished turn.
DSH 插件：复用 QwenWorkCN（千问办公）桌面 App 登录态，零配置接入 DSH
Canvas view beside the Chat tab for DeepSeek Harness: each turn is a mind-map node, and you can branch follow-ups from any node within the same session.
Browse workspace files from the DSH left sidebar (Chats | Files switch) and drag files or folders into the composer as @path references for DSH to read or edit.
Prompt polish ✨ — a DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that adds a one-click button to rewrite rough input into a structured, professional prompt, written back into the input box.
选中回答里的文字就地加注释（注释1/注释2…），每条注释各问各的问题，再带着引用一次性发出去。
窗口启动状态：在 设置 → 通用设置 里选择 DSH 桌面窗口每次启动时以 默认 / 最大化 / 全屏 打开（Windows）。
Switch between Plan and Build mode via Tab button or key, with per-mode preset models.
DSH 插件：用 Bing / DuckDuckGo / Mojeek / Google / Brave 多引擎混合替代默认的 DeepSeek 网络搜索；支持无头浏览器取数，引擎顺序、代理、凭据均可配置，并带可视化设置页。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: query OpenCode Go quota (5h rolling / weekly / monthly) from the settings sidebar

Model-facing handoff for DeepSeek Harness: hand this session off to a session inside another workspace, with two history policies — full copy (fork the complete event history) or summary only (start a blank session from the written brief). dsh-handoff：把当前会话交接到另一个工作区的新会话里，可选「完整复制历史」或「只写总结不复制历史」；由 Agent 在对话中自行调用。

Run the locally authenticated AGY CLI as a DSH model provider. Official-binary-only transport; lean prompts, adaptive tool projection, and DSH-governed security boundary.

Expose the locally installed ZCode CLI as a DSH model provider.
Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。
微信代聊机器人 · DSH 插件：OCR 读屏 + 拟人节奏，用你本人的口吻替你回微信

LeetCode practice bench for DeepSeek Harness: the problem bank is fetched from leetcode.cn at runtime, with per-problem Java drafts, dictionary completion, one-click submission through a local cookie, and copy-to-chat AI coaching.

命令窗：实时显示 dsh 发起的命令内容与执行输出，无需暂停对话即可查看进度。

Live2D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: multi-instance transparent always-on-top windows, chat bubbles, AI-controlled expressions and motions, in-window pose editor, screen reading, TTS with lip sync, and proactive wake-up.

webCandidates.description: Native Windows Acrylic appearance with readable, consistent menus and floating surfaces.

Per-workspace Agent preset bindings for DeepSeek Harness: bind a preset to a workspace once and every new session there boots with it. Written for the current DSH line (0.2.0 per-entry settings; also runs on 0.1.7) and still loads on the 0.1.5-and-older named-namespace line.

DSH web plugin: a collapsible, draggable A-share quote widget pinned to the shell. Shows live index + individual-stock prices with change % and color, refreshed on a timer. Data from the public Tencent quote API.

DSH web plugin: a draggable ring-gauge dashboard pinned to the bottom-right that shows live model output speed (tok/s), with an expandable detail panel (per-step exact speed, TTFT, cache-hit rate, cache read/write, reasoning and input tokens, model, cumulative tokens).
Ask a follow-up from selected text in a DeepSeek Harness answer, in a real Session branch with a tree of context.
钉钉私信 / 群 @ 消息实时接收、按发送人记录来源、AI 建议回复与自动回复插件
Session cleanup for the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar: a destructive Delete session action and one global archived-session visibility switch.
Session plugin, MCP server and skill panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation view, with a one-click GitHub star shortcut.
微信 ⇄ 钉钉私信/@我 实时桥接插件（DWS 个人事件订阅 + 微信 iLink 机器人）
按工作区分级列出 DeepSeek Harness 的全部会话，支持单选/多选删除。
QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)

A right-sidebar narrator for DeepSeek Harness: three plain-language lines on what the agent finished, is doing, and will do next — plus a read-only explain channel, a non-interrupting steer, and a stop that says what it kept.
A team of long-lived DSH Sessions with durable tasks, review and acceptance.
DSH plugin: OpenCode Go API-key pool with quota-driven automatic switching, a Settings tab and a composer quota badge.

Russian interface translation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): registers complete ru dictionaries for the DSH platform and its plugins, adds Russian to the language picker, and activates it on first run. Translation only - no typography, spell-check or layout-fix extras.
Use the models included with the Loomy desktop app in DeepSeek Harness with no configuration.
Interactive Agent Client Protocol (ACP) client for the DSH web UI: attach any ACP-capable agent and stream its session.
DSH remote-aware web-startup replacement + username/password auth plugin: allows --host 0.0.0.0 when paired with the auth plugin
DSH plugin: per-project LLM token usage and RMB cost (input / cache-hit / output) based on model standard prices.
把本机已登录的超算互联网（SCNet）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：无需二次登录或填写 API Key，自动读取客户端里的 30+ 个模型，可逐模型开关、设定上下文预算与思考档位，并在插件页提供一键诊断。
给 AI 装上三样感官：眼睛（按需看屏幕）、嘴（回复完自动念）、耳朵（喊唤醒词就听）。每样都能单独关。
Task boundaries for DeepSeek Harness Web: use Focus for execution scope and Persistent Anchors for explicit constraints without rewriting prompts.
A collapsible in-conversation interactive terminal: each tab is a live host PTY (xterm.js over WebSocket) with per-project persistent quick commands
Per-turn and whole-session DeepSeek API cost estimates for DeepSeek Harness Web.
Turn-based conversation colors for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
Turn DeepSeek Harness conversations into interactive dashboards, 14 chart types, Mermaid diagrams, instant what-if calculators, code diff review gates, and live task trackers.
DeepSeek Harness tools for preparing Markdown articles with an external md2wechat CLI

DeepSeek Harness web 插件：把工具调用卡片（含 MCP 工具）与 thinking 行渲染成紧凑时间线（左侧色轨 + GitHub 风 diff + goal callout）。
DeepSeek Harness web 插件：在主对话区左缘中部渲染「对话地图」刻度（每条 = 一轮用户提问），hover 梯度展开并预览该轮提问/回复摘要，点击跳转（未渲染的老轮次自动分页加载后再跳），滚动时当前轮次自动高亮。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：把 DSH 的动态 Cordis 工具集（inspect/define/run/stop/undefine）以 MCP 暴露给 Claude Code。端点强制身份认证，token 可在 DSH 设置页配置。

Route every delegated child agent by strategy: pin one LLM route, or spread children over candidate routes (round-robin / random / priority) with health-aware failover, a fallback route, and a settings page

DSH Web 运维面板：安全重启、健康监控、备份和 Linux 权限维护。
A Super Chat panel for DeepSeek Harness: a super-chat Source for dsh-superagent-prototype, with one tagged chat stream, topic-filtered views, SQLite storage, and a single-session fallback.
DSH Web 插件：调用智谱 GLM 视觉模型分析图片（analyze_image 工具 + 插件设置卡片）。
A configurable DeepSeek Harness custom mode with a Minimal default and Markdown system prompt.

A workbench right beside your agent chat: it keeps your artifacts in order, sums up what you've learned, remembers what you've decided, and lets your workflow grow on its own. A Claude Code plugin, adapters for Codex, Antigravity, DeepSeek Harness and Pi, an MCP server for other hosts, and a CLI.
Drive the Gemus AI design canvas from DeepSeek Harness — plan workflows, run generations, and pull assets back as native dsh tools.

A Zotero-compatible literature library for DeepSeek Harness: browse and edit a real zotero.sqlite, import PDFs with metadata lookup, annotations, WebDAV file sync, an agent chat dock, and a full Zotero-compatible Microsoft Word citation plugin.
把消息里的 GitHub admonition 语法（> [!NOTE] / > [!BOOK] 等）渲染成带彩色标题的提示块。
Compact DSH front-end: sidebar status card, project and task-line integration, in-session group chat room, and a guided new-project dialog. Follows the DSH theme as-is.
Project rooms for DeepSeek Harness: group sessions into projects, see per-project runtime, and open a room with a shared board, task list, todo queue and message delivery to member sessions.
侧栏余额与用量面板：DeepSeek 账号余额 + 今日/本会话 token 用量（数据真实，失败显式提示）。
Evidence-based research workspaces and deliverables inside DeepSeek Harness
跨会话 Agent 通信：让 DeepSeek Harness 里不同的 Agent 会话互相收发消息。
A searchable, Visual Studio Code-style settings page generated from every live plugin's Config schema.
DSH Web 对话 mermaid 渲染插件：将消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表（缩放 / 适应宽度 / 全屏查看 / 预览代码切换），渲染失败时保留原代码块并内联展示错误。
Browser notifications for finished agent turns, pending approvals or questions, and session errors.
增强提示词：输入框一键 LLM 改写草稿，三态按钮 + 一键回退

Codex-style attachment format expansion for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: PDF text-layer extraction (pymupdf4llm / pdfjs), Office text extraction, long-document spill + index cards, scanned-PDF OCR (tesseract.js), and browser-decodable images to PNG.

DeepSeek API peak/off-peak pricing indicator: a live composer pill (red during peak, green off-peak) with a countdown to the next switch and the weekend/Chinese-holiday off-peak rules, plus a dsh_peak_status tool the agent can call to warn about cost.
Copy one finished assistant reply as a long PNG screenshot — tables re-laid out, referenced images full-size, overlong replies split into readable parts.
Send the DSH composer with Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS); plain Enter inserts a newline instead of sending.
DeepSeek Harness 跨设备同步插件：把 DSH 的「设置与状态」（agent 预设、定时任务、自动化任务、任务看板、cordis.patch.yml 配置）同步到 WebDAV。明确不含会话历史与附件。零第三方运行时依赖（用 Node 内置 fetch 手写 WebDAV 客户端）。服务端提供 sync_* 工具 + HTTP 路由，客户端提供侧栏页。

DSH plugin: select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, or translate it with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a native always-on-top overlay (draggable, resizable). · DeepSeek Harness 划词工具：任意应用里选中文字即在锚点右下角弹出菜单，用 Harness 解释/总结/翻译（自动带上选区所在的上下文段落），流式落在零依赖的原生置顶浮窗里（可拖动/缩放）。
Standalone DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for asking context-aware questions about selected text
DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：工作便签——左侧栏便签面板，便签画布自由摆放、月历与甘特图拖拽改期，数据只存本机浏览器

Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — NC yellow × neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter & message SFX, boot glitch, Relic interference, slang chips, and hidden easter eggs (try sending: relic / johnny).
用本机 QQ 的音效提醒 DSH：任务完成响「好友消息」，需要你放权限 / 回答问题时响「系统消息」。Windows 下自动探测 QQ 音效目录，未安装或其它平台回落到内置仿 QQ 合成音。QQ-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness.
Drag the sidebar's global panel entries to reorder them in DeepSeek Harness. The order is remembered across reloads.
Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — plain markdown files, no database, no worker.
时间提醒（reminder）— DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间 / 距上次发言 / 提醒 / 倒计时。定位是会话内的短期提醒（纯 client 半，数据存浏览器本地）
Cross-session collaboration for DeepSeek Harness: assign work to another session (a room), get a report back, and watch it all in a sidebar panel.
Claude Code style quote & reply for DeepSeek Harness: select text, reply in a popover, stack editable blocks above the composer, send them together.

DSH web plugin: schedule an automatic /goal execution from inside a conversation, with both a /timed-goal command and a Web UI (per-conversation input control + settings section). Configure an absolute datetime (year/month/day/hour/minute/second) plus a prompt; at the scheduled moment the plugin pins the session to full access (danger-full-access) and creates an armed goal that the goal-round-driver executes automatically.

Cyberpunk 2077 red/neon fork of the Night City theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI — neon red × cyan × green identity, base64-embedded Ryzes & Cyberpunk fonts, CYBERPUNK 2077 INFECTING boot screen, Tab 'relic virus' session switcher (left 120° arc + hacker terminal), green code-rain particles. Forked from dsh-theme-cyberpunk2077 by Tommy00748.
Hot-pluggable Deep Whale day/night skin with themed scenes, companions, controls, and lightweight ambience for the dsh web GUI
会话删除与回收站：侧栏会话菜单里的「删除」，日志先移入回收站，可恢复、可手动彻底删除
DeepSeek Harness 插件：论文伴读工作台 — PDF 转录 / 检索 / 原生对话伴读 + 内置阅读器页面。
执行强度提示：一段工程化过的 system prompt（真跑验证 / 不编造已验证 / 结论优先不堆篇幅），插件页可开关与改文本
Voice dialog for DeepSeek Harness: multi-speaker ASR, priority queuing, auto-read replies

She keeps count both ways - three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm; come back after half an hour and she greets you with "I was not waiting for you"; the first few meetings she is shy; ten quiet minutes and she drifts to a corner, visually only, never moving the position you chose. 按域名决定哪些 HTTP 请求走代理或直连（Route requests per domain through a proxy; everything else stays direct）

Mobile use for DeepSeek Harness: iOS/Android device tools plus a live Simulator mirror in the right Sidebar.

Ask side questions in DeepSeek Harness without interrupting the current task, reusing the prompt cache.
在 DSH 插件页管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks。
让 DSH 的回答变成能直接操作的界面：计算器、图表、表单、模拟和小游戏。
AI personalities for DeepSeek Harness. Choose one globally or per conversation, and create, import or share your own.
Themes and appearance for DeepSeek Harness: one-click installs from theme markets, automatic recovery and AI repair guides.
Rewind conversations and file changes in DeepSeek Harness, with undo.
JavaScript workflows for DeepSeek Harness with native subagents and jobs, resumable runs, token targets and worktree isolation.
在 DSH 里用上 Codex、Grok Build、Cursor、Pi 和 ZCode 的工作方式，模型还是你自己的。

Let the AI in DeepSeek Harness operate browsers and desktop apps, with live previews and annotations. You can step in at any time. macOS, Windows and Linux.

Click any UI element in your running dev page — opened in the DSH built-in browser — and get its Vue / React / Svelte / Angular source file as a file reference chip in the DSH chat, jumpable to the exact line.
Telegram channel for DeepSeek Harness — rich tables and lists, real image delivery both ways, inline-keyboard questions, and in-chat model/preset/mode control

A green interrupt button beside the DeepSeek Harness send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements; the interrupt prompt is customizable.

Environment housekeeper for DeepSeek Harness: toolchain inventory, agent scratch/cache scan with safe one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) view/edit - all in the Web GUI settings. Zero runtime dependencies.
An eye that grows: accumulated design taste for DSH agents. A taste corpus + codified principles that sharpen with every example you feed — review designs against learned judgment, not a fixed ruler.
Give your DSH agent hands: drive a real browser (Edge/Chrome over CDP) from the chat, with a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI. Zero runtime dependencies, no API key, one command install.
Evidence-first frontend release checks for DSH: real browser inspection, user flows, visual baselines, and reproducible reports.

Faster Session switching for DeepSeek Harness: dedupes read-only RPCs and makes the first-screen history window configurable.
Bluxe手绘工坊 · 生图工作台（图文 / 摄影）：DSH 侧栏图像生成工作台，默认使用内置本地账号池，亦支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口（Base URL / API Key / 模型）；可自定义工作台名称与图片存储目录。

Evidence-driven learning memory and automation for Git-native AI agents
DSH 会话清理（第三方插件）：侧边栏独立页面管理 ~/.dsh 下的会话记录与归档缓存，删除先入回收站可恢复，正在使用的会话会被拦截。

Tech pulse — a DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel aggregating first-hand tech updates: Hacker News, publisher RSS, AI-lab announcements (OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek / MSR), and GitHub activity from tech leaders, with an AI digest and on-demand Chinese translation.

Game-style floating HUD for DeepSeek Harness: HP bar (account balance vs ¥20 cap), MP bar (context remaining), official peak/valley pricing with switch countdown, auto-compaction when context < 5% remains, and a memory-carrying new-conversation button. · 游戏风格悬浮 HUD：余额血条、上下文蓝条、官方峰谷定价与切换倒计时、上下文不足5%自动压缩、携带记忆开启新对话。
文件夹时光机：给任意文件夹留下历史时间点并一键回到过去——像 Git 一样有版本历史，但不需要懂 Git，任何文件夹都能用。 · Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click.
Task-centered desktop development with Session progress, acceptance evidence, Artifacts and PR/MR delivery for DeepSeek Harness
ERP 助手 (Adapt ERP): a DeepSeek Harness desktop workspace that learns your ERP sites from the sidebar browser and keeps a private local index per site
Weather & Sky: a hot-pluggable live weather overlay for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI (sun by day, moon with phases by night, clouds, rain, snow, fog, lightning).

Bookmark conversation turns in DeepSeek Harness: name the turns you care about, jump back to them, and quote their answer straight into the composer.

Yunzhijia plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: yzj-cli bridge, model-facing tools (six domains + swimlane todo + AI advance board), model defaults, and a browser UI (rich tool cards + workspace panel) — monobundle aggregate of the workspace packages
Windows 桌面提醒：任务需要审批或提升权限时弹出可穿透「请勿打扰」与全屏的系统通知，并可自定义提示音与响铃时长；某个对话任务跑完时再弹一条带绿色对勾、几秒自动收起的完成通知。点一下通知就能把 DSH 窗口切回前台；DSH 在前台时都不弹，全部可在 DSH 设置里调整。
Conversation turn overview: a header button that turns the conversation window into a per-turn list with jump, focus, cross-session distribution, and multi-session task composition.
Task hub for DeepSeek Harness: stacked task entries with per-task timing, linked work scenes, plans and reminders — and a guided "restore last workspace" flow that asks before opening anything.
DeepSeek Harness 侧栏滚动补丁：左侧面板列表固定 4 行、可滚动，右侧栏被裁掉的内容改为可滚 / Make the DSH sidebar panel list scroll instead of eating the window, and un-clip overflowing right-column panels.
TinyMCE WYSIWYG editor for HTML files in the DeepSeek Harness Better Sidebar.
DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：在对话输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户剩余余额与本会话 token 费用估算。
Reach this machine's DeepSeek Harness from anywhere: a public entry point, a relay you configure inside dsh, and a mobile shell for the existing web GUI.
Right-sidebar media tab for DeepSeek Harness: inline playback for local audio/video — HTTP Range for native formats, ffmpeg transcoding for mkv/avi/flv/wmv.
DSH 活动统计：彩色时间线看什么时候在干活/改代码，每日 token 消耗按项目/日期/小时查看。

在鲸鱼娘旁显示毛玻璃拟态的状态气泡（余额 ¥ / 今日 ¥ / 缓存命中 / 峰谷，本轮在悬停提示里），并在每次计费时播放命中·输出·未命中扣费弹幕；Ctrl+Alt+D 可显示 damage-pulse 原悬浮卡。数据合并自 dsh-damage-pulse 与 dsh-whale-widget。

DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges images to external vision APIs and returns text-only analysis

Codex-like persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-injected memory summary, raw memory tools, and per-session rollout summaries distilled into a bounded global memory file.
Rewrite the composer draft into a complete prompt using the current conversation as context.

DSH web UI-tweak plugin: show the provider display name next to the model name in the composer model seat, remove the chat column max-width, and more — every feature has its own switch on a dedicated Settings page. / DSH web 界面美化插件：在模型选择器显示厂商名、取消对话列最大宽度等，每个功能都在独立的「设置 → 聊天增强」页中开关。
A DeepSeek Harness Mix plugin for vision routing plus GPT Image generation and editing.
DSH 插件商城 · 用户端统一仓库（源码 + 产物）：悬浮球 / 设置页 / 会话视图三入口 + 本地安装器 RPC + 反向代理桥。配套服务端见 dsh-store-server。
A searchable command palette for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins
TypeScript/JavaScript diagnostics lens for DeepSeek Harness

Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: move a Session's durable log into a local trash directory, drop its Workspace accounting and archive/pin entries, and expose it through the sidebar row menu plus session_delete tools.
A fail-closed automatic approval mode with selectable reviewer models and visible decisions for DeepSeek Harness
A bilingual file workspace and secure remote API for DeepSeek Harness WebUI and mobile clients.
Drag the chat column's right edge to widen it (520-2400px, remembered across restarts). Pure front-end, no build, no host services. DSH 网页版聊天列宽度可拖拽调节插件。
Clear DSH error summaries, original messages, on-demand network evidence, copyable troubleshooting reports and bounded retries.
Agent-native browser DevTools workbench with session-scoped controller arbitration for DeepSeek Harness
Use a Command Code Go subscription from DeepSeek Harness through the Command Code CLI alpha transport. Unofficial; not affiliated with Command Code.

DSH plugin: import the connections DBeaver already knows (saved passwords included), query them through nine MCP tools across SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and openGauss - shared by every DSH profile and by any other MCP client, read-only by default, every call audited.
Run and manage Codex CLI tasks in DSH with complete answers, background execution, live settings, optional quota reminders and recovery, and experimental model and reasoning-effort selection
Let DSH watch a live screen or camera feed: score every frame by how much the picture changed, keep only the ones that matter, and pack them into one image. · 让 AI 实时看见你的屏幕，只传「画面变了」的那几帧。
DeepSeek API balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: a shell.overlay pill showing live account balance
Right-to-left, right-aligned text for Chat messages and the composer.
DSH Web profile 模组管理器：在设置页里开关第三方插件，通过改写 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 并由 patch watcher 热生效，无需手动改文件、无需重启。
LAN pets with dsh-pet 0.3.8 shared physics, real-time local collisions and exclusive collision ownership.
DeepSeek 网页版聊天 — 在 DSH 里同步并继续 chat.deepseek.com 的对话 · Sync and continue your DeepSeek web chats inside DSH
Task-based plugin plans, disposable runs and installation into your current DeepSeek Harness environment
Let DSH use the locally installed Codex Computer Use runtime on Windows.
Plugin conflict detection, quarantine, recovery and offline rescue for DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness 会话费用统计插件:本会话成本、当日费用、历史记录与官方价格同步,支持多厂商多模型价格计费(内置 170+ 模型 ID 价格目录与自动匹配)、主流 Coding Plan 订阅额度查询与显示(16 家,含 WorkBuddy 官方积分、OpenDesign 工作区查询、含小米 MiMo Token Plan 控制台 Cookie 查询、SCNet Token Plan 本地 Credits 计量与火山方舟 Volcano Ark Coding Plan AK/SK 签名查询)、自定义 Provider 余额查询(可配任意 HTTP 端点)与余额进度条、峰谷计价时段显示与切换前弹窗/系统通知提醒(位置/提前量/类型可配),界面中英双语。Session cost tracking plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-conversation cost, daily totals, history and official price sync, with multi-vendor model pricing (built-in 170+ model-ID catalog with auto-matching), Coding Plan quota queries & display for 16 vendors (incl. WorkBuddy official credits, OpenDesign workspace queries, Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan via console cookie, local credits metering for the SCNet Token Plan and Volcano Ark Coding Plan via AK/SK signature), plan/API dual-track billing with per-1% & full-window Token Plan usage estimates, custom provider balance lookup (configurable HTTP endpoint) and balance progress bar, plus peak/off-peak pricing display with pre-switch popup & system-notification alerts (position / lead time / type configurable), in a bilingual (Chinese/English) UI.
JeV 思维链外显：将 DeepSeek 的任务规划、进度与阶段小结呈现为聊天正文，支持轻量摘要、原生翻译及父子任务流程图，不改主模型上下文
在 DeepSeek Harness 中统一开关所有配置的 pnpm 构建脚本审批。
Collapse Think, tool cards and turn-process sections in DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web; pinned headers and customizable shortcuts.
Find, show/hide and arrange plugin controls in DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web, with layout backup and restore.
Point at a webpage, give your DSH agent feedback, and compare the result in place.
DSH for WSL: Windows and WSL hosts, resident stdio bridges, native Linux launch and Windows interoperability

FileLens — right-column file explorer for DeepSeek Harness: lazy directory tree, multi-format preview (Markdown/JSON/CSV/diff/log/hex/image), search & grep, tabs, inline editing with containment + version-guarded writes.
Unified local plugin: session identity, global prompt, auto-resume, session log reposition, peer message (5 plugins consolidated).
人格—记忆—状态—技能—反射 五维陪伴插件，用于 DSH 人格演变；记忆跨窗口贯通带时间感，请勿在正式工作对话中开启 / Persona evolution plugin for DSH; memory spans windows with time-awareness, keep off work chats
常驻 AI 队友：记得住、守得住、收得回。默认 dry-run 演习、执行前自动快照、可一键回滚，并支持错峰调度省钱。
桌面悬浮球：Windows 桌面悬浮球 + WebView2 聊天窗口，支持模型、权限、推理等级切换，图片/附件上传，图标裁剪、形状、大小、聊天背景区域与消息颜色自定义。

把 composer 的 model seat 换成 Gear Grid（2D Cosmic Shifter）风格：28px 药丸触发器 + 星野弹窗 + 元素×强度 2D 网格，一次选择模型与推理等级。数据与提交完全复用 ctx.modelDirectories（与 /model 命令、原生 seat 同源），本包只做显示层；原生 seat 折叠而非卸载。视觉只用 dsh 主题令牌（--dsw-alias-* / --dsw-radius-* / elevation / mask-blur / focus-ring），宇宙色相经 color-mix 派生，自动跟随明暗色板。
A reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness with model-defined levels, character themes, and a live settings preview.
Download files delivered by `present` straight from the Web GUI delivery card — no SFTP, no extra tools.
DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
Task hub: list TAPD requirements and ZenTao tasks assigned to you, then dispatch a DSH agent on a branch you name.
DeepSeek Harness client plugin that persistently stores sent prompts and recalls them with the up and down arrow keys in the Lexical composer.

DeepSeek Harness bundle for the MotoMoto relay: outbound identity and SSE compatibility plus a status card in Settings and the Plugins detail page. The provider route itself lives in the user settings layer.
One-click lock screen for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a sidebar footer button covers the frame with the current desktop wallpaper; press Esc twice to unlock.
Local/remote status chip for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar; follows the currently visible session (本地 / 远程 · 机器名) and never modifies workspace titles.
Ask for a comment before inserting a quoted selection, as one block — in chat and in file previews.
Pluggable content renderers for the DeepSeek Harness conversation: preview/code switching for HTML, and a renderer registry to grow.
Download watermark-free Douyin and Xiaohongshu videos, transcribe them with local or cloud ASR, proofread the transcript with AI terms, and export Markdown/TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON/HTML/DOCX.
Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness — read-only graph, spreading recall, evidence chains, offline snapshots. 记忆星图：把 DSH 各工作区的记忆只读连成一张可交互星云。

Let DSH see the world through a camera: score frames by how much the picture changed, keep only the ones that matter, pack them into one sheet, and wake the model when something actually happens. · 让 DSH 通过摄像头看世界。

Multi-dimensional token guard for DSH. Measures what a session actually spends and what it actually produces, then nudges or blocks only the wasteful part. Defaults to advise mode: it cannot deny anything until enforce is explicitly enabled and shadow-backtest misfire rate is under 0.5%.

DSH web 插件：折叠思考过程直接输出回答内容；在会话输入框上方增加会话活动状态条，展示 Think / Edit / Bash / Read，可展开与收起。 / DSH web plugin: folds the thinking process so answers render directly, and adds a session-activity status bar above the composer showing Think / Edit / Bash / Read, expandable and collapsible.

DSH web 插件：折叠思考过程直接输出回答内容；在会话输入框上方增加会话活动状态条，展示 Think / Edit / Bash / Read，可展开与收起。 / DSH web plugin: folds the thinking process so answers render directly, and adds a session-activity status bar above the composer showing Think / Edit / Bash / Read, expandable and collapsible.
在 DSH 侧边栏「插件」行右侧加一个小箭头：点一下收起插件区（插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 上下文洞察 / 更多），再点一下展开。

DSH web 插件：在「设置」中增加「显示」页，用两个滑杆分别调节输入框与内容展示区的宽度百分比，改动即时生效并持久化。 / DSH web plugin: adds a "Display" page under Settings with two sliders that adjust the width percentage of the input box and the content area, applied live and persisted.

Auto-approve mode for DeepSeek Harness: auto-grants approval requests (sandbox escalations, or everything) and adds an "自动审批" (auto-approve) option to the permission selector. Install with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <path-or-package>`.
Show the current session ID in the session header and copy it to the clipboard with one click
Add a Show in File Explorer action to each DeepSeek Harness workspace menu
Manage DeepSeek Harness skills and MCP servers from inside a session
dsh-spend + DeepSeek account balance: usage/cost dashboard (peak/off-peak aware) plus the official CNY balance readout
DSH 插件：对话里的 mermaid 围栏实时渲染成图，可缩放、全屏、导出 SVG，渲染结果本地缓存，切回来不重画。
BotCrew — run WorkBuddy and QwenWork from one DSH group chat, with members, permissions, artifacts and a live work panel.
富江原版人格、功能面板、知识库、报告、任务编排与插话回应，适配 DSHA。
GPT image generation and editing for DeepSeek Harness: image_generate and image_edit tools, plus an in-app settings page with connection test, model picker, and gallery.
Hub: one floating panel for TODO, Note and Prompt — three tabs, full CRUD, edge docking, grid and list views.
在 harness 对话中框选任意文字后点击「解释」按钮，弹出 Markdown 实时流式解释气泡，支持递归追问，配置常驻在设置→通用页顶部
DSH 后台完成一轮或需要人工介入时，闪烁 Windows 任务栏图标提醒你。

Agent2Agent (A2A) v1.0.1 dual-end plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multiple inbound servers (per-instance agent presets; skills derived from each preset's skill directory), multiple outbound connections, GUI-managed instance lifecycle.
DeepSeek Harness 记忆系统(单包单入口):JSONL 存储 + 本地向量检索(BGE-M3)+ 六个模型工具 + 自动召回注入 + 管理面板。
LOOPScope: an agent-loop trajectory visualizer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — interactive LOOP cards, waterfall timing, token accounting and tool-call inspection in the web UI.
粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」到 DSH 输入框时自动折叠为紧凑引用，发送时把代码快照以独立上下文消息内联给模型。
协作涌现智能（CEI）：认知边界钻探机 — DSH 动态插件。呼吸循环九步、三裁决点（涌动确认/涌断收束/盲区显影）、五档共振探测+LLM引擎（真实DeepSeek API）、时序共振（时间维度）、9档案双副本容灾、只沉默不删除。
Personal assistant plugin for deepseek-harness that organizes commitments from conversations, tracks plans across sessions, and delivers low-interruption reminders.
Delete one complete closed turn from a DeepSeek Harness session without deleting the session
Network operations, topology and monitoring for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness 前端插件：梁系强度滑动条 —— 用 6 档滑块替换输入框的模型与推理等级按钮（小难梁/牢梁/梁子/梁圣/梁神/梁祖），悬停时在进度条上方显示对应档位形象图，切换带交叉淡入淡出渐变

Geek level for the Performance & usage setting: a live reading of the newest request (first-token latency, speed, tokens, total, amortised) plus a drawer listing the last ten, all derived from the shipped Statistics view data
调整 DSH 设置弹窗的宽度、高度与透明度：在「设置 - 通用设置」里用三个滑动条实时调节，并记住选择。
把 LINE 官方帳號（Messaging API）接進 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：內建 Cloudflare Tunnel、人設選擇（大肥魚或插件自訂）、主動傳訊與完整設定面板。
Schedule a composer message to be sent at a chosen time, so DeepSeek tokens are spent inside the off-peak pricing window.
把浏览器收藏夹接进 DeepSeek Harness：卡片书架 + 分类树 + 搜索 + 卡片详情。 · Browser bookmarks as a shelf inside DeepSeek Harness.
Peer multi-Agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness
月升 Moonrise — a warm amber-on-midnight theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

Project kanban for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: a sidebar entry opens a board grouped by project, each with four fixed columns (待办 / 进行中 / 待反馈 / 已完成), and each project has a page for its key data and results — two trees you can arrange by drag and drop, with links that show which result came from which data.

Prompt booster for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: one click lightly polishes the composer draft in place (undoable); right-click picks a boost mode (concise, structured, coding, research, academic, English …), edits each mode's template or adds new ones, and chooses which model does the rewrite. Based on dsh-prompt-enhance by rongxingda.

Small DeepSeek Harness features with a settings page on the Plugins page: keep the Mac awake while dsh runs, and a macOS notification when a conversation finishes its task. Each feature has its own switch, and notifications can be chosen per workspace and per conversation, all changed live without a restart.
Workspace pages for DeepSeek Harness conversations: one page per workspace, freely placed conversation cards, links, and named boxes that group conversations.
Show the current workspace git branch beside the composer mode controls, with focus/visibility-driven refresh
Turn articles in DeepSeek Harness into editable Excalidraw canvases

Non-blocking interactions for DeepSeek Harness: approval requests park as pending items while the model keeps working (approve later, retry once), and ask_user_question runs in timed mode so a question never blocks the turn.
Auto-continue on 429 rate limit and quota-exhausted errors for DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Host-side RATE_LIMIT/QUOTA recovery plus an on/off switch at the bottom of the chat input area.
Per-model wire protocol for DeepSeek Harness: compile model-level protocol intent into legal llm-pi-ai routes, probe all three protocols, hide unusable models. Mutually exclusive with dsh-gearbox.
MCP connection manager for DeepSeek Harness: list, add, remove, and test MCP server connections at runtime
Real-time operations dashboard for a DS Bot team: live activity, message flow, task hand-off and per-Bot token usage, read from local dsh data.
DSH Web GUI「添加对话」插件：在聊天区划选对话文字后出现「+ 添加对话」悬浮按钮，一键把选中内容作为引用暂存到输入框上方（最多 12 条，可预览/删除），发送时引用自动以 Markdown 引用块并入消息开头（仿 Codex quote 体验）
DeepSeek Harness plugin: semantic blast radius for agent code edits — who calls what the agent just changed, and which of those callers have no test covering them
DeepSeek Harness plugin: LLM cost metering with budget enforcement (deny/warn), peak-valley pricing and a live usage dashboard
Full-duplex voice mode for DeepSeek Harness: streamed ASR -> LLM -> TTS with barge-in

webCandidates.description: dsh-notebook-studio 是 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：上传多篇 PDF，用提示词做文献综述、关键信息提取与研究设计，并生成带页码引用的报告（DOCX/PDF）或演示文稿（PPTX/PDF）。| dsh-notebook-studio is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: upload PDF papers and use prompts for a literature review, key-finding extraction and a study design, then generate page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).

DSH-Paper-DeepRead is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin that bundles the 文献精读库 Paper Deepread library and the paper-deepread-html deep-read skill: browse reports, upload PDFs into a managed library, let an agent deep-read them, and manage/rebuild the library from a sidebar panel. | DSH-Paper-DeepRead 是 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web 插件：内置「文献精读库」与 paper-deepread-html 精读技能，支持在侧边栏浏览报告、上传 PDF 到受管书库、由 Agent 精读成稿，并管理/重建书库。

WeChat-style screenshot button in the DeepSeek Harness composer: native macOS region capture (optionally hiding the window), copied to the clipboard and inserted into the composer as a draft attachment.
Open a sidebar file in the system default browser from a DSH tab's right-click menu or the unpreviewable-file empty state.
DeepSeek Harness 语音输入插件：DeepSeek 原生 ASR、自动 AI 优化、光标回填与长录音恢复。复用宿主凭据和模型，配置 Key 后即插即用。

dsh web GUI plugin: manage and delete conversation records (whole sessions or individual messages, cascade delete) from the settings page. Dual-face: node half serves /api/session-cleaner routes, browser half registers the settings-page view.
星河 · A procedural WebGPU Milky Way skin for DeepSeek Harness

Archived-sessions page for DeepSeek Harness: per-row and batch deletion that clears the session log, the projection cache and the archive index together, with a 30-day recycle bin, subagent-aware refusals and a per-row disk footprint.

macOS menu bar indicator and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: alerts when a tool needs approval (including sandbox escalations), when a question waits, and when a turn finishes — community fork of dsh-notify, compatible with DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.1
DSH QQ 鎻掍欢妗嗘灦锛歄neBot 11銆佷富浜虹鐞嗕笌鍙楅檺 Agent
DSH client plugin: select content in TXT/Markdown/code/CSV/PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX document previews and append a provenance-aware quote to the current conversation draft.
Turn-level live and completed throughput/latency telemetry for DeepSeek Harness agent workflows.
DeepSeek Harness 插件:任务完成/失败通知(含本次消耗与金额)+ 按 Key·模型的 Token 消耗统计 + 实时计价(改价即生效)+ Token Plan 回本/性价比与每日费用分析 + 工具箱小工具。
脉络 / Threadline —— 把一段对话对工作区做了什么（文件、命令、子智能体、决策）串成一条可下钻的时间线，只读地嵌进 DSH 会话页、每轮操作区与输入框命令
Paper-style sticky notes, paper notes, calendar, drawing and a reusable prompt library inside DSH

Custom background image plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: upload a local picture or paste an image URL, and render it behind the whole app surface with adjustable opacity, scrim, panel transparency and frosted-glass blur.

Third-party provider reasoning-effort AND input-modality settings for DeepSeek Harness: thinking levels and image-input support declared per model, auto-adapted from a model knowledge base + wire-protocol inference, edited right inside the official Models page card.

DSH web plugin: DeepSeek balance & platform usage monitoring, integrated into the Models settings provider row and the composer tool row (left of the model name). Replicates the DeepSeekMonitorWindows backend.
Inline +N −M diff badges on edit/write tool rows and a per-turn file change summary card for DeepSeek Harness. PTC dispatch fallback (code-dispatch/ptc-dispatch), no git required.

A Review tab plus fenced git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: workspace changes vs HEAD as a filterable file tree with per-file diffs, a commit graph, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations, served by an in-host fenced git API.

DSH web plugin: a usage statistics panel with per-day / per-hour token trend, GitHub-style activity heatmap, cache hit-rate curve and per-model / per-provider breakdowns, replicating the reasonix usage stats feature.
Background image plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (dsh web): pick a local image as the whole-UI background, adjust a theme-aware matte, or clear it anytime.
Skill picker for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (dsh web): choose a skill from the composer tool row like the model selector, inserting the /skill reference into the draft.
DSH web plugin: right-side context-and-files panel (directory browser, injected-context documents, read-only git commit graph) plus the session-log download action

DSH web plugin: cross-session capability for the Web UI — sidebar content search, composer @-references to other sessions, message forwarding between live sessions, and the model-facing session-query tools (config-gated)
Show the DeepSeek API account balance under the DSH sidebar brand row, refreshed every 60 seconds through a same-origin endpoint so the browser never touches the API key.
Git workbench for deepseek-harness: changelists, staging, history, branches, stashes and optional AI assistance
Cross-session agent-to-agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness: claims, verification and a decision ledger, so two agent sessions don't repeat, contradict or deadlock each other.
Per-request tier routing on the Laya judge, plus an Auto tier chip in the composer
DSH Cordis plugin using the shared Ark Play WSS gameplay core
MCP + Skill panel for DeepSeek Harness: a settings-page UI to manage MCP servers and agent skills.

webCandidates.description: Xcode build and development loop for DeepSeek Harness: build/test/clean/archive/run with a live, filterable build log panel.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: built-in desktop notifications (toasts, sound, title markers, approval quick actions) plus Discord bot forwarding for approvals, scheduled tasks, todo digests, goal notices and token usage.
Local HTTP fetch for DSH with opt-in TUN Fake-IP bypass and a first-run self check
Bridge DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions into Herdr Core as hc terminals
DSH-Video2Agent for DeepSeek Harness: index a video locally, search what was said and shown, cite exact frames, and optionally manage a logged-in Bilibili library.

Appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: an ordered list of model rules, each carrying its own wallpapers — every image with its own framing and theme color — plus layout mode, opacity, brightness and blur; the background follows the model you switch to, a rule can rotate through several images on its own rhythm, and an off-by-default switch lets the agent change any of it through two tools.
Agent desktop pet overlay for DeepSeek Harness: static or frame-animated poses that react to agent status and tool calls.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle: an eleven-role specialist roster, a durable workmate library, team staging with a shared board, and native dsh-Go panels and tool cards.
Discover all public GitHub repositories tagged dsh-plugin, with domestic mirror fallback and resumable scans.
Fold tool-call cards in the DSH conversation into a minimal expander — maximum collapse, click to expand
DSH profile plugin: notify in the web sidebar when a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh version is available on npm
DSH vision plugin: image recognition (Codex + Zhipu fallback) and generation (GPT Image + CogView fallback), text-only-model safe
Localize leftover DSH UI chrome to Chinese (command palette descriptions, permission presets, reasoning effort) at the display layer, and detect when the official build adapts them

Cloud workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: pick "Cloud (SSH)" in the workspace chooser and the agent's bash/read/write/edit/glob/grep tools transparently run on your Linux server over SSH. Includes ssh_* agent tools, an SSH host settings card, jump-host support and persistent connection pooling.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: balance at a glance, spend attributed to the session that caused it
Right-click any file path in the DSH Web UI (chat file links, editor tabs, path bar) to reveal it in the OS file manager.

todo-ledger for DeepSeek Harness: resident prompt section plus native tools that keep authoritative task state and cross-session context in the repo's ledger directory — `_todo/` preferred, legacy `todo/` still supported (todo.md + tasks.md + tasks/*.md + archived/ + context/).

Model-facing analyze_image tool for the DeepSeek Harness: multi-modal image understanding via any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with 8 analysis modes, local path / http(s) URL / data URL input, and a Web UI hint that guides image-incapable models to the reliable local-path route.
Clawd on Desk bridge for DeepSeek Harness, extended: context usage, approval/juggling/compaction signals, balance alerts.
A local-first developer control plane for multiple DeepSeek Harness runtimes.
DSH-native GroupX room bridge for local multi-agent collaboration
Optional allocation-conscious tool-result pruning for DeepSeek Harness, with independent Web switches
DSH-native Obsidian bridge: index local projects into a vault and build a wiki-link knowledge graph
Authored PR feedback inbox with shared Codex/DSH progress, priorities and read-only GitHub collection.
DSH-native multi-runtime baseline, ablation, and reproducible evaluation control plane
Safe DSH restart coordination and durable top-level session autoresume
Lifecycle-safe Codex-style Session context actions for DeepSeek Harness.
给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话加一层「文件夹」归类：按 cwd 自动归档、手动移动到任意文件夹，文件夹路径即项目记忆作用域。 Adds a folder layer to DSH sessions: auto-file by cwd, move sessions between folders, folder path = project-memory scope.
DSH SuperTerminal: natural-language tasks, resizable terminals, and a local agent library
DSH SuperTerminal: natural-language tasks, resizable terminals, and a local agent library
DSH-native uv environment manager with pip fallback and conda visibility
dsh-voice — turn-based voice loop for DeepSeek Harness: pluggable Qwen / MiMo / local ASR+TTS engines, agent-driven speak/listen tools and browser PTT UI, built for interviewer presets
DSH-native Harness Flow Hub for DeepSeek Harness plugins, Agent Stacks, and recoverable Profile transactions
A floating desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness with activity-aware pets and a growing local collection.
Safe DSH restarts with acknowledged handoff, verified in-place reconnect, and policy-based session recovery for DSH 0.2+
TODO-first orchestration with isolated workers, a two-lane queue, and saved model/reasoning choices for each role.

更清晰美观的会话 Token 用量条：上下文占用、输入/输出/缓存分解、吞吐与首字延迟，取代默认的纯文本 stats 行

A DSH web GUI color-scheme plugin: a data-driven registry of themes (Catppuccin, Everforest, Nord) selectable from a settings row, with theme-adapted tooltips and hover cards. Add new schemes by dropping one file into ./schemes and rebuilding.
ClinePass model provider and settings UI for DeepSeek Harness
Native reasoning-effort selection for custom (relay / self-hosted) model APIs in DeepSeek Harness: turns each model's reasoning switch on and fills in the vendor-correct levels and request fields.
GPT/Codex 对话桥：把本机 Codex CLI 的多轮会话接进 DSH，侧栏与右侧抽屉可查看往来，会话落进 Codex 会话库并可 resume 续接；提供 codex_gpt 工具与模型/推理强度切换。

DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing guard for DSH: detects the price window and current model, pauses running tasks at peak, resumes them automatically when off-peak begins, and schedules work for the next off-peak window.
Codex-style @path references for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: search workspace paths without injecting file content
Unofficial community plugin: per-viewport (desktop/mobile) visibility rules for DeepSeek Harness Web UI elements, with a settings page.
Kimi (Moonshot AI) chat-completions adapter for the DeepSeek Harness LLM seam — three routes: kimi-code (Kimi Code subscription), kimi-cn, kimi-global

DeepSeek Harness 备份与恢复插件：在 Web UI 设置里新增「备份与恢复」页，把全部工作区、完整对话（会话文件字节级复制）、附件、设置与 dsh-mnemon 记忆数据导出为一个 ZIP 备份包，并可预检后合并 / 覆盖导入。会话内容全程不解包不改写，任何 dsh 会话格式代际（v0–v3+）都可携带，harness 升级后可正常导入，dsh-mnemon 上下文注入恢复后与原本一致。

DeepSeek Harness 通用通知插件：新会话 / 待审批 / 任务完成 / 任务中断时，在 GUI 内显示 Telegram 风格应用内通知；前台后台都会响提示音（前台页面内发声，后台由系统原生通知发声），仅通知、不回调。
Evidence-first research workflow with durable state and a Web workspace
Cross-session notebooks with model tools, typed Remote API, and a Web workspace
Codemini-inspired compact disclosure for every DSH Web Tool call

Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail side, a curved length gradient anchored on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size, and width.

Conversation task-completion reminder for DeepSeek Harness (Web UI and DSH Desktop): a Windows system toast (Web Notification) on every stop — task complete, the agent waiting on you (approval request / question / plan review, each with its own title, and Approve / Reject buttons right on an approval toast), or an error stop (any failed turn — a gateway HTTP error such as 400/401/429/500/502, a provider outage, or a connection failure) — with subagent sessions (a lead's or any other agent's spawned agents) muted by default behind its own switch, two timing modes (always / only when the window is unfocused), a notification language of its own (follow interface / Chinese / English), clicking a toast opens that session at your last question (so you read the answer top-down) and, in DSH Desktop, raises the minimized or tray-hidden app window, plus a completion chime with four synthesized effects or your own uploaded audio file (stored locally in IndexedDB, never uploaded) that play instantly on switch — all in a dedicated Settings → Task reminder page with one-click restore defaults and a Check for updates entry at the bottom that reads npm (official registry plus the mainland mirror) and upgrades the plugin in place through DSH's own plugin manager, so updating is one click instead of a reinstall.
Animated video background for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI — a GPU-friendly looping video behind the interface, with a mute toggle, tab-hidden pause, and skin-center occlusion/blur support.
Right-to-left text direction for the DeepSeek Harness Web client. Marks Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Syriac content as RTL by script dominance, leaving Latin content untouched.
DSH 用量统计插件：token 采集、活跃热力图、费用估算、超限守卫

Provider failover for DeepSeek Harness: on rate-limit (429) or quota exhaustion, automatically switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, fall back to the last one (e.g. DeepSeek official), and show a visible notice in the UI.
Ponytail for DSH — the lazy senior dev. Live intensity switching (off/lite/full/ultra) with a toggle in the composer, injecting a minimal-code ruleset before every step to cut token usage.

Public HTTPS gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: username/password + TOTP or email-code login, brute-force protection, and a hardened reverse proxy to the loopback dsh listener.

把 DSH 页面里的实时思考内容抽出来，做成一个可拖拽、可调透明度、可点击穿透的置顶悬浮窗；逐字流式、绿灯跟速、自动英译中，也能一键弹出成独立小窗。零外部依赖，安装即启用。

Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.
ColorGuess DSH plugin: session-header action that opens the game in a drawer iframe (game hosted on GitHub Pages).
Hold Space to talk in DeepSeek Harness — local SenseVoice transcription (streams sentence-by-sentence while you hold) with automatic polish on release. 按住空格键语音输入：长按录音、逐句实时出字，松手后自动校对优化。
自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，并加进 DSH 的模型选择器。

把 Tailnet / 反向代理页面当作「本机」来用：启用 host 持久化设置，并按 Tailscale 身份只放行指定用户（Host/Origin 栅栏保持不动）。
DSH client plugin — 左侧悬浮会话轨迹条：悬停刻度/簇点显示浮窗预览，点击刻度/簇点/浮窗条目精确跳转；轨道跟随对话窗口左缘（v78）。

DSH client plugin — flip to the back of the page for a floating glass task console: live background jobs, subagents, session overview and workspace of the current session, with mouse-draggable and mouse-resizable cards (bottom-right handle, size persisted per card). Maximizing a card unrolls its controls onto the card's own canvas, where every control is a draggable, editable item and the board card stays a live thumbnail whose control order follows that arrangement; built-in cards open as a fullscreen view. The top-right card conversation calls a temporary agent session to refactor each card's style and internal controls from natural language, and any conversation can author cards via [taskcard] blocks (text/heading/note/stats/progress/trend/kv/links/chips/checklist/counter/button/table/code/toggle/countdown/bars/image/embed). Embedded web apps can be marked 受控 and routed through the bundled local page bridge (bridge/server.mjs), which injects an agent into the page so the workbench — and the agent — can click, type, scroll and read inside it through [page] action blocks; the app height is dragged on its bottom edge, accurate on the zoomed canvas too. Cards can be published as copies onto a fullscreen infinite canvas with named boards, share strings and a zero-dependency WebSocket relay for multi-user editing, and a right-hand dock renders the project's archify architecture diagram (embedded, sandboxed, resizable).
MoE4All local inference plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with engine management, model discovery, and downloads.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: ownership-checked delete_subagent / release_subagent / list_subagents tools and host routes that permanently remove subagent sessions and refresh open web clients.

Theme skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — one token engine derives the 126 --dsw-* color tokens per appearance from ten inputs, light and dark, switched in-app. Eight skins: Material Palenight/Ocean/Darker/Lighter, Catppuccin Latte, Vitesse Light, Snazzy Light, GitHub Light Gray.
任务进度条 for DeepSeek Harness：把会话的 todo 清单变成输入框上方一条常驻进度条，实时显示完成度、当前步骤与每一项状态。

DeepSeek usage terminal: a stock-terminal style K-line panel for usage, spend and balance

DeepSeek API 计费峰谷提示：常驻显示当前峰/谷时段；峰时段使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 提交任务时弹窗二次确认（支持今日不再提醒）

DSH Chat Lanes — 把对话窗口切成两列：我的话常驻左栏，模型的话在右侧流动
DeepSeek Harness settings, profile and local plugin backup/restore — packs every local plugin with its link topology and restores it to the original directory

HelloAI Theme: ten selectable color themes for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, plus an inline editor to add, reference, edit, rename and delete your own themes, with optional glass styling and token overrides.
HelloAI Works — card-based notes and resource collection for DeepSeek Harness: tag categories, text+image cards, JSON export/import and rotating on-disk file backups.
SkillHealth: cross-host skill usage statistics, health diagnostics, and default-load control for DeepSeek Harness.

Declutter the DeepSeek Harness chat: hide agent execution-log rows (Think / context injection / tool calls), tighten message spacing and font sizes, wrap messages in rounded-corner bubbles, and inject an editable "reply concisely" instruction into the system prompt.

DSH 插件：在对话框工具行、权限选择框右侧只读显示当前项目的 git 分支；目录不是仓库时不显示。

DeepSeek Harness plugin: secondary working directories for a project. The agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd, gains equal write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories under workspace-write mode, and is notified of configuration changes at the next message boundary. Managed from the composer's own '+' menu (official option picker, with an owned directory browser when no native picker can answer), configurable before the first message through a sessionless multiFolder remote API, and referenceable with @ in the input, subdirectories included.

DSH web plugin: zero the collapsed left sidebar's 56px rail and get a working expand control - prefers dsh-qol's hamburger, falls back to the official toggle, then to a tiny floating button.

Whole-left-column manager for DeepSeek Harness: one sequence across the panel list, the footer action row and the Settings seat — reorder, drag across seats, rename, re-icon, show/hide and collect rows into flyout groups. Configuration lives in a new Settings tab and applies instantly.

Plugin Foundry — a self-extending, everything-is-a-plugin compiler for DeepSeek Harness. Ships a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) as a runtime Service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.

Keeps a long agent turn answerable to the user's actual request: a standing maintainer-document reminder, two pre-execute gates (read a same-basename precedent before editing infrastructure; say what a side-effecting step is for), an objective anchor that quotes the user's latest instruction plus an explicit precedence rule, and a nudge stage that corrects before it blocks. Details: (1) A standing system-prompt section that tells the model to read the workspace maintainer documents (plan.md / conventions.md / stack.md / state.md / maintainer/README.md) before every operation, so small-model context compaction cannot erase long-term project memory. (2) A `tools/pre-execute` precedent gate that denies a write/edit inside a guarded infrastructure area until a working same-basename precedent has been read. (3) A `tools/pre-execute` intent gate that polices the turn's side-effecting calls when the model never said what the step is for. (4) An OBJECTIVE ANCHOR: the user's latest instruction, quoted verbatim in a second prompt section with an explicit precedence rule (user's latest instruction > your own last stated plan > a lead you found yourself), so a long turn cannot silently redefine its own task. (5) A NUDGE stage that corrects before it blocks — the first unexplained action only injects a reminder the model reads at its next step, a drift reminder fires once per long turn, and only a repeated offence is denied. Plus a right-sidebar tab that views and edits those documents, and ten runtime knobs exposed in the harness settings page (设置 → 插件 → 插件配置).

Agent teams for DeepSeek Harness: named long-lived teammates over ctx.subagents, a shared task list, a member-to-member mailbox, virtual workspaces, and an interactive voxel world in the conversation view

Session-scoped memory tab for DeepSeek Harness, rendered beside Chat / Trajectory / Context, covering the whole /memory surface (list, query, add, rewrite, remove, merge, proposals, budgets, audit, adapters, export, import). A companion to dsh-memento: it consumes the public ctx.memory seam and registers its own routes, so it never forks upstream. Reading the tab never increments the store's recall counters. Every route call carries a deadline, so a wedged request reports a failure instead of locking the tab. Removes address entries by primary key, so two memories with identical text stay individually deletable.
A dsh web GUI panel that lists the plugins you installed into your dsh profiles, with install spec, version, kind, and live loader phase.

DSH 会议室 v6：单一「会议室」入口的工作台（房间树/新建/设置内置）、官方主题色、邀请列表只列真实顶层会话、聊天页简洁气泡，每个会议室自带内置记录员 AI（目标达成自动出草稿、须用户审核）；你发的消息只写进会议室记录、永不进入与会者对话（要他们回应请点「唤醒与会者」），修复与会者每轮「本轮运行失败」（思考等级读取改走 ctx.get('llm') 并 await 官方 async 契约），踢人/驳回/再议/散会改用插件自带输入面板（不再依赖桌面客户端界面运行时不实现的 window.prompt），去掉房间页头的在线人数与记录员 chip；v5 起投递/唤醒时宿主自动激活与会者会话、发送后自动滚到底、「会议文件」在房间页头按钮；0.6.1 修复大 inode 下目录身份判定误报（合法目录被误拒）；v7：去掉「唤醒与会者」按钮——每次发送自动给与会者发一行『有新消息』提醒（你的正文仍只留在会议室记录里），踢人不再弹「踢出理由」输入框（点 ✕ 直接踢出）；v8：与会者 room_say 缺省 = 写进记录 + 自动接力（向除发言者外的成员各投一条不含任何正文的「有新发言」提醒，默认最多 6 跳、可用 autoContinueHops 调整、0 关闭；人类发言后额度归零），会议室不再「答完一轮就静止」；v9：《会议结果》与「会议文件」移到房间页右侧常驻栏（两个页签 + 收起/展开开关），新增只读预览端点 GET /rooms/:id/file?name=，删掉旧文件抽屉与聊天区内联结果盒；v10：修复「停在会议室页几秒被弹回聊天界面」——客户端粘性守卫（非用户主动导航就把面板抢回：先重挂 main 登记再设选中，400 ms 限流、6 s 内超 3 次放弃，localStorage 诊断环），宿主 index.js 与端点/工具/配置项均无增删；v11：取消自动接力的 6 跳上限（autoContinueHops 只当开关：0 关闭、非 0 开且可一直接力；回包去掉分母、不再写「已达上限」系统行；删掉内部 autoCapNoticed 状态），端点/工具/配置项仍无增删；v12：修掉「标记达成 / 散会」弹红框 signal timed out（客户端对触发记录员的两个接口改用 300 秒超时，宿主加 240 秒惰性看门狗、卡住就抛中文 503，并把失败原因写进会议记录）、新增第 13 个工具 room_task_done（与会者 AI 在真正有结论时发「任务完成」指令，记录员立即出草稿、仍由用户审核）、会议文件固定放进房间目录下的「记录/」「附件/」两个子目录（旧 files//results/ 自动搬家）、策划会议新增「文件管理」（保存方式 全部保存 / 只保存记录员的记录，后者在散会与结果发布后清空附件），端点无增删、配置项只加一个仅供自测调小的 recorderTimeoutMs；v13：修掉「新建子文件夹」把房间目录改成它自己的子目录导致无限复制（现在新建/选择文件夹 = 把整个房间搬到 <分类目录>\<新文件夹>\<房间id>，宿主对「搬进自己子目录」与「搬到分类目录本身」直接 400），散会后 room_say 与人类发言都不再广播（记录照写，重开会议恢复），唤醒消息里告诉与会者把文件写在房间「附件/」而不是桌面（与会者会话 cwd 是桌面），客户端新增普通会话式的自动下拉跟随（用户自己滚动即停跟随、不打断往回翻，另有「↓ 跳到最新」按钮）与右侧消息索引（每条消息一条横线，会议目标时间点加粗变色、悬停预览、点击跳转），端点/工具/配置项均无增删；v14：与会者写的会议文件真的会进房间「附件/」了（与会者会话是 workspace-write、只能写会话 cwd 与临时目录，所以改成在与会者 agent 作用域用影子工具把顶层文件名重定向到系统临时暂存区、本轮结束时由插件同名搬进「附件/」并刷新面板，唤醒消息相应改为「直接以相对文件名保存即可」），「文件管理」简化成只回答「会议文件留不留 + 放在哪个文件夹」，右侧消息索引改为悬浮一列、一个轮次一个刻度（主持人发言与目标时间点各算一轮，目标加粗变色），并修掉索引常量在样式对象之后声明导致的客户端启动崩溃；端点/工具/配置项仍无增删；v15：「文件管理」里的「文件夹」只留两个功能——「打开文件夹」（系统资源管理器，走第一方 /open-in-app/open，失败退回复制路径）与「选择文件夹」（直接弹系统文件夹界面，可在里面选或新建；选中的文件夹就是房间目录，客户端不再拼 <文件夹>\<房间id>，v13 的 joinPath 已删），换目录护栏新增「目标文件夹已经属于另一个会议室」400；与会者界面的「排队消息」不再堆积——同一位与会者最多挂一条未领取的自动接力提示，新提醒用 DSH 公开的 inbox.locate/replace 原地替换旧的那条（替换不了就退化为普通投递，绝不丢提醒），人类发帖与决议投递照旧每条新投；房间页头三个按钮并成一个（展开时「收起侧栏」、收起时「会议文件」）；端点/工具/配置项仍无增删；v16：会议文件真的进「附件/」——真机取证发现 v14 的影子工具在部分宿主上根本没接管、且与会者多数用 pwsh 写绝对路径，改为三层兜底（①影子保留并暴露 rec.tools 状态；②投递即开窗 + tools/post-execute + agent/turn-stopping 做快照差集、本轮新建的移走原件、只被改过的取副本；③不依赖 agent 钩子的 sweepSession 在 room_say 与每次投递时按上次巡检时间收拢 cwd 顶层新文件、首次只立基线），新增唯一端点 GET /dsh-room/staging 只读诊断、唤醒消息文案与实现对齐；与会者守则由宿主以 agent 作用域 systemPrompt.section 注入（恒定文本只落一次、不进对话历史，拿不到就静默降级）；《会议结果》驳回后把审核意见整套投给每位与会者要求逐条回应、记录员提示词新增第 5/6/7 条（只记最终共识/不编造/简洁）；房间列表每个分组标题加「＋」可在该分组目录下新建、「换分类目录」改走系统文件夹界面（拿不到再退回浏览式）；「回到最底」按钮不再只在有新消息时出现（跟随即常驻、有新消息点亮）；结果草稿编辑区标题改单行、正文随栏高伸展；底栏新增只读房间数据条（轮次/步/累计 tok/缓存命中/上下文占用，取自 sessionProjections 三视图、4 秒缓存、拿不到就整条不渲染）；v17：批准重开不再只改状态（「与会者申请重开 → 用户批准」后立刻把「已重开 + 申请理由 + 当前目标 + 继续口径」整套投给全体并接力，修掉真机上「批准了但没人开始讨论」）；与会者的权限请求可在会议室里实时批准 / 拒绝（宿主注册 ctx.on('approval/request')，只接管本房间成员并把请求挂到房间面板横幅上：点「允许」→ allowed-once、点「拒绝」→ rejected；非成员 / 超时 / 请求方取消一律 next() 交回 DSH 原审批链；新增房间级端点 GET/POST /rooms/:id/approvals，callId 走 body）；聊天输入框上方那条数据条挪到输入框下方、原来输入框下方那条长提示整条删除；工具仍 13 个、配置项零新增；v18：修掉真机上「与会者的权限申请依然只弹在会话页、会议室不出现横幅」——DSH 把 approval/request 转发给浏览器的那座桥注册得早且阻塞等用户在会话页点按钮，普通注册的监听器永远轮不到，改为用 { global: true, prepend: true } 插到桥前面（仍只接管本房间成员、非成员照旧 next() 交回原链），房间成员 id 的 session- 前缀写法不一致也认得出，GET /dsh-room/staging 增加只读 approvals{ready,options,pending,seen} 诊断；客户端零改动、工具仍 13 个、配置项零新增
