webCandidates.description: VS Code (from a code-server release) inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab driven by the plugin's own launcher over the in-process VS Code server (lib/launcher.mjs), plus an editor bridge (assets/extensions/dshcs-editor-bridge) that gives the agent what only the editor knows (unsaved buffers, language-server diagnostics, the active selection) and lets editor gestures drive the session. The bridge is completely read-only: all four of its routes (/health, /sync, /old, /event) are reads. Asking DSH from the editor opens a floating dialog inside the DSH page (draggable, resizable, bottom-right): the plugin's client half sends the question as user input (POST /api/code-server/ask/send) and renders that session's new content with DSH's own Markdown renderer - the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives instance the UI uses, required from the page's module table, so typography, highlighting and math match the interface and a renderer version mismatch is impossible. Thinking appears as collapsed rows and approval requests (writing outside the workspace / running commands) can be answered in place: whole-plugin write route POST /api/code-server/ask/approve, constrained to pending in-process requests and the outcomes allowed-once/rejected; dialog-first for 5 minutes, handed back to the official card the moment the dialog closes, never auto-approved. There is no build step anywhere: lib/client.js (client half including the dialog panel) and the extension are committed hand-written source, devDependencies holds a single test-only entry, and the published package carries no frontend bundle. Also: the tab claims DSH file addresses (dsh-resource://file/**) by file type (setting claimExtensions), so produced-file chips, delivered-file previews and inline prose mentions open in the workbench; the IDE is a resident surface moved with Element.moveBefore instead of being remounted, so switching sidebar tabs does not reload it; opening the tab switches the right sidebar to fullscreen by default (setting fullscreenOnOpen); a workspace switch re-navigates the workbench with the new ?folder= without restarting the IDE process. Requires a DSH with the right-sidebar services (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight, >= 0.1.5-alpha.1); older DSH versions only get an upgrade notice on the settings page. Two serving modes: loopback port (default) or same-origin mount on DSH's own webServer (/code-server, protected by ctx.connection.requestRejection). The diff the bridge opens always has the real pre-write text on the left, taken from result.value.before in tools/post-execute into a bounded snapshot cache and fetched by opaque key over the read-only GET /old, so files that are not open in the editor work too. No code-server Node layer, no argon2, no C++ toolchain.

Progressive long-term memory for DSH: sharded markdown bodies under ~/.dsh/memory/topics/, with only a live-generated map (shard · keywords · count · latest date) injected into the system prompt, entries pulled on demand via grep + read — so the prompt cost stays flat however large the memory grows. Two layers (global + per-project) plus the global rule files, viewable AND editable in DSH Settings, with per-layer switches and an index/full injection toggle. v0.5.0 adds enforcement hooks: a write guard on the native tool pipeline (format/secrets/history rules, optional external command judge, deny/ask with reasons fed back to the model), post-write audit log, a read reminder when memory files are read, a mandatory discipline block, and an optional injection filter command. Zero extra LLM cost, live re-read. v0.5.1 keeps the switches in ~/.dsh/memory/settings.json — read live by the plugin and edited from the settings pane over the plugin's own route, independent of the host settings API. v0.6.0 fixes the index silently degrading to a title-less directory once memory outgrew the hardcoded 9k budget (which is why an agent could see memory injected and still never read it): the index now shrinks per-shard along a newest-N-per-shard ladder under a configurable indexBudget, adds per-shard keywords (routing hint) and latest-entry dates, ships a 'check memory before starting a task' discipline, and makes full mode read the shard bodies (auto-falling back to index when over budget) instead of the retired memory.md navigation file. v0.7.0 makes 'map' the default injection mode (shard-level map only, no entry titles): retrieval = grep the memory dir with task keywords, then read the matched line; layers with <=12 entries stay inlined; the discipline block teaches that two-step path and routes cross-shard lookups (>=3 entries / >=2 shards / >=3k body) to a subagent that returns facts + line numbers instead of raw bodies. v0.9.0 adds the card-memory layer for roleplay sessions and makes every path Windows-safe: home resolution follows os.homedir() (so an undefined or empty HOME no longer roots paths at the drive root), tool and bash paths are normalized before guard matching, and drive-letter cwds produce valid project slugs. v0.9.2 fixes retrieval ranking at scale (IDF-weighted entry scores, df=0 CJK bigram fragments excluded from the coverage gate, BM25-style length normalization, preview windows anchored on the rarest matched token instead of a fixed 240-char head cut; measured locally: shards covered per top-8 2.88->5.75, largest tie block 4.38->1.13, previews containing a matched token 67%->100%): shard-level bonuses no longer inflate every entry in that shard (they were added inside the entry loop, so all hits from one shard shared an identical score and ordering collapsed to date-then-line), a per-shard quota stops one shard from filling the whole result page, and the default scope is the current project layer (other projects' shards — 60% of the pool locally — are skipped but reported in dropped.offScopeLayers/offScopeFiles, with scope:'all' to opt back in). v0.9.3 stops query function words from being searched at all (a CJK stopword set plus Latin stopwords, judged per-token so a real word that merely contains a stopword character stays searchable) and rejects sub-2-character queries, which previously collapsed into an unfiltered whole-library substring match: on the local corpus 'the/of/...'-style Chinese stopword-only queries went from 1270 hits to 0, and a single-character query from 1459 hits to a clean rejection, while the 15-query positive suite kept 14/15 recall with per-query hit counts unchanged (ranking, IDF, length normalization, per-shard quota and preview anchoring are untouched). v0.9.4 adds the mapless injection mode: the global shard map stops living in the system prompt entirely (locally measured: 188 shards = 40364 chars injected every turn) and is replaced by a fixed 370-char pointer, while shard-level routing moves into the memory_search reply as a query-scored top-8 bridge. Measured on 10 real tasks from this machine: entry-level retrieval alone finds the right shard in 6/10, the bridge in 10/10 (the 4 tasks entries miss, the bridge returns at rank #1) because a task phrased in Chinese colloquial prose cannot literally match an English shard name, and bridge scoring only needs topic-level overlap. Injection size becomes independent of memory growth and no longer invalidates the KV prefix when a memory is written. Bridge cost averages 1378 chars and only pays on turns that actually search. Also consolidates the inject-mode whitelist, which was the same ternary chain copy-pasted in three places (host 1 + client 2), into normalizeInjectMode()/INJECT_MODES plus a probe assertion that both tables agree, and keeps the per-shard over-limit warning in the bridge because the map that used to carry it is gone.

Delete a turn from the model-visible context and edit a per-session supplementary system prompt, from the bottom of a DSH conversation.
多磁盘分工管家：自动识别 C/D/E/F… 固定盘，用绿/黄/红标出可直接清理、需要确认、系统占用的空间，核对系统下载文件夹、浏览器、微信/QQ/Steam 的下载目录，并给出多盘分工与迁移建议。只读，不删除文件。
把本机已登录的 Qoder 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：按上游目录读取每个模型的积分倍率，支持逐模型图片输入，以及卡片与输入框里的只读积分胶囊读数。
Attach extra folders to a workspace: they become writable for the file tools and shell, listed for the model, and manageable from the workspace context menu.
DSH web plugin: cross-session token usage, request count, and optional cost analytics (ctx.tokenUsageStats), with a self-contained dashboard page and a sidebar footer entry.
MOKI Canvas for DSH — a local-first infinite canvas with mind maps, media, and two-way AI collaboration.
MOKI Library for DSH: local file management, rich previews, Office editing and precise AI selection collaboration.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a session into a timeline: swim-lane tracks, a flame graph and timing statistics for model calls, tool calls and background processes.

Testing-stage companion runtime for DeepSeek Harness: local-first memory, core memory, mood, heartbeat, proactive messages, switchable personas and a memory star map. Expect issues; not production-ready.

SSH terminal panel and AI connection manager for DeepSeek Harness: model-driven SSH connections (connect/exec/list/status/disconnect), auto-saved connection records, keep-alive + auto-reconnect, execution mutex, credential-safe auth, and an XShell-style multi-tab terminal panel in the Web GUI.

LLM-as-a-Verifier for DeepSeek Harness (unified): fine-grained reward tools (verify_compare / verify_select / verify_track) with Probabilistic Pivot Tournament and vLLM/SGLang prefill, PLUS the Best-of-N conversation mode. Configured from the dsh web Plugins page or the profile's Cordis patch. Merged from dsh-llm-as-a-verifier (TaurenMountain) and @aispin/plugin-verifier (Aispin).
DeepSeek Harness web plugin: copy a whole chat message - text, images, videos and files - and paste it back into any session's composer with the media still attached.
Install and build local DeepSeek Harness plugins from the Web settings Plugins section.
DeepSeek Harness 心情插件：33 种心情各有数值，每 3~6 小时自动判定，用户消息小幅累积加减分，达到余量才切换，支持混合心情；附带每日心情日记、跨会话可检索的硬盘记忆；把当前心情注入提示词，影响回复语气和深度思考里的内心话。附带每天 23:59 自动生成的心情日记、用户自配来源的时事、可选的主动开口，以及可迁移到任意盘的数据目录。

多模态路由 for DeepSeek Harness：纯文本模型的每一步请求里的每张图片（用户上传 / 工具返回 / MCP 渲染）都先经多模态理解模型转述为文字再作答，图片类报错自动转述重试，两类模型全程交叉协作。Multimodal router for DSH: every image in every step of a text-only model's stream is transcribed to text by a multimodal understander first; image-related failures auto-recover with a transcription retry.

webCandidates.description: Prompt Studio: per-session system prompt append/replace with templates, global defaults, and live preview for DeepSeek Harness.
A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
A standalone Hacker News reader with app-scoped AI conversations for DeepDeck
Persistent NGA reader with app-scoped AI conversations for DeepSeek Harness
The official Strudel REPL experience for DeepDeck with a sandboxed runtime and AI-assisted live coding
Video Sherlock — agent-driven video evidence dashboards for DeepDeck

In-chat approval review: when the model asks to change a file, a composer takeover replaces the native approval card with a true diff review. Line diffs with word-level highlights, disk-sourced context with line numbers, one-sided green creates, red deletion reviews. One file per card (consecutive same-file calls merge into one diff with two file-scoped buttons); everything that is not a file-changing approval falls through to the native card.

Example plugin for dsh-granular-settings: three bouncing squares, one per settings scope (session, workspace, global). Switch sessions and workspaces to watch each scope behave differently. Exercises toggle, text, color, slider, number, enum, and multiselect controls.

Diff view: a reusable two-text diff viewer for DSH client plugins. The diffView client service exposes the line-LCS + word-span engine and a self-contained split/unified diff component with line numbers, context collapse, and its own stylesheet. No persistence; no approval coupling.

Event relay: one shared SSE channel pushing host-side events to subscribed browser surfaces. Frames carry an optional JSON payload — some plugins use it as a pure change signal (doorbell style, refetching their own truth), others consume the payload directly (notifications, kanban updates). Client opens the stream with the union of subscribed topic prefixes (server-side filtering) and signals reconnects via __relay/open.

Prompt manager: live census of every system-prompt section with suppress and replace, custom system prompts (additive or complete mode), and a persona library with default plus per-session selection. Adds a Prompt tab to Granular Settings and a persona picker in the chat composer.

Granular settings platform: one Granular Settings page in the settings dialog with Workspace/Session/Plugin tabs. Three scopes (workspace, session, global) registered by plugins, namespaced storage, doorbell-only push.

Markdown view: markdown rendering for DSH client plugins, exposed through the client service mdView. A thin facade over the harness MarkdownText primitive (GFM, math, footnotes, highlighted code) plus README-ism handling: raw tags and document-relative targets resolved against the repo.

Scratch pad: one shared floating text surface in the middle of the screen. Other plugins open it through the client service scratchpad: read mode shows big text (scrollable, selectable, Close only); edit mode adds Save and returns the edited text to the caller via onSave. No persistence; the caller owns the text.
Workspace Overview GitHub tab: an About card, the repository README rendered as markdown, and the default-branch commit history with per-file patches, all for the workspace's github.com remote.

Workspace Overview tmux tab: live/frozen/cold session state for the workspace, one-click terminal attach through tmux-fridge, freeze/snapshot/recover actions, and explicit workspace-to-session links for custom session names.

Workspace History: journals every compaction summary to <workspace>/.dsh/history/<unix-ts>.<short-session-id>.md, and adds a History subtab to the Workspace Overview tab for reading the journal. Per-session toggle lives in the granular Settings tab — requires dsh-granular-settings (hard dependency).
Workspace overview: a Workspace Overview tab beside Chat with a subtab facade for other plugins, and a GitHub pill in the session header when the workspace has a github.com repository.

Push notifications from DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to your phone via ntfy, one way only: nobody can send anything back into your agents. Turn results, approvals and questions, failures, an optional live heartbeat, and a ping_me tool so automation tasks alert you only when they find a problem.

One small Restart button in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI sidebar that works with your setup: systemd, Docker/Podman/Kubernetes, pm2, supervisord, launchd, terminal/tmux, Windows. Restarts in place (same PID), no supervisor detection or config, reloads the page when dsh is back. Agents get it too: a dsh_restart tool that wakes them with a continue prompt once dsh is back up.

Live hardware load panel for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a btop-style tab showing CPU load per core and overall, DRAM usage, CPU temperatures, and per-GPU temperature/load/power/VRAM. Reads /proc and nvidia-smi on the host and polls ~1s in the browser.

Message recall for DSH: cut the conversation back to before a chosen user message so it leaves the model's context, hide it in the transcript, and put its original text back in the composer. Works through the kernel's own surface-replacement mechanism, so nothing is deleted from the session log.
DSH Input Translator: 输入框悬浮快捷翻译与历史找回挂件 (支持当前会话模型 / 智谱 GLM-4-Flash / 自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点)
在 DSH Desktop 中看清每一次请求的 Token、费用与速度，按模型和供应商汇总花费，统一同一模型的不同名称，核对余额并比较模型实际表现。

Archive management for DeepSeek Harness: one panel with two tabs (archived / active) where every session row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete. Reuses the harness's native archiving; deleting removes the session log and projection cache but never the bound workspace directory.
Supercharged subscription-based LLM provider aggregator for DeepSeek Harness (ChatGPT/Codex, Grok, Google AntiGravity, Claude, Copilot) with unified auth, quota pooling, and zero-config defaults.
DSH Web 桌宠插件：模型开始输出时，桌宠从「等待」→「变身」(持续 2 秒) → 并保持「奔跑」，输出结束回到「等待」。纯客户端插件：host 半区为空 apply，浏览器 bundle 经 exports["./client"] 提供。
File Explorer for DeepSeek Harness: right-side resizable file tree (expand/collapse, search, syntax-highlighted preview, in-panel editing) with one-click VS Code / system file manager open

A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents (orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers) that turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline with machine-verified delivery evidence, review-gated merges, a full audit-log event stream and a live kanban tab; design inspired by the Hermes Agent kanban
Qiaomu Audio for DeepSeek Harness
Original Qiaomu Blog Publisher for DeepSeek Harness
Qiaomu Cover Design for DeepSeek Harness
乔木 Home：DeepSeek Harness 的起点页插件——壁纸与问候、会话搜索、今日待办、最近会话、常用入口、专注计时、时间进度、世界时钟、每日一句与天气。
Qiaomu Publish for DeepSeek Harness
乔木电台 · DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 里收听全球直播电台，五种播放器环境、场景频道、本地口味记忆。
乔木阅读：DSH 的 EPUB、PDF、TXT、Markdown、HTML 阅读器，支持朗读、生词本、阅读笔记与原生 AI 伴读。
Qiaomu RSS reader for dsh: featured + personal feeds, AI translation/rewrite assist, agent tools, and a web reading panel
Qiaomu UI Learn for DeepSeek Harness
隐藏 DSH 侧栏会话行右侧的相对时间戳（刚刚 / 7小时 / 1天）
在桌宠中允许一次普通请求，高风险请求跳转DSH手动审批
删除 DeepSeek Harness 中已归档的对话：侧边栏归档会话菜单的删除入口 + 供助手调用的工具
DeepSeek Harness 技能安装器：按名字搜索或直接输入 GitHub 仓库地址，列出仓库中的 SKILL.md 技能，勾选后安装到全局 / 当前项目 / 自定义目录，与内置 skill-filesystem 联动，装完即时生效。
DSH Web Settings surface for DSH Crate export, import, inspect, and history
Atlas: six material skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — one token engine derives the 119 --dsw-* alias tokens per appearance, light and dark, switched in-app. No images, no host route.

Leshan: three photograph skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — River Night, Lingyun Dusk and Emei Mist. Each photograph is the page, one token engine derives the other 119 shell tokens, light and dark, switched in-app.

AIVN's stage engine inside DeepSeek Harness: a workspace is a play, the playwright preset writes Stage DSL, and a Stage tab in the conversation renders it live (backgrounds, sprites, dialog, stop-point choices, line-by-line TTS). dsh-aivn：把 AIVN 的舞台引擎装进 DSH——工作区就是一部剧目，剧作家预设写 Stage DSL，对话页的「舞台」tab 实时演出（背景、立绘、台词条、停止点选项、逐句语音）。

Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: mind_map surveys the agent's own context surface (seqs, token weights, clear-boundary markers and the clear-mind playbook), clear_mind replaces a chosen span with a model-written checkpoint through the platform's native compaction transaction, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long. dsh-clear-mind：让模型自主压缩自身上下文——mind_map 俯瞰上下文表面（seq/token/清理边界标记 + 清理手册），clear_mind 把一段对话历史替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 可展开审计），上下文涨长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理。
Command-level guard for DeepSeek Harness: allow-by-default whitelist with configurable workdir/command rules that ask for human approval or deny outright. 命令级守卫：默认一切放行，命中配置规则的命令弹审批或直接拒绝。

Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness — in-page toasts, PWA system notifications and browser notifications, with Web Audio synthesized sounds and per-event toggles. dsh-hybrid-notify：DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件——按窗口可见性自动切换页面内 toast / PWA 系统通知 / 浏览器通知，附带 Web Audio 合成音效与事件级开关。

Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.38.0) for DeepSeek Harness: humanized message delivery (send delay + typing two-phase), message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool. @xmanrui/dsh-im 的拟人化分支：人化发送（延迟+输入中两阶段）、message_break 与 streaming 共存、状态表情、回复引用、per-bot 全量覆盖。
Advanced model-context injection and request-only rewriting for DeepSeek Harness with Keysmith rules compatibility. dsh-inject：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供高级上下文注入与请求侧消息重写，兼容 Keysmith 规则集。
Live2D session view with realtime voice: continuous voice input, streaming TTS, subtitle translation, multi-model catalog, standalone entry / Live2D 实时语音会话视图：连续语音输入、流式 TTS、字幕翻译、多模型目录、独立入口

DeepSeek Harness OS: a whole-GUI theme for the DSH Web interface — conversation flow, sidebar, code blocks, tool cards, dialogs and composer repainted in light and dark through the official theme-token layer, plus a home terminal desktop (ASCII field, boot self-test, live host/harness HUD with a real per-model token ledger) and an in-session telemetry strip. dsh-os：覆盖整个 DSH Web GUI 的主题——会话流、侧边栏、代码块、工具卡、弹窗与输入框用官方 token 层换墨（深浅两套），首页则是一台赛博终端桌面（ASCII 字符场、开机自检、真实系统与会话 Token 账本 HUD），会话内另有遥测条。

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake turns with tombstone compaction; ships a web panel for alarm and history management. dsh-proactive：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒——模型自订闹钟（单次/循环/cron+随机抖动），冷会话到点自动 resume，安静时段与每日投递预算约束自主跟进，静默唤醒折叠压缩不污染上下文，自带 Web 面板管理闹钟与唤醒历史。

Quality-of-life tweaks for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Chrome-style session tab bar, edge-swipe sidebar, IME/keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, full-screen mobile settings and more — 17 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings page, with instant effect and per-browser persistence. dsh Web GUI 体验优化插件：会话 Tab Bar、侧栏滑动开合、输入法/键盘适配、触摸反馈、移动端设置页全屏重写等 17 项功能，均可在设置页独立开关，即时生效并按浏览器持久保存。

Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, review 👀, done ✅). dsh-session-prefix：基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji。

Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, review 👀, done ✅). dsh-session-prefix：基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji。

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: through the TypeSafe Jev decision model (it reads each turn's instruction, classifies the task and picks a preset) or through its own tool calls, the agent switches model presets and thinking depth on its own, following the task at hand. Includes set_model / list_models agent tools, preset mode with switch_preset / list_presets, presets that declare reasoning effort only so one model can retune its own thinking depth, a configurable stage-to-preset prompt, plan-mode auto-transition, provider whitelist and context-window guards, active-model runtime context injection, and a bundled Web settings page. 为 DSH 提供的插件：通过 TypeSafe Jev 决策模型（每轮读取指令、判断任务类型并选出档位）或调模工具调用，让 Agent 根据任务场景自主切换模型预设和思考深度。含 set_model / list_models 自主调模工具、switch_preset / list_presets 档位切换、只声明思考强度即可在同一模型上调节思考深度的档位、可配置的「阶段→档位」提示词、Plan 模式自动升降级、Provider 白名单与上下文窗口护栏、活跃模型运行时上下文注入，以及插件自带设置页。

Quickly toggle the DeepSeek Harness Web UI sidebar grouping between workspace and flat list via Alt+R or by clicking the section header title (Sessions / Workspaces). dsh Web GUI 侧边栏分组快捷切换插件：支持按 Alt+R 快捷键或直接点击侧边栏分组标题（会话 / 工作区）在工作区分组与平铺会话列表间一键切换。

Zen Mode view tab + foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: a calm minimal surface (status message, latest user message, live activity hints, markdown AI reply, one-line turn stats) while the agent works, with screen-watching time tracking, daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle, auto enter/exit and an Alt+Z shortcut — pure client-side, no network. dsh-zen 禅模式插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简的 Zen 视图标签页（状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 最终回复、单行轮次统计），并统计前台盯屏时长、给出每日/每周禅值，支持隐藏中间过程、自动进出禅与 Alt+Z 快捷键——纯前端、无网络请求。

Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, review 👀, done ✅). dsh-session-prefix：基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji。

Conversation steward for DeepSeek Harness: one folder per conversation, a recoverable Delete conversation row, an automatic handover log per conversation, type-aware right-click file actions, link actions that open in any installed browser, and an opt-in three-rule safety baseline written into the global AGENTS.md.
会话级自动上下文压缩插件：回合中每步前 + 回合结束检测上下文用量，超过会话阈值自动 compact，摘要注入上下文后自然继续（DeepSeek Harness / DSH）
DSH better-sidebar plugin: read paper PDFs and translate a selection with the LLM, contextual and isolated from the main conversation.
Marks the DSH Web GUI as untranslatable (html translate=no + google notranslate meta) so browser page-translation can never rewrite React-owned DOM and wipe composer drafts.
Mobile/touch optimizations for the DSH Web GUI: iOS input-zoom fix, safe-area insets, touch targets, and viewport clamps for stock dialogs on narrow screens.
DSH web plugin: searchable model picker + provider management settings page
Photo upload for the DeepSeek Harness composer — native picker feeding the stock paste pipeline
Serena dashboard lens for DeepSeek Harness — m4/m5 tabs embedding Serena's tool-call stream inside the GUI
Voice dictation for the DeepSeek Harness composer — mic button + Web Speech API
Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx) previews for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar document pane — OOXML parsed locally in the browser, no Office installation and no network.
Unlock DSH Web settings and credentials when you open the UI from a LAN IP or public hostname
Calls a System One model at configured points of the agent loop and writes each call, request and response, to a JSONL trace. Decides nothing.
冻结计划的浏览器自动化中间件：计划由人给出，执行器逐步选择元素、动作并检查可验证信号；模型只做选择、风险与完成票，不生成动作。
DSH 插件：在右侧栏原生自定义 tab 中渲染加密行情技术分析图表
The final compatibility bridge between DSH Native attachments and the classic path-backed P2P workflow.
DeepSeek Harness 免設置模式 — 安裝後開箱即用，自動完成最佳設置（No-Setup Mode for DeepSeek Harness: one-click out-of-the-box setup）
DeepSeek Harness官方首页主题插件，包含流体鼠标效果、弹性网格与动态小鱼。
让 dsh 用独立的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型读图：主对话历史只保留纯文本描述，图片字节不进上下文，纯文本模型也能读图。
Open any DSH conversation in its own native window, so several conversations can be watched at the same time.
Raise running conversations to the top of the workspace session directory.
个人上下文：各来源的消息收进来，投进指定的 agent 会话
Proxy mode for DeepSeek Harness: follow the system proxy, connect directly, or point at your own proxy — from Settings, applied live.
Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces.
Adds Finder / Zed / Ghostty open actions to workspace folder rows in the sidebar.
DSH plugin that injects an editable section into the global system prompt, with a settings page to customize it.
Per-command proxy for DeepSeek Harness: the agent decides which shell commands leave through a proxy, backed by a kernel the plugin installs and supervises itself.
dsh 多平台聊天网关插件：将 SillyTavern Gateway 的 QQ/Telegram/Discord/飞书/QQ官方/钉钉适配器移植到 DeepSeek Harness，实现通过 IM 远程指挥 dsh 会话。
dsh 提示词优化助手：发送前调用专门的提示词工程 agent 润色/补全/扩写命令，支持重写、多轮改写与撤回（host + client 双半插件，dsh plugin add 一键安装，随 harness 启动自动加载）。
DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站 —— 读字幕挑出值得的、每条写一份笔记，值得的就 @ 你
以「封面 + 正文」组织知识的 DSH 记忆插件：封面只写在项目级 handoff 文档里（唯一源头），正文独立落盘成文档；封面按项目 → 主题 → 全局三层聚合。库在 ~/.dsh-memj/，拷一个目录即迁移。
将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.

webCandidates.description: Design, observe, diagnose, and reuse evidence-backed multi-Agent work in DeepSeek Harness
在运行中控制 DeepSeek Harness 的出站代理：设置界面（内置/系统/手动三选一）+ 系统代理探测 + 连通性自测 + 如实状态上报，改动无需重启。系统代理仅桌面版提供
DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 MCP 管理插件：卡片式服务器管理、自定义 stdio/Streamable HTTP 接入、公共 MCP 目录一键安装。
Wallpaper Engine 工坊清理：对照“我的订阅壁纸”截图（支持多页），把不属于你的壁纸文件夹移入回收站。带设置页、悬浮模态框与 agent 工具。
DSH Web GUI 内的 B 站随机视频小窗（鲸鱼监工）：可拖拽缩放、弹幕、扫码登录、多档画质、任务完成联动

Bilingual UI (zh/en)

DeepSeek Harness live voice preview with exact-session consent, a local synthetic demo, and one bounded manual turn

GEO / Bulk 转录组工作台（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：GEO 检索下载、自有测序矩阵导入与清洗、差异表达、功能富集、免疫浸润、临床生存与高级预后、单细胞映射、circRNA/miRNA/lncRNA/fusion/可变剪接。

Conversation lineage for DeepSeek Harness: fork at a completed turn and show the family tree. Does not rewind files or merge logs.
Set the startup window size and position of DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with fixed/memory modes, 4:3 / 16:9 / 16:10 presets, custom presets, and a visual settings panel.

Self-management & self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: health snapshots, config pre-check, blue-green evolve with auto-rollback, and an on-demand standby supervisor — let dsh manage itself.

DSH 侧边栏行情卡片：BTC / ETH / SOL，可收成一枚小胶囊，零依赖零密钥。

无限画布插件仓库：把第三方插件拖入画布脱离全局、组装成组合、开启后重新加入全局响应。Infinite-canvas plugin warehouse: compose third-party plugins into activatable workflows.
Alibaba Cloud Token Plan monthly usage in DeepSeek Harness: an ambient composer strip, a settings page, and an alibaba_token_plan_usage agent tool.
Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
DSH plugin: sign in with a ChatGPT account (Codex OAuth) and generate images with the subscription quota instead of a paid API key.
Data lens (数据透镜): a conversational, read-only data analyst for DeepSeek Harness — natural-language question to validated SQL, inline chart, and an audit trail.
为 DSH 会话设置自定义 SVG 图标和颜色，并支持模型工具调用
OpenCode Go 订阅用量小部件：滚动/周/月用量百分比与重置倒计时，右下偏中悬浮显示（服务端代理 opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage + 浏览器小部件，key 不落浏览器）
每轮提问的 LLM 用量记录：左侧栏按钮 + 抽屉面板，列出每轮的 tokens/耗时/工具调用，点击跳转到对应会话
DSH side chat plugin with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and main-conversation handback.
生图桥：给没有生图/修图能力的模型接入外部生图模型。在 Web 界面配置 API 与 Key，模型即可直接调用生图/改图能力。

Delete DSH sessions completely: clears all six on-disk locations (session logs, title cache, bili/billion-context SQLite index, workspace registry, cost-meter ledger, bridge logs), with backup, rollback, and automatic DSH restart.
In-web plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: categorized list, tags, one-click preset switching, plugin marketplace, import/export. 在网页里管理 dsh 插件:分类/标签/预设一键切换/插件市场/导入导出。
Memory plugin with built-in governance for DeepSeek Harness
君说 KingSpeak — a DSH voice dictation panel: realtime speech-to-text, per-session timestamped blocks, one-click insert into the conversation composer.
Read-only Agent Team console for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: live roster, shared task board, and collaboration activity from one same-origin JSON snapshot route.
「项目开发模式」+ 开发进度看板：预设 persona/团队职责/看板守则，7 个 project_board_* 工具（含 prune 批量清理），只读快照路由与聊天内悬浮看板。
A skinnable corner balance badge for DeepSeek Harness — swap the frame template, compose the panel from elements
My Files for DeepSeek Harness Web: a sidebar entry listing every file produced across all conversations, grouped by session, openable from one panel
DeepSeek Harness 独立预测消息插件；复用会话模型，输入框灰字接受。
Connect the DSHM Android client to official DeepSeek Harness for remote conversations and approvals
DSH 插件：SSH 远程运维/开发工具套件（run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull）+ ControlMaster 连接层 + 状态面板 + 设置页主机管理。
跨压缩记忆：同一个超长会话被压缩多次后，早前问过/定过的事仍能被检索到并作为参考注入。压缩时入库（0 模型调用），提问时本地检索、命中才注入。
ZCode-style model picker for the DSH web GUI — provider submenus that open upward, reasoning-effort selection, and keyboard navigation. · DSH 的 ZCode 式模型选择器：向上展开的提供方子菜单、推理等级选择与键盘导航。
Auto Title: keep session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.
Delegation Mode: a per-session switch where the main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work.

DSH Docs: browse official DSH developer documentation in the Plugins page; in Creator mode the agent also gets two read-only tools to search docs and inspect plugins across the catalog, npm, and GitHub (dsh_docs, dsh_plugins).
Font: customize the interface, conversation, code and terminal fonts and font sizes of the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping commits and generating commit messages.
Subagents: configure the model and reasoning effort for new subagents, and see each one's last-used model in the conversation popup.
Safe Auto: a reviewer model answers approval requests one call at a time; includes review history with full audit trails.

Search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a reply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork the current session or message other sessions.
Unrestricted: a session preset that removes the limits on what the model answers and delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it. May get your account banned.
Manage and rank web search and page-reading providers in one settings page—with built-in DuckDuckGo, Exa, Tavily, Linkup, Zhipu, and others—for the model's web_search and web_fetch tools.

Zhihu site and web search, hot list, Zhida AI answers, knowledge bases, question recommendations and answer summaries, published content and comments, creator stats, quota tracking, and draft sync with image uploads.
Spaces for DeepSeek Harness — switch DSH workspaces like Discord servers.
Suggested follow-up prompts for DeepSeek Harness chat: AI-generated next steps as clickable cards under every agent turn — one click sends the reply, zero typing. 15 languages.
Visual feedback & design review for DeepSeek Harness: click any UI element in the browser, comment, tweak CSS live, and send structured context + screenshot to your agent.
Select any answer text to get a streaming explanation card; card text stays selectable for further explanation, and nothing enters the main conversation context.
DeepSeek 官网风格皮肤：深蓝宇宙感背景（流体极光 + 粒子鲸鱼 + 星座网格）与浅色玻璃主题，右上角一键切换

Reverie for DeepSeek Harness: an isolated, read-only open-ended association experiment over a corpus you configure — a notes folder, a JSON/JSONL export, or your own session history. One bounded run searches, expands and reflects on what is actually there, then leaves a report and a private note. Mock mode needs no model call.
勿忘我：给任何 LLM 用的封存式记忆大脑——艾宾浩斯遗忘、联想召回、可塑性性格、自动总结，附 3D 莫比乌斯记忆星环与脑图。DeepSeek Harness 插件 / MCP / REST
Renders full pages (login, dashboard, table, form) inside the chat; export as standalone HTML.
Packs Skills, sessions, installed plugins and settings into one zip and restores them on a new machine; sanitize or encrypt sensitive content.
配置保险箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚（设置补丁、插件清单、技能规则、工作区列表），恢复前自动安全快照，凭据默认排除。零构建、零运行时依赖。
DeepSeek Harness 的 AI DJ：把对话变成点歌、切歌与场景播放，驱动本机 LX Music（洛雪）完成搜索与播放。插件本身不含音源、不下载音频。
可自定义的 DSH 外观主题：壁纸、明暗两套 19 项配色、文案与六款表情，支持配置导入导出和 AI 生成配色（预填聊天框/补充指导/粘贴回复/提示词下载）；聊天框高斯模糊 + 高级模糊开关
Explore with AI in DeepSeek Harness and grow knowledge you can revisit and revise in your own Obsidian vault
DSH web plugin: inline 3D model preview (STL / 3MF) for dsh-better-sidebar, with Bambu Studio & OrcaSlicer plate detection and per-object filament colours.
On-demand tool groups and role-scoped tool surfaces for DeepSeek Harness: hide heavy tools, switch review/build/research by label.

Japanese (日本語) interface for the dsh-advisor settings page — a standalone DSH client plugin that adds Advisor Settings, consultation budget, history, and connection-test copy in Japanese without touching the Advisor core.
dsh-AgentTask: 纯任务监视(胶囊 x/y + 面板三段 + 点击跳转), 全端可用
DSH Host+Client plugin: 权限确认窗口（审批面板）中文化 —— 接管 conversation.composer 审批卡片并用中文重绘，翻译授权原因与命令明细；本地词表优先，model_router 兜底。
分类树形式的工作区管理器（分类 > 工作区 > 会话），接管 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏的工作区浏览器。

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that runs scheduled shell automation on remote Aliyun ECS, Tencent Cloud CVM or AWS EC2 instances through zero-inbound command channels, with a Cloud Tasks sidebar page and agent tools.
DSH context compression with visual token-budget settings: default 8k handoff + 16k recent context, adjustable for small-context models, with searchable full history
GitHub + 发布工具 for DeepSeek Harness：调 REST API、一次提交多个文件、建仓库/Release、查 token 身份，以及一条命令把「版本同步→测试→打包→提交打 tag→GitHub Release→npm 发布→三处哈希核验」走完。token 只存在插件自己的设置里，不进仓库、不进工具输出。推送前会扫一遍高置信度凭据（默认只告警）。

Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a real Chrome over CDP. One call fetches several pages, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest (80-98% fewer context tokens). Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, auto proxy.
DeepSeek Harness 关机插件：Settings 增加「关机」页，一键优雅退出 DSH 服务（先响应页面再退出进程）。
DeepSeek Harness 更新检查插件：DSH 本体与 profile 插件版本可见性（模型工具 + Settings 页面 + 周期复查），只报告不执行升级。
DSH bundle adding a per-session prompt-profile axis: named system-prompt sections grouped into profiles with per-section order and scope, sealed into the session prompt.
DeepSeek Harness companion for the Codex DSH Bridge.
GitHub Actions CI manager for DeepSeek Harness: live pipeline dashboard, OAuth device-flow sign-in, repo browser, run logs, and the github_ci agent tool.
dsh plugin: desktop message alerts when dsh needs the human — permission approvals, user questions, plan reviews, turn/session completion, goals, errors, and workflow runs
DSH 右侧栏「画布」插件:无限画布 + 直接在图上标注 + 接 GrsAI(gpt-image-2 / nano-banana)按标注改图,结果放在原图旁边对比,画布自动存到工作区
任务完成庆祝：根代理完成任务时，DSH Web GUI 页面底部出现 DeepSeek 官方鲸鱼喷水 3 秒。本地外部插件，不改 DSH 源码。
美树沙耶香桌宠：把会话状态变成表情、台词与配音——没事睡觉、跑代码拔刀、报错伤心、成功高兴。Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
锦鲤池塘 — Koi Pond theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI (Canvas koi pond animation, component-split CSS)
Git history as a tab inside each DSH conversation: the session opens its own repository, with branch lanes, commit detail, diffs, refs and working-tree operations.
DSH 插件：大肥鱼的大脑 —— 知识库 + 记忆库 + QQ 通道端点 + 设置页与输入框开关；附带 AstrBot 转发桥源码

DSH 插件：FX战士大肥鱼 —— 和大肥鱼（鲸鲸）切磋：EUR/GBP/TOKEN 对 token、黄金、鲸元五个品种，杠杆 10~500x、计时赛 90~500s，或「重生之久留美归来」：30 万本金、不限时、先摸到 2000 万赢、负债即出局（空中飞人计数）；鲸鲸出招可选本地免费算法或 DeepSeek API（会消耗 API 余额）；入口在左侧图标条；一键安装器（Windows 双击 install.cmd），换机即装即用
DSH 增强功能静态化常驻包(bundle):余额查询/会话完成提醒/费用预估与账单明细/粘贴图片转文字/Token 用量统计;仓库另含模型选择器增强等插件源码与一键安装脚本

DSH-LULUX Flow (DSH工作流（LULUX Flow）): run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and Grok CLI on the models you already configured in DeepSeek Harness (no CLI logins, keys never passed to the CLI), and wire them into DAG workflows.
Open chat.deepseek.com inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, through a Host-side loopback proxy that keeps the DeepSeek login across restarts.
Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。

DeepSeek Harness bundle providing HTTP Basic Authentication, a bilingual web login page, a Web UI settings card, remote IP access, and a Web Cryptography UUID polyfill for self-hosted server deployments.
J-Space Cognition Suite V3.6 - Inference-time cognitive control and deep reasoning for DeepSeek models
DSH plugin: per-session model switching for main agent, subagents, and plan mode / 为 DSH 的主会话、子代理与计划模式分别选择模型与思考强度

DeepSeek Harness personal toolkit: small runtime-toggleable quality-of-life optimizations, each shipped as one card in the Toolkit settings page. Optimizations: workspaceless chat, edit-and-resend last message, activity grouping in the sidebar, Chinese slash-menu descriptions, a per-turn change report, the OpenCode Go per-conversation session header, model-capability sync for an llm-pi-ai route, and a ghost-text suggested reply in the composer (Tab to fill) whose registered routes are called through the DSH llm runtime (any protocol) with a direct fallback and that learns the user's phrasing locally.

Verdict-based compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the lossy compaction summary with fast per-call keep/truncate/drop decisions, keeping everything else verbatim (port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction)

Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness model picker: the host half mirrors the provider's model catalog and logo set to loopback, and the browser half draws one monochrome mark per model row, the way the provider's own dashboard draws it.

Rustvy for DeepSeek Harness: vendor marks in the model picker, a model list kept in step with what the provider actually serves, a raised stream idle timeout so long-reasoning models are not cut off by the adapter's watchdog, a ClientHello-fragmenting transport that reaches model traffic when a DPI filter is measured to be blocking, an optional packet-level bypass that downloads zapret's winws and registers it as a service — the only way to defeat a filter that reassembles TCP, since injecting a decoy packet or overlapping sequence numbers is not expressible through a socket, an optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy scoped to rustvy traffic alone and switchable without a restart, and a ring of API keys that lets each chat send its requests with a key of its own — the host half mirrors the catalog and logos to loopback, regenerates the pi-ai route's models from the route's own endpoint with the drift shown before anything is written, and clones that route once per key, so a key value stays in the harness credential store and never in the plugin's files.
Official KolmoPDF plugin for DeepSeek Harness: high-fidelity PDF to Markdown/OCR (formulas & tables), layout-preserving PDF translation, and Markdown export to DOCX, PDF, HTML, and LaTeX.
ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
DSH client plugin: render a session as an S-shaped (boustrophedon) trajectory timeline, with per-turn nodes and file sub-nodes linked by tool-call edges

PKU Weiming Teaching-2 cluster for DeepSeek Harness: a bar to pick WSL distro or the local machine, several PKU clusters in parallel, sidebar login with password + OTP, multiplexed SSH, and a loopback relay so WSL can reach the cluster through the Windows VPN.
Deep-sea whale-girl theme for the DeepSeek Harness desktop client: deep-blue palette (light/dark) plus two whale-maid corner illustrations.

Novel-as-wallpaper reader for the DSH Web GUI: renders a TXT novel as a full-frame text layer behind the chat, with a stealth draggable controller float (TOC, prev/next chapter, auto-scroll, wheel and arrow-key navigation, settings).
Third-party DSH plugin: brings the text-to-cad live 3D viewer into DSH's right sidebar and renders offline rotatable model previews.
DeepSeek Harness 授权提醒：DSH 审批、Agent 提问、macOS 权限弹窗与管理员密码弹窗出现时播放系统声音，带插件页开关和中文配置表单。
桌宠开关：一键开/关桌面上的 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关闭时还能顺手把它启动起来。A desktop switch for your dsh-pet pet, with one-click Harness launch.
让 AI 把图片重画成矢量画：本地色块描摹 + 自写渲染器，纯 CPU、不联网、不训练，输出可无限放大的 SVG 与 PNG
DeepSeek Harness status-light plugin: character expressions follow the model state, chat-bubble notifications, and a Windows always-on-top mini-window. 状态灯插件：角色表情跟随模型状态 + 聊天框气泡 + 系统级置顶小窗。
DeepSeek Harness status-light plugin: character expressions follow the model state, chat-bubble notifications, and a Windows always-on-top mini-window. 状态灯插件：角色表情跟随模型状态 + 聊天框气泡 + 系统级置顶小窗。
Composer prompt tuner: rewrite and correct the draft with one configurable prompt and model.
DSH Web client plugin: vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat area, with clickable markers per user message for quick navigation and hover preview bubbles.
dsh usage & performance statistics: settings-panel plugin + TUI (tokens / TTFT / TPS / cost)
DSH prompt library and reusable snippets plugin for saving, editing, and inserting prompts from the composer.
DSH Skill selector and skill browser for browsing user-invocable skills and inserting slash commands into the composer.
DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for secure provider balance, quota, and model health monitoring
dsh Web GUI remote access: bind the webserver to 0.0.0.0 for LAN/remote access and inject the crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure HTTP origins.
主题管理插件：设置-主题大分类，内置森林绿/海洋蓝，支持上传 __ModuleLoader__.load 格式的 JS 主题（overrideTokens + CSS + slots UI），点击切换，磁盘持久化。
Computer use for DSH/AryaCode: agent-desktop UIA engine, agent-browser web lane, takeover UI with a ghost cursor
ComfyUI-native image generation for DeepSeek Harness: chat tools, creative canvas, Studio workbench, workflow comparison, and built-in server control.

Zero-credential Outlook automation for DSH Harness on Windows: the AI agent drives your LOCAL desktop Outlook client via COM: search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy. No Graph API app registration, no SMTP passwords, no tenant admin rights. Anything that leaves the machine (send mail / meeting invite) passes a three-layer human gate: two-call confirmation + content-hash binding (the confirmed retry must match what the user last saw) + an independent one-time token the bridge demands. A NewMailEx watcher pushes arrivals to a sidebar badge and the maildesk_check_new tool, and a three-pane panel gives the mailbox a real face: folders, a selectable message list, an HTML reading pane with Proofpoint links unwrapped and remote images blocked, and mark/move/delete on the selection; a composer that keeps drafts in the harness instead of stacking them in Outlook, and sends only after the exact content is confirmed. A draft opened from chat appears as a card in the conversation, points at the same harness draft, and can be finished in the panel or sent from the card.
Arya Plugin Market: packaged releases, updates, and version restoration.
AryaCode Polish: one install for the small things that make AryaCode feel finished. One Plugins row, one switch per quality-of-life feature.

DeepSeek Harness 的只读工作区 Git 面板：分支、ahead/behind、改动清单与差异，外加「这个会话改过哪些文件、审到哪了、跑了什么工具」。A read-only workspace Git panel for DeepSeek Harness — branch, changed files, diffs, plus per-session change attribution, review progress, and tool activity.
DSH AI-PM 插件：把 pm-scaffold 的 PRD 工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness——agent 侧提供 pipeline 模型工具（init/status/entry/gate/reflow/skill/artifact），GUI 侧提供需求看板与不可绕过的人工确认闸门。
One panel for the credits and daily check-in of locally signed-in Trae and WorkBuddy accounts, with an opt-in daily automatic check-in.
TellerU：在任何对话里输入 /telleru，AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲。
D2 diagram preview for DeepSeek Harness: open .d2 files in the right Sidebar with a live-rendered chart, a code editor, and switchable chart / code / split views.
Configurable, optional skill discovery for DeepSeek Harness: standard catalog, local keyword search, or hybrid retrieval with Jetson, Google, OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible embedding providers.

ChatGPT-style voice input for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: mic button, recording pill with live waveform, transcription via transcribe.cpp (Handy model catalog), whisper.cpp, the Codex/ChatGPT subscription, or an OpenAI-compatible API
DSH 虚拟桌宠 vpet：ds娘（仿《虚拟桌宠模拟器》），聊天气泡提醒、拖拽、滚轮缩放、余额计数器、DSH 设置联动
DeepSeek Harness host bundle that talks to the official Antigravity ACP server over stdio (Agent Client Protocol v1).

Customizable inline code rendering for DSH: six paired light/dark presets, audited syntax palettes, optional file icons and badges, typography controls, Font Lab overrides, and dual-tab host-integrated settings.
Umi / 呜咪 — an animated DeepSeek Harness companion with English/中文 UI.
A settings page for the Hindsight memory stack in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
以 refresh-* 独立 provider 提供最新 pi-ai 模型目录，复用已安装协议能力，不改原路由或安装目录。
OpenDesign CoRouter：套餐赠送与付费模型双 Provider、桌面登录态额度及独立登录
中文化 DSH 已知提示词；原生设置页逐条编辑译文、组件开关、精确版本门控及匹配诊断，按 Profile 保存。保留工具名、参数结构与动态值。

显示独立 DeepSeek API Key 与 DSH 本机账号余额（账号入口默认开启）、火山方舟（arkcli 官方 CLI 路由：Agent / Coding Plan 个人版与企业版席位，设置页合并为一组）、Z.ai（中国与国际）、Kimi、MiMo、OpenCode Go、Command Code、SuperGrok、Codex（ChatGPT 订阅，默认关闭）、GitHub Copilot（复用 Copilot 提供方登录，默认关闭）、MiniMax（中国）、Synthetic、NanoGPT、SiliconFlow、OpenRouter、Novita、Hyperbolic、DeepInfra、Chutes、Ollama Cloud、Vercel AI Gateway、ZenMux、LiteLLM、OpenDesign、APIGOTO 的订阅余量与余额；共享刷新与凭据管理，新安装有效默认开启 11 条数据入口、关闭 20 条（火山个人版与 Team 分组开关）。
Progressive tool discovery for DSH: four-entry admission protocol with a host-independent domain kernel and a DSH adapter
火山方舟 Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan：OAuth 登录、账号、模型与额度管理。
Adds a native “Restart DeepSeek Harness” entry to the Windows tray menu and the account menu, plus an official settings page that survives DSH updates.

Show the running DeepSeek Harness version and every mounted plugin's package version inside the dsh web UI.
Get记忆插件：对话开始时自动拉取GitHub指定仓库的内容并注入上下文；对话结束时提取值得长期记住的新信息写回并提交；左栏快捷面板实时查看状态，设置界面进行详细配置

DeepSeek Harness 生图与改图工具插件：把任意 OpenAI 兼容的生图/改图服务接成平台工具，模型在对话里直接生成或修改图片，图片以平台原生 image 块输出并显示在工具卡里（缩略图 / 全屏 / 下载 / 在工作区打开）。生图 API 与对话模型 API 完全独立，可配置调用前确认。
阿哈酒馆：DSH 插件，提供沉浸式角色扮演聊天、剧情插画与台词语音
DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter plugin backed by llamapad-managed llama.cpp containers
mesh-memory: shared memory network for AI agents — plain Markdown, multi-device, reviewable growth.
隐几 — 在 DSH 左侧栏隐去选中的工作区，并在右侧文件树里隐去不想看的目录与文件（纯界面隐藏，不影响模型访问）。

Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend, with the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand. · 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

DSH 创建工作区对话框：上面填名称，下面选文件夹；只填名称就在「新建位置」下建出同名文件夹，选文件夹则弹出自己调的原生 IFileDialog 并延续上次所在的目录。 · A Codex-style Create Workspace dialog for DeepSeek Harness: name it and go, or pick a folder with a chooser that remembers where you were.
XMUM Moodle inside the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: sign in, browse courses by term, read announcements as a schedule, and batch-download course files.
DeepSeek Harness 启动屏与同风格界面主题：暗色金属控制台 + 红色 HUD，启动序列依次为标题砸下、进度与日志、北京航天中心工牌扫描翻面核准、授权通过；界面主题覆盖 125 枚 --dsw-* token，并带 UEG 水印与机构徽标。配色/质感/文案全可调。

Mobile UI fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web profile: a restart row, a scrollable question region, a throttled reaction to streaming message storms, a guarded subagent-catalog refresh, click-to-open lineage chips, a narrow-header collector sheet, a throttled session-list render under background streaming load, and a hover-kept connection card with manual refresh. Binds the host's stable data-* contracts and local class names, never build hashes, so a rebuild cannot silently disable it.
DSH 本地插件：在标题栏「编辑」右侧显示北京时间的高峰/低谷胶囊（工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰）。
从任意已完成轮次把会话分支到一个新模式：会话标题栏的 Agent 预设标签变成菜单，每轮完成回复下方、产品自带分支按钮旁多出一个「分支模式」胶囊；选一个模式，就以该模式新建会话并把这段对话迁移过去（事件日志复制，源会话不被改动）。
DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
DeepSeek Harness 原生模型质量测试与报告插件
A safe, accessible session manager for DeepSeek Harness with archive controls, activity details, lineage, and output-file cleanup.
Lightweight usage analytics for DeepSeek Harness — token trends, activity heatmaps, model breakdowns, and exports.
🚀体验轻量云插件 — Tencent Cloud Lighthouse connector plugin for DeepSeek Harness

Marisa UI: a static, zero-blur aurora-glass theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — frosted panels, specular rims, chromatic edges and a drifting-look aurora backdrop without per-frame rendering cost.
Configure model input capabilities and reasoning efforts for DeepSeek Harness
DSH Web UI plugin — drag a conversation onto any workspace in the sidebar to organize it. / DSH Web UI 插件：在侧边栏把对话拖到任意工作区即可归类整理，可在设置页开关。
DSH plugin to manage rule files (one .md per rule) at global and project scope, with a settings-page UI (Host webServer HTTP routes + Client settings section).
Sync AiSpot (sapi) group pricing and show per-turn and per-session cost.
Real-time per-session token cost for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with per-provider pricing and configurable peak/off-peak tariffs

GalGame mode for the dsh web GUI: a third conversation view tab (after 轨迹) that renders the real agent session as a visual-novel stage — whale-girl (DeepSeek) portrait with diff switching + draggable thinking bubble, Markdown dialogue box with typewriter + block paging, GalGame-style question/approval choices bound to the portrait, backlog drawer, and a debug mode. Pure presentation layer: never writes the session and never blocks the agent loop.

Skill manager for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a panel listing the skills visible to the current session (split into global / local groups) with per-skill on/off switches, create / import / edit / delete. Disabling a skill removes it from the model catalog, the `skill` tool, and /name gestures through a shadow provider on the host skill registry; state persists in ~/.dsh/dsh-skill-manager.json. Hot-pluggable — mounted via a profile bundle link, no dsh source changes.

Side-by-side multi-session grid for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: every session you click in the sidebar joins the conversation area as its own pane (max 3 per row), the active session stays highlighted, and panes can be reordered by dragging their top-right handle.
微信有新消息时，把一条『去看看』的提示投进指定的 DSH 会话。只看本地库的修改时间，不读正文、不发消息；群消息只在被 @ 时叫醒，系统消息不叫；可按群／关键词把消息分到不同房间。
DSH「专家体系」插件：单角色专家（人设 + 方法论 + 工具白名单）与多 Agent 专家团（团长编排、串并行执行、整合交付），支持手动创建 / 文件导入 / AI 生成。
A team of AI cursors marks up the developing page like a design tool (rulers, selection handles, size labels, guides) inside the Harness sidebar browser, then the markings vanish.
安全版本地语音输入插件 for DeepSeek Harness:输入框右侧麦克风按钮,录音后经同源宿主代理转写(本地 SenseVoice-Small INT8 ONNX,音频不出网)。后端仅绑定 127.0.0.1 + 随机 token,无 CORS,模型 sha256 校验。

Repo Browser for DeepSeek Harness: right-side panel listing your GitHub repositories (name / description / language / stars / forks / topics / last push, private & archived flags) with local grouping folders and quick actions (move to group, make private, archive); auto-hides on the new-session page. DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 仓库浏览器插件。
Codex architect and read-only reviewer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop
Hide decorative DeepSeek product branding in the DeepSeek Harness Web & Desktop UI while enabled; disabling immediately restores the original interface.

Per-command sandbox allow-list for the DSH bash tool, managed from Settings and the Plugins page: allow-listed CLIs run with configurable writable roots (workspace stays writable on macOS/Linux) instead of prompting for danger-full-access; write-neutral pipes such as `2>&1 | tail -N` still match, and a narrow-root rule can accept any command shape.

Access-password gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: every request on the gateway port requires authentication (no unauthenticated surface besides the login/setup page), first visit sets the password, and it can be rotated from the dedicated Security settings page.
Live node-graph view of what an Agent preset is made of, drawn as a DSH conversation view.
在 DeepSeek Harness 里一键构建 / 启动 / 停止 Remotion Studio 动画工程（含日志、健康检查与工程下载）
给 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）加 QQ 机器人通道：OneBot 11 协议，兼容 NapCat。在 dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4 基础上分叉，加了消息合并、分条发送、群聊工具闸、静默作息、试运行 dryRun、每日收发统计与可视化设置页。

DSH 页面内统一状态通知插件：双通道按页面可见性自动路由（前台→横幅+铃铛角标+WebAudio 轻音；后台→Windows 系统通知+标签标题标记），P1（权限审批>方案待确认>提问）页内防误触裁决（拒绝一键、同意长按、高危无一键同意），P2 执行完成先过真完成确认窗（idle 持续 doneConfirmMs 可配 3~60s，窗口内回 running 即取消）再按会话攒批防连弹（静默窗 doneBatchMs 可配 1~30s）后弹聚合通知。条目 localStorage 持久化（刷新恢复、200 条上限、500ms 防抖写入）。主题三态（跟随宿主/浅/深，自动跟随 html[data-sm-theme]）。会话级单次提示（perSessionNotify 默认开：同会话 P2 弹过一次未处理前不再弹横幅/系统通知，跳转成功或切回该会话解除，P1 不受影响）。已处理即消失（v1.4：裁决/跳转成功/interaction 消费后条目直接从面板移除，不再保留灰标签历史；已处理条目不入盘。v1.7 移除面板头「已处理 N 条」累计计数，旧键启动清理）。P2 面板按「会话标题 + 分钟桶」融合（v1.6：同一分钟内同名条目合并成一条，不再显示条数；跨分钟不融合；点查看跳组内最新 sid 成功后整组消，P1 仍逐条）。通知条目治理（v1.8：P2 完成类条目超 24h 未处理=化石条目，启动恢复前过滤+周期轮询自动清除，不再拖角标；P1 超 24h 未处理转「已过期」灰显回看，退出角标/待裁决口径，面板保留永不自动删除；同会话再次完成并入原条目，at 刷新+doneCount 累加+「N 次完成」副标，不新增条目）。视觉层 v1.5 重构：全量接入宿主 DSW 设计令牌（--dsw-static/alias 三层），组件规格对齐已批准原型（铃铛 28×28 r8、面板 400px r12、行 r12 无分隔线、横幅 toast 深底右下滑入、动效四项+prefers-reduced-motion 降级、双主题暗色跟随 body[data-ds-dark-theme]）。角标与面板头=未处理组数（P1 逐条计 + P2 融合组每组计 1），裁决或跳转成功才转已处理。铃铛面板挂 token-monitor 徽标左侧（不改其源码），卸载即回退。替代 dsh-notify-me。
Multi-layer project whiteboard view: a mind-map of boxes and connectors over layers, registered into the conversation view ring (no service). 发布为 DSH 客户端插件，可 GitHub / npm / tarball 分发。

DSH 官方桌面端音效播放器：全部操作集成于设置菜单（设置 → 音效播放器），无悬浮窗。为对话完成、发送消息、权限请求、被提问、服务终止、子代理运行完成、最后一个子代理运行完成等 7 类情况播放提示音；内置合成音效、Windows 系统提示音与 34 个 meme/游戏音效，分「默认 / 神人 / 自定义」三个可编辑音效库并支持导入自己的音频；每条绑定可独立设置音量、播放区间（毫秒级截断）与「渐弱消失」特效，支持试听并中途停止；提供 soundPlayer 服务（window.__dshSoundPlayer__）供其他插件调用。
Archived-session manager for DSH Desktop and Web
Clipboard-assisted installation of free skills and DSH plugin archives
Native DSH settings page for global and project skills
Native DSH subscription authorization and LLM integration
AI News & Intelligence Feed plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
DeepSeek Harness 壁纸插件：图片/视频背景（GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM），格式自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调跟随，填充方式可调，侧栏/顶栏等组件透明度可控。纯客户端实现。
DeepSeek Harness 壁纸插件：图片/视频背景（GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM），格式自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调跟随，填充方式可调，侧栏/顶栏等组件透明度可控。纯客户端实现。
DSH plugin: branch visibility and git worktree isolation for Web UI sessions
dsh local plugin: persist per-request model token usage (live hook + first-run history backfill + web settings stats page)
Configurable, unobtrusive Agent lifecycle sound cues for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), synthesized with Web Audio.
A deterministic piano performance plugin for DSH: shared musical timeline, piano audio engine, visual engine, and DSH-compatible host/browser boundary.
Fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling for DeepSeek Harness replies, including Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool results.
DirectorX：第一个以 DeepSeek Harness 为内核的 Video Agent Harness——面向端到端 AI 视频生产的开源 dsh-plugin，覆盖视频生成、分镜画布、智能剪辑、FFmpeg 质检与交付。The first DeepSeek Harness-native video agent harness for AI video production.

QQ2006 skin plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): visible blue-frame chrome on the live DSH 0.1.2 shell, coral-blue --dsw-alias-* / --dsw-specific-* overlay, body[data-ds-skin] mirror, zh/en locale copy, and a settings toggle (Appearance row is still the built-in trio).

DSH 钉钉群通知插件：AI 需要你选择/审批、或一轮任务完成时推送到钉钉群，自带设置面板（详细度、门控、@、免打扰、诊断）。DingTalk group-robot notifications for DeepSeek Harness — ping your phone when the agent needs your input or finishes a turn, with a settings panel in the DSH UI.
把 DSH 的追问（ask_user_question）做成晾衣绳卡片，吊在窗口上方：鼠标停到顶边即垂下，卡片轻摆，可直接作答。Inspired by alejandrobujan/tendedero.
Search, pin, combine and inject skills and prompts into the current conversation from the DSH right sidebar.
Display-only folder grouping for Workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, plus durable per-Workspace Session folders, with per-row icon customization.
DSH Flash 精简预设：两个 agent 预设（精简·PTC v3（lean-v3），flash-lean-ptc-v3，13 条规则，默认；精简·PTC v3 balance，flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance，3 条规则），以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）形式安装到 profile，并附带计划模式组件（plan-mode v1）。
DSH Web plugin: one-click chat folders under ~/dsh_CHAT/<date>/chatN, a 对话区 history panel, and a split/mixed sidebar layout for chats vs projects
Capture the literal HTTP request/response of every LLM provider call (by patching globalThis.fetch) and show them in a Wire Trace session tab

MCP Master for DeepSeek Harness: global and project (.mcp.json) MCP servers, chosen per session from a picker beside the model selector — switchable at any time — with OAuth sign-in and trust review for project servers.

Bridge a WeCom (企业微信) smart bot to DeepSeek Harness: user groups own a Workspace, a model and an agent preset, members get their own Session, refused senders are told to ask an operator and wait in an authorization list on the plugin page, administrators can switch Sessions and select the Workspace their commands default to.
Push a WeCom (企业微信) group-robot notification the instant DSH needs a human: permission approval, a question, a finished task, a blocked goal, or an error
A cockatiel appearance for the dsh-workpet capability in DeepSeek Harness.

灵感便签 (Sticky Notes) for the dsh web GUI: jot ideas while the agent is thinking — without interrupting it. A dock chip (or the sidebar entry) opens a floating popover panel; notes are auto-persisted (browser localStorage + host file, so nothing is lost across restarts or port changes) and the panel closes on an outside click. One click sends a note (or merges several) into the current conversation — or forwards it into any chosen conversation — through the queue channel: when the target agent is busy the message is queued and processed after the running turn. Destructive clears are guarded by an in-panel confirm.

探奇 (Tanqi) for the dsh web GUI: AI-generated curiosity items with layered deep-dives. A sidebar entry opens the panel — 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item can be unfolded into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, every layer, every similar point) in browser localStorage. The model channel reuses the host's own LLM (ctx.llm, zero config); when the host has no usable model, the user can paste a DeepSeek API key which is stored locally in the browser. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
DeepSeek 官方余额徽章插件：会话头部常驻余额显示（状态圆点+金额）、余额明细、用量统计（今日小时级/7·30 天每日级图表、按模型拆分、每日明细、历史回填 90 天）、站内充值浮窗（官方收银台），自动刷新与低余额预警
Point the Harness at your own OfficeCLI binary: one tool, and ten bundled guides injected as skills behind one workflow entry point.
Shows average output tok/s and prompt-cache hit for the most recent Chat response.

DeepSeek Harness web plugin: adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar questions on a conversation fork and default-browser link opening. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark for jumping back, the menu opens on selection or from the right-click menu, and the translation model can be picked separately.
CAD visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cad_view / cad_info tools with an embedded 3D (STL/OBJ/STEP/IGES) and 2D (DXF/SVG) viewer card in the Web UI
Agentic Tool Catalog for DSH: an agent builds and maintains a tool catalog; schemas stay out of context and tools load on demand.

DeepSeek Harness enhancements: Markdown theme for every renderer, select-text annotations with pins, a file right-click menu, a narrower sidebar, and startup defaults (maximized window, narrowest sidebar, colourful running marker). 中文：DSH 增强插件——Markdown 主题、划词批注、文件右键菜单、侧栏宽度、启动默认状态。
Sci-fi HUD: turns the session stats line into game-style level bars, a speedometer and a rolling token counter.

OpenCode Go cost/peak: полоса над полем ввода показывает тариф текущей модели — пиковый, льготный, единый или бесплатный — цены за 1M токенов (вход, выход, кэш) и время до смены тарифа. Каталог OpenCode Go подтягивается при запуске DSH.
Switch between Bottom, Right, and Automatic Composer layouts, with responsive sizing and space-aware controls.
让它自己活着：给 DSH 里的 AI 伙伴一套「内在状态 + 心跳 + 具身小手机」—— 自主心智节律、群聊分寸决策、主动找主人撒娇、通过 ADB 操作属于它的小手机（看屏幕、点、划、打字、开App、截图分享、安全办事）。走 OneBot 11 HTTP。
API token usage and estimated cost reports for DeepSeek Harness, with per-route pricing, session totals and CNY/USD display.

Codex-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness. An independent reviewer decides allow/deny, fail-closed, with a rationale for every decision. Engine: an LLM route, or TypeSafe's Jev (`reviewer.engine`). · DSH 插件：独立复核器裁决，引擎可选 LLM 路由或 Jev。
把 DeepSeek 宿主原生调不了的外部 harness（claude / codex / pi / MiMo）接入 DSH：作为子代理派发任务，可指定各家模型，并在设置页里查看已配置的 harness

邮件助手（DSH 插件）：Hotmail/Outlook OAuth2 设备码授权 + 通用 SMTP 发信，让 AI 真正把邮件发出去。零运行时依赖。

项目记忆（Project Memory）：本地优先的项目记忆插件。每个项目一份 .dsh-memory.json（按 cwd 隔离），提供 memory_read/recall/write/update/delete 五工具、/memory 命令、设置页记忆管理 UI（编辑/删除/拖动排序/一键保存排序/状态过滤/搜索/多项目切换），全部遵循'随核心快速适配'（适配器+探测-退化-上报）与'万物皆插件'（可独立挂载/停用）。【单线 0.1.3】2026-09-11 起取消双线：只面向 DSH 最新核心（0.1.5-rc.1 及更新，桌面端 2.0.7+/2.0.9），不再为旧核做适配；含读取保序修复与「保存排序」二次确认/回读校验。同属 0.1.x 系列——**只有出现较大优化或新功能时才升 0.2.0**（本版暂不发布）。
Context-aware emotional avatar presentation for DeepSeek Harness
A per-conversation total-token safety fuse for DeepSeek Harness
Recoverable session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: move sessions to a trash folder, restore them from a UI page, and purge automatically after 7 days.

Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness: configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat (for example "query 128"). Read-only by default, with writes opt-in per connection.
拖入/粘贴文件：输入框上方文件栏（chips）+ @文件名 光标内联插入 + 随消息发送（含绝对路径）+ 气泡文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message (absolute paths included).

Workspace bots for DeepSeek Harness: resident Bot agents with their own sessions, modes, long-term memory, self-waking routines, cross-session messages and multi-bot rooms, stored inside the workspace.
在 DSH 侧边栏底部、用户名正上方显示 DeepSeek 账号剩余额度（总余额 + 赠金余额）的 Web 插件。
DSH plugin: one uniform frosted-glass material for the UI surfaces, plus an optional image/video dynamic wallpaper behind them.

DSH plugin: start/stop a local llama.cpp llama-server from the settings → plugins page — two model slots (A/B) with per-slot model-file selection, eight editable launch-parameter groups (text/vision × fast/long × 2 slots), one shared DSH provider carrying both slots' models with four thinking-effort levels, and a proportional-threshold compaction engine (./compaction) that replaces dsh-compaction-basic for small local windows.
DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 语音输入插件：在输入框发送键左侧添加麦克风按钮，支持浏览器本地识别、OpenAI 兼容语音转写接口和自定义 JSON 接口，配置可导入/导出。
Built-in auto-update plugin for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): manual update check from the Settings page, guarded update pipeline with health check, automatic rollback, circuit breaker and degrade ladders.
Regenerate and edit chat messages in DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with validated V4 context replacement and reversible transcript presentation.
给 DeepSeek Harness 一台真的 QQ：三层架构（NapCat 适配 / Controller 判断 / 砍过的 Mind），会观望、会接梗、会自己管群。
Persona and system-prompt manager for DeepSeek Harness: pick an AI persona from the sidebar, guide Chinese chain-of-thought, and apply it to new conversations.
Adversarial pro/con debate with a neutral judge for DeepSeek Harness: /debate human command, subagent-driven rounds, verdict record, and a web debate card.
OpenCode Go plan usage monitor for DeepSeek Harness: a quota bar under the chat input showing the 5h-rolling, weekly and monthly windows

Chat-first development flow tracker for DeepSeek Harness: scan, clarify, plan, review, test and report repository-aware changes.

Union workspaces for the dsh web GUI: merge multiple directories into one session (primary + members), persist them under ~/.dsh/union-workspaces.json, apply a permission preset per union, browse member files in a right-side panel, and manage everything from a settings section and the /uw command. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules link, no dsh source changes.

DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 n8n 工作流运维插件：设置页可管理多个 n8n 实例（每个实例一个别名 + 实例地址 + API Key，存储于 ~/.dsh/dsh-n8n-plugin.json），并提供 24 个 Agent 工具（n8n_instances、n8n_workflows、n8n_workflow_get/create/update/delete/publish/validate/clone/tags、n8n_executions、n8n_execution_get/cancel、n8n_wait_execution、n8n_webhook_call、n8n_tags、n8n_tag_create/update/delete、n8n_credentials、n8n_variables、n8n_datatables、n8n_datatable_rows、n8n_api）。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a session-header badge showing whether the current Beijing time falls in peak hours (09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00), with a configurable badge language in Settings → General.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a General-settings selector that chooses which language the model reasons in, via a system-prompt section.
Custom background wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness chat page — upload a local image or paste an image link, tune opacity and brightness, scope to chat area or full screen.
DSH 输入框提示词增强按钮：一键优化未发送的草稿，可选择采用或拒绝。

Quick prompts dock for the dsh web GUI: a row of user-defined prompt chips above the composer — click a chip to preview and edit its text (with {{placeholder}} fields), then sync it into the input or send it directly. Prompts are stored in the official settings document, not localStorage.
OpenCode Go quota ring for DeepSeek Harness: three windows beside the composer context meter.
Six-Line Divination (liuyao) for DeepSeek Harness — one-click casting, eight-palace najia chart, AI interpretation, chart card and case archive. 六爻起卦 · AI 解卦：一键起卦、纳甲装卦、按所问事项断卦。
DSH-native persistent memory and safe session-aware retrieval plugin.
DSH plugin for browsing, searching, inspecting, importing, uploading, and safely deleting skills across global and registered workspace directories.
A message timeline rail for the DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced tick marks for every user message along the left edge of the conversation, click to jump, hover to preview.
DSH plugin: usage and credit balance monitor — auto-query provider balances from configured API keys.
DSH 插件 dsh-runner：左侧「运行」面板按项目启停服务（状态/端口/日志/重启/依赖），输入框下方保留运行快捷菜单，并提供 dsh_runner_config / dsh_runner_run AI 工具。

Choice on window close (background or quit) and per-session / per-workspace child windows for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

Replace DeepSeek Harness's 'Deep diving...' turn status with rotating Claude Code-style loading words.

API-MRI workspace in the native DSH sidebar

Turn any SSH host or WSL distribution into a DSH workspace: discover targets, install dsh remotely without sudo, port the local model configuration, and drive the remote DSH UI inside a sidebar panel of the local one.
dsh-mineru: MinerU 文档解析插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 多模态全格式 (PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/HTML/图片) → 结构化 Markdown. 填 Token 走精准解析 API, 留空走 Agent 轻量解析 API. 注意: 解析需把文件上传至 MinerU 远端(内容出网), 无完全离线模式, 涉密/不得出网材料请勿使用.
Original mecha-command visual layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile
Update button for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): when a newer dsh is on the registry, a top-right Update pill installs it with npm and restarts dsh.
cat-loop for the DeepSeek Harness: three independent Agent Teams (Plan, Build, Review) in one conversation, with enforced permission boundaries.
A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web.
DSH session intelligence: a persistent right sidebar with first/latest user-request summaries and read-only Git status.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: estimated cost of every conversation, with official prices from DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, and 11 Chinese vendors, a currency switcher with daily exchange rates, peak/off-peak DeepSeek pricing, a breakdown panel, and costs in the sidebar.
A local-only Texas Hold'em table for DeepSeek Harness — play while your agent thinks.

Mini-games collection for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (dsh 0.2.x) — one draggable frosted-glass window with seven games: Tetris, Snake, 2048, Minesweeper, Breakout, Gomoku and Memory, light/dark themes and per-game local leaderboards. · DeepSeek Harness Web 端小游戏合集：俄罗斯方块 / 贪吃蛇 / 2048 / 扫雷 / 打砖块 / 五子棋 / 记忆翻牌，毛玻璃悬浮窗、深浅色主题、各游戏独立排行榜。
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for writing linked short-story collections inside one shared world, with character profiles shared across collections and every write gated by native approval.

English intensive reading for DSH: speaker-diarized podcast transcripts, Ctrl word lookup, a wordbook with phonetics, meanings, word forms and etymology that fills in a word's other senses from every transcript while idle, a spaced-review mode with daily rounds, a read-only graph of how transcripts and words connect, and an optional shared library that lets every project use one set of materials.
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: one red "Shred session" row inside the native session menu, for permanently deleting an archived session.
Rice Patrol: bounded reasoning repetition guard and clean recovery for DeepSeek Harness
Isolated multi-model coding matches with deterministic verification, scoring, and reports
GPT Image 2.5 generation through Codex subscriptions or API keys, with progressive previews for DeepSeek Harness

QQ 2007-inspired retro messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with Codex-generated original artwork, compact desktop chrome, an account card, optional original send chime, and reversible settings.
A local token-safe DSH theme generator, editor, auditor, and exporter
Live Agent Teams task, communication, subagent, and Workflow topology for DeepSeek Harness
Transactional data-only DSH configuration packs with integrity, ownership, and rollback
Two byte-preserved original whale animation loops for DeepSeek Harness Web.
A local-first DSH whale world with ImageGen raster companions, dynamic goals, collectibles, expeditions, and privacy-safe sharing
Kimetsu no Yaiba skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: night-forest palette over the stable --dsw-* token layer, breathing-style wallpaper rotation, a flame band and a toggle dock.
两幕启动动画（默认档案暖白 + 鲸鱼娘扫描睁眼，2K/4K 可切），支持导入视频/图片、三段转场、11→6 套配音音色与 5 种声音效果、聊天背景/循环视频、内置 iframe 启动模板（全景大肥鱼-含彩蛋版）与更新前自动回滚。

Context-aware desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: turn completion, waiting-for-approval, waiting-for-answer — with a per-situation summary, and no interruption while the client is in front. 上下文感知的桌面通知：回合完成 / 等待授权 / 等待回答，按情况给出任务摘要，客户端在前台时不打扰。
Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list. 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。
DeepSeek Harness advisor plugin: pair a fast executor with a stronger reviewer model for plan / correction / stop guidance.
Review DeepSeek Harness file changes in native sidebar tabs
DeepSeek Harness plugin: the model answers with an interactive interface
Code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness agents: LSP-backed symbol discovery, a persisted project blueprint graph, and Serena-style semantic retrieval tools

Usage statistics plugin for the dsh web GUI: per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection plus a live token usage ledger, with a compact price glance card above the sidebar's Settings row (LegifyX fork: signed-in account balance in every currency, deeprelay subscription meters, always-on peak marker)

DSH diff-viewer plugin: PiUI-style visual diff surface (split/unified, change bars, real file line numbers, word-level marks, collapsed context, windowed rendering) replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls. Registers into the ui-tool keyed toolview slots.

PiUI-inspired home feed visual refinement for the DSH web client: sidebar palette unified with the conversation feed, feed header aligned with the sidebar controls, and the header hairline replaced by a soft gradient — all via a plugin-owned global stylesheet. Zero core changes; works on official dsh distributions.

DSH HTML-artifact plugin: an `artifact` tool (create/patch/read/destroy/list) whose HTML documents render live in a sandboxed iframe in the GUI. The model PATCHES an artifact by id (edit-style old_string/new_string replacement) instead of resending the whole document; each settled patch updates the live preview in place. Pure extension: the `card: 'artifact'` render intent rides presentResult and a keyed `tool.call.toolview` atomic view — no harness core changes.

DSH mobile-friendly web UI plugin (PiUI chat-pager mode): on narrow screens the stock three-column frame becomes a horizontal scroll-snap pager — sidebar | chat — with the chat column rendered completely untouched as a flush rounded card with a PiUI-style 3D flip; swipe or the top-left button flips pages, a settle re-snap always lands on a whole page, and the sidebar page shares the chat background. Safe-area + virtual-keyboard insets, touch-sized controls, hidden scrollbars on coarse pointers. Pure client-side adaptation over the stock frame — zero core changes, works on official dsh 0.1.2+ distributions.

DSH split-pane conversation plugin: PiUI-style multi-pane conversation surface — split/stack panes, per-pane sessions, sidebar session drag & drop, single-row fused header. No core patch required: each pane runs the core's own slot renderer against a pane-scoped host.
Folia 壁纸引擎：把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸搬进 DSH 界面（场景实时渲染 / 视频 / 网页），内置液态玻璃与 Folia 吉祥物，并可从自建站点拉取壁纸。单包形态（组件已合并）。
Long-form voiceover pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: chapter planning, spoken-script adaptation, subtitles, manifest, and resumable jobs. Turns a document into a publishable audio set.
