The person talks to existing sessions through @alias, #role or * routing, with role grants, human priority, audited notes and decisions, bounded subagent delegation, one-to-one relay, credential scanning, pause/emergency-stop, per-group sensitivity, dedupe, fan-out caps and daily token budgets. Each session keeps its own context, model and workspace.
Remaining-time, Token budget and reference cost estimates for DeepSeek Harness, calibrated locally without a separate model call.

CursorLike — Cursor-style coding surface for DeepSeek Harness (open source, MIT; fork of dsh-vscode-mode): cumulative per-file diff review, pending-files card, side Monaco editor and file tree, Tab completion and Quick Edit.
Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
零依赖的 DSH 联网搜索：DuckDuckGo / Bing / 百度 / 360 聚合去重 + 网页正文读取，免 API Key，可选 Tavily / Serper / Brave / Exa / SearXNG。Zero-dependency web search for DeepSeek Harness, no Playwright, no SQLite.
给 DSH 补一套 Claude 风格的定时任务：到点新开对话跑一轮，运行会话不进左侧列表。

Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness: bundles aria2, probes file size and picks aria2 multi-connection or curl fallback automatically (Windows x64/arm64, Linux x64/arm64, macOS x64/arm64, HarmonyOS arm64; any platform with aria2c on PATH or DSH_SMARTDL_ARIA2_PATH). Verifies downloads against MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-512 checksums, applies an if-exists policy (overwrite/skip/rename), preflights free disk space, sends custom UA/Referer/headers, can auto-pick a GitHub mirror that provably serves the same file, and can cancel or retry tasks from the built-in download manager
Honcho memory explorer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: browse peers, conclusions, sessions and a relationship graph, with semantic search.
DSH web plugin: extra right-sidebar document previews for 3D models (STL/OBJ/PLY/glTF/GLB), archives, media, fonts, subtitles, TOML, Intel HEX, JCAMP-DX, VCD, KiCad and DFU.
给 DSH 会话配一位常驻指挥员：托管「算不算完成、能不能改目标、该不该问用户」三个判断点，全接管时按轮次驱动下一轮。A resident commander agent for DSH sessions that gates goal completion, goal edits and user questions.
DeepSeek Open Platform balance and session consumption readout (host + web client)
Local and remote knowledge bases for DeepSeek Harness, with scoped recall, controlled write-back, and a Web management console
Long-lived AI companions with QQ, WeChat, Matrix and Mattermost channels for DeepSeek Harness
Unified trusted settings and password access gateway for DeepSeek Harness
Secure SSH, FTP/FTPS/SFTP file transfer, browser terminals, proxies, port forwarding, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness
A Luo Xiaohei-inspired animated dark theme for DeepSeek Harness
Configurable and secure multi-provider web search for DeepSeek Harness
Session-scoped tool declaration and named prompt-section snapshots that reduce unexpected prompt-cache invalidation, with explicit review before anything is sent.
DSH 右侧栏的通用日历：月视图点选、当天事件列表、今天/本周一览；事件存在插件本地，Agent 也能读写（calendar_panel 工具）。
DSH 右侧栏的卡路里日记：内置常见食物热量表，选食物+克数自动算 kcal，按餐次记、看当日合计与目标进度；本地存储，Agent 也能读写（calorie_panel 工具）。
DSH 右侧栏的金融终端：跨资产行情 + 会转的地球 + 风险偏好读数 + 中文说明 + 相关资讯，并且能和 Agent 双向对话（finance_panel 工具）。
DSH 右侧栏的 IRC 客户端：宿主用 node tls/net 直连 IRC（也可选走本机代理的 HTTP CONNECT 隧道），右侧栏收发消息，Agent 也能读和发（irc_panel 工具）。
DSH 右侧栏的记账本：记一笔（金额/分类/备注）、本月支出收入结余、按分类统计；数据全在本地，Agent 也能读写（ledger_panel 工具）。
把右下角鲸鱼挂件的余额/今日已用/峰谷/每轮消耗接到左侧 Lucy 身上：复用 dsh-whale-widget 的宿主数据管线，只增加展示与交互，不改它的记账逻辑。
DSH 右侧栏的媒体台：把抖音/YouTube 链接丢进来，本机 yt-dlp 下载、ffmpeg 转 16k 单声道 WAV、官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）转写，字幕进面板，Agent 一键总结。
DSH 右侧栏的番茄闹钟：25 分钟专注 / 5 分钟休息循环，计时在宿主侧（切 tab、关面板都不停），Agent 也能读状态和启停（pomodoro_panel 工具）。
DSH 右侧栏的 QQ 邮箱：读最近邮件、看正文、发纯文本（发送需 confirm 门禁）。凭据只从私有 secret.json 读，授权码绝不进 git、不进日志、不回显。
把 godot_citys 里的车载电台搬进 DSH 右侧栏：three.js 车内视角 + 会弯的夜路 + radio-browser 网络电台（City Pop）。
DSH 右侧栏的 RSS 阅读器：订阅源在配置里，条目按时间排，可标已读/收藏；宿主抓取，走本机代理。
DSH 右侧栏的轻量待办：一行一件、勾掉即完成、可折叠已完成；本地存储，Agent 也能加/勾/删（todo_panel 工具）。
把助手的回答用小艺的声音朗读出来：宿主侧用零依赖的 Edge TTS 客户端逐句合成，页面侧用 Web Audio 无缝连播，默认开启。
DSH插件：将推理强度选择重构为滑动条组件
Let DSH plan and review while Codex executes: one codex_exec tool over `codex exec --json`, with selectable model, effort and role, plus an in-session selector.
Impact X-Ray for DSH: inspect potential code-change impact, provenance and real source evidence before AI edits.
Explain DSH plugin failures through observable composition paths. Read-only, offline by default, with snapshots and upgrade preflight.

DSH 多 Agent「会议室」插件：会籍（会议室）+ fork 上下文入场 + 主持人控场多轮讨论 + 会后各自压缩并回到工作区继续工作。基于 dsh-std 元协议。

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：大模型请求报错时按规则休眠后自动重试。支持 HTTP 状态码 / 机器码 / provider 返回字段=值 / msg~子串 四种命中形态，每条规则独立配置休眠时长与最大重试次数；首字超时（firstTokenTimeout）在模型迟迟不出第一个字（正文/思考/工具调用）时中断并按 TIMEOUT 上报；模型不支持多模态时不直接报错，改为往上下文注入提示并交给路由换模型；输出达到 token 上限被截断时自动注入「继续」接力，会话框内显示重试卡片，GUI 设置页实时编辑规则。

DSH plugin: runs a power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle. The toggle never survives a host restart, and the countdown is always cancellable.
Per-workspace activation control for DeepSeek Harness: turn individual skills, MCP servers, and plugins on or off for each workspace, from a dialog on the workspace row.

模型选择弹窗＋路由分组：模型失败后自动换到组内下一个可用模型并继续本轮；免费渠道页签一键装 Our Free Model、CodeArts、WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder、Providers Hub 六个插件，覆盖华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy、有道 LobsterAI、TRAE、Cline、MiniMax、智谱 ZCode、Gemini、Accio、讯飞 AStudio 等 23 个免费平台；另含数据看板与错误重试配置。
TavernWeave X DSH: 23 rolecard-engineering Skills, Host Front Door, selectable agent preset, and the bundled TavernWeave DSH client panel in one DeepSeek Harness plugin.
把峰谷动态、提示词候选、输入历史三个功能合到一个插件里，每个功能各有开关，设置沿用原来的字段。
在 DSH 界面显示下载任务名称、真实百分比进度条、下载速率与剩余时间：插件自带 download_file 工具，也为 shell 下载提供兜底识别。
Tavily-backed web search provider plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh), with a GUI configuration card for the API key and an on/off switch.
经验库(更有经验的DeepSeek):实时采集/打标队列/半自动+全自动空闲派活/位置索引/10本试验经验技能书+benchmark数据。适配 meow-memory 教训层。host 半 esbuild 自包含产物 + export default 插件形态。
Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: learns from past sessions in the background and gives new agents a short memory summary. A port of the OpenAI Codex memory pipeline.

Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff for DeepSeek Harness: one confirmed model call curates earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into a new conversation. No silent background calls.

Artifacts-like documents for DeepSeek Harness: the agent writes an HTML document, it opens in the dsh sidebar, you comment on any part, and one click sends the comments back for the next version. A local-only fork of tdoc.
DSH plugin: a right-sidebar page browser that inserts a picked element into the composer as context, plus a page-reading tool for the agent.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: routes every pwsh command execution on Windows through Git for Windows bash — the pwsh and bash tools actually run git bash, so the model writes bash natively.
DSH 角色扮演插件：角色卡（人设系统提示注入 / 用户提示词改写两条链路）、预设与自定义角色卡、本地库与单文件导入导出、聊天区「角色」页签。
DSH 里用 DeepSeek 官方朗读音色朗读对话、导出音频，并提供「文本进、音频出」的接口与工具。宿主半走 DS 官方 TTS（ticket + wss），文本投递由真实浏览器经 CDP 完成（不逆向 PoW、不伪装 TLS 指纹）。
Hmm-Wait 思维链弹幕：监听模型思维链（reasoning）输出，当出现 hmm / wait / let me 等触发词时，在 dsh Web GUI 上弹出可配置的弹幕动画（方向 / 速度 / 抖动 / 样式均可调），配置面板挂在 0.1.6a2 插件管理页的插件自己的页面上。
蓝色大肥鱼表情包回复插件：模型按语境在回复里贴一张会动的大肥鱼，配置面板画在插件管理页里本插件自己的页面上（预览墙 + 下一轮指定）。素材经插件自有 HTTP 路由直出，不经过附件流水线（那会把动画压成静图）。
DSH 插件：给 agent 一个快捷入口，把工作区里写好的 HTML 页直接展示在对话里（对话内卡片 / 画面内全屏 / 在浏览器打开原文件），并让用户在页面上产生的反馈快速回到 agent 手里。

Text-file drag-and-drop for the dsh web GUI: dropping md/txt/log/code files into the page inserts the content into the composer when it fits (<= 1000 characters), otherwise the host copies the file into the session workspace .dsh/drops directory and the composer receives the readable absolute path (read access follows from the workspace write policy).
DSH 工作区树：把左侧栏工作区重做为文件系统树双模式——文件夹模式按真实目录层级浏览并新建（会话 cwd = 目录，环境隔离），工作区模式只管工作区与会话；工作区=目录强绑定，含拖拽排序、状态向上透传、会话/文件夹搜索过滤与配置面板。

微信风格皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness — WeChat-style light theme for DeepSeek Harness: green bubbles, WeChat green accents, conversation-list sidebar, a far-left function rail, message avatars, and a resizable composer. Light mode only; dark mode falls back to the official look.

DeepSeek official-home style theme for DeepSeek Harness (desktop app and dsh web): WebGL fluid-flow background, liquid glass with SVG edge refraction, glass sidebar and composer, frosted header, running-subagent progress panel, and peak/valley window tint
ZenTao bug ledger in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: triage, drafts, evidence, and explicit submission with readback.
DSH 会话头部大模型余量监控插件：当前模型额度徽标 + 全部提供方详情弹层 + 用量统计页签
IDEA-style database explorer for the DSH right sidebar: connections, schemas/tables, inline editable preview, import/export, and a SQL/Redis console.
A minimal IDEA for the DSH right column: files, editor, search, and Git.
Claude Code Desktop theme for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — visual & interaction overhaul

webCandidates.description: Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: compose runtime prompts, overrides, and request-local synthetic turns in one live editor
Session-first workspace view for the DSH sidebar
DeepSeek Harness 懂球帝阅读插件。
大肥鱼语音情绪耳朵：听语气、识别情绪，并让 DSH 按对方当下的状态自然回复。 · Voice + emotion-aware companion for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness Desktop plugin: opens the native Windows Explorer folder picker directly when adding a workspace, replacing the in-app directory browser.
毛颖 — DSH 网文创作辅助插件：主编 + 五帮手编排（大纲/写手/审校/设定/考据），novel/ 结构化文件为数据库
庖丁 — DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 编排模式安装器：host 感知的角色工具过滤 + Web 设置页可视化配置器
从本地 Codex (~/.codex) 导入会话，生成带完整历史的新 DSH 会话
定时计划任务：左侧栏开关 + 计划时间框 + 错高峰，到点自动在原会话继续任务（full access）

DevSpace nodes and remote-directory mirror workspaces for the DeepSeek Harness: manage N MCP endpoints in one place, adopt a remote directory as a local mirror Workspace, and move files with devspace_pull / devspace_push

Project secret management for the DeepSeek Harness: discover every .env file across a monorepo (root and workspace packages), edit keys safely in a Settings page, and hand the model a DSH_ENV_FILE / DSH_ENV_FILES pointer so shell commands can source the right environment.
斗地主房间插件。三人/四人、经典/癞子，Host 权威房间 + 欢迎积分账本。
把 WorkBuddy / Trae / Qoder CN 的模型统一接入 DeepSeek Harness，带账号管理与请求记录

在 DSH 会话视图标签行查看外部子任务（Claude Code / Codex / ACP）的委派提示词、流式运行日志与返回结果。支持 dsh 0.2.2-rc.1；官方发行版需安装 patch/ 补丁包启用实时日志。Inspect delegation prompts, streamed run logs, and returned outcomes of external subagent tasks in the DSH conversation view tab row. Supports dsh 0.2.2-rc.1; official releases need the patch/ package for live logs.
点击会话消息中的引用文本，回到原文并居中高亮。Click a quote in a DSH message to return to its source, centered and briefly highlighted.
在 DSH 右侧预览面板直接播放工作区视频。Native video playback in DSH's right-side document preview.
DSH WebUI capability controls for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approvals, and safety guards at session, project, and global levels.
DSH plugin that watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages into a DeepSeek Harness session.

DSH WebUI chrome switches as one Settings section: hide or reshape the sidebar brand, account menu, panel layout, New Session and collapse buttons, and the composer placeholder — applied live without a reload.
Simultaneous handoff-document sync for independent DeepSeek Harness sessions, with targeted directory-change reminders and a session-group management panel.
Workaround for WebKit Bug 219670: on macOS with an input method active, trackpad Tap-to-Click can lose the first click in DeepSeek Harness.

Work planner for DeepSeek Harness: groups GitHub issues into session-sized work packages, orders them by dependencies, importance and urgency, and hands the next package to the coding agent. Reads GitHub issue fields, sub-issues and dependencies; plans stay local.
Alt+Enter inserts a newline in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer
Suggested next actions under DeepSeek Harness replies; clicking one fills the input draft, never sends.

Version control panel for DeepSeek Harness, in the right sidebar: working changes, their diffs, and history with a lane graph, for Git and Jujutsu repositories, plus switching Git branches and one-click fast-forward-or-push sync.

Mem0 long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: managed Platform, self-hosted server or local OSS, with a visual settings page, automatic recall/capture, editable memory summary, token budgets and weekly memory hygiene.
Strata Context: layered, restorable context management for DeepSeek Harness. Deterministic tail cuts, model-written folds, a local archive, and search.
English translation and learning for DeepSeek Harness: bilingual reasoning, selection translation, composer polish, offline dictionary, pronunciation, vocabulary notebook
Long-conversation render relief for the DSH chat view: off-screen message bodies skip style, layout and paint.
DSH 原生分层上下文压缩：模型自己把旧对话折成三层摘要，只写宿主本来就认识的会话事件。名字取自「渐渐消退」——模拟记忆的自然衰退，越旧的内容分辨率越低，但不是删掉。
Codex-style code and file selection for DeepSeek Harness Web: workspace file tree + file viewer; selecting code or a whole file adds it to the message as context automatically

Per-model token pricing for the dsh web surface: durable USD rates with multi-window peak hours, a cost readout in the composer dock, and a collapsible draggable floating window with per-turn and per-model cost views

Use your own OpenAI-compatible vision model in DeepSeek Harness: images are described before the main model sees the request, plus an image_understand tool for reading charts, screenshots, UI and OCR.
Knowledge Center (知识中心) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: distill workspace documents into Markdown knowledge notes, preview them like VS Code, and let permitted workspaces use them through agent tools.

Fixes DeepSeek Harness web_fetch behind Clash/Surge/TUN fake-IP proxies: auto-detects your local HTTP proxy, routes web_fetch through it while it runs and directly when it does not, with a sidebar switch and warnings in web_fetch results.
Context-efficient local search for files, documents, notes and logs across Pi, OMP and MCP clients
Codex-style up/down input-history recall for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
P2P-based, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi, and other workspaces from web and mobile clients.
P2P-based, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi, and other workspaces from web and mobile clients.
P2P-based, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi, and other workspaces from web and mobile clients.
Read-only file previews inside DeepSeek Harness for images, PDF, CSV, Markdown, JSON, YAML, source code, and large files.
会话氛围灯：根据 DSH 会话状态在屏幕边缘显示柔光晕——运行中绿色闪动、完成粉色、待审批琥珀、计划待审青蓝、待回答紫色；多会话聚合，顶部悬停胶囊可跳转会话，输入框下方常驻状态条；颜色、宽度、过渡与环境光/噪点/扫光均可定制。
老板任务面板：发布任务、蒸馏历史会话、阶段化子代理执行与自动读取、面板验收。
Open up to 16 live chat windows side by side in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with a top-right split-view button and freely resizable panes.
MiniMax web search, image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis and transcription for DeepSeek Harness
StarBridge (星桥) gateway client for DSH — one plugin for gateway access, sign-in, chat / feedback / knowledge-base tools, and Web UI panels.
Session tabs in the DSH conversation header: switch, close, rename and persist open sessions, with workspace/title labels and live status.

思考强度滑条（Thinking Slider）：接管输入框右侧那枚官方的「模型 · 推理等级」chip（隐藏官方座位），把推理等级从菜单点选换成可拖拽的滑条——拖动中连续跟手、松手吸附到最近档位并且只提交一次请求；轨道内自绘填充、刻度点与白圆钮，只有最高档（xhigh/max/ultra）才铺品牌色流动渐变，轨道两端标出最低/最高档名，同一张卡片还能展开官方模型清单。键盘 ←/→、Home/End、PageUp/PageDown 按整档移动并自动提交；用目录对象上的世代计数器丢弃迟到的响应；数据全部取自官方 ctx.modelDirectories，不新增任何能力。
Rewrites DeepSeek Harness identity text out of requests sent to selected models (gemini, claude) and renames tool and skill identifiers outbound while restoring the original names in model responses.
Workspace and session UI for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar, Recents, project folders, sections, composer prediction and history, themes, settings workbench, and mobile layout
DSH 插件：在 Web 界面右下角挂一个 B 站音频播放条 —— 粘贴 BV/av、视频链接或番剧 ep/ss 即可听声音。队列和最近播放记在本地，宿主反向代理解决 CDN Referer 403。不需要登录。
Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness: one board per workspace, task cards bound to long-lived native Sessions, live run status, and the Session's real conversation inside the board.

DSH 工作台：把「AI 改 md → 生成 Word/Excel/PDF → 你审这一版」变成一条看得见的时间轴（版本快照、带理由的审批、打开某一版、和上一版比正文差异、把漏记的产物收编成记录），产线按最近动过排、目录从「最近用过 / 已登记工作区」里选，可停在右栏与对话并排；另带命令行记录器（AI 产出一版就记一条）、技能库（读 ctx.skills 的完整技能目录，可一键跳到文档迭代流程技能）、文档配对看板与「待我审」角标。
把 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区、项目成果和对话内容整体迁到另一台电脑
文言文应答模式：主界面一个开关，开启后 DeepSeek 一律以文言文作答——上文下注（上文言、下白话译），并化身蓝色古风、惯吃白饭的大肥鱼；开关按对话独立，关闭即恢复现代汉语。
Unofficial basketball desktop pets for DeepSeek Harness

DSH web GUI right-panel system: a pixel-faithful re-implementation of FileManager's Explorer + Preview columns (file tree, filename search, git changes, multi-tab preview of 10+ formats) driven by real host-side fs/git services, hot-pluggable via a profile bundle without any dsh source changes

Multi-channel IM gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): DingTalk / QQ / WeChat(iLink) / Feishu(Lark) / WeCom with QR-scan binding, streaming replies, and a unified ctx.imGateway service. 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供钉钉/QQ/个人微信/飞书/企业微信多 IM 通道接入。
Cron-based scheduled task plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): pure UI management, zero LLM tools, cross-session timer, multi-level notifications.

Session management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): list / delete / archive & restore sessions, with a built-in "Archived" group and a delete confirm dialog (real delete, not trash). 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话管理：列表 / 真删除（二次确认）/ 归档分组与恢复。
Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): list / enable / disable / delete / add skills from the web UI settings panel. 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能管理：列表 / 启用 / 停用 / 删除 / 添加。

Panel-style local + SSH terminal for the DSH web GUI: real PTY sessions (node-pty), multi-tab terminal panel with xterm.js, workspace-cwd shells — hot-pluggable via a profile bundle without any dsh source changes

Per-model vision (image input) toggle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): list every configured model and flip a switch to enable/disable image support without hand-editing settings.yaml. 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型的「支持图片」开关：无需手改 settings.yaml。
让同一想法，长出更多实现方案！在 DSH 主对话里比较回答、文件与网页，选风格，盲选或公开对比，再审查采用。Compare 2–4 answers, files or live pages in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop and Web, then review and adopt.
Codex 账号工具：为 DSH Codex 订阅提供安全的 JSON 导入、预览与导出。

Question index for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click one to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes the full history of every session on open and persists it locally.
在 dsh 里一键领取 WorkBuddy（CodeBuddy 国内版 / 国际版）的每日签到积分与福利活动积分：网页登录授权即可用，不需要安装 WorkBuddy 桌面客户端。
User-confirmed DSH Index discovery, install preparation, issue drafts, and community report drafts for DeepSeek Harness.
会话页头部的余额芯片。点击跳转充值页，悬停看赠送与充值的拆分。每 60 秒与窗口获得焦点时刷新；未配置密钥、密钥失效、余额不足、限流、超时、断网、响应异常各自给出提示。密钥只在宿主侧读取。
输入卡底部工具行的计费时段徽标，附倒计时。高峰为北京时间周一至周五 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00；周末全天算空闲，周五 18:00 后显示距下周一 09:00 还有 63 小时。
Enterprise-grade Zero-Trust Authentication, LAN/Public Access Control & Security Gate Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Left-click applies the selected action to delivered files, changed-file rows, file mentions, and tool-card file names; right-click takeover is configurable: all menus, only where DSH has none, or never.
Reorder models in the DSH composer picker, store three per-million-token prices, and estimate per-turn and session cost with built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
A Garmin Connect plugin and MCP server with official Personal API and secure browser-based MFA for DeepSeek Harness and other AI agents
Voice Input plugin for DeepSeek Harness with real-time recording, pause, playback review, and OpenAI-compatible proxy transcription
Windows 2000 skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners and a 16px scrollbar. 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 经典外观。
Auto context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: token-pressure-driven summarization checkpoints with a configurable (LATE-by-default) trigger threshold and a settings card.
超级模组注入器：运行时注入任意本地 DSH 插件包（junction 链接 + loader.create，不碰 patch/package.json/不重启），热重载全家桶 + 开发侧挂区一键转正 + 一键卸载 + 路由自愈 + 插件管理 UI（设置页：列表/卸载/拖入内化），清单持久化重启自动恢复——DSH 生态的 BepInEx 式模组注入入口
插件管理升级版：直连 pnpm 升级插件（绕过 dsh CLI 拦截），带插件列表与一键升级设置卡片。Plugin manager upgrade: direct-pnpm upgrades bypassing dsh CLI interception, with a plugin list and one-click upgrade settings card.
Social-network-style AI agent UI with personified Skills, direct messages, group chats and automations for DeepSeek Harness
GAL 视窗的吃饭插件：鲸元券/饱食度/好感度 HUD + 美食街吃饭流程（需要 gal-view 0.4+）
灰度模型检测工具：一键开测 40 个并发 dsh 会话（V4 Pro + max 思考），流式监听思维链——出现 I'm/I'll 特征标记为灰度神模型，出现 Let me 标记为正常模型；统计灰度出现率，结果可在设置页查看。
让 AI 以群友身份接入 QQ 群：OneBot 11 接入、角色卡、独立模型切换、设置页可视化配置
DSH plugin: route only the model channels you tick through an HTTP proxy, everything else stays direct — with a settings card in the Web UI.
对话栏左侧常驻大纲：快速定位每次 user 提问与最后一条 assistant 回复（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。
A buildboard popup (notes, images, live account HUD) whose history rows offer edit / analyze / delete; analyze opens a fresh DeepSeek session to judge the note against workspace conversations.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: five-layer intent recognition (rules / vector / Jev / fine-tuned / LLM fallback). Zero-config basic edition (local file storage) out of the box; advanced edition adds PostgreSQL + pgvector vector retrieval. Scenario & service management UI included.
Adds a real Delete action to a Session's sidebar row menu: removes the stored log, the projection cache and (optionally) the subagent logs, then retires the row. | 为侧栏会话行菜单加一个真正删除会话的操作。
大肥鱼桌宠：自带 104 个动作与语音的独立 DSH 插件，不依赖 dsh-dafeiyu

小白友好的 DSH Web 一键配置：dsh-at-file + dsh-better-sidebar + dsh-web-ui 精选 + 账户状态栏 + Checkpoint + VSCode 式左侧栏（文件树/会话/对话大纲，含 ⋯ 菜单：置顶/删除/复制路径）+ 全局设定（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 编辑器，CLAUDE.md 风格）。 English: Beginner-friendly one-command DSH Web plugin bundle — dsh-at-file + dsh-better-sidebar + curated dsh-web-ui + account status bar + Checkpoint snapshots + VSCode-style left sidebar (files/sessions/outline) + Global Settings editor.
MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页展示 MCP 服务器与 Skill 目录，随时启停释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（dsh_mcp_search/dsh_mcp_call）按需使用 MCP。
琉璃主题 —— DSH 界面增强插件：M3 动态取色、壁纸磨砂材质、声纹可视化、日/夜切换
Agent Theater — a DSH conversation view that turns a session into a character stage: scene-driven pet, comic bubbles, a completion report and real deliverables.

DeepSeek Harness web plugin: live Typst preview as a native right-Sidebar tab, rendered by a per-file `tinymist preview` server proxied over the app origin, with the source face highlighted from tinymist's semantic tokens.
Export and import a DeepSeek Harness Desktop configuration, including installed plugins, plugin settings, MCP entries, and user skills. Credentials and API keys are not exported.
在 DSH 中撤回自己发过的消息：工作区文件与对话历史一起回到那条消息发出之前，消息的文本与附件自动放回输入框，改完即可重发。文件走独立影子 git 快照（不碰项目自身的 git），对话走官方 sessions.fork，原会话归档可找回。
DeepSeek Harness Web 增强插件：完成/审批/提问提醒（三种事件各有独立音效与立绘弹窗，支持裁剪/翻转/本地持久化）、外观定制（背景图、透明度、输入区折叠），以及按轮次聚合的文件变更页签（行级差异 + 修改前后代码高亮）。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-session token usage and estimated cost in the sidebar session row hover card.
Mobile-device preview browser for the DSH right sidebar: pick a phone or tablet size, @-mention or /url-insert the page URL from the composer, copy the URL in one click.
Codex-style right sidebar for DSH Web with automatic output collection, responsive previews, and session-aware tabs
DSH 技能管理：统一管理本机各软件技能库，按本机技能自动分类，英文简介自动翻译，支持仓库地址识别安装与输入框内按分类选择技能。
Claude Code-style git worktree support for dsh web: create, switch, and delete worktree sessions.
API Hub — manage and call local API providers (keys, models, balances) and skills from inside DeepSeek Harness
Persist the DeepSeek Harness Web frame's left sidebar and right panel widths across restarts, which the shipped layout store keeps in memory only.
视频总结:侧边栏入口 + 主面板,把一个视频链接变成带时间轴的总结记录(yt-dlp 取音频/字幕、faster-whisper 本地转录、模型写总结)
Multi-agent team management plugin for DeepSeek Harness
One-click update for self-built Linux dsh-desktop: checks the fork's GitHub releases, downloads the deb, swaps the app dir and restarts. 桌面端 Linux 自建版一键更新。
Collaborative human-AI workspace workbench: session-attached interactive terminal, git management, and browser integration for DeepSeek Harness

DSH 的双语覆盖层：为插件、命令与 Skill 叠加中文名和功能说明，三种显示模式，英文原版一键开关。DSH Bilingual layer: Add Chinese names and descriptions for plugins, commands and Skills, with three display modes and one-click toggle to revert to the original English view.
DSH 右下角悬浮余额监视器：实时查看 DeepSeek API 余额与用量费用图表（7天/30天）

Multi-provider quota & balance glass card for the DSH sidebar footer (11 providers incl. StepFun / Xiaomi MiMo / Claude with one-click browser login; Step Plan credit). Installable from the dsh-plugin marketplace (GitHub topic "dsh-plugin") or via file: linking.
提示词体检：读你的历史会话找出反复踩的提问坑（缺路径、没定格式、漏前置条件），每条给可直接粘贴的改写；输入框旁一键出更短的带约束版本。不承诺提升准确度。
Token usage & cost monitor for DeepSeek Harness: aggregate usage across all sessions, per-model cost (USD/CNY), time-window filtering, auto-refresh, embedded settings panel
上下文占用色调：按占用档位给 DeepSeek Harness 输入区的上下文胶囊改色（圆环 + 百分比），并在百分比右侧显示 emoji；五个分界值、五档颜色、六档 emoji 均可在插件配置页修改。纯客户端，不依赖桌宠与图片素材。
Push the agent to deliver its answer as soon as it has one instead of running extra queries.

归档会话管理 · Archived sessions — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 设置面板：列出本机全部已归档会话，支持多选、批量复原、批量永久删除与会话搜索（标题/项目/路径 + 可选的内容搜索）；首屏只读缓存与目录事实，不再为每行折叠会话日志。 A DSH settings panel for archived sessions: multi-select, batch restore, batch permanent delete, and search across titles, projects and paths (plus optional session-content search), with a first paint that never folds a session log.

侧边栏 DWG/DXF 预览：宿主侧用 LibreDWG(WASM) 把 DWG 转成 DXF 并渲染为矢量 SVG，客户端在文档预览标签里显示。 A DSH sidebar preview for DWG/DXF drawings: the host half decodes DWG with LibreDWG (WASM) and renders vector SVG, the browser half shows it in the document preview tab.

会话重试 · Session retry — 助手消息动作条上的「重新回答」按钮：先把这一轮的旧回答从模型上下文里移除，再把该轮的用户提问重新提交给同一个会话。 A DSH plugin that adds an "answer again" action to every assistant turn strip, dropping the previous answer from the model context first.

用量 · Usage — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 设置面板：当日与累计的 token 用量（累计记在本机账本里，删除会话不会让数字变小；卸载插件或重装 DSH 后历史仍在）、缓存命中、历史用量热力图，以及已接入 API（kimi-coding、commandcode、opencode-go）的额度与刷新时间。 A DSH settings panel for token usage kept in a local ledger outside the Harness home (uninstalling the plugin or DSH keeps it), cache hits, a usage heatmap, and provider quotas.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop remote-control plugin: persistent links, QR pairing and mobile UI
Ink-wash poetry wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness: a daily couplet from the Chinese poetry corpus, set in calligraphy on a generated ink-wash landscape.
Third-party DeepSeek Harness brand plugin: whale mark plus a minimal 'deepseek' wordmark for the Web client sidebar.
Third-party macOS menu bar activity indicator for DeepSeek Harness
Session-sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness: git-backed cross-machine session sync with its own web settings surface, row-menu action, and sync-records dialog
Third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-workspace custom prompt configured from a slash command and injected into the model context at session start.
DSH plugin: choose models for subagents and plan execution separately / 为子代理和计划执行选择更合适的模型
AgentDuel plugin for DeepSeek Harness

Presmium's bundle for DeepSeek Harness: the workbench of presmium studio, its host side (Presmium's tools, approvals, document context, skills and routes) and its client side (the root layout and the workbench's panels, precompiled) (experimental)
DSH Tavern 附加功能：编辑上一条发言并重新生成
让 DeepSeek Harness 能导入 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 之外的图片格式：拖放、粘贴与一键选择三条通道，浏览器端转码为宿主接受的格式 · Import more image formats into the Harness composer
在侧栏账号头像的右侧常驻一个设置按钮，一点直达设置面板 · Keeps a Settings gear right of the account avatar in the sidebar foot
DG-LAB 控制插件：为 AI 提供 dglab-kit 工具集 + 扫码配对手机 APP 的 Web UI
BUPT 教学云（ucloud）插件：在「设置 → 插件」页配置学号与密码，并为 DSH 提供未完成作业、作业详情、课程搜索、附件上传与作业提交工具。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供外挂识图模型：网页配置面板、发送图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图识图工具，支持多协议与一键安装/卸载。
A small floating box in the DSH web UI: jot down a line or drop a screenshot, press Enter, and it is saved as a Markdown file in your workspace.
Novel writing companion: interview the author about world, characters and plot, finalize an outline per chapter, then write chapter drafts.
Falstad CircuitJS1 circuit drawing and simulation workspace for DeepSeek Harness
GeoGebra drawing workspace for DeepSeek Harness

ChatGPT Codex, xAI Grok, Zhipu GLM, AWS Kiro, Google Antigravity, Cursor, Ollama Cloud, Kimi, and GitHub Copilot subscription OAuth for DeepSeek Harness — PKCE / device-code / Google login, local Responses proxy, llm-pi-ai sync.
An Overview tab for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into progress, artifacts, and references.
Reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness — a dark card with one mascot illustration per level.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：Google Antigravity 直连代理与模型服务，支持 OpenAI 兼容协议转换、最新模型列表自动发现与一键同步、实时双模型池额度监控、热切换网络代理与长文本输出防御。
Runtime log panel for DeepSeek Harness: live SSE log view in Settings plus bounded date/size rotating JSONL files.
Durable multi-level context undo/redo for DeepSeek Harness, with per-user-message WebUI actions.
Minimal live taskboard: what Claude Code / Codex / DSH / Open Design are doing right now.
Minimal offline Beijing peak/idle indicator for DeepSeek Harness
Attune — 微信 AI Agent / 微信 AI / WeChat agent / WeChat AI for DeepSeek Harness: emotional memory, moods, relationships, voice. Search 微信agent / 微信ai / wechatagent / wechatai.
插件页卡片显示包内组件状态，设置页配置选项卡显示提供者包名，便于排查问题。
Show the official COT machine translation inside dsh-better-display's reading view. · 在阅读视图里显示官方「思考过程机器翻译」的译文。
Git panel for the dsh web GUI: commit graph with branch filters, working-tree status, per-commit diffs, branches, stash, merge conflicts, remote sync and repository settings.
Arona-themed alias-token theme for the dsh web GUI (light + dark), inspired by G:\ARONA HELPER design

DSH client plugin: reverses the conversation reading layout — the composer pins to the TOP of an active conversation (centered on a new one) and the transcript plus turn navigator render newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.

webCandidates.description: DSH 小说工作室：四角色协作创作，支持可编辑系统提示词、半成品导入、剧情改写、原稿对照与版本回退。
Add a Git repository source to the new-workspace flow, with background clone progress and local credential reuse
小鱼娘的声音：日语语音 + 界面漫画气泡 + 中文字幕。接本地 GPT-SoVITS（芙莉莲 v1）。

Import chat.deepseek.com conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions. Feature supplement for upstream 0.2.1: imports images and documents, cleans the markdown, and refreshes the session list.
在 DSH 设置里可视化查看、创建与编辑 AGENTS.md：项目级跟随工作区目录链，全局级覆盖 ~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents，并按工具子 Tab 集中管理 25+ 个第三方 AI 工具的规则文件（含注入字节 / 字数 / token 统计）。
布局：自定义 DSH 界面结构（左栏 / 右栏 / 会话区 / 设置页）
为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器加两级 Tab（提供商 + 模型系列），大目录时减少滚动翻找；族规则可在设置页配置。
浏览、导入和整理本地 HTML 知识卡片。
把设置入口从账号二级菜单提到侧边栏底部：一键打开设置页。 DeepSeek Harness client plugin that puts a settings button at the bottom of the sidebar.
DSH Web GUI 会话右侧快捷跳转锚点（turn rail）随音乐律动：宿主侧 WASAPI 环回采集 + FFT 频段经 SSE 推送，浏览器侧驱动锚点短条伸缩，宛如旋转 90° 的频谱柱。
Agnes AI image generation and video generation for DeepSeek Harness (main features), plus optional image recognition. Tool results are text-only; generated media is written to a local folder.

DSH plugin: free web search tool (DuckDuckGo via ddg-kit with system-proxy support, automatic Bing fallback) + front-loaded vision understanding tool (vision_understand: understand images via a vision-capable model configured in DSH when the conversation model has no image modality) + composer-level paste-image capture (paste/drop an image in the conversation input → vision model → description, bypassing DSH's image gate on text-only models) + drag-drop file stash (drag/paste/attach any file → stashed into the session workspace, attachment list injected into the next message via agent/pre-step — clean draft, replayable history) + token auth toggle (turn off token verification for open access, effective immediately, persists across restarts). Official bundle plugin, install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:LingyeSoul/dsh-rider#main。DSH 插件：免费网络搜索（duckduckgo_search 工具）+ 前置视觉理解（vision_understand 工具）+ 对话输入框粘贴图片捕获（粘贴/拖入图片 → 视觉模型 → 描述，绕开 DSH 对纯文本模型的图片拦截）+ 对话窗口拖拽上传任意文件（拖入/粘贴/选择文件 → 暂存进会话工作区，附件清单随下一条消息经 agent/pre-step 自动注入，草稿零污染）+ Token 验证开关（关闭后免 token 直接访问，立即生效，重启保持）。适配 dsh ≥0.2.0（settings Config 导出契约 + client 纯净性要求）。
为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH Desktop) 加一个 Codex 风格的 Git 面板：会话头部 Git 按钮，提供提交、推送、切换分支、创建并切换与初始化仓库。
鼠标静默时 DSH 背景模糊归零，移动或点击时按可调百分比模糊；适配 dsh-cool-theme 0.9/0.10（图片和视频背景），设置里可调活动模糊度、过渡时间和静默时长。
Replace edit/write tool cards with inline full-line colored code diffs (green add / red delete), shown right after each modification.
股市行情皮肤+功能插件：从 Trading Terminal 皮肤演进而来的自选跑马灯、实时行情、自选列表与持仓盈亏面板，点击跑马灯弹出个股日K图（蜡烛/MA/成交量）（A股/港股/美股/指数/加密/外汇，腾讯+Binance+Yahoo+Frankfurter 聚合）
公文全流程处理专家 - GB/T 9704 格式检查/修复/内容优化/模板生成/版式注入
Session-backed writing pad for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with Markdown preview, complete-draft XML requests, human-readable transcript projections, and focused AI writing tools.
Balance and per-session spend HUD for the DSH Web GUI: shows your DeepSeek balance and what this session has cost, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DeepSeek Harness: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.

webCandidates.description: Local AI art generation for DeepSeek Harness game development: drives the machine's SD WebUI / ComfyUI backends through eight image_* model tools, a /gig REST surface and a 美术工坊 (Art Studio) better-sidebar panel, writing Godot-ready assets.
DS Bot: a team of long-lived Bots for DeepSeek Harness, with Main Bots, Bot-to-Bot messages and group chats
Fully local multilingual speech recognition with whisper.cpp: 99 Whisper languages, automatic detection by default, no data sent over the Internet.
Remote Host Tunnel Manager for dsh: allocate and register remote ports, run dsh web on a remote Linux server via systemd, and keep a resilient SSH tunnel from this machine to it.

Permanently delete a Session from the Workspace sidebar in DeepSeek Harness with one click: a native row action and menu item, a lightweight confirmation, live-Session protection, cascade for derived Sessions, and cleanup of the projection cache and workspace bookkeeping.

DeepSeek Harness model selector with collapsible provider groups: providers stay collapsed behind a triangle toggle, and only the provider of the current model starts expanded. 模型选择器厂商分组折叠插件：厂商默认收起，仅当前模型所属厂商展开，三角箭头切换。
ComfyUI workflow canvas for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) desktop right sidebar: browse, inspect, edit and run local ComfyUI workflows on a native infinite canvas instead of an embedded browser.

DSH 桌面版右侧栏的无限画布：打开任何格式的图片都会落到同一张可平移缩放的画布上，支持拖动/缩放/旋转/锁定/撤销、框选与涂抹批注、一键把批注变成给 Agent 的提示词、导出 PNG，并可用本机 ComfyUI 直接改图/出图；0.6.0 起还能在画布上直接查看 .glb/.gltf/.fbx/.obj/.stl/.ply 3D 模型（three.js 本地渲染，可旋转/缩放/平移）。所有能力本地完成，不调用任何外部 AI 服务。
DSH 桌面版输入框工具条插件：在「听写」左边加「录屏」与「截图」两个按钮 —— 录屏前先弹「选择要录制的内容」框（屏幕/窗口/自定义区域，可折叠、可收起成小横条），截图带选区 + 标注（拖完框选手一松就能画），还能一键隐藏 DSH 界面截到被它挡住的内容。Screen capture & recording buttons for the DSH desktop composer.
DSH 插件：打开 DSH 时先零配置探测本机有没有装《原神》——装了就直接启动游戏本体（起不来自动改起米哈游启动器），没装就把启动器安装包下载到桌面（带 224MB 体积安全闸，下载不成退化成打开官方下载页）。

CapyReporter — an always-on-top capybara task reporter for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. A transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, tells you which project is reporting, alerts you when a task completes while you are away, and lets you upload your own pet art.
Role-based AI swarm orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: duty-table model pinning per role, parallel task DAG with review loops, and a live Swarm dashboard tab in the web GUI.
Opening animation overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web: user-picked image animations or a video, then a configurable transition hands the screen back to the UI.
dsh 插件：把工作区 Excel/CSV 导入本地 Turso（libSQL），并以句柄化的 dataset_* 工具做增删改查。

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin — Codex-style attachment expansion: PDF text-layer (pymupdf4llm/pdfjs), Office (docx/xlsx/pptx) to Markdown, TIFF/epub/odt/rtf, long-document spill to index cards, scanned-PDF OCR (tesseract.js + 8 cloud providers inc. DeepSeek Vision), and browser image to PNG. dsh-plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
Liquid-glass billing overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: provider balances, session cost, daily spend and token buckets. DeepSeek-first with an extensible provider registry.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：把网页版豆包与网页版 ChatGPT 免费账户的生图能力接进 DSH（含图生图、生视频与 Web 设置页）。
DeepSeek Harness Web UI in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) — converts the rendered interface, including third-party plugin copy, at the DOM layer.
Input-box-top next-prompt suggestion bar for dsh web: async side-call after each completed turn (reply-first, async-suggestion two-phase UX), tap-friendly adopt/send/dismiss buttons
DeepSeek Harness plugin that incrementally indexes the current workspace via the configured BCE MCP and enhances composer prompts.
Web Settings plugin control: start/stop Cordis Loader plugins from a new 启停控制 tab under Settings → Plugins.
Cross-session long-term memory in plain Markdown files, with zero extra LLM calls.
Memory Fortress for DeepSeek Harness: 5-track layered memory, self-evolution, knowledge graph (SQLite+FTS5), status pill. 本地记忆堡垒：五轨记忆·自我进化·知识图谱·状态灯。
API balance & usage monitor: a settings section showing the configured provider's account balance with manual refresh. Key never leaves the host.
DSH 字体插件：修改整个界面的文字显示效果（正文字体 / 代码字体 / 显示比例 / 行高 / 字体平滑 / 代码连字 / 字体浏览器 / 中文字形标记），设置 → 字体。
DeepSeek API 账户余额 + OpenCodeGo 余量实时显示：左下角悬浮徽章（可拖拽，双段显示）+ 两个设置页；Host 经 curl 调用官方余额/余量接口，API Key 持久化在 ~/.dsh/ds-balance.json，OpenCodeGo Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。
DSH task-board plugin: adds a kanban tab (Chat/Trajectory/Tasks) to the DSH web GUI with drag-to-execute real agent runs.
Inline next-message prediction in the DSH composer: a grey ghost line, Tab to accept, ArrowUp to recall sent prompts.

Manage DeepSeek Harness agent presets (personas) from the desktop app's Settings page: create, edit and delete persona presets in place, copy an existing preset as a base, import a Markdown document, and export a JSON backup or a persona document.
桌宠「宠物聊天」：基于 dsh-pet 的二次修改版——QQ 风格对话面板（对话记录/收藏/分支）、合并转发卡片、面板停靠与八向缩放、本地寒暄省 token。
给 DeepSeek Harness 增加真正的「删除会话」：从侧栏会话菜单永久删除一个会话（停活动、清工作区记账/归档/置顶、删除投影缓存与日志文件），而不是只能归档。
Notify for Chrome: Chrome notification alerts for DeepSeek Harness turns, approvals, questions and errors, with a silent in-app toast fallback.
Hard-delete archived sessions, archive workspaces, move sessions, and fork into a new workspace.

Curated durable memory for DeepSeek Harness: automatic capture of decisions/corrections/prohibitions/open work, progressive-disclosure recall, duplicate consolidation, old-vs-new conflict resolution, and a sidebar management panel.
「昔涟印象」主题包：为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供月白 / 潮汐 / 夜阑三套配色、可选的开屏动画、侧栏品牌位、对话线稿水印和热切换面板。

RigorQuant for DeepSeek Harness: session-scoped unattended, context-isolated multi-agent research for empirical/computational mathematics with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.

DSH 宿主插件:注册一个 `auto` 模型路由,内部按配置的有序链依次尝试多条「provider + model」;某条在**产出任何内容之前**失败时,先按官方同款策略在该路由内原地重试(瞬时错误白名单,默认 5 次),重试耗尽才静默切下一条,对上层表现为一个普通模型;并可用 compactWindow 把自动压缩点钉在指定 token 数附近。0.4.0 起自带浏览器半侧:插件页该 bundle 的卡片上直接渲染配置表单,可直接改 compactWindow(官方 SettingsForm 原语,保存才写入)。0.5.0 起同一处再渲染只读「回退链」面板:当前生效链 + 最近若干次请求的真实回退过程(数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes,打开页面时读一次、可手动刷新)。0.5.2 起:DeepSeek 原生路由可用 routes[i].keepThinking 保留工具循环思考,缺省仍摘;(B1/B2) 跨路由的历史思考改为从 content 与 replayState.blocks 同步摘掉,不再被上游降级成正文;(B) 真的发生静默路由切换时,在出站消息末尾追加一条与 DSH 自带同款的 model changed 通知(只改出站负载、不写会话记录)。0.5.3 起:新增 routes[i].breakToolLoop —— 历史里存在「带工具调用却没有思考块」的助手消息、且出站以工具结果结尾时,在出站消息末尾追加一条用户提示,把请求改成「以用户消息结尾」,绕开 DeepSeek thinking 模式的工具循环校验(这种情形下思考是「从来没有」,keepThinking 挡不住)。0.6.0 起:routes 成为可写配置,插件页那张卡片上的「回退链」面板升级成可编辑 —— 拖拽排序、从 live 模型目录(新增 GET /api/llm-auto/catalog)里选模型、按行开关 keepThinking/breakToolLoop;写入走官方设置服务落进 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml(注释保留),靠懒读 volatile 引用免重启生效。0.7.0 起:同一张卡片上再多一段**只读**的「额度」摘要 —— 链上两家订阅的余额/窗口用量(Command Code 的美元余额 + 5h/周窗口,OpenCode Go 的 5h/周/月三档百分比),数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes 新增的 quota 字段;宿主侧只读查询、按 TTL 缓存、永不因此改变端点状态码,**查不到就显示「不可查」而不是 0**;同一个响应里还在确有 profile 覆盖时多一个 user.routes,让面板的「恢复包内默认链」按钮终于有判据可依。0.8.0 起:回退链的顺序改由插件**按订阅额度自动决定** —— 有月度重置时刻的订阅按「越早重置越靠前」排,查不到重置时刻的按配置顺序,永不过期的按量兜底排最后;某一跳因窗口额度耗尽被拒(错误码 QUOTA)时,插件补查该来源的额度接口,确认后把它冷却到对应窗口的重置时刻、期间不再尝试,到点自动恢复(进程内冷却表,不落盘)。新增 volatile 配置键 ordering.mode(auto 默认 / manual = 回到 0.7.0 的「完全按 routes 顺序」),插件页那张卡片上多一段「自动排序」摘要与开关;/routes 响应新增只读字段 ordering(effective 实际尝试顺序 + cooldown 冷却表),chain 仍是配置顺序。0.9.0 起:插件页那张卡片的界面**按排序模式收敛** —— 模式开关(自动/手动)挪到卡片最上面、在「回退链」标题之前;自动模式下主视图是「生效顺序」(插件排出来的实际尝试顺序),可编辑的配置链折进默认收起的「配置顺序」折叠项(点开照旧可拖可改),提示语也换成「自动排序生效中」那句;手动模式下主视图就是那条可编辑的链,不画生效顺序。0.9.1 起:放宽「窗口额度耗尽」判据 —— 不再要求 `usage limit` 紧跟 exhausted/reached(Command Code 的实际文案是 `You've reached your weekly usage limit for your plan. Your limit resets at …`,旧判据对它返回 false,于是每次请求都先白撞 CC 并原地重试 6 次),改为「窗口词 + 额度词 + 耗尽/重置词三者同时成立」;该判据由宿主侧(补查额度、冷却该 provider)与适配器侧(不再原地重试,直接切下一条)共用同一个函数。0.10.0 起:`auto` 在模型选择器的档位面板上只有两档 ——「Default」(插件一个推理档位都不写,交回宿主/上游默认)与「max」(逐条路由取该家最高档,与 0.9.x 的旧行为逐字等价);声明面是 `resolveModel()` 的 `reasoning.efforts=[max]` 且**不给** `defaultEffort`(给了就没有 Default 那行)。⚠ 要让「默认档」真的不带推理强度,pi-ai 路由的 profile 里不能有 route 级 `reasoning:` —— 本机 2026-10-09 已从 desktop / headless 两个 profile 删掉。0.11.0 起:冷却表**落盘** —— 结论写进宿主领域存储(域 llm_auto_cooldown / 表 cooldowns,介质 <DSH_HOME>/storages/llm_auto_cooldown.json),跨 dsh 重启与插件重组合存活到重置时刻,不再有「重启后第一条白撞」;被 QUOTA 拒的当下先同步记一条 5 分钟短闸门(补查确认后换成重置时刻),周期补查见该家已恢复则自动解冻,面板冷却行右侧多一个「解除」按钮(走设置服务的 ordering.unfreeze 一次性指令,不新增写端点),并显示冷却表落盘状态;存储服务缺席 / 打开失败 / 写入失败一律降级为纯内存 + warn,绝不影响注册与请求。0.11.1 起:把「解除冷却」指令的**已消费记录也落盘** —— 面板写进配置的那条 ordering.unfreeze 值一变就生效,但面板自己**不会清掉它**,而 0.11.0 只把「消费过了」记在内存里 ⇒ 宿主重启后旧指令会被当成新指令再消费一次(清冷却 + 删介质记录 + 第一条请求又白撞那家,2026-10-12 真机实测:撞 Go 948 ms 被判 QUOTA → 切走 → 6 秒后介质被重写成 source=confirm)。0.11.1 把这个值写进冷却域(域 llm_auto_cooldown)的 global 槽 —— 不改域名 / version / cooldowns 表结构,老介质(global: null)照旧能打开 —— 水合时读回来,同一个值永不再触发。另加一条**陈旧判据**:指令里的 epochMs 早于宿主**进程**启动时刻 ⇒ 只记为已消费、不做任何解除动作并 warn(面板不可能在宿主没运行时被点到;用进程启动时刻而不是插件 apply 时刻,免得重组合把合法点击误判成陈旧);配置里现存的那条旧指令因此在升级后的第一次重启也不会再撞一次。已知代价:宿主停机期间(或点完还没被消费就重启)的「解除」不会被事后补偿,重启后再点一次即可;写 global 失败 / 读不出来都只 warn,冷却水合照旧。
艺术工坊：DeepSeek Harness 里的视频/图文生产流水线 —— 知识库抽题、链路编排（插件可自由替换）、流程节点自定义、一键出片、作品复盘。

Browse, install, enable, and update plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
Calendar diary: a plain notebook. A month page in the DSH sidebar, backed by one user-specified .xlsx in the DesktopCal two-column format. No schedule coupling.
DeepSeek Harness tools for GenBox: image generation/editing (including inpaint, upscale, cutout) and video generation through a local GenBox server.
本地优先、支持富文本编辑的 DSH Web 侧边栏工作清单插件
Compact, searchable, tag-based agent preset management for DeepSeek Harness
Content-free prompt profile editor and versioned composition framework for DeepSeek Harness
Self-contained SillyTavern-style safe message renderer for DeepSeek Harness
星火课堂：DSH 桌面端插件 —— 家长挑片、按周排课、孩子看完打勾、课卡判分、错题回炉、盲盒与勋章，附带家长锁。

Prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: structural analysis, ambiguity and redundancy detection, and an engineering-grade rewrite.

All code and data live inside this package directory.
Windows toast and macOS notifications when a DSH task finishes or the agent needs you; click to return to DeepSeek-Harness, with a settings page inside DSH
Pin workspaces whose sessions are running or waiting for your reply to the top of the DSH sidebar.
Native system notification banners and a Dock badge when DSH waits for your answer, waits for approval, or finishes a turn.

Full-screen SAO-inspired startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable beam, dial, language, and character settings. The original high-fidelity rendering is the default; optional compatibility mode for low-end GPUs, and an optional tunnel-only intro.

Personal usage profile page for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: tokens and spend by range, longest task, activity streaks, cache hit rate, a 12-month token-activity heatmap, model distribution, token stats by content, projects and a per-provider breakdown, all folded from the local session logs.

Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: lists global and per-project skills, enables or disables model and slash-command invocation, previews and edits SKILL.md, and creates, imports or deletes skills.
DSH 侧栏里的安卓真机：scrcpy 实时画面 + 亚毫秒控制通道 + 截屏/长截图，并把手机操作能力作为工具交给模型
Fail-closed durable execution ledger and operator-attested readback for opt-in DeepSeek Harness tools
Lightweight skin manager for the dsh web GUI: scans installed skins at runtime (no hardcoded list) and switches the active one via profile patch + config HMR.

Git GUI panel for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: visualize working-tree changes (including every modification the agent makes), stage/commit/branch/merge/log/pull/push/stash/revert — all from the browser.

webCandidates.description: dsh-fleet — Punica Studio. A multi-harness fleet console for DeepSeek Harness Web: manage local + remote dsh instances from one place and read cross-device conversation history (token-gated), so past sessions never restart. 原名 dsh-harness-workbench。Harness Fleet：一个面板统管本机与多台远程 Harness 并可跨设备读取原有对话记录。
把 WorkBuddy 的文件式记忆系统移植进 DeepSeek Harness：用户级 + 工作区的人类可读 Markdown 记忆（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md 与 <cwd>/.deepseek-harness/memory/）。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: adds catalog quick-load (pi-ai / models.dev) and per-model compat switches to the official Models settings page
DeepSeek Harness 插件：Session header 的 "Open In..." 按钮组底座，提供注册契约供同类插件补充目标软件。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：向会话头部「Open In...」按钮组与原生右键菜单注册 CodeBuddy CN 打开方式，一键用本机 CodeBuddy CN 打开 workspace 目录。
把会话内联可视化能力移植进 DeepSeek Harness：render_visual 把 SVG/HTML 源码渲染成会话流内联卡片，get_visualizer_spec 提供统一渲染规范。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：为用户显式声明的工作区目录预置 Windows ACL 完全控制 ACE，补上沙箱授权所需的 WRITE_OWNER 前提，消除危险模式弹框。
DeepSeek Harness global account-balance card: live session/job status plus GLM / KIMI quota windows and OpenRouter / DeepSeek balances, pinned to the shell overlay bottom-right

Separator-transparent, abbreviation-aware slash-menu matching for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: provides the slashMatcher service the ui-commands and ui-skill sources consult, so `dshp` matches `dsh-plugin-creator` and `dbc` matches `dsh-better-command`.

Lovstudio in-place application restart for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: a host half exposing restart/status routes and a settings-header button with live running-conversation monitoring, confirmation dialog, and in-flight spinner.
Composer model seat takeover: sticky search + fuzzy matching over the shared model directory
Local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin marketplace with GitHub and dshfind providers
Composer model seat takeover: sticky search + fuzzy matching over the shared model directory
A local-first video editing workbench for DeepSeek Harness with Remotion, GSAP and pluggable ASR
Persistent Quick Actions for the DSH message composer

Zero-dependency molecular-biology plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: sequence analysis, primer design (incl. cross-intron qPCR primers, TaqMan hydrolysis/MGB probes with ordering CSV and multiplex compatibility), in-silico PCR, cloning simulation, SnapGene .dna parsing and plasmid maps, Sanger verification, protein tools (incl. helical wheel, hydropathy and charge-pH plots), methylation-aware restriction analysis with double-digest buffer checks, qPCR analysis and plotting, multiple sequence alignment that conserves every input residue, conservation analysis, sequence logos, codon-usage analysis, phylogenetic trees with bootstrap support, Newick I/O and long-name label wrapping, CpG-island/GC-skew composition analysis, k-mer dotplots, read-level FASTQ QC, vector/adapter contamination screening, FASTQ trimming/filtering, batch file analysis with CSV export, silent restriction-site mutagenesis, family-aware CRISPR gRNA design (SpCas9/SaCas9/Cas12a/Cas13) with off-target search, an opt-in hand-off that shows a generated plot to the model as an attached image, plus a browser-side right-sidebar panel (plasmid maps, sequence logos, and a rotatable realistic 3D ball-and-stick/space-filling preview of PDB/mmCIF/SDF structures drawn in the Web GUI) and a literature/protocol/experiment record system.

Browser panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a Molbio tab in the right sidebar that draws plasmid maps and sequence logos from workspace sequence files, using the same computation modules as the dsh-molbio-tools plugin.

Favourite any DSH conversation, copy its session id + transcript absolute path, delete one conversation permanently (guarded), batch-archive conversations idle for more than N hours, filter the sidebar down to favourites, export a conversation list as tab-separated txt, edit-resend or undo any user turn with automatic file snapshots that roll back with it, hand a long conversation over to a fresh window with a distilled brief (requirement timeline + task progress, preset inherited), diagnose/clean the sidebar 'Ungrouped' bucket (with a boot-time warning and a dry-run-first one-click fix), sweep orphan projection-cache records that no directory scan can see, and hide the bucket by default — additive slot extensions over the shipped archive feature, editing no official file. 为 DSH 对话加上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条永久删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选，并导出对话清单；另含会话管理：用户消息可编辑重发、撤销整轮，AI 改过的文件自动快照并在回滚时一并还原；再含一键新窗口继续对话：把长对话蒸馏成「要求时间线 + 任务进度」交接书，继承原对话预设，在新窗口自动发送；还有侧栏「未分组」体检：一键只读诊断 + 先试算后执行的清理，并在每次开机时告警；外加清理目录扫描看不见的投影缓存幽灵，且默认就隐藏该分组。全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方一行代码。

DSH 产物路径联动器：常驻注入「产物路径铁律」让模型输出完整绝对路径，同时把聊天正文里的文件名/路径渲染成一键可点的产物芯片——左键在右侧边栏预览（对齐官方交付卡片，绝对路径 0 次解析直通，侧栏认领不了自动退回系统默认程序），Ctrl/Shift/Cmd+左键用系统默认程序打开，Alt+左键复制绝对路径，右键 8 项菜单（在侧栏打开 / 在浮窗中打开 / 在文件夹中显示 / 用默认程序打开 / 另存为… / 复制文件 / 复制文件路径 / 添加到对话框）。宿主端提供回环只读路由与 /saveas /copyfile 两个文件搬运动作（Shell COM 揭示、WinForms 保存对话框、CF_HDROP 剪贴板），客户端零侵入、不改 React 节点、不接管 markdown 图片语法。解决「产物要打开得先复制路径再粘到文件管理器」的反复割裂。/ Turn declared artifact paths into one-click chips: resident system-prompt rules force absolute paths, the client half renders file names as clickable chips, left click previews in DSH's built-in sidebar (absolute paths resolve in 0 round-trips; unclaimed types fall back to the default app), Ctrl/Shift/Cmd+click opens with the system default app, Alt+click copies the absolute path, and the right-click menu offers eight actions (open in sidebar / open in floating window / reveal in Explorer / open with default app / save-as / copy-file / copy-path / insert-into-composer). Host routes are loopback-only; zero telemetry. Note: 0.5.4-0.5.6 had a broken open-in-floater action; 0.5.7 fixes it.
侧边栏浏览器搜索引擎以及书签功能补丁插件（dsh-browser-hub）：给 DSH 自带「浏览器」Tab 增加搜索引擎选择、书签收藏、多级文件夹与导入 360/Chrome 书签 HTML。

对话里的图值得被认真看：点一下全屏灯箱（缩放/拖拽平移/下载另存/左右翻页），一键把会话内的图收成可调列数的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏（不留空白）；本地图 TIFF/HEIC 自动无损转码，网图被防盗链拦截时自动转存本地显示；并内置「图片投递铁律」——强制图片写进回复正文而不是只躺在折叠的工具行里，避免用户误以为没发图。| Chat images get a proper look: full-screen lightbox (zoom / drag pan / download / prev-next), a conversation-wide thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, hide/show without leaving blank space, lossless TIFF/HEIC transcoding, and automatic local fallback for hotlink-protected images — plus a resident delivery rule that forces every image into the reply body instead of a collapsed tool row, so nobody ever wonders whether an image was actually sent.

DSH console sentinel for Windows — one-click cleanup of taskbar windows and empty console shells, plus per-window provenance (parent chain / full command line / script path / start time) so you can see what spawned each console and decide whether to block it. Each row also carries a red parent chip (父：name(pid), or 父：已退出 for orphans whose parent already exited), and a one-click orphan cleanup closes console windows whose parent has exited but which kept running — safe mode never touches mpiexec/fluent/ansys/node compute processes. Graceful WM_CLOSE (= Alt+F4) per window or whole app, UAC-elevated close for admin apps, icon-grid and detail views, preview-before-execute, persistent whitelist, and hard protection for the DSH host and Fluent/MPI solvers. Note: 1.3.4 stops the auto-hide log flood of 1.3.2 and earlier; 1.3.5 fixes a broken console_windows_list tool.

Unofficial DeepSeek Web provider for DeepSeek Harness: use chat.deepseek.com as an LLM source AND embed the DeepSeek web page inside DSH (right sidebar tab or draggable whale floating window) with one-time sign-in shared by the settings page and both panel surfaces. Select conversation text and right-click to copy it straight into the embedded DeepSeek composer. 非官方 DeepSeek 网页端插件：既能把网页端当模型用，也能在 DSH 内嵌网页面板直接对话（侧栏标签页 / 鲸鱼悬浮球），登录一次，设置页与面板共用同一份宿主凭据；选中会话文字右键即可把内容复制到 DeepSeek 网页输入框。仅供个人方便使用，可能存在账号风险，作者不承担责任。
「字」悬浮球 + 字体DIY面板：每区域独立调字体/颜色/字号/粗细/斜体/行高，全局统一、方案管理、8 款可爱字体一键安装、130 款皮肤三球同步。

LobsterAIDaddy — a draggable floating ball for DSH that manages multiple LobsterAI accounts with its own built-in data layer (reads LobsterAI's SQLite directly and calls the official APIs), so no separate desktop console has to be running: the drawer shows the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, then the account list with balances, plan, today's usage, reward details, per-account check-in state and last check-in time, plus four action buttons (check in all, log in a new account without signing out, refresh quota, sync gateway into DSH) and one-click account switching. Also ships a scheduled auto check-in, an account-count badge refreshed every 30s, a resizable persisted drawer, a self-hosted board page, and a follow toggle that keeps the panel with the ball. 把 LobsterAI 多账号管理变成 DSH 界面悬浮球的插件：签到、额度、切号、当前账号显示全部由插件内置实现（直读 SQLite + 直调官方接口），不依赖 LobsterDaddy 控制台常驻；可拖拽摆位并自动记忆，面板可跟随悬浮球移动；点开即显示当前登录账号与账号列表（余额、套餐、今日已用、奖励明细、已签到状态与最近签到时间），顶部四个操作按钮（立即全部签到 / ＋免退出登录新账号 / 刷新额度 / 同步网关到 DSH）加每行切号；内置定时自动签到调度器，悬浮球账号数徽标每 30 秒自动更新，并自带本地看板页。

三级级联模型面板：来源 / 模型 / 强度三列并排，识图与思考强度一键开关，内置「启用智能体团队协作」开关，逐模型真实测活并持久化结果。| A three-column cascade model picker for DSH: provider → model → reasoning effort, one-click image/reasoning switches, a built-in teammate toggle, real per-model availability probes with persisted results.

侧边栏日程中心（dsh-better-sidebar companion）：今日一屏（多城市天气按 8:30/12:00/17:30 定点刷新 + 黄历 + 可折叠星座运势）、农历月历、日程与待办、日报周报与签到、按人设置班制与上下班倒计时；多账号邮件客户端（IMAP 收信 + SMTP 发信，附件收发、群发、草稿箱、收藏/垃圾/垃圾箱/已读未读）；久坐 / 喝水 / 护眼 / 听音乐提醒弹面板内胶囊（停留秒数与位置可调）并可同时推 Windows 通知；壁纸轮播（顺序或随机洗牌、透明度与磨砂）与界面文字颜色可调。数据只存本机。

Unified audio + video player for dsh-better-sidebar: one file viewer for mp4/webm/mov/m4v/ogv and mp3/wav/flac/ogg/opus/m4a/aac, with a draggable whole-track scrubber, live spectrum bars and pitch (Hz + note name), streamed from a Range(206) host route so seeking really works. Note: the current 0.2.x build still has a number of known bugs and is being reworked.

技能浏览器：悬浮球打开面板，把本机技能库变成可浏览、可检索、可治理的资产——五个 Tab（技能浏览/调用台账/MCP 管理/市场/快速上手）、树状/平铺双视图、手动+关键词+AI 三种分组（分组只改视图不动技能文件）、调用台账看板（调用次数/成功率/趋势图/技能调用排行）、130 款三球同步皮肤（6 列宽屏菜单）、9 步快速上手、MCP 管理（读取运行时 MCP 配置、真实连接状态、工具清单与自动功能概括、调用统计落盘、启停即时跟随/重连/卸载/导出标准 mcpServers JSON、重绘不跳顶且面板记忆上次滚动位置、卡片每行列数技能 3~6 / MCP 3~5）、DSH 设置页悬浮球导航分区（「作者插件/插件版本」两块切换 + 15 行插件版本一键检查全部）；一键热重载，技能库位置可配置，悬浮球可拖拽可复位、市场（MCP 市场：官方 Registry + 29 条精选免费目录、19 大类平铺分类带每类数量、网格/列表双模式、卡片逐字复刻技能卡、每条 MCP 用其自身真实图标并自动降级、一键安装写入 cordis.patch.yml 并自动备份、一键卸载、仅免费筛选、24 小时磁盘缓存、与 MCP 页双向即时同步）。

DSH todo 悬浮球：常驻可拖动悬浮球实时显示当前会话 todo_write 任务清单进度（完成数/总数/进行中任务名），带百分比进度环；Shadow DOM 样式隔离，点击折叠/展开完整清单，右键胶囊模式；状态颜色（待办蓝/进行中橙脉动/完成绿）。数据双路同步：权威会话投影帧为主 + MutationObserver 抓官方 todo 面板为辅，旧计划自动归档为历史不会被误算进进度。可固定多会话并排查看，130 款共享皮肤（8 组：官方主题 / 浓郁深底 / 尘埃灰调 / 招牌特效 / 浅色纸面 / 柔光深底 / 中性点缀 / 克制精选 + 随系统深浅自动）。宿主端每轮注入 todo 纪律并硬性要求首个工具调用为 todo_write。双端可用（Desktop 桌面端 + Web 网页端）。零遥测，仅一条本机回环健康路由。

让 DSH 干完活会开口说话：回合结束自动播报「完成 / 失败」，零配置内置 20 个音效（无需 API Key），也可使用在火山引擎「声音复刻」克隆好的音色 ID（插件不提供录音与训练，只负责播放）。另有第三个「审批」音效槽位，但只能手动触发（/dsh-voice-alert/play?kind=approval），不会自动播报。| Make DSH speak when the job is done: automatic voice/sound alerts for done and failed turns, 20 built-in sounds with zero config, or a voice ID you cloned on Volcengine Voice Cloning (this plugin does not record or train — it only plays). A third approval slot exists but is manual-only (/dsh-voice-alert/play?kind=approval) — nothing fires it automatically.
A draggable to-do note on every session: short-term tasks, long-term plan progress, and a live prompt snapshot so the agent stops re-reading context.

DeepSeek Harness bundle: 象棋对弈助手 / Xiangqi Mate — a human-vs-AI Chinese Chess plugin. Open the panel and a minimal board appears; you play Red, the model configured in your DSH session plays Black. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step for the host half.

DSH 插件市场：浏览官方与社区插件，装之前先给出兼容性结论，一键交给官方安装管线。Plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: browse official and community DSH plugins with a compatibility verdict, and install them through the official plugin manager.

Layered, auto-injected cross-session memory for AI coding agents: a DSH plugin plus a standalone zero-dependency CLI. Borrows the spec/change/archive discipline from OpenSpec (MIT), but pushes instead of pulls.
Context-aware composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness, with draft completion, prompt polishing, per-session suggestions and stale-response protection.
Vietnamese language pack for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with full coverage across 50 core namespaces.
Paste images / drag any files into the DSH composer -> saved into the session workspace as files -> images read by modlens, other files read by the model by path
Read-only panel showing the network destinations the Harness host process sends data to, with trust tiers, explainable suspicion marks and blocked calls.
Neo-brutalist comic sticker skin for DeepSeek Harness: ink outlines, hard offset shadows, halftone paper and sticker controls.

webCandidates.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件「公众号成稿台」：写稿、按段改稿、朱雀报告质检、公众号排版预览和一键复制。
VisionForge: vision understanding + image generation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Create and manage standalone DSH sessions that are not attached to any workspace.
书架阅读器：扫描本地 EPUB / TXT / PDF / DOCX 文档建立本地书架，并在 Harness 面板中离线阅读。
Live2D 看板娘插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 可拖动的 Live2D 模型，支持 DSH 状态驱动动画、本地模型导入和完整配置页。
DSH plugin: GDScript syntax highlighting for dsh-better-sidebar CodeMirror editor
DeepSeek Harness web plugin: settings pages for managing user skills and MCP servers
让推理模型专注干活，让交付内容好好说人话。写入标记、PROSE 规则集、旁路审查、延迟润色。
DeepSeek account balance dashboard for dsh web: shows your DeepSeek API balance above the chat window, auto-refreshed.

Glassmorphism UI theme for DeepSeek Harness web: frosted-glass surfaces, adjustable opacity/blur, custom fonts, background images & live video wallpapers with carousel, NetEase Cloud Music player with dock lyrics, custom CSS and soft animations. DSH Web 毛玻璃 UI 主题：可调透明度/模糊、自定义字体、背景图与动态壁纸（多图轮播）、网易云音乐播放与歌词、自定义 CSS、柔和动画。
DSH 侧边栏工作区按身份上色（OKLCH 生成、自动避开背景色相），当前对话标题与运行中圆环标红，自带可视化设置面板。
人脑式上下文压缩逻辑 — DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩统一协同层: 集成 dsh-argp / dsh-compaction-instant / dsh-headroom / dsh-sgme / dsh-memory-vault / dsh-mcp-lens / dsh-context-doctor，提供统一配置、工具协调与验证机制。适配 DSH 0.1.5。
DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件：在设置面板为 llm-pi-ai 提供方按模型配置思考开关/思考等级（reasoningEfforts），为官方 DeepSeek 配置思考开关（thinking）与思考等级（reasoningEffort），并为各提供方模型配置输入类型（llm-pi-ai 写 input、官方 DeepSeek 写 inputModalities）。
DeepSeek Harness 计划评审增强插件：评审弹窗内直接输入意见继续对话修改计划；输入行提供「查看计划」按钮与浮层，浮层支持直接编辑计划内容并留档。

DSH web plugin: a hierarchical workspace tree for the sidebar with browser-style session tabs, time-bucket sorting and session pinning. Workspace titles containing "/" group into virtual folders (web/前端 · web/后端); sessions open in replaceable tabs (Shift+click for a new one, drag to reorder), sort by recency buckets (today/yesterday/7d/30d/earlier) or pin to the top of the sidebar.
Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: after a turn settles, the empty composer shows a dimmed suggestion of your next message; Tab accepts it.
Customize the DeepSeek Harness UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page with a live preview — 在设置页自定义界面中英文/代码字体与全局字号偏移，实时预览、全局生效。
PromptX for DeepSeek Harness: a global-hotkey prompt editor that floats above every app, with a Markdown prompt library and model-assisted rewriting.
dsh bundle plugin: grok2api image & video generation tools plus image recognition (generate_image / generate_video / recognize_image) for the DeepSeek Harness

Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation, order/random playlists and a fullscreen wallpaper.
DSH desktop notifications that name the project, with a soft phone-style bing and a warm, selectable sound pack.
Local memory and skill evolution for DeepSeek Harness
DSH 屏幕截图插件：聊天输入框的相机按钮 + Agent 可调用的 screenshot 工具（框选区域 / 指定窗口 / 整屏）。截图直接进入对话，并保存到工作区。
Windows desktop notifications, sounds, and DSH-styled in-app notification cards for DeepSeek Harness
DSH-styled three-column workspace with file editing, Markdown preview, Git controls, terminals, and native conversation

DSH 会话自动命名：全消息 LLM 总结标题（首条提示词/handoff 自动 + 会话头按钮/命令手动），标题调用强制关思考（0.2.0 设置模型下思考接线自补齐），标题语言与最大字节数可设置。适配 DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2（会话格式 v4；更早版本请用 0.2.3）。
COROS Sport panel for DeepSeek Harness: sign in to COROS inside the app, read your devices, workouts and health, and create a four-week training plan after an explicit confirmation.

Shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates. · 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前峰谷时段，并按官方高峰/空闲价估算每个会话与每一轮的花费。

Export every conversation to a folder you pick (OneDrive works) and import it back on another machine, with a per-session picker, an overwrite switch and a confirm dialog. · 一键把对话导出到你指定的目录（OneDrive 也行），换台电脑再一键导回来；支持逐个会话挑选、覆盖开关和确认弹窗。

Codex-style conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: a floating panel listing every user question in the current conversation with search, load-older and click-to-jump (scroll + highlight). Bilingual zh-CN / en.
ChatGPT-style text selection helper for DeepSeek Harness: select text in a conversation and a floating 「询问 DeepSeek」 button appears; click it to quote the selection into the composer.

Delete a conversation from the DSH sidebar instead of only archiving it, and see the whole family it spawned — every subagent session and derived conversation, nested — before choosing which of them go with it; delete many at once from the trash icon beside the workspace search, aligned with the icons around it and visible under every dsh-claude-style search style. / 在会话菜单里真正删除对话；确认框会把整个家族（子智能体、派生对话及其下一层）按层级画出来，删之前先看得见，并可勾选连带删除哪些；工作区搜索图标左侧另有批量删除入口（兼容 dsh-claude-style 主题的搜索框样式三档，图标自动对齐相邻图标）。
AI查余额 — a balance-checking tool and per-turn balance-aware power-saving policy for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH 换肤插件：10 套预设皮肤 + 自然语言换肤 + 自定义背景图片 + 界面控件联动 + 恢复默认，设置 → 通用 →「皮肤」行内切换，settings.yaml 跨设备同步。
Review agent-produced file changes (line-level red/green diff + undo) both as a chat turn-tail row and as a dsh-better-sidebar tab; a port of left0ver's dsh-file-review.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: control which models appear in the model selector — per-model switches, provider-level batch toggles, and search. Hiding a model never touches your provider config or running sessions.

Multi-entry web search hub for DeepSeek Harness: route ctx.web search through configurable model entries (DeepSeek official, GLM Coding Plan Zhipu web_search, future Kimi) with exactly one active entry; ships a Settings page tab for management.

DSH web plugin: shows the current session's DeepSeek API cost as a small chip in the composer button row (conversation.input.right). Prices every assistant/message by its timestamp with the official DeepSeek pricing table, including the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy.
Arknights theme skin for DSH Desktop (DeepSeek Harness)
DeepSeek Harness 皮肤大师：主题壁纸/自定义皮肤插件 —— 全局背景图片/视频、毛玻璃、输入框背景、弹出框毛玻璃、滤镜、AI 回复文本与消息气泡颜色

DSH bundle (组合包): read-only project knowledge graph — modules, tech stack, architecture layers, file-level import graphs, observations. Provides /kgraph command, project_kgraph model tool and a browser UI panel.
会话自动唤醒：给任意会话设一条唤醒规则，宿主轮询其最新一轮状态并在满足条件时通过 sessionController.prompt 真正叫醒它继续干活。
Embed the desktop DSH UI inside DSHA's WebView instead of handing it to the system browser: a loopback reverse proxy on the phone plus an iframe shell page.

Born for dsh-desktop-link: that plugin carries you from DSHA on the phone into the desktop DSH; this one makes that desktop UI usable with a thumb — 40px touch targets, 16px body text, no page-level horizontal scroll, and a focused field that scrolls back above the soft keyboard. Active only on (max-width:1023px) and (pointer:coarse), a complete no-op on desktop.
DSH sidebar button: open the desktop DSH Web GUI from DSHA on your phone, in one tap.

DSH 插件管理：所有插件一屏看完，一个开关直接开关，更新完自动热替换不用重启。/ Plugin rack for DSH: every plugin in one list with a power switch, an auto/manual flag that scopes the one-click bulk actions, and hot-swapped updates that need no restart.
DSH 插件：京东沙发商品自动采集、详情图核对与产品规格卡（PNG + 可编辑 PPTX）归档
DSH client plugin: the ArtCraft live-preview panel inside the DSH Web GUI (layer C of docs/PREVIEW.md).
Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client, editable live from a settings card
DeepSeek Harness Web overlay: hide chrome, dock the composer, filter transcript kinds, and drive sidebar/details occupancy
DSH 工程面板：把低代码工程目录树搬进 web 端 —— 左栏常驻图标 + 中栏工程浏览器（多级文件树 / 推送状态 / 文件内容）。

DSH Research OS — a fully automated scientific research plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): survey, idea, experiment contract, durable runner jobs, claim-evidence ledger, manuscript and release bundle.
Adjustable opacity for DeepSeek Harness popup menus and the session header.
A third-party Dracula dark theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

Big Fat Fish clean — an unofficial graphical panel for the locally installed Mole CLI (tw93/Mole): live system health, cleanup previews with explicit confirmation, disk analysis, app inventory, maintenance, cleanup history and a guided Mole CLI install. Not affiliated with the Mole project; no Mole code or assets are bundled.
Full-screen cinematic boot video for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: plays once per app start, skippable, and compatible with the wallpaper plugin.
Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the dsh web sidebar, kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.
dsh-purge 优化版（衍生分支）：在上游 1.1.90 基础上恢复技能库 23 个技能、POC/EXP 知识库与本地靶场白名单，并补齐 nuclei 模板类目筛选与翻页。Derivative branch of dsh-purge — restores the skill library, knowledge base and local-lab allowlist.
Linux lab box cockpit for DSH: manage ssh tunnels, spot orphan listeners, discover remote services.

Prompt enhancement for the dsh web GUI: rewrite the composer draft into a well-structured prompt through the harness LLM service, preview the before/after, then fill back, copy, or undo. Original draft is always preserved.

Workspace file explorer docked in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: a lazy directory tree of the current session's working directory, a Settings on/off switch, and drag-to-resize.
让 DSH 在长工具链执行中途输出可见进度说明（system prompt 规则 + 步骤级注入提醒 + 控制面板）

Browser: per-session isolated Playwright browser for DSH with a live tab panel, sidebar section, per-site proxy and DevTools-grade tooling.
Single-choice board in the chat: pick one of several answers, images or sounds with a click

DeepSeek peak hours, live token prices, session spend and a spending analytics page, for the official provider.
Restart DeepSeek Harness from the sidebar or from an agent tool, optionally continuing the same session afterwards.

/alias add|remove|list for DeepSeek Harness: define your own slash commands, persisted in settings, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.

chatjimmy.ai provider adapter for DeepSeek Harness (text-only route, 6144-token context)
Feynman-style research workflows for DeepSeek Harness behind one /feynman command (deepresearch, review, audit, review-loop, …)

/loop <rounds> <command> for DeepSeek Harness: repeat a command across agent turns; 0 loops forever, /loop stop ends it.
OmniRoute provider surface for DeepSeek Harness: query its live model catalog, its connections, and the quota each upstream connection reports.
Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode, for DeepSeek Harness: bundled skills, an always-on anti-over-engineering ruleset, and a Plugin configuration card.
Quota and API-balance readout for the selected provider, in the DeepSeek Harness composer statusbar.
Browser-style restore bar for DeepSeek Harness: after a reboot or crash, resume goals and continue every session that was mid-flight.
Windows 2000 theme for DeepSeek Harness: a ctx.theme token layer, a cube under the Appearance row in Settings → General, and period chrome for the parts a token cannot spell.
「哨兵 / Sentinel」：任意工作区/会话需要确认时，在 DSH 右下角逐条提醒，可配置弹出动画与提示音；点击去处理后左下角反馈“正在处理”。只提醒，绝不替你做决定。

Inherit a long DeepSeek Harness session into a clean one: adds an "Inherit" row to the session "..." menu, mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent tool failures, commands, todos) from the source session log without calling an LLM, creates a brand-new session in the same workspace and sends that handoff as its first message. The source session's agent preset is inherited by default.

Conversation-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness: plays a short synthesized sound when a user-initiated task actually finishes — not when it is interrupted — with a settings panel for voice and volume, plus an optional Windows taskbar unread-count badge.
DeepSeek Harness 跨会话总控插件（御书房）：白名单冷热采集、可追溯摘要与修订、只读首辅及受控任务调度（Fail-Closed）。
Codex-style global Enter for DeepSeek Harness: approve a pending authorization request without moving focus into the prompt first.
DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆与自进化插件：L0 对话捕获 → L1 记忆提取 → L2 场景归纳 → L3 用户画像，自动召回注入 + 技能合成，纯本地。
Conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness, backed by your local ComfyUI.

DeepSeek Harness network-proxy plugin: route the agent's own network requests (web_search / web_fetch / external APIs) through a configured HTTP/HTTPS-CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy — both the global fetch wrapper and the harness proxy layer that web_fetch actually uses — with in-memory traffic logging (previews, counts, byte totals) and a settings UI.
枝条笔记：嵌在 DeepSeek Harness 里的剧本枝条笔记，AI 直接使用 Harness 内置模型（无需填写 API Key）
Hash-anchored UTF-8 file reading and atomic editing tools for DeepSeek Harness
综合性增强插件：界面优化、布局调整与提示词注入等更多功能。A comprehensive enhancement plugin with UI polish, layout tweaks, prompt injection, and more.

Rich-text notes with images, links, symbols, categories, backgrounds and export.
把「得到大脑（Get笔记）」搬进 DeepSeek Harness：本地优先的 Markdown 笔记库面板，左侧栏入口 + 中央面板，浏览/搜索/编辑/新建/删除全部离线可用；云端同步是一次性可选的增强（OAuth 登录后拉起全部笔记落成本地 Markdown）。Local-first Get笔记 (biji.com) vault panel for DeepSeek Harness.
Five switchable interface skins for DeepSeek Harness, each with its own animated boot sequence and sound design.
Automatically load the full conversation history when a session opens — no more clicking "Load earlier".

DSH web UI plugin: a session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px) by overriding the chat content-width CSS variables, so the chat column, composer, and user bubbles all widen together.
本地长期日程管理插件:better-sidebar 侧边卡片「日程」tab(今天/本周/历史月历统计)、行内编辑与详情视图、日程-会话链接跳转、完成打勾、重复日程、一次性日程可选自动顺延、agent 工具。数据长期保存在本地文件。

DeepSeek balance floating widget for the dsh web GUI: a small overlay window pinned bottom-left showing the account balance from the official API, with a collapse chip and 5-minute auto refresh.

模型选择 + 推理强度滑块 + 可选提供商开关：模型保持下拉菜单，推理强度改为 Claude 风格滑块，最高档可选四种动画（喷射流光 / 暗流涌动 / 流体 / 晚霞，后两者每次打开浮层随机重掷；晚霞配色采自参考图）；设置-模型 底部多一个「可选提供商」面板，逐个启用/停用模型提供商（提供商配置原样保留）。已适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 与 0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2（plugins.item / configForms / settings.models.footer）。
OpenCode Go subscription quota widget for the dsh web GUI: a floating window showing rolling/weekly/monthly usage with progress bars, refreshed every 5 minutes.

Calendar todo plugin for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a week/month calendar where you drag-select time ranges to create tasks, with Eisenhower urgency/importance quadrants, subtasks, pinned execution session + LLM provider, and host-authoritative scheduling — constrained daily/weekly repeats copied onto their dates (optional holiday skip) plus one-off auto runs through real dsh sessions. Host-authoritative ledger + scheduler; browser is a same-origin async view. Mounted via dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.

DeepSeek Harness 计费插件:持久化账本精确计费(每次模型调用)、官方余额、预算、今日/本月/累计汇总、会话明细与历史记录、峰谷计价、官方价格同步,界面中英双语。Billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persistent ledger with exact per-call cost, official balance, budget, today/month/total summaries, per-session details and history, peak/off-peak pricing, official price sync — bilingual (zh/en).

Import sessions from a local Hermes Agent into the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as bounded, untrusted background context.
