Minecraft (Paper) server manager for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar panel, process control, plugins, worlds and backups, server.properties and gamerules, plus agent tools.
Group the DeepSeek Harness plugin inventory into official vs user-installed plugins, so user-installed plugins stay easy to find and control
Permanently delete DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces - real disk deletion instead of unregistering, with a session-menu entry and /purge command.
在 dsh 中编辑 ComfyUI 工作流、实时预览，并让 AI 操作当前节点图。
会话成本预估：在输入框上方显示下一步与本轮的大致花费
Template-driven conversation statistics row for DeepSeek Harness (${variable} placeholders, shadows the shipped stats line)

Cross-platform computer use for DeepSeek Harness with the Cua Driver core bundled: window-scoped capture, mutation approval, screenshot cleanup, a visible focus cursor, and a settings page under Settings, and an install self-check that names the folder to delete when a stale install breaks dependency resolution.
Session-scoped checklists for DeepSeek Harness: the agent tracks work as a tree, the model always sees a compact digest, and a read-only sidebar tab mirrors it.

DSH Metafolder Plugin — visual meta-folders for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspaces: nest real workspace folders under named, collapsible groups, by drag and drop or the row menu. Paths, permissions, sessions and workspace ordering are untouched.

Searchable, curated composer model picker for DeepSeek Harness: live model search, a Model Picker Augmented settings page to show/hide and pin models, and a Refresh providers button that syncs the running harness with settings.yaml (no restart) and auto-discovers newly declared provider models from their endpoints.
Local prompt library editor for DeepSeek Harness, with standalone SQLite storage or an existing Augmentor service
Fixed rail of conversation landmarks with hover previews and click-to-jump navigation for DeepSeek Harness Web
Margin notes for DSH: select text in a document or an assistant reply, jot a note in the margin, collect them, then send the whole batch into the composer at once.
DSH Background: upload photo/GIF wallpapers, pick which images join the carousel, and tune glassmorphism, typography, accent colors, aurora, and portable themes for the DSH Web GUI
Adds an account-balance pill to the DSH conversation composer dock: wallet balance, this session's spend, and this turn's estimated spend. Click it for the breakdown.
Skin switcher + custom wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness: curated --dsw-alias-* palettes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur controls, and durable per-user persistence (like Codex themes)
Expert Center for DeepSeek Harness: 20 software-engineering experts plus 5 fixed expert teams, each with a preset lead, independent child experts, skills, tools and plan mode.
Skills button for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: browse the session skill catalog with Chinese descriptions, search, keyboard navigation and recent picks.
Shows CPU temperature readings from supported platform sensors or an external snapshot in the DSH composer.
CalibGuard file-security auditing for DeepSeek Harness: a locally calibrated CodeBERT gate exposed as agent tools, with on-demand cloud LLM review of the gray zone.
PC Manager (电脑管家) — system status monitoring (model tools + right-sidebar dashboard), junk cleanup, and app uninstall for DeepSeek Harness
PlantOmics Hub：把国内植物组学数据库的公开接口聚合成一套工具，一次维护、两个出口：stdio MCP server（Claude Code / Codex / Reasonix 可用）与 DSH 原生插件。
DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：App Store 风格设置页，探针 GitHub dsh-plugin 生态、dsh.do 与社区雷达仓库，按 star/实用度/分类浏览，支持手动/自动刷新。
把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 DSH 界面背后：场景/视频/网页/图片四类壁纸，液态玻璃外观、音频可视化、遮挡省电、费用显示。
Build trustworthy ontologies from data, documents and code — a Palantir-style ontology builder plugin for DeepSeek Harness
AI-generated session titles for DeepSeek Harness: one-click generation inside the session rename dialog.
内置网关自动接入 Tabbit 国内版与国际版：账号登录与导入、多账号池、周期额度、模型用量倍率、每日签到和工具调用。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: one hub for AI coding providers — account login, multi-account pools, silent credential refresh, credit claiming, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway
豆包式语音对话客户端插件：麦克风按钮→语音转文字发送→回复自动朗读（支持 Edge TTS / MiMo TTS / 自定义 TTS）。
Local-first usage insights for DeepSeek Harness
Windows native notifications for DeepSeek Harness

Windows 桌面端专用，没有网页端那一半。在屏幕角落弹出通知卡：任务跑完、等你审批、等你回答的时候提醒你一下。跟随系统深浅色与 DPI，落在鼠标那块屏幕，只有黑底白字和白底黑字两套配色，文字按亮度抗锯齿绘制，不抢焦点。Windows desktop only, no web build: a notice card that appears in a corner of the monitor under your pointer when a turn ends, or when DSH is waiting for an approval or an answer. Follows the system theme and DPI, ships two monochrome palettes (white on black, black on white), draws text with brightness-only anti-aliasing, and never takes focus.
提示词增强：把输入框里的草稿一键改写成更完整、更可执行的提示词，可撤销
DSH 定时任务插件：规则存为 Cron 表达式，由系统 cron（用户 crontab）在进程外执行 headless 任务，Web 端负责规则管理、部署与结果归类。
Independent literature library with portable PDF annotations for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness 待办清单插件：列表 / Markdown 双视图，新建时自动补齐创建时间、提醒时间与提醒模式。
DeepSeek Harness 谷价调度插件：谷价时段自动发送排队指令，支持新建/历史会话、模型与权限选择、峰谷定价、余额告警、记账本与中英双语
DSH 侧边栏「稍后再看」中心：分类、打分、时效性提醒，统一收进转发的图片/文章/链接/剧集，并同步 B站与抖音稍后再看
Codex-style selection quote annotations for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Watch unattended DeepSeek Harness sessions: session numbers, a pending-answer seat for decision cards, and a pluggable judge that answers mid-session questions or hands them to a human.
DSH web theme that recreates NieR:Automata's YoRHa UI — beige palette, grid texture, CRT FX, wipe-fill hover, and staff-line ornaments.

DSH 上的类 VSCode 编码体验：Monaco 编辑器（文件页签/QuickOpen/状态栏，可驻 DSH 0.1.5+ 官方右侧 Sidebar 与对话同屏）+ 命令栏（Ctrl+Shift+P）与可扩展指令系统 + VS Code 兼容代码片段（.code-snippets 全局/项目，IntelliSense 展开）+ Agent 编辑差异审查（整文件差异/采纳/拒绝/归档/回滚）+ SVN 集成（侧栏变更面板/日志弹窗/并排差异）+ 语言服务器（LSP）智能（跳转定义/引用/hover/大纲 + VSIX 扩展市场安装），状态持久化到工作区旁车，界面状态（页签/光标/侧栏/编辑 Tab/导航历史）镜像到 DSH home 跨重启恢复
DSH 产出总览插件：统计 DSH 生成的代码行数、文档数、采纳率与成本，Web 面板展示。Output statistics for DeepSeek Harness: generated code lines, docs, adoption rates, and cost.
Cybernetic work protocol for DSH: the session goal (dsh-goal) driven loop of task -> verify -> triage agents, implicitly advanced via one workflow run per round. Server plugin + client goal tab.

DSH service farm: register, start, stop, restart and watch long-running project services. Left-sidebar entry + overview drawer (per-workspace groups, live log follow, search, export); farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register tools for the agent; optional farm.yaml declaration per workspace.

Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session's log, export it, fork a session at a turn boundary, or forward a selected portion into another session (or a brand-new one) as a self-contained graft message. Agent tools: graft_sessions/graft_search/graft_read/graft_export/graft_fork/graft_forward.
Third-party dsh web plugin: a rich Markdown notebook for the composer region — tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service
Right-click (⋯) any conversation in DSH and permanently delete it — log, projection cache, and workspace entry.

webCandidates.description: DSH Coding Workbench: a full-screen VS Code-style AI coding IDE for DeepSeek Harness — explorer, editor (CodeMirror), diff review, git, PTY terminal, background tasks, problems, and an AI propose-change approval loop.

DeepSeek Harness desktop hub — Tauri 2.x shell + dsh web plugin layer. This npm package ships the plugin half (client UI + HTTP routes + cordis.patch.yml); the desktop shell ships as the NSIS installer (see build/).

DeepSeek Harness desktop hub — Tauri 2.x shell + dsh web plugin layer. This npm package ships the plugin half (client UI + HTTP routes + cordis.patch.yml); the desktop shell ships as the NSIS installer (see build/).

Settings-page editor for DeepSeek Harness workspace instruction files: the user-global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md, project-chain AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files, and AGENTS.local.md/CLAUDE.local.md overlays, with byte-budget display and new-session hints.

Text-to-speech (TTS) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — Fish Audio API only, bring your own key. Per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle in the composer, an agent-callable audio-generation tool for chat channels, settings for model / voice / encrypted API key / proxy. Third-party, not affiliated with Fish Audio.
Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin: Grok OAuth, fused web/X search, Imagine image generation and editing, experimental video generation, and session media cards.
Second Look (过目): per-session routine and enhanced review for DeepSeek Harness.
Unofficial ServerChan watchdog for DeepSeek Harness: send a mobile notification when an approval, plan review, or question remains unanswered.

Named subagent library for DeepSeek Harness: a directory-backed roster with model, role prompt, depth and background-mode settings, exposed through list_subagents, delegate, a /subagent command and a Settings page.
Use a neutral introduction instead of the default DeepSeek Harness prompt for selected models.
dsh LAN/public reverse proxy plugin: IP whitelist, one-time login codes, device management, access log. Runs inside the dsh process; dual-stack IPv4/IPv6.
VulnClaw + DeepSec 桥接插件：AI 安全 CLI（授权渗透测试 / Shield 代码审计）→ dsh 工具 + 设置页安全工具台 UI

Expert Orchestrator — multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): triage → PM planning → delegate implementation to domain experts via a merged roster (summon_expert), dependency-DAG taskboard, file message bus, tiered delivery gates, experience pooling. 专家编排模式：多智能体任务编排，分诊、PM 先行规划、专家委派、依赖 DAG 任务板、消息总线并行落盘、分级交付门禁、经验池沉淀。
给 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）加 QQ 机器人通道：OneBot 11 协议，兼容 NapCat，支持私聊群聊、图片语音、t2i 卡片与设置页配置。QQ bot channel plugin for deepseek harness via OneBot 11.
DSH better-sidebar Source Control tab that mirrors VS Code Git workflows.
DSH「翻译」面板：丢入电子版 PDF，翻成中文并**保留原版式**（字号/配色/页眉页脚/公式编号按原件量出后重排），产出中文 PDF 与 md。 / Translate a text-layer PDF into Chinese while preserving the original layout.
DSH「日程」面板：左侧栏日历 + schedule 工具，共用同一份数据（宿主 Typert Remote 服务 + 客户端 ctx.remote）
DSH 窗口置顶：把桌面应用窗口固定在最前面（Win32 SetWindowPos / WS_EX_TOPMOST）。左侧栏底栏一个图钉按钮，另提供 window_pin 模型工具。 / Pin the DeepSeek Harness desktop window always-on-top, toggled from a sidebar pin button.

Multi-provider quota monitor for DeepSeek Harness: balance type (query + JS parser) and window type (local sliding-window metering), with Command Code and Cline support, a compact/expandable sidebar panel with a hover detail popper, a per-request latency matrix, live spend animation and refresh progress. Sidebar widget + Plugins page.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: your DeepSeek API balance and the current peak/off-peak billing window, below the message input.
ChatGPT-style regenerate for DeepSeek Harness: fork the turn and re-run the same prompt — including turns whose generation failed.

DSH Web GUI 的普通对话插件：独立侧边栏「对话」入口，不绑工作区、不带工具，直接复用 DSH 现有 ctx.llm 模型路由（支持切换已导入的任意 provider/model，流式输出），多会话历史持久化到 ~/.dsh/dsh-chat.json。热插拔 —— 通过 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml + node_modules symlink 挂载，不改 DSH 源码。
Composer button for DeepSeek Harness that rewrites the draft into a sharper prompt and shows the result beside your text before anything is replaced.
财搭子研究看板：存储、AI基建、PCB/CCL及美国政策与数据中心，接入财搭子 MCP。

Heat marks that make the sessions and workspaces with the most recent conversations obvious: a sidebar entry, a heat dot before each session title and a hover-card heat section. | 会话热度：用热度标识最近发生过对话的会话与工作区。
One-click DSH background switcher backed by local Wallpaper Engine images/videos (WE Web API first, Steam workshop/myprojects directory scan fallback)
Permanently delete a chat from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: log and cache removed, no archive copy left behind.
Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for Command Code, ported from pi-commandcode-provider (MIT). Registers the 'commandcode' provider route with a Models-page card and live model catalog.
DeepPilot companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness: use DSH from a native iPhone app over an authenticated, direct connection to your own computer.

DeepSeek Harness session batch manager —— sidebar multi-select, batch archive / unarchive / delete, and session management dashboard with token usage, cache and context pressure visualization. | DSH 会话批量管理——侧栏多选、批量归档/恢复/删除，以及会话管理面板（token 消耗、缓存、上下文占比可视化）。

webCandidates.description: Theme Studio for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: edit the design tokens the client paints with (alias colors, component fills, static palette, typography) per light/dark scheme, with presets, a movable editor panel and custom CSS.
Turn navigation rail with prompt summaries, right-click renaming, latest-turn following, and large/original mark sizing.

Provider badge icon beside the composer model selector: DeepSeek whale SVG, bold GO/ZEN wordmarks for OpenCode Go/Zen, blocky initials otherwise. Client-only DSH plugin. · DSH 客户端插件：在模型选择器旁显示当前 provider 图标（DeepSeek 鲸鱼 / OpenCode GO·ZEN 字标）。

Configure the default provider, model and reasoning effort for new subagents from the Web settings page; optionally apply changes to existing idle subagents. · DSH 插件：在设置页可视化配置 subagent 默认的提供商、模型与思考等级，新创建的 subagent 立即生效，可选的让空闲 subagent 也跟随新设置。
Tag-based long-term memory for DSH agents.
面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：共度时光（自动蒸馏的经过，会随时间衰减）、情感日记（手写感受，不衰减）、人格手记（每轮全量注入）、浅层记忆（7 天 TTL）与人设卡（带版本历史）共用一份 token 预算，配召回、体检、压缩与整包备份还原。一个包全管。
Hot-disposable realtime voice Agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness WebUI and future WeChat Mini Program clients
连接微信小程序，随时与电脑上的助手协作。

Martin's self-contained two-way voice plugin for the DSH web app: unified voice composer in, per-message speaker buttons and auto-read out (own TTS server), plus the speech-to-text wiring. Forked from @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-voice-input 0.1.7-rc.2 and maintained here as a standalone plugin.
Explain what a pending dsh approval will actually do, with one LLM call: an Explain button beside Allow/Reject plus the Host /explain command behind it

Host fix for the Windows workspace-open action: open the workspace directory with explorer.exe /e,<dir>, because the shipped explorer.exe <file:// URI> invocation reports success without raising a window on some hosts
Review a file, a folder or a web page in the Plannotator browser UI from DeepSeek Harness, and get the annotations back as a message.
RGB effects for DeepSeek Harness: composer ring, sidebar rail, session indicator, and glowing brand logo.
Advanced per-model reasoning and capacity settings for DeepSeek Harness
动态舒尔特方格 · dsh 等待时间小游戏（浏览器端插件）
DSH plugin marketplace: sidebar catalog tab + agent tools (mp_search, mp_similar, mp_details, mp_install, mp_trending) over dsh-plugins-mp.com
Mobile adaptation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: phone layout, overlay sidebar drawer, bottom navigation and a manual Desktop/Mobile switch.
Official-seam privacy masking for DeepSeek Harness: toggleable secret/PII masking, a reversible vault, and safe execution tools.
SSH host panel for DeepSeek Harness: manage hosts (key or password) in Settings and let the agent use them through ssh_list / ssh_exec.
Git workflow for DeepSeek Harness: confirmed Web Git actions, slash commands and read-only tools
Permanently delete a single session from the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar - one extra entry in the official session context menu, with zero plugin-row takeover.
Adds a search box to the 'Fetch available models' candidate dialog in DSH Settings — pure browser-side DOM enhancement, no component modification. 为「设置→模型→获取可用模型」候选弹窗增加搜索过滤，纯浏览器半增强，不改任何组件代码。
用户消息超过 10 行自动折叠（DSH 0.2.2+），只接管文本节点，保留官方消息行与操作按钮，兼容 dsh-rewind 等行装饰插件，支持 HMR 热重载
Model availability tester panel in the Models settings page: one-click real streaming test per added model with TPS / first-token / elapsed metrics
将 Qoder（国内版 / 国际版）的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring Qoder (CN & international) models into DeepSeek Harness.
Inject a user-configured custom prompt at the very top of every session's system prompt; editable live from the web settings page
DSH web plugin: 让侧边栏按窗口「比例」打开（左侧栏 14% 起，右侧栏可选），拖原生把手/快捷键直接调，比例存 localStorage；并让子代理会话继承父会话的右侧栏标签。不改 DSH 源码。
回合完成时向 webhook 发送通知，支持 GET/POST、自定义字段、请求头、发送日志
DSH plugin: remember the last used workspace directory for the Add-workspace flow (prefill + auto-memory over the official browse dialog)
Human-and-agent control plane for DeepSeek Harness — visualize live wiring, trace activity, and safely automate plugin blueprints.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) IM gateway plugin: foolproof multi-channel (5G消息 / email / feishu / wechat / qq / http) -> per-chat persistent Agent -> reply routing.
Cyber IT Department — a pixel-office view of DSH Agent Teams with snapshot + command routes.
DSH 提示词库插件：集中管理提示词（增删改查、标签分类、导入导出、AI 优化），聊天快捷收录与调用。 DSH Prompt Library plugin: manage prompts (CRUD, tags, import/export, AI polish), quick capture & reuse in chat.
把 QQ 官方机器人（Webhook 回调）接入本机 DeepSeek Harness：QQ 群/单聊消息（含群全量消息上下文）→ DSH 会话 → 回复发回 QQ，支持被动回复与群主动消息。Connect the official QQ bot (webhook callback) to a local DeepSeek Harness.
一个让 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 能够进行结构生物学信息分析、展示的插件：在 dsh 右侧边栏内嵌本地 Mol* v5 结构查看器，让你在对话里直接加载、渲染、标注和分析分子结构（PDB/mmCIF 等），AI 可以将结构生物学分析的图像直接展示给你。
Reveal the containing folder of any file open in a dsh-better-sidebar editor tab (explorer /select), one button per tab
Codex-style file search INSIDE the built-in dsh-better-sidebar Explorer tab (filter box under the workspace folder name), plus per-file-type icons/badges in the explorer tree and editor tabs

Session Icon — visual icons for DSH sidebar sessions: keyword rules, then session content, then a one-shot model verdict, then a workspace fallback. 445 Ant Design icons, editable settings page, keyword mining.
划词追问：在助手回答里选中文字后右键追问，问答全部留在右侧面板，并从主对话中隐藏。

Codex-style hook management for DeepSeek Harness: hooks.json discovered from config, plugins and projects, each hook pinned to a sha256 fingerprint you approve before it runs, with a review dialog in the composer, a /hooks browser and per-hook run stats.

Collapse large pastes in the DeepSeek Harness composer into a Codex-style [Pasted Content N chars] placeholder with a clickable pill, and expand it back to the full text on the host before the model sees it. Threshold 1000, same numbering and FIFO expansion as Codex. Pure in-memory: it saves no tokens.
Answer annotation and highlighting plugin for DSH Web

DSH-TV — a right-sidebar short-video/TV panel for DeepSeek Harness (Douyin / Short-drama / YouTube / Bilibili / Instagram / HackerTube, plus a random global TV player). Desktop uses an Electron webview with a real browser engine.
Live runtime health for DeepSeek Harness agents: loop detection, runtime_health tool, Runtime Health panel and a per-turn health summary for the user and the model.

Web on/off chip with Ollama web search (automatic search, Sources reminder, web_read that returns only the passages answering the question), plus a tool budget and a scratchpad for small-context local models, and the Ultralight and Advanced thinking modes.

Live writing panel for DeepSeek Harness: the AI writes a text or Markdown file section by section into a right-sidebar editor where you can type at the same time; rewrites of existing text become proposals you keep or refuse change by change.
Conversation history edits for DeepSeek Harness: edit one of your messages and rerun, recall a message, go back to an earlier reply, or edit an AI reply in a copy of the conversation.

Step-by-step plan runner for DeepSeek Harness, built for small local models: each step runs in a fresh child conversation with its own model and access, verified by mechanical checks and an optional read-only reviewer; one retry, then a finer split proposed to the user.

Reliability guards for small local models in DeepSeek Harness: in-turn correction of false success, invented DOIs and commands, denied capabilities and cut answers; approval before destructive commands; /explain read-only mode.

Local voice for DeepSeek Harness: a microphone button (click to talk, click to stop) puts the transcribed text (faster-whisper, French or English) into the message box, 'command <name>' becomes the matching /command, and a Read button speaks an answer with a local Piper voice. No wake word, no always-on microphone, nothing leaves the computer.
Synapsis 析域 —— 把讲义铺成一张能走进去的概念图（DSH 官方桌面端插件）
Configure DSH projects with experts, skills, rules, connectors, and optional shared capability libraries.

把本机 skill 清单与本会话真实用量注册成 dsh-better-sidebar 的侧边栏页面（用过点亮）
Independent DSH compaction plugin: native, goal-aware, and file-handoff checkpoints with a read-only inspect API.

替换 DSH 运行状态行（「深度求索中，用时 …」）的图标、文本与颜色；默认图标为旋转太极，默认文本「少女祈祷中」，默认颜色为红色。

Real-time quotes for A-share, Hong Kong and US listings: the stock_quote and stock_search tools, a watchlist page, and a per-stock page with daily candles and an AI analysis prompt.
Multi-session split view for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: split the conversation panel into up to four live session panes.
Open Markdown file links from the DSH conversation in Typora instead of the in-app preview.
版本记录 + Markdown 对话主题排版 —— DeepSeek Harness 插件（动态 define 与常驻安装双通道）

DSH 图像背景移除插件：本地 rembg（CPU/GPU），自带插件页设置面板
DeepSeek Harness-native integration for agent-vision-toolkit: image Q&A, OCR, grounding, UI restoration, pixel diff, Artifacts, and Web UI.
DSH 插件安全审查：静态扫描 + 当前会话模型语义审查 + 用户确认
第三方 API 接入 DSH 查询余额插件。
PocketPilot 的 DSH 插件：在侧栏底部加入「手机连接 / Phone link」入口，弹出配对二维码；界面文字跟随系统语言。装到电脑端 DSH，与手机 App 配套使用。
GitHub plugin discovery and one-click profile installation for DeepSeek Harness
天机阁 · 算法天书：把 219 门图形/动画/物理/AI 算法连同现成实现链接，做成 agent 可直接查询的工具（检索 · 档案 · 问天书 · 复核 · 体检），自带起始库，装完即用。
Floor-triggered session compaction for DeepSeek Harness: compact old history once M real user floors accumulate, keeping the newest N verbatim
DSH 优化插件：会话体检 / 归档 / 清理 + history 分页补丁管理（流式 chunk 事件不再拖慢会话切换）
MAGI（三贤人）决策系统 —— 三台独立人格单元各自表决，敏感/重要事项需三票一致。
Lazy senior dev mode for DeepSeek Harness: always-on minimal-code ruleset, intensity switching, and short review/audit/debt/gain/help skills

Codex desktop-pet skins migrated into DSH: auto-detects community Codex pet skins, copies them into the DSH home, and renders an animated desktop pet with per-session status dialogs and a settings section.
Quote a passage in a DSH conversation: it becomes a temporary annotation file attached to the composer as a reference chip, and is deleted once the turn reads it.
Work-first local memory plugin for DSH: 4 work categories + separate persona, 5 category files, local-only retrieval.

在模型选择弹层的「模型」行与输入框上方的模型按钮中，于模型名后追加该模型所属平台的名称。
DSH plugin: save public X (Twitter) posts as offline Markdown with a three-pane library reader.

Upload an image, crop it to a 1:1 icon and set it as the dsh desktop app's own icon — instant update across Finder / Apps / Dock, no restart, one-click restore.
部署在 Mastodon 的大肥鱼 bot：自己发 toot、自己回嘟文，带一个小本本，记下聊过的人和话。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: hide the raw chain of thought and show a summarized chain of thought produced by a small model (any Chat Completions-compatible API).

DSH right-sidebar documentation tree: curated layers, records lifecycle badges, full-text search, in-pane Markdown reading, and an AI-assisted /docs-organize workflow.

DSH plugin: zoomable, pannable image preview for the right-sidebar document pane. Adds wheel-zoom (cursor-anchored), drag-pan, fit / fit-width / 1:1, and a zoom readout to the images dsh already shows. / dsh 右侧边栏图片预览缩放插件。
Archived-session management for DSH: a Settings page that lists archived sessions by time, restores them, and permanently deletes them
Shows the DeepSeek account balance and a low-balance alert ring in the sidebar footer
Workspace profiles, team rules, commit validation, and session-scoped rule injection for DeepSeek Harness.

Sticker and emoji reactions for the DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop chat: a composer sticker picker, agent stickers that render as images while the transcript keeps the pack tag, emoji reactions under the user bubble, and an emoji-rain effect.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes the built-in web_search tool to a self-hosted SearXNG instance and web_fetch to a self-hosted Firecrawl instance through the ctx.web provider seam.
Agent Memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: local, file-per-memory long-term memory with human approval.
把默认的四种模式切换塞进「新会话」按钮里，新会话创建更方便（与设置里的 Agent 预设双向同步）。
左下角便签：随手记点子/感想/TODO，实时保存到归档目录，清单+悬浮归档
Auto-healing, argument normalization, Code-Mode bridging and execution diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness
Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.

Better Notice — unified visual and audible session notices for DeepSeek Harness: hot-session tab seats, sidebar state glyphs, per-state sounds and popout artwork
Full-screen settings page with a collapsible navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness, plus a small page holding the three switches (full screen, collapsed rail, and the panel motion).
Inspect and control the UI other plugins register into DeepSeek Harness slots (visibility, order, mirrored entries), and fold the sidebar's panels behind a single "More (N)" row.
DSH Web plugin: collapse consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item
DSH Web plugin: a floating DVD-style wordmark that drifts across the viewport and bounces off the browser edges, cycling color on every hit
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin: a QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a self-contained semantic memory (RAG) over all your chat sessions. Indexes messages live via session/event, stores embeddings in one local JSON file, and exposes a rag_search tool.
DSH Web plugin: a real PTY terminal in a VS Code-style collapsible footer panel (host PTY + WebSocket + xterm.js)

Discover, install, and upgrade curated plugins from the OpenHarness catalog in DeepSeek Harness

Notifications for DeepSeek Harness: desktop toast, browser tab, ntfy push and Feishu bot, on turn end, approval and question.

On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.

DeepSeek Harness 插件：按屏幕尺寸与比例匹配手机/平板/桌面。给输入框与会话页头补安全区（刘海、Home 指示条）、窄屏收紧留白、触摸设备放大控件，并把配色换成 Miracle 设计语言（暖白纸面/墨蓝色阶/蓝紫品牌/柔和圆角/克制阴影，暗色独立配色）。手机上完全收起 56px 图标栏（入口在会话页头）；侧栏与主会话按 Miracle 动效纪律同步位移（只动 transform、两向同时结束、reduced-motion 瞬时降级）；不动文档高度、不含任何覆盖层，所以不可能把界面锁住；桌面级窗口一条规则都不命中。

dsh third-party plugin: queue during peak hours, drain off-peak, report the savings.

Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness - model spend, tokens and cache usage across all sessions (settings section). DSH 费用看板：汇总全部会话的模型输入/输出/缓存 token 用量并按价格表计费。
Bridge DeepSeek Harness to whatever coding-agent CLI is installed (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, ...) through data-driven recipes: auto-discovery, capability-driven UI, per-run reports.
Everyday usability upgrades - workspace icons, AI model logos, unread reminders, profile styling, cleaner sidebar.

Command Code usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: plan credits, 5-hour/weekly windows, period request stats, plan tiers, and an API key editor — as a Settings tab plus a draggable floating capsule.
对正在使用的模型提供商询价：账户余额 + 模型单价（USD / 1M tokens）
DSH plugin: AI chapter/section outlining and layout-preserving PDF book translation with glossary support, resumable cache, ranges and side-by-side comparison PDF.

会话清理（喂鱼）：把不要的会话拖到侧栏底部的小胖鱼嘴边，它张嘴吃掉 —— 会话目录送进 Windows 系统回收站、可撤销，撤销会把它放回原来的工作区；清空回收站后对应记录自动消失；删除前会问一句（弹窗的文字色/背景色可自定义，带实时预览）并写出这条会话烧掉多少 token；拖拽时可以换成大白饭/蛋炒饭/金币三只碗（设置里直接摆缩略图点选，图全部内联在插件里，选完立即生效、不必重启）；碗的大小可调到 320px 并浮在指针上方；点图标直达设置里的「会话喂鱼」（直接调设置面板自己的 store 切分区，不再依赖点 DOM；账本拿不到时才退回 DOM 兜底，最长重试 3.6 秒）；被别的挂件挤到时自动让位到下一行，让位后铺满整行变成卡片，卡片的底色与描边跟随侧栏实时采样；头像连续加载失败三次才会被收起（兜底立绘同样内联）；18 段界面文案可自定义。（DSH Web 插件）
在新对话中通过 / 快速选择本地 .md 提示词模板；模板约束力等同于 AGENTS.md，并对整个对话持续生效。Pick a local .md prompt template with / when starting a new DSH conversation.
在 AI 每段回复（不含思维链）旁增加翻译按钮，用 设置 → 模型 中已配置的模型翻译成所选语言，译文显示在原文下方。Translate DSH AI replies segment by segment with your configured models.

让 DSH agent 识别微信/QQ 表情包与聊天截图并判断对方情绪（GLM-4V-Flash），暴露 wechat_emoji_analyze 工具。

Trace AI answer sources in DeepSeek Harness chats, review original passages, connect archived excerpts and conclusions in a local graph, and preview or export mind maps and structure diagrams as PNG or SVG.
DSH 宝 — TRAE 宝式的个人助理：长期记忆（跨会话注入）、专属助理预设、定时进度汇总、桌面通知与工作状态速览面板。
Stay in your DSH coding flow: see your current git branch, switch branches, commit, push, merge, stash, and diff — without leaving the chat.
DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态天体背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机认证序列，以及无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮修复

Refuse-compaction for dsh: intercepts the harness's AUTO-triggered context compaction (step pressure + model-switch pressure; overflow recovery is policy-gated) while manual /compact stays structurally untouched — the preset-scoped engine is resolved via agentPresets.serviceFor and wrapped in place. Four tiers: temporary (block the next 3 turns; auto-switches to manual-ask at >=90% occupancy), manual (block-first ask via an in-conversation bar: compact now / refuse / quiet for 3 turns / stop asking; a busy or failed compact-now is never silently dropped — it approves the next compaction checkpoint, which then runs at the engine's own step boundary), forbid (block all auto compaction), off. v0.2.0 adds an in-conversation occupancy gauge (ring progress + percent/tokens + tier quick-switch, revealed within a configurable fraction of the compaction point); v0.2.1 reads the dsh-compaction-policy row's live config straight from the loader entry tree (zero changes to that plugin) so the gauge follows its effective strategy. Optional linkage with dsh-exa-distill: while distilled digests are pending, pressure compaction is held until the condensed surface lands (95% safety valve).

Per-session LLM cost meter for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: folds provider usage into uncached input / cache read / cache write / output per model and prices it against DeepSeek and Xiaomi MiMo pay-as-you-go rates (DeepSeek peak-idle tiering included).
Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.3
Single-owner native cloud tasks for DeepSeek Harness, with local and IM entry, continuous follow-up and verifiable artifacts
DSH Web 任意文件接入：粘贴/拖入（含整个文件夹）/按钮把非图片文件作为输入框上方卡片添加，发送时自动附 @路径；图片保留原生附件管线。
Mogu Multimodal Runtime - DeepSeek Harness 统一多模态能力运行时 (Comfy Local Provider V1)

Advanced Tavily model tools for DeepSeek Harness (tavily_search, tavily_extract, tavily_map, tavily_crawl, tavily_research, tavily_get_research) with multi-key rotation, failover and a per-account in-flight cap, plus a key and usage management card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced. | DSH Tavily 可选高级搜索工具：多 Key 轮换、故障转移与按账号并发上限，另有 research 综合调研报告，插件配置页含密钥与用量管理卡片；内置 web_search 永不替换。
在 DeepSeek Harness 里托管 Minecraft 服务器的插件：状态/启停/日志/白名单/投票授权，静态命令拦截，本地/Pterodactyl 可插拔适配器，游戏聊天直通 QQ 群（不经过 AI、不耗 token），把人设注入 QQ 会话，并让游戏内玩家用 /ai 和「小铜」对话（配套 Forge mod）。需要先安装 QQ 机器人插件。
Original-image context menus for Codex-generated and user-sent images in DeepSeek Harness.
声生观察台 · DeepSeek Harness 插件：上传清唱干声，分析音色、音域与嗓况，并给出编曲混音建议。
Standalone DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: Mojie (mojieaigc.com) LLM model provider
Git source-control sidebar for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: repo init, staging, commit/push/pull, branch & remote management, AI-generated Conventional Commits messages, and a commit-history graph.
自定义 DSH 左下角的昵称与头像：设置页里改，点保存后生效，支持缩放、位移与尺寸
一键回到对话底部的悬浮圆形按钮：上滑看历史之后不用再手动滑回来
Git worktree and branch isolation for DeepSeek Harness
A multimodal workspace for Agents: Core Web, MCP, CLI and native DSH tools with model pools, durable media tasks, ComfyUI and explicit plugins.
因幡巡主题皮肤（Inaba Meguru skin）for DSH Web: 三档出场强度、深/浅两版照片墙、满屏立绘、设置页。素材走 assets/ 同源路由，官方图需自备（仓库不含）。
DeepSeek Harness plugin exposing the SeismicX earthquake-catalog skill as typed, model-facing tools

可视化套件 — render fenced blocks in the DSH web conversation as real diagrams, charts and task reports. Eleven renderers (Mermaid, Graphviz, nomnoml, ECharts, Vega-Lite, hand-written SVG, isometric, voxel, metrics, matrix and report), every one configurable, integrity-checked and served by the plugin itself — no CDN, works offline.
「声琢」VoxPolish — 把说出来的话打磨成清晰表达：原话/整理后双通道，先说后改再发送，全程不碰输入框。Voice input with an expression coach for DeepSeek Harness; local SenseVoice ASR, no extra model download.
把 WorkBuddy 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness —— 不依赖桌面 App，走 OAuth 设备码登录。

MiniMax speech-to-text (asr-1.0) and text-to-speech (speech-2.8-hd) as a global DeepSeek Harness plugin: a transcribe_audio tool, an announce_speech tool, a settings card, composer voice input, spoken turn announcements, and handsfree conversation.
DSH web extension: a live subagent run monitor with a sidebar trigger and a floating card panel
A free-form grouping layer for the DSH Desktop sidebar: assign sessions from different workspaces to the same group without changing their official workspace membership or logs.
DSH 侧边栏标签页：该面板提供鸿蒙模拟器管理、HarmonyOS 应用构建与部署，以及设备日志、设备截图与代码检查结果。同时向 AI 提供 8 个鸿蒙调试工具。
DSH 插件: 归档会话定期清理 —— 物理归档堆与页面归档会话超保留期(默认7天,页面可配置天/小时)自动物理删除
Right dock platform for DeepSeek Harness web UI: a pushing (non-overlay) right panel with multi-tab seats — other plugins contribute tabs through the rightdock.tab slot
Workspace file explorer for DeepSeek Harness web UI: right-side resizable file tree with recursive search (skips .git/node_modules), Markdown rendering and multi-language syntax highlighting
Unofficial DeepSeek Harness settings panel for Command Code: credits, usage windows, and model-catalog sync.

webCandidates.description: DSH 插件：电商店铺账号管理（拼多多 / 淘宝 / 天猫 / 抖音 / 京东 / 1688 商家端）——一店一份独立登录档案，登录一次长期复用；浏览器优先 ego lite，未安装时回退 Chrome CDP；支持静默/定时检测登录态、保活续期与采集作业编排。
File tree panel for the DSH Web UI: the right details column shows the current session workspace tree (lazy, read-only).
Message recall (撤回) for the DSH Web UI: remove a message — and everything after it — from the conversation, durably, without ever reverting code changes. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
Bounded, cursor-aware log analysis tools and Conversation card for DeepSeek Harness.
Manage dsh profile plugins from the web UI: enable / disable / delete composition rows with live hot reload, no config editing by hand

Global IM channels for DeepSeek Harness — Telegram, Discord, Slack, Mattermost, Zulip and Matrix in one plugin, with a Settings page (add / test / save channels, live reload), per-conversation sessions that survive restarts, and platform-correct markdown.

Zero-token scheduled script runner for DeepSeek Harness: runs shell commands on a cron schedule inside the Host without waking the model, with conditional wake-on-change, a Qinglong-style task table (overview cards, search/filter, human-readable schedules, next-run, recent runs, log drawer), editing from the page, and a sidebar panel.
Provider-neutral multi-account scheduling, affinity, health, and Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness
Seven games for DeepSeek Harness: task-linked arcade battles, convoy escort, Chess, Gomoku and Xiangqi in one floating window.
SOLIDWORKS 建模自动化的预览与反馈环节：把 agent deliver 出的 STEP/STL/OBJ 画进 DSH 文件预览面板，拾取面/边/点并生成坐标交接单交回 agent 修改
DSH 免重启热刷新插件：监视插件源码变化，重新加载 host 侧插件模块，并在会话标题栏给出一颗「刷新界面」按钮，让插件更新立刻生效，无需重启桌面端。
Browse, search and install SkillHub skills inside DeepSeek Harness. / 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能。
A floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH web GUI: click to spin it, drag it anywhere, with a spin-speed slider and synced LRC lyrics.
Manual multi-source update checks and update plans for DeepSeek Harness plugin bundles.
Bilibili live danmaku as an always-visible overlay in the DSH Web UI.
Makes ! a shell prefix in the DeepSeek Harness composer: runs the command in the session's working directory and records its output as a tool result, with a configurable command length cap.
A DeepSeek-style paperclip attach button in the DSH web composer; uploads files to the DSH host (model-aware: native image blocks for multimodal models, file paths for text-only models).
插件热度榜：按 GitHub 收藏数排名 DSH 插件，收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万的插件会被收录，掉出前排也找得到。 · Star-ranked DSH plugin radar with a sticky inclusion rule.
星邮客户端（for DeepSeek Harness）：让 DSH 连上星邮——好友、群聊、动态、广场、漂流瓶、狼人杀、剧本杀，starpost_use 单入口（16 个家族）+ 外部事件注入 + 8 标签设置页
Anime2.5DRig × DSH pet: PSD auto-rig 2.5D desktop pet using Anime2.5DRig rendering instead of Live2D
便携式 GitHub 连接插件：在对话框左下角一键让 DeepSeek 等 AI 连接你的 GitHub 账号（OAuth 设备流 / Personal Access Token），连接后 AI 可通过 github_api 工具直接操作你的 GitHub。
DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 模型预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全自动批准、危险转人工（fail-safe），最小人工介入，含人工审查 UI

DeepSeek peak-pricing cost guard for DSH: during peak hours (Mon–Fri Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, ×2; weekends all valley) the agent automatically switches to ultra-compressed caveman-style output to save tokens, and a header badge + toast keep you posted on every peak/valley transition. Since 0.2.0 it also meters how many tokens you saved during peak hours and what that is worth in RMB (DeepSeek pricing, cache hit/miss invoiced separately). · DeepSeek 峰谷计价省钱插件：周一至周五高峰时段自动切 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏徽章 + 切换提醒；0.2.0 起计量高峰省了多少 token、按 DeepSeek 定价折合多少人民币（输入缓存命中/未命中分列计费）。
DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4.6V-Flash，限流自动降级 GLM-4V）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图
File-defined DSH command hooks with approval-only UI, read-only details, lifecycle and tool gates

Web GUI console for MCP servers: manages the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/enable/disable/reconnect/delete servers, live status, mcpServers JSON import. No MCP protocol code: connection and tool registration are 100% the official client, resolved from the running DSH profile.
Schedule a detached DSH restart from inside DSH via /dsh-restart command or dsh_restart agent tool

生物信息学「许愿式分析」插件：Python 执行器（bio_python：Biopython 全功能 + 出版级绘图）+ 94 个高频语义化工具（差异表达/GSEA、代谢建模/FBA、合成生物学设计、CRISPR、ML、文献检索、Addgene 质粒库、UniProt、单细胞 QC、来源审计、FASTA/GFF 批量工具箱等）+ 3 个 repair 管道工具（受控修复事件 v0：脱敏登记/只读状态/台账完整性校验）+ 52 个 skill（1 主 skill + 17 领域配方 + 21 协议 + 5 研究方法 + 8 agent 指南）+ 零依赖自举 Python 环境（uv+venv 自动下载到插件私有目录）。用户下载安装即可许愿式分析。

OpenCode Go subscription usage page for the DSH Web UI: official 5h / weekly / monthly used-percent windows, reset countdowns, a local sampling trail, and multiple API-key accounts you can switch between
Workspace memory for DSH: a per-workspace Markdown memory directory (MEMORY.md index + one fact per file), injected into every main session and refreshed by background extraction, ported from ZCode
Community add-on for @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot: dispatch tasks to QQ sessions and manage customizable feature modules

Agent-decided approvals for DeepSeek Harness: an 自动审批 permission mode where every sandbox escalation is judged automatically by an LLM (default judge: one direct LLM call with no subagent session; optional isolated judge subagent) plus an independent 自动审查 per-call review mode (Full access base; the machine-changing calls bash/pwsh/write/edit/str_replace_editor and MCP tools mcp__* are reviewed before execution by the TypeSafe Jev decision model — read-only tools are not reviewed — with interpreter scripts the command references expanded into the judge state so temp scripts are judged by their actual code; risky calls rejected with no human fallback), with a configurable judge model and a per-session audit trail in the conversation window's 审批 tab.
Archive manager for DeepSeek Harness: DSH < 0.1.7 gets the grouped search/restore/delete panel; DSH >= 0.1.7 adds the delete action missing from the built-in archive management.
WhaleHarbor web onboarding: lite-client standalone window (--app), background installer download with mirror fallback + SHA-256 verify, browser task notifications, and a full-version install prompt.

DSH 正式 bundle 插件：在官方右侧边栏（sidebarRightTabs）注册「HiLog 检查器」与「ArkUI Inspector」两个独立页面 Tab（HiLog 实时流 + 过滤；ArkUI UI 树 dump / 截图 / tap / swipe / text），并提供 .ets 文件查看器（ArkTS 语法高亮，内容经官方 remote.workspaceFiles 分页读取）；为对话 agent 提供 harmony_project 工程模型（JSON5 配置 / 模块 / Ability / 权限 / 产物）、ArkWeb Web DOM 只读工具 harmony_web_dom（Chromium CDP DOM 读取 + outerHTML）与 ArkTS 运行时调试器 harmony_debug（Hvigor Source Map 驱动的 .ets 源码断点与源码调用栈，兼保留编译 URL 断点；attach / 暂停 / 单步 / 求值，与 DevEco Studio 同款调试通道；应用停在断点时自动把暂停位置与调用栈通知回会话，无需轮询；日志与应用管理直接用官方 devecocli log / devecocli device app，不重复造轮子）；路径配置为设置根区的「HarmonyOS Suite」页面（settings.section；DevEco Studio / HarmonyOS Command Line Tools，含三平台自发现、两者互斥、CLT 最低 26.0.0 校验；若 PATH 存在 devecocli 则优先使用，忽略配置路径；未安装 devecocli 时设备列表 / 日志 / 截图 / Tap/Swipe/Text / 窗口列表自动降级到 SDK 自带的 hdc）。

DSH 正式 bundle 插件：在 DSH Web UI 里管理 Git 工作区——入口在输入框「模式」选择器旁（仅 git 仓库显示），进入与设置同规格的居中面板：变更暂存（hunk 级/行级/stash）、分支与 tag、交互式 rebase、提交历史（分支线图形/过滤/范围对比/revert/reset/fixup/undo）、合并冲突解决、blame/reflog、worktree 管理（行内脏状态、作用域切进 review 改动、自动注册为 DSH 工作区）、remote/config 设置，以及**子仓库支持**（git submodule + 嵌套独立仓库：仓库树发现、变更聚合分组、仓库切换、指针 diff 与冲突解决、submodule 管理与嵌套仓库注册）。

Persistent project memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from ZCode: ZCode-style markdown memory store (per project + global) with a full memory-management page in Settings, index-first prompt injection with provenance, an agent memory lifecycle (memory_save / memory_get / memory_list / memory_forget / memory_correct / memory_review), a restorable recycle bin, supersede chains, and one-click import from an existing ZCode memory directory.
为 DeepSeek Harness 中本地已配置的模型追加系统提示词：按 provider/model 精确匹配或服务商级通配（provider/*）注入到系统提示词末尾，设置面板逐模型管理，规则持久化、重启不丢。

Remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pairs a HarmonyOS phone app with the desktop Host over an end-to-end-encrypted public relay (WebSocket). Lets the phone list/create/switch sessions, send prompts, watch streamed replies, cancel turns, and answer approval and ask-user-question requests from anywhere; pushes Huawei Push Kit notifications (gracefully disabled when AGC is unconfigured) for approvals, questions, and turn completion. The pairing QR lives in the DSH settings panel ("DSH Pocket"). Fail-open by design: any relay timeout or fault hands the request back to the desktop answerer.

Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness (7/30-day per-model charts + yearly heatmap) plus an inline coding-plan balance/quota readout in the composer (minimax/deepseek/kimi/openrouter/zhipu/mimo/opencode-go/bailian; mimo uses the dashboard cookie since MiMo exposes no API-key quota API; bailian Token Plan uses AK/SK -> CLI access token -> console gateway, configurable in the settings page when a qwen token plan model is set up).
Provider-aware peak/off-peak badge for DSH: shows in the composer toolbar only when the selected model is billed with a peak/off-peak split (DeepSeek's own API, or OpenCode Go's two DeepSeek models).

Sticker/emoji expression plugin for DeepSeek Harness — assistants send stickers to express emotions, with library management, AI tagging, auto-matching, dialects and style mimicry. · DSH 表情包插件：让助手用表情包表达情绪，含图库管理、AI 识图、自动配图、方言口音与学我说话。
助手管理（Hana 式）：卡片堆叠 + 新建助手 + 元选择，后台把配置落成 dsh 预设（.agent-presets/<id>/），即插即用；单包内置 soul 记忆/人格运行时（assistant-soul，按 dsh-assistant-manager/soul 子路径被预设引用）。

Offline diagnostic for DeepSeek Harness — 28 built-in + 5 catalog checks across env/profile/session (Layer A checks-as-data), self-update (Layer B), and a semi-automatic LLM observer (Layer C, --observe); Doctor panel in web UI settings.
Codex Lens: inspect a Codex thread from the DSH right sidebar — overview, live activity, workspace files, stats.
Sidebar-foot Reload UI and Restart App buttons: reload refreshes the interface and client plugins only, restart relaunches the DeepSeek Harness desktop app together with its Host.

Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens — each works on its own and more arrive as the shell grows: an eight-theme minimalist gallery, sidebar panel folding, and reload/restart buttons at the sidebar foot. · 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加：8 套极简主题画廊、侧栏面板收纳，以及侧栏底部的刷新界面与重启应用按钮。
CHIRAL PULSE - a Death Stranding-styled BB pod vital-signs monitor for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the session's heartbeat waveform is the hero, and the pulse reacts to real agent activity.
把 DSH 侧边栏的全局面板行折叠成一个「插件大全」入口，恢复工作区可视高度。纯客户端插件，零依赖，不需要构建链。
dsh-deep-search（深海搜索）：DeepSeek Harness 全局会话检索插件。遍历所有会话历史，按关键词/正则与时间、工作空间、提问/回答/执行、文件类型组合筛选，流式返回并精确跳回原轮次或工具调用。
Inline and tabbed video/audio playback for DeepSeek Harness: a player under the reply, a full player in the right sidebar, and a minimal recent list. No ffmpeg required.
QQ 经典农场自动化助手面板 — DeepSeek Harness 插件（面板 + 控制面 + LLM 工具），自动化由独立 Farm Agent 承担

DSH plugin: hand the agent a GitNexus code graph (impact, context and query as model tools), anchor the index to the commit it describes after every refresh, and put GitNexus's own web UI (resizable 3D view, AI settings pre-filled from the environment) beside a sidebar panel for coverage, refresh gating, symbol and full-text search, file history and maintenance.

划词翻译：在右侧栏（文件树 / 文档预览 / 浏览器 tab）选中文本后，于选区正下方弹出翻译卡片。选区有两条来源——同文档 DOM 直接读，侧栏浏览器（Electron <webview>，跨域无 preload）走 executeJavaScript 注入 + 轮询的桥。译文有三条引擎路径（微软翻译免费端点 / Google 翻译免费端点 / DSH 已配置的模型），默认用微软翻译、点引擎标签可切换；源语言与目标语言是两个独立下拉，默认 自动检测 → 中文；端点调用、token 缓存、结果缓存与失败码收口都在宿主侧。卡片跟着选区滚动重定位（卡片内部滚动不会关掉它），切换引擎/方向时旧译文留在原位不闪白。

OpenRouter Provider List — 从官方目录勾选 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商，或按模型规则分别限定，并设置量化位数限制与服务层级（service_tier），作为 provider.only / provider.order / provider.quantizations 与顶层 service_tier 注入；支持图片输入（按宿主的图片预算契约透传）；路由按 baseURL 主机识别，provider 可任意重命名；可选地把请求改经 billion-context 压缩代理。配置由插件自持（$DSH_HOME/openrouter-providers.json），不依赖 settings 命名空间注册，因此同时适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1。配置入口：DSH >= 0.1.6-alpha.2 在侧栏「插件」页的组合包页面，更早宿主在「设置 → 插件 → 插件配置」。
dsh-pocket 的 fork：把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋——一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。

Remote Windows administration for the dsh web GUI: WinRM/PowerShell Remoting host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-winrm.json), PowerShell exec / streaming console / service & process management / remote text read-write-edit / streamed file transfer / cluster execution, plus agent tools (winrm_list, winrm_exec, winrm_service, winrm_process, winrm_read, winrm_write, winrm_edit, winrm_upload, winrm_download, winrm_cluster). Runs entirely on a native Node.js WinRM client (winrm-client) — no Python/pywinrm required. Standalone Cordis plugin — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules link, no dsh source changes.
DSH CPA provider and runtime plugin
Ligui: a thin, model-agnostic composition layer for DeepSeek Harness
Nico glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI — glass material rendered by nico-glass-kit. Adapted for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
A generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement; tuck it away with a header button at any time.
Independent local RSS Pal reader and AI companion for DSH
GitHub 趋势日报的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：按日 / 周 / 月周期定时 spawn 本地 trendradar 核心，抓取 Trending、生成中文简介与周期总结，并可选把订阅仓库的新 Release 合成中文摘要，一起提交到你的仓库、自动开 PR 合并；内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。
统一管理本地技能的安装、更新、删除与接入，让同一份技能在多个 Agent 间复用。A skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: install, update, remove, link and toggle agent skills.
Moren 无限制梁神模式：把 dsh-purge 的无限制模式/无限制子任务与梁神模式合成一个原生预设，带左侧栏入口、图片与视频识别、本地生图、编码器、Token 守卫和可自检修复的回退。
Everything DeepSeek Harness

Work-chain workflow for DeepSeek Harness: the current session is the leader; configurable members (each with its own model) work the task in parallel as durable Agent Teams teammates and report through the built-in team task board. v0.7.0 keeps the team mode only (the disposable-subagent rotate mode was removed). Member provider/model are picked from dropdowns populated by the live DSH provider catalog, defaulting to deepseek-v4.1-flash. Member names default to the selected model name (v0.6.1; duplicates get -2/-3, and legacy pro/haiku/kimi/ds-flash names migrate automatically). Also ships an aesthetic advisor (v0.6.0): a leader-only aesthetic_advice tool that hands a delivered artifact (UI file, screenshot, URL or description) to a disposable reviewer subagent for ranked visual/UI critique — advice only, it never edits files — with its enable switch, model and style notes configurable on the same plugin page. v0.8.0 makes the aesthetic advisor a callable virtual member named "aesthetic": it counts among the callable members and can be dispatched from work_chain subtasks or work_flow tasks, without taking a team slot (only runs when named). v0.8.1 adapts member model locking to the DSH 0.2.2 agent.model.select() contract (with a fallback to the legacy agent/request waterfall on older runtimes). v0.8.2 gives the aesthetic advisor a generous 900s default budget (up to 1800s) and returns any advice already written as a partial success instead of a timeout failure. v0.9.0 ports the plugin to DSH 0.2.2's subagent-backed Agent Teams: members are spawned with ctx.subagents.startActivation (per-member model via agentOptions + agent.model.select), the roster uses listDescendants, messaging/interrupt go through the subagents service, and the team task board is auto-enabled for the lead session. v0.9.1 fixes the subagent roster, capacity and task-owner mapping on DSH 0.2.2-rc.3: members are recognized by their catalog name or the plugin label (work-chain member / work-flow worker), capacity counts only live members so historical subagents do not exhaust the long-lived session, and reassigned task owners resolve to Session ids so workers can edit/complete their own board tasks.

Git status, commit, and push sidebar plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Show a local image or short video inside the current DeepSeek Harness conversation card, with click-to-preview. Does not replace the official read_image model path.
Resolve unique kebab-case skill substrings in DeepSeek Harness slash tokens, so /oneshot can load game-package-oneshot.

dsh-model-master（模型选择大师）for DeepSeek Harness — 15-language UI (top-15 world languages) — 保留 DSH 原生模型按钮与菜单，在原版狭小下拉列表即将弹出时无缝接管为 Spotlight 大面板。集成 TTFT/TPS 流式测速（失败如实展示、绝不编造数据）、原生渠道分组、⚡ 智能优选、全球百强榜（点击行搜本机渠道）；内置推理档位 FX（官方菜单推理等级行滑条 + 档位切换芯片能量闪动）；原生模型位被其它插件占用时自动出现工具行备用入口（防顶掉）。
PRTS · 源石协议：可旋转 3D 源石晶簇 / 工业指令面板 / 普瑞赛斯记忆残片 / PRTS 启动动画
Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) locale plugin for DeepSeek Harness — translates the Web UI and auto-activates for Portuguese browsers.
DSH plugin for FreeCAD: inspect and edit STEP/STP solid models, then generate first-angle 2D machining drawings (SVG/DXF/PDF/PNG) with automatic HLR, dimensions and a hole table.
DSH 桌面端优先的 B 站视频阅读插件：面板里装依赖、扫码登录、管缓存；对话里用 /bili 或 bili_watch 把视频读成文本。

DSH desktop plugin: text-to-image, image-to-image, and text-to-video tools for the agent, backed by Agnes Image and Video 2.5 Flash, with a Settings page that stores the key in the DSH credential store.
Pins each OpenCode Go session to a fast gateway route by probing candidate x-opencode-session ids, without sacrificing its prompt cache.
浏览器式右侧栏标签管理：批量关闭、浮出/收回、重新打开已关闭的标签、标签总览面板；并为右侧栏文件预览补上视频/音频内联播放
连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务；桌面端支持左下角菜单与桌面悬浮小沐
DSH Web GUI: one-click expand/collapse all reasoning chains and tool chains in the current session (官方 repository-plugin 格式 / official bundle format)
Independent DSH authorization review with bounded execution, sandbox modes and bilingual settings

Routes web_fetch through a user-configured local proxy (SOCKS5 with remote/local DNS, or HTTP CONNECT; default socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890) with auto/always/never routing, editable in Settings → General. Zero-runtime-dependency DeepSeek Harness bundle with a General-settings companion row.
Restore normal subagent defaults after narrowly identified pre-creation model-argument errors
DSH web client plugin: select text in a chat message and quote it into the composer as an inline reference chip; the full text materializes on submit via the input-trigger reference codec.

Manage MCP servers from inside DeepSeek Harness: add, enable/disable, remove, reconnect, authorize with OAuth 2.1, renew tokens on a schedule whose policy is editable in the UI, renew after expiry, and browse every MCP tool with its description.
DSH 插件 · 刷贴吧：读帖挑重点、写日报、自动签到；学习每个吧的语风（风格库），回帖与楼中楼可选（默认关）。支持人设、日记、峰谷定时，另带只读 MCP stdio server（未逐客户端实测）。

Virtuoso Bridge for DeepSeek Harness: managed virtuoso-bridge-lite runtimes, fixed or automatic-session daemon discovery, an isolated Python environment, agent tools, a left-sidebar configuration page and a right-sidebar runtime panel.
DSH 侧栏播客面板：订阅 RSS、倍速播放、记住进度、三行摘要。
盯住 GitHub / Gitee 仓库：有新的 issue / PR 就提醒你，让 AI 接着干活
Dark-only starry-sky theme for DeepSeek Harness: deep-space palette, twinkling stars and constellation figures behind the interface.
Open A2A network plugin for DeepSeek Harness: signed agent cards, decentralized peer/zone discovery, direct routing model tools, and joinable session nodes with a sidebar control
Quick prompt templates for DeepSeek Harness: global and per-session templates, a browser panel, and a pure-TS node:sqlite persistence backend
DeepSeek Harness bundle: shows your DeepSeek API account balance in the web GUI (sidebar widget) and exposes it to the model through an api_balance tool
Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web client, with local Russian speech recognition for voice input
Agent 工作记录 / 任务复盘 / 自动生成项目报告：从 DSH 会话日志只读还原这次任务做了什么，并产出可读的《本次 Agent 工作报告》

DSH plugin: context-aware per-step reasoning-effort routing (the drift engine). Classifies the task origin once (trivial/standard/engineering/hard) from the originating brief, then drifts the class on stacked evidence: a decay-weighted short window of tool errors / repeats / todo completions / orchestration returns / compaction checkpoints / failure carry, a long window of gzip-discounted information volume on linear ramps, and real-time frugal signals — no hysteresis. Clamps to the target model's advertised efforts and injects an 'Auto' mask into the native model selector. Fills default reasoningEfforts for profile-declared llm-pi-ai custom models the Models page has not configured (0.2.1-aware). All user-facing options live in the plugin config file (no settings UI); the GUI surfaces (composer badge, trajectory hoisting) are read-only displays.
Pack de idioma español de Chile (es-CL) para la interfaz web de DeepSeek Harness
Tree-shaped knowledge bases for DeepSeek Harness: per-session activation, a node graph view, and review markers for model edits.
FDE 工作站：跑在 DeepSeek Harness 里的单机插件——把客户经营从线索到采用做成可推进、可验证、可复盘的一屏作战台（看板 + 今日 + 8 阶段门禁 + FDE 方法库 + 资料库 + 招采关联）。
Durable roundtable Conversation Node rendering multi-round discussions for dsh web

webCandidates.description: Growth workbench for DeepSeek Harness: conversation-header button + right-sidebar panels for new-media ops, ecommerce and marketing — accounts, topics, platform variants, calendar, metrics ledgers, products, feedback, campaigns, SOP, glossary and copy rules, all backed by your Obsidian vault.
Project-scoped custom SKILL roots for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness web plugin: a live activity line under the composer that says what the turn is actually doing (tool running / waiting on you / retrying / model thinking).

Model router for DeepSeek Harness: keep a pool of models and every step is routed to one of them with its reasoning effort set — a click-only composer panel, three authorization scopes (a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and effort scope is bound to the one model you choose), task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (todo, context pressure, token budget, subagents) and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a tool call made with thinking off.
Multi-round deep research for DeepSeek Harness: the same session keeps drilling into a topic round after round and writes a cited report in the right sidebar.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: every DSH session becomes a Telegram forum topic, mirrored both ways, with approvals, questions, commands, files and voice
DeepSeek Harness 破甲（精简版）：只做提示词注入与宿主补丁。无演练台、无资产库、无技能库、无规则面板、无在线更新，设置页一个只读状态面板。
WorkBuddy 记忆桥：把 SOUL / USER / MEMORY / topics 渲染进 DeepSeek Harness 的 system prompt，两边共用同一份 Markdown，不落副本。
EVA Unit-01 / Unit-02 themes for DeepSeek Harness, switchable live: entry-plug boot cinematic, LCL, sync-rate meter and a restrained everyday skin.

The machine's execution surfaces as one DSH tool: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash/zsh/fish/brush), PowerShell itself, and a real console for interactive programs. Background jobs, timeout promotion, sandbox escalation and persistent sessions ride the same call, so a session stops reaching for another shell tool.
DeepSeekBot: persistent agent teams, project workflows, context governance and evidence-based retrospectives for DSH
allow/ask/deny permission gates for DeepSeek Harness tools: path/params/agents surfaces, argv decomposition, network rules, redaction, grants, dry-run, fail-closed config
Conversation rewind for DeepSeek Harness: cut the model context back to any of your earlier messages, optionally restore the files that turn changed, and put the original text back in the composer
Session management for DeepSeek Harness: catalog, search, annotations, trash/restore, workspace move, preset migration and export
Map third-party provider models onto official DeepSeek model capabilities (image input, reasoning effort) inside dsh.
DSH rotation pool: a sidebar panel to pick configured provider/model routes and fail over across them on quota errors, plus optional multi-key rotation.

Sniffs which thinking levels each third-party pi-ai route actually accepts and declares them, so the composer's model picker offers a strength switch; a sidebar panel switches sniffing and strength per provider.

Workspace Explorer for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the native sidebar workspace region with a multi-root browser — a conversation tree grouped by each session's real working directory, plus a read-only resource tree that previews files in the native right Sidebar.
Third-party DeepSeek Harness channel plugin for Narra Messenger

DSH image-generation plugin with native support for the zhenzhen-image async task gateway (POST /image/generations -> top-level task_id -> poll GET /image/generations/<id>): text-to-image and multi-reference image-to-image, no bridge process or external image host required. Forked from @dickpy/dsh-imagegen.

GALFree — Ren'Py galgame full-pipeline workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Host-side project service (write gateway, git snapshots, dialect-subset parser, derived progress, review stamps, pinned SDK validation, playtest) behind one deep seam; the workbench is an embedded web panel consuming the same state.

Bitwarden / Vaultwarden vault for DeepSeek Harness: real-time sync, entry browser panel, masked reads, TOTP, passkeys and read/write tools. Local fork of dsh-vaultwarden 0.17.6 (MIT) that fixes official-cloud password login for Argon2id accounts; supports Bitwarden cloud (US/EU) and self-hosted Vaultwarden.

Beautified archive manager for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, each with an unarchive action, with a flat session list, folder group headers, relative timestamps and hover unarchive buttons.
说人话 (Shuorenhua) — DeepSeek 对话去 AI 味与大白话润色插件，集成 shuorenhua 与 Humanizer-zh 规则，一键简化优化 AI 回答。
喵体中文 agent preset 系列：原版单体、管家、码农、独立校验者、可行性探针，以及可配置的团队设置页。
/btw for DeepSeek Harness: a side question about the live session, including the running turn; the answer stays out of the conversation history.

DSH web plugin: switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at any time, even after the conversation has already started - the stock UI refuses that. Provides a session-header dropdown plus a fenced /preset-switch/api route.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a small floating window over the conversation showing the balance left on your API account, and what recent turns actually cost.
Automatic handoff for DSH sessions: build a compact handoff document from project facts, context summary and todos, then create and wake a new session with it.
DSH 会话总线：让同一项目内的独立会话按 session id 或自注册名互相发消息并唤醒对方，无需人工复制提示词。默认关闭，仅在存在 .dsh-bus.json 且 enabled=true 的项目内生效。
dsh-manager tunnel and direct LAN access for DeepSeek Harness
Open a workspace directory from the DSH web GUI in a configurable launcher (VS Code / file explorer / Windows Terminal / any CLI).
中国传统色 DeepSeek Harness 主题包 · Chinese traditional color themes for DeepSeek Harness
Session and turn wall-clock timing for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: per-session total, per-turn duration, and period aggregates.
Approval mode control for DeepSeek Harness: default approval, bypass approval, or bypass that still asks before a sandbox escalation, next to the permission selector. DSH 审批模式插件。
把每台机器上 dsh-bridge 的公网隧道地址汇总到一个 Gist：地址变了自动更新，任何一台机器随时查得到

GitHub-flavored Markdown alerts for DeepSeek Harness: render > [!NOTE], > [!TIP], > [!IMPORTANT], > [!WARNING] and > [!CAUTION] blockquotes as GitHub's alert boxes in replies, and ask the model to prefer them. DSH 的 GitHub 提示块插件。
Load a workspace's own VSCode/Copilot AI configuration (.github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/instructions, .github/skills) into every DeepSeek Harness session. DSH 加载 VSCode/Copilot AI 配置插件。
让 DSH 更贴合 NEVSTOP-LAB 使用习惯的本地化定制插件，各项定制按需开启。

CLI Bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one package bridging six local coding-CLI agents — agy (Google Antigravity CLI), Tencent CodeBuddy Code, Xiaomi MiMo (MiMoCode), OpenCode, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex CLI. Each provider keeps its own agent preset (cordis-agy / codebuddy-first / cordis-mimo / opencode-first / claude-first / codex-first), tools (<id>_run / <id>_continue / <id>_status, plus per-provider model listing), rate-limit/network fallback dialog, and zero-dependency MCP server, unified under a single home-level status light, one settings file, and one bundle patch. Merges agy-first-bridge, codebuddy-first-bridge and mimo-first-bridge.

codebuddy-first bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): prioritize the local codebuddy CLI in every mode (full DSH control, no prompts), with a rate-limit/network fallback dialog, a live status light (dynamic form + home-level plugin), per-project token usage accounting, and a zero-dependency MCP server so any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cherry Studio …) discovers codebuddy itself. Single npm package: install the home-level status light via `dsh plugin --profile web add codebuddy-first-bridge`.
Native Codex and Antigravity subscription accounts inside DeepSeek Harness, based on CLIProxyAPI
DeepSeek Harness 基础默认提示词插件，紧跟在系统提示词之后注入，像 Codex 一样提供核心指导与全局指令
Codex-like diff review plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: interactive side-by-side file diffs, compact floating review bar, and turn-scoped deliverable change tracking.
DeepSeek Harness 的原生执行过程折叠与样式增强插件。提供 Codex 风格用时显示、单任务总折叠且保留插话上下文、流式执行常闭折叠、展开后灰度紧凑样式；纯 UI 交互增强，零模型提示词注入，稳定不破坏消息 DOM。

DuckFleet: one flock of machines, one command. Add a machine once and its ACP delegation tool appears — drive one, several, or all of them from natural language. ／ 鸭群：一群机器，一声令下。添加一台机器即自动获得它的派活工具，用自然语言让某个／某几个／全部机器干活。
A pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: a draggable edge handle, one-shot or cycle counting, and selectable chimes including an airport-style announcement.
Unified plugin & skill manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): inventory, update checks, and safe transactional updates.

LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against a session-capable dsh base (0.2.0 and 0.2.1) the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.
Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable floating ball with a per-session task panel showing done/total, speed and ETA.
Select text in a DSH conversation and explain it in a floating window: independent channel, no session pollution, pinnable to a real session. / 划词解释浮窗：选中即弹、独立通道、不污染主会话、可固定成正式会话。

Publish selected chat text and notes to Yuque Notes from DeepSeek Harness.

Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI — macOS-first defaults, 34 pre-registered features across session/view/clipboard/model/permission/system groups, one-click recording to add your own bindings, silent permission cycling with color feedback.

Progressive tool and skill selection for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Jev

统一管理 Discord、飞书渠道、会话绑定、消息交付与进度卡片的单插件。

DSH 预设提示词插件：10 条内置思维框架 + 自定义提示词（变量、分组、版本历史），面板注入会话输入框，数据本地落盘。
GitHub Trending radar: fetch daily/weekly/monthly boards, analyze every repository, and render an interactive card report inside the Harness Web UI.
Thin, non-duplicating dsh wrapper over the native @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: composition- and settings-driven MCP server mounts.

dsh plugin + agent preset that replicates opencode + oh-my-openagent (omo): opencode's toolchain and system prompt, omo's multi-role subagent orchestration, and browser-side omo role selection + per-role model/fallback settings.

dsh plugin: manage skill enable/disable across global/workspace/session scopes

Model-facing weather tool (weather) over public Open-Meteo APIs, as a DeepSeek Harness profile bundle
DeepSeek Harness 通知 + 状态栏插件：任务完成、需要输入、需要选择时弹系统通知（macOS / Windows / Linux）；macOS 与 Linux（含 UOS、Deepin、麒麟）状态栏常驻小图标，显示任务进度与花费。Windows 没有状态栏，只弹通知。

WebUI restart button for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar-footer trigger that restarts the host on Linux/WSL (systemctl --user restart dsh-web) or Windows (detached watcher + your launcher), either immediately or once every session has finished, with single-flight dedup, a loopback security fence, and a post-restart suppression flag.

MontageX: a full-pipeline AI video production harness for DeepSeek Harness — brief triage, shot planning, storyboard, image/video/audio generation, an infinite shot canvas, and local ffmpeg editing, grading, subtitles and QC, plus team collaboration. MontageX：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的导演全流程 AI 视频制作插件，覆盖需求分诊、镜头排期、分镜、图像/视频/音频生成、无限分镜画布、本地 ffmpeg 剪辑与确定性质检，并内置团队协作。
DSH ticket management plugin: Epic/Story/Ticket hierarchy backed by SQLite + Markdown

Windows desktop shortcut that boots `dsh web` inside your WSL distribution and opens the browser: one double-click entry point for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in WSL, plus a wsl_launcher model tool (install / status / open / uninstall).
QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)
File upload for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a folder button, paste, and drag-drop that save files into the session workspace uploads/, with file cards shown alongside image thumbnails.

侧栏变抽屉、手势开关、宽度可调、键盘不挡输入框、会话标题两行显示、字号不小于 15px。把电脑版界面调成适合手指用的样子。A mobile-friendly layer for DSH Web: swipe drawer sidebar, adjustable width, keyboard avoidance, two-line session titles and a readable font floor.

Use your logged-in web AI (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao...) as model providers in DeepSeek Harness. Web models emit tool calls, DSH runs them under its native permission system, and results return to the same web session. No API keys.
Session-completion reminders for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar entry, system notification, in-app toast and chime.
Agent CI for DeepSeek Harness: turn real sessions into regression cases, replay them in isolated git worktrees, and verify tests, changed files, steps and tokens. Local-only.

Turn the context window into a zen garden: every message or tool result plants a plant (code = cactus, image = flower, error = weed), context compaction is the harvest, and harvested plants become seed currency as the field moves through four seasons.
Right-click a file or folder in the DSH right Sidebar file tree to add it to the conversation as an @ reference, with multi-select batch insertion.

Rewrite the composer draft with the model, in place: a star button (inline SVG icon, same on macOS and Windows) in the composer's trailing controls that turns a rough draft into a clear request, using the topic-matched conversation as context.
Preflight for DeepSeek Harness: predict a task's steps, tokens, duration and cost from your local session history, with a local price table for cost estimates. Read-only and local-only.
Line-level provenance and a decision ledger for agent edits: which session, model and tool wrote each change, browsable by workspace and file, with Markdown/JSON export. Read-only and local-only.

A living composer slime: it matures through life stages on the tokens your agent writes, reacts to errors and context pressure, dozes when idle, loves being petted, splits into a colony, wears a breed hat, molts on compaction, occasionally appears as a rare morph, keeps a diary, and lives in a day/night habitat totaling every session.

Turn-level file undo for DeepSeek Harness: every write and edit is snapshotted before it lands, and the model (undo tool), the human (/undo command) or the GUI button in the message action row can roll back all files a turn changed.
Device-wide token usage for this Harness: Chat and Code scene cards, tokens per day, and a per-model breakdown, folded from the local session logs on the settings Usage page.
为 dsh 的每条 shell 命令按 workdir 计算环境：PATH 追加、venv 自动激活、禁用 mise 自动安装。Replaces the built-in bash executor so every `bash -c` gets an environment resolved from its own working directory.
把 dsh Web 侧边栏的全局面板菜单（插件 / 扩展管理 / 定时任务 / IM …）收起为一排横向图标按钮，可在「设置 → 通用」里切回原列表。Collapse the DSH sidebar panel menu into a horizontal row of compact icon buttons, switchable from Settings → General.

工作流时间线面板（ZCode 形态）：阶段站点时间线 + 表情状态机小脸 + 侧栏/中心双入口 + 历史持久化 + 一键清空全部（立即落盘） | ZCode-style workflow timeline panel for DeepSeek Harness
Ring a real system sound when a DeepSeek Harness agent finishes a task OR needs your input: custom sounds, 4 intensity levels, auto escalation, and a settings card in the GUI.
Atomic plugin releases and signed, recoverable A2A tasks for single-owner DeepSeek Harness fleets.
Live DeepSeek, Kimi and ChatGPT subscription quota widget for DeepSeek Harness web, with an in-app ChatGPT OAuth login card.
Manage DeepSeek Harness conversations from inside a conversation: new_conversation, rename_session, list_sessions, read_session, archive_session model tools plus official-slot UI actions
Turn-atomic message editing, retry, reroll and version-tree navigation for DeepSeek Harness conversations

Vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: delegate image reading to a one-shot subagent on a configurable vision route (MiniMax / Kimi / any OpenAI-compatible provider), keeping image bytes and the vision model's context out of the main session.

By Ruby · DSH plugin: requirement clarification -> PRD -> prd.json (snarktank/ralph compatible) -> acceptance checklist, with a bundled skill.
By Ruby · DSH plugin: Fetch YouTube transcripts, segment them into readable timestamped paragraphs, and export them as cited Markdown notes with DeepSeek Harness.
Drag non-image files/folders into DeepSeek Harness web and insert their real absolute paths into the composer — no more "only images allowed". 拖拽工程文件/文件夹进 DSH，自动定位真实绝对路径插入输入框。

Chat UI colour theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Ships the Mariana palette as its default preset and adds a colour engine: 18 adjustable colour slots, 9 Markdown prose roles, saved presets, WCAG contrast hints and light/dark modes.
Project Atlas — 可视化项目工作台：只读索引本地 AI 项目、技能、会话与产出。
Ask about selected assistant text in an ephemeral DSH Web sidebar using a snapshot of the main conversation.
Caches DSH Web file and session reference indexes for local @ filtering while preserving native mention insertion.

DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar session-row menu enhancements: mark unread via the official completed-reminder dot, copy session ID, delete session with confirmation, archive confirmation, and recursive subagent-session deletion.

在主会话或侧栏选中文字，直接在原文旁写注解。也可标注文件和代码差异，将多条注解随消息一起发送，并从注解记录跳回原文。
Local-first memory layer for DeepSeek Harness: identity root, layered memories, beliefs, emotions, persona and speaking habits in one SQLite file.

DSH 输入框一键提示词增强：把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词，可一键还原。照搬腾讯 WorkBuddy「增强提示词」的双层提示词机制；独立模型调用，不建会话、不写会话记录、不读对话历史。 / One-click prompt enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness composer: rewrite the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, then restore the original with one click. Ported from Tencent WorkBuddy's EnhancePrompt two-layer prompt design; the model call is independent and never touches the session log or conversation history.

Read-only monitor for local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions: live task board, per-session tails, blocking reply wait, Markdown export, and optional IM push via dsh-im

Writes DSH_HOME\dsh-launcher\settings.json (serviceLifetime: 0 always-on, 1 tray-resident, 2 follow-window); the shell applies it on window close / tray exit. No runtime dependencies.
Russian language pack for the DSH web GUI
Custom background plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: gradient presets, solid colors, image URLs and local images with opacity and size controls

Edit, delete or fold any message of a DeepSeek Harness conversation — the user's own and the assistant's. User edits, assistant edits, tool-result edits and deletions rewrite what the model sees through the core's message projection (no placeholder, no correction prefix, thinking kept for assistant replies, and editable in the panel); plus display-only folds and fork. Desktop-adapted fork of dsh-chat-editor from DSH-CyberWorkStation.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: supervise a local workbuddy2api gateway process and write its models into an editable llm-pi-ai provider

Sidebar badge that marks the current DeepSeek peak-pricing window (24-hour schedule bar, countdown, click to copy) plus a settings card that splits your logged usage into peak / off-peak tokens and compares what it actually cost against all-peak and all-off-peak.

Chinese classical poetry viewer for DeepSeek Harness Web: a '诗词' conversation-view tab (next to 对话/轨迹) with token-free search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, and AI explanation via your own DSH session. 免 token 诗词查询插件：会话页头新增「诗词」标签页。

Global Chinese calendar & weather for DeepSeek Harness Web: a '熊猫日历' conversation-view tab (next to 对话/轨迹) with solar/lunar dates, ganzhi/zodiac, solar terms, traditional & international festivals, China public holidays (incl. 调休 workdays), multi-city weather, an epoch↔date converter with time-zone selection, and on-this-day history (大事记 + 名人诞辰) — free data sources, no API key. 熊猫日历：会话页头新增「熊猫日历」标签页，公历/农历/干支/生肖/节气、中国传统与国际通用节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区、自动处理夏令时）、历史上的今天（大事记 + 名人诞辰）；全部数据源免费、无需 API Key。

DSH plugin: universal unit conversion across length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy and power, with Chinese/English aliases. 单位换算 DSH 插件（长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率，支持中英文单位名）。
Manage the conversation view tabs (对话/轨迹/…) in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: enable, hide, reorder and rename view labels, with locale-aware copy (zh/en) and npm update reminders.
DSH 插件：Windows 系统盘清理能力 —— 扫描 → 五级分级（可安全删除/谨慎删除/建议迁移/保护名单/长期防护）→ 用户确认 → 分层执行与迁移
DSH Web settings page for custom CSS, background images, local image assets, and a user JS file.
跨会话事实记忆：SQLite 权威事实库 + 三工具（memory_search / memory_write / memory_forget）+ 常驻目录与每轮提醒 + 提案队列 + 向量/重排通道 + 事实图谱 + JSONL 导出导入 + 梦层（长文整理，双时态/热度/主题索引/历史回填，默认关闭，采纳才入库）。只记「下次会话仍成立」的事实，带来源与时间。
DeepSeek Harness 登录门卫插件：为 dsh Web UI 提供外部访问入口 + 用户名密码登录验证

Mem0 persistent memory for the DeepSeek Harness web profile — automatic recall injection, tidal-coalesced memory writes, and mem0_search/add/update/delete tools against a self-hosted Mem0 server (X-API-Key). Zero-intrusion bundle plugin; no dsh source changes.

Generic per-turn prompt injector for the DeepSeek Harness web profile — manage a list of context prompts (with enable switch) in the settings page; every round of conversation injects each enabled prompt as a notice line (「上下文注入 xxx」) into the model context, exactly like the mem0 recall reminder. Host-only logic + client settings card; zero dsh source changes.

给 DSH 加一个「灵魂」：在设置里写 Markdown 人设卡，按 会话 → 工作区 → 默认卡 解析后注入系统提示词；聊天标题栏和新会话页可给单个会话换卡；模型只读（persona_read）。只做人设，不含记忆。

Generic Web content fetcher plugin for DeepSeek Harness with dual pluggable data sources (CDP browser + Tavily). Each data source is registered as its own tool so the LLM can pick context-appropriately. Zero-intrusion bundle plugin; follows strategy pattern.

Search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web profile (ctx.web): defaults to the AnySearch unified API (anonymous free tier works with no API key; add a key for the paid quota), and still speaks any SearXNG-compatible JSON endpoint. Includes an in-settings configuration card. Zero-intrusion bundle plugin.

Ships the tushare-data research skill to every DSH session; set your Tushare token in the Plugins settings tab, or via /tushare-token.

A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.
本地插件：让 DSH 操作其原生侧边栏浏览器，支持页面读取、截图和受控交互。
