Umbrella bundle for Hindsight coding-agent memory in DeepSeek Harness: the memory engine plus a visual configuration panel (local client settings, and server-side bank data over HTTP). · Hindsight 记忆的可视化配置面板（伞包：引擎 + 面板）。

工程决策笔记：把每次非平凡改动写成 .agents/notes 下的 Markdown（问题 / 决定 / 被否决的备选 / 后果），进 git、可像代码一样 review；提供 note_search/note_read/note_write/note_verify/note_skip 五个原生工具、你发下一条消息时结算上一轮、改过代码就必须结账的钩子，以及随包分发的 write-notes-like-deepseek 技能。另附把这些笔记渲染成侧边栏看板的面板（浏览层，非本体）。
DSH proxy center: global TUN, subscriptions, nodes, and multi-hop dialer-proxy chains
Shows each session's project (Workspace) name under its title in the DSH sidebar's flat session list (单列表).
Chat Bridge for DeepSeek Harness, derived from QQ Bridge. Connects OneBot and QQ via SnowLuma.
Configurable knowledge retrieval with source citations

Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness web (China-ready): Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR via a local bridge. Mic button in the composer, streaming recognition, cursor-aware insertion, silence auto-stop.
考研每日一题 — DSH 插件：每科每天一道独立校验过的考研题，含倒计时、错题本、收藏与按题隔离的追问。
给 AI 对话打表：按 DeepSeek 官方价显示每轮 / 每会话 / 每工作区人民币费用——token 三档 + 峰谷分时，2026-11-01 起网页搜索/抓取按次计费（¥5/1000 次）；WorkBuddy 接入的模型另按积分（✦）估算并用真实余额校准
DeepSeek Harness 内置插件：遥控器 / 方向键空间导航（焦点按屏幕位置移动，OK 激活，返回分层退出，会话长按滚动加速）
Encrypted SSH host vault and model-facing SSH tools for the DeepSeek Harness — Windows only
VMware Workstation / Player / Fusion virtual machine control for the DeepSeek Harness — power, snapshots, live resources and network configuration
DeepSeek 平台用量面板（dsh web 客户端插件）：余额、每日 token 用量与花费、缓存命中率、月度热力图，入口在侧边栏底部
DSH 提示音插件：任务完成 / 需要回答 / 需要授权 / 出错时用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音提醒，可在「通用设置」逐事件选音、上传自定义音频，对话左下角有临时静音喇叭；兼容 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端（Electron）与网页端。
DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：在「设置」里上传壁纸，并调整磨砂玻璃（透明度 / 模糊 / 饱和度）。
决策地图 (Decision Map) — a DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that renders the current session's execution trace as a readable timeline plus stat cards.
Preview-first prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: it clarifies a draft without inventing facts, asks instead of filling placeholders, and writes back only when you click apply.
Install and update six DSH enhancement plugins from Desktop/Web configuration or the CLI, including Motion UI.
Readable conversational UI, interactive HTML/SVG, editable motion and local MP4 production for DeepSeek Harness.
Discover, install, update and uninstall plugins in the active DSH Desktop or Web profile.
OpenCode gateway headers, provider Default helpers, and optional reasoning augmentation for DSH.
DeepSeek Harness 的 soul.md 风格人设 + 长期记忆插件：设置页输入人设卡名称和内容即可，文件由插件自动管理；可按工作区指定人设、聊天框可给会话单独切人设；AI 可自行演化人设与记忆（soul_read/soul_update/memory_*）。
DeepSeek Harness 的 TencentDB Agent Memory 移植：L0 对话捕获 → L1 结构化记忆提取 → L2 场景/L3 画像，自动召回注入 + 记忆/对话搜索工具；复用现有 ~/.memory-tencentdb/memory-tdai 数据；附 Web UI 设置栏。
DeepSeek Harness 外置视觉模型插件：inspect_image 把本地图片或 http(s) 图片 URL 发给任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，视觉模型看图的文字回答直接带回对话；附 Web UI 设置栏。
Independent Codex Guardian-style approval reviewer for DSH.
Independent Codex Guardian-style approval reviewer for DSH.
Mind maps and Excalidraw canvas with CLIs, browser editors and a DSH plugin
Read Plane: cross-agent session discovery, turn inspection, workspace aggregation and distillation from raw local session files.
DeepSeek Harness 通知中心：标签页鲸鱼状态灯（绿=跑完 / 琥珀=待处理）+ 浏览器系统通知（完成/待处理提示、45 个 opencode 音效可选、音量可配）。
⚡ DSH 多机算力组网：把朋友间、局域网、云上 ECS 的闲置算力汇聚成分布式 AI 算力池，一台机调用整个团队任意一台机的算力，任务派发、agent 执行、结果回流与会话保留。一个人掌控多台 Harness，并行推进多个开发与研究项目。
Surface and border colors, named presets, palette spectra, and radius presets for the DSH Web GUI
飞书对话查看器：DSH Web 客户端插件，在会话头部展示与飞书 bot 的私聊记录（数据来自 OpenClaw 独立网关的 agent 会话文件，同源路由 /feishu-chat.json）。
狼兔一一任务宠物：DSH Web 桌面宠物插件，可在狼/兔/一一三个角色间切换，狼兔各有全套 16 个表情、随 Agent 任务状态自动变化，也可手动挑选表情。资源持久化打包，Host 同源路由提供，无需公网。

桃桃股市工具 — 1:1 复刻自 LeekBox（dsh-leekbox 0.19.3，MIT）的 A股看盘助手：实时行情、毫秒级全市场搜索（代码/名称/拼音首字母+实时价格）、大盘指数与市场情绪温度计、个股详情弹窗（当日分时图·资金流向·F10财务摘要·同花顺式前复权K线）、自选股（持仓成本+实时盈亏+价格预警）、条件选股（评分+多策略交叉）、三源聚合 7×24 快讯、ETF/可转债/LOF。Runs as a DSH web client plugin.
Independent second-model reviews for DeepSeek Harness assistant decisions
Durable reviewed task cards for DeepSeek Harness
Obsidian vault table of contents as a Harness conversation view: folders, tags, word counts, headings, @-path copying and vault switching.
Verdandi White Vow skin for the DSH Web GUI: deep crimson navigation, bridal-white workspace, soft-gold knight details, and scoped plugin-safe surfaces.
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器调试与操作能力：ctx.browser 能力服务 + cdp / electron 双 provider + webpage_* 工具 + 客户端观察面板；cdp 连外部 Chrome，electron 开桌面端独立窗口。
Persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: memory_* model tools, automatic memory:recall prompt injection, /memory/api JSON routes, and a 设置→记忆 (Settings → Memory) management panel.

DSH plugin for the Axolotl Launcher (美西螈启动器): the launcher's 269 MCP tools folded into 9 domain tools plus status and raw, control-session lifetime handled for you, screenshots returned as real images
把 Penpot 接进 DSH：三种连接目标 + REST 读写通道（不用浏览器也能改设计稿）。

DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量与预算面板：官方模式读取宿主已登录账号的余额、账单、每日用量与费用；本地模式读取 DSH 全部 Provider 的会话日志，按可编辑的逐模型费率估算 Token、费用和 API 次数，支持用量日历、趋势、模型排行、会话排行与官方/本地对账。支持主题切换，以及侧边栏 Token、消费、API 次数指标的开关、改名、换图标和拖动排序；可设置每日 Token／CNY 限额，达到上限后熔断所有后续模型调用，在状态栏显示红色告警并在对应会话返回失败原因，北京时间次日自动恢复；顶部状态栏与侧边栏共享同一份今日用量快照，保持数据一致。 官方账单口径：复用 DSH 已登录的 DeepSeek 平台账户读取余额与账单，按账户汇总（可包含该账户在其他客户端或机器的调用），不提供单独配置 API Key 查询账单的入口。通过 API Key 或其他 Provider 发出的 DSH 请求，在会话日志上报 usage 后进入本地统计；本地金额按费率估算，不等于 Provider 实际账单。

二十四节气卡片 + 内置 jieqi skill：对话区标题栏下沿的一颗小圆点，悬停展开今天的节气、日柱时辰、七十二候、消息卦、养生一句与年表，点日柱看今天适合做的事，卦页能铜钱摇一卦并回看七天 · A quiet drag-anywhere solar-term dot under the conversation header, with day/hour pillars, a day reading page, a seven-day cast log and the jieqi skill bundled.
DSH 插件：集中管理 MCP 服务配置，并展示每个 MCP 的工具清单、参数与返回契约
DSH 插件：把 cordis.patch.yml 里模型条目的 input 模态声明做成设置面板里的勾选框（写入/移除 input: [text, image]），省掉手改 YAML 的缩进风险。只改 DSH 侧声明，不改 API 能力。
DeepSeek Harness 会话进度看板：侧边栏入口（三色角标）+ 全部/进行中/已完成分栏 + 工作空间筛选。Session progress board for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar badge, All/Running/Done sections, workspace filter.
DSH Web GUI skin plugin: six palettes (blue/orange/green/gray/purple/rose) across light and dark, plus a hex-grid ripple effect. Toggleable at runtime; disabling restores the stock look exactly.
把你已登录的百度搭子（DuMate）变成 DSH 的模型供应商：模型进选择器、对话默认走云端网关（App 不用开着）、积分余额/消耗/每日签到作只读读数挂在输入框上。支持桌面版登录态或手动导入两个 Cookie 两种登录方式。

MATLAB in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: a VS Code-like .m editor with a persistent MATLAB session (figures really open), file tree with extra folder mounts, live workspace variables, .mlx preview, and an agent-facing matlab_run tool.

R in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: an RStudio-shaped workbench with a persistent R session, R syntax highlighting, a file tree with extra folders, an environment pane, a plot gallery, and an agent-facing r_run tool.
One goal, a co-evolving harness team. Native DSH companions, shared capabilities and continued work, with visible configuration and delivery facts.

On-demand review for DeepSeek Harness: audits the uncommitted changes in a workspace in one of its modes (code review, architecture review, or a mode the user writes) and renders the report as a card in the conversation — or, until the session's first turn starts and the harness draws a transcript at all, above the composer — for the human who asked for it.
按工作区记录未完成任务：自动捕获排队/执行中的用户指令，持久化到磁盘，一键恢复重发。

Sidebar restart button for DeepSeek Harness with double confirmation: one click opens a two-step confirm flow, then restarts the dsh web process (WebUI + backend, one process) and auto-relaunches it with the same args. Cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows), no hardcoded paths, configurable. / DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏一键重启按钮（带二次确认）：点击后需连续两次确认才会重启 dsh web 进程（WebUI 与后台同属该进程），并以相同参数自动重新拉起。跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows），无硬编码路径，可配置。

webCandidates.description: MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page.
DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

A DSH PreToolUse decision gate — five questions before every shell command, then allow, ask, or deny. Swappable judge backend, path-scoped exemption, JSONL decision log, and a pre-authorized list for approved irreversible steps.

Permanently delete one conversation — archived or not — from its sidebar row menu in DeepSeek Harness, with a confirmation dialog. Removes the session log, its projection cache, archive/pin state, and bound reminders. · 在 DSH 侧栏会话菜单里彻底删除单个对话（含已归档），并清理日志、投影缓存、归档/置顶状态与提醒。
Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with live fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
Mail channel for DSH: one dedicated mailbox per machine, email as session entry, replies continue the session
DSH web plugin: a real-time proxy (mihomo) status panel — active node, latency, run state, port.

DSH web plugin: a Cmd/Ctrl+F find bar (like the browser's built-in find) for the desktop Electron shell, which has none. Centre/right segmented scope picker (hidden while the right column is collapsed), collapsed regions skipped and re-added on expand, with highlight-all, match count, and Enter/Shift+Enter navigation.
Choose Git for Windows bash as the agent shell in DeepSeek Harness on Windows. Additive: the official PowerShell executor and tools stay untouched.
DSH 生活质量包：给 DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端补上体验细节的插件（源自 DeepSeekGUI）——沙箱 Low 标签与工作区授权自动修复、DeepSeekGUI 皮肤、四项上报默认关、改动/Git/项目管理/记忆四个视图、项目与全局记忆、删除已归档会话、本地技能库、用量统计、流式平滑、Git 与 PR 工具、应用内更新、系统通知。

All-in-one inline media for DeepSeek Harness chat: ```mip-img / ```mip-video / ```mip-audio fences render images (cards + lightbox + grids, TGA→PNG), native <video> and <audio> players right inside the message (house pattern of img-preview/dsh-mermaid/pbr-render). Image route whole-reads local workspace images; media route streams with HTTP Range seeking and an ffmpeg transcode fallback (cached) for containers browsers cannot play (mkv/avi/flv/wma...). Trust-fenced (loopback + webRuntime.trustedHosts) so LAN/mobile access keeps working. Supersedes the separate img-preview + video/audio fence plugins.
会话内待办事项：右上角悬浮待办面板（展开/收起 + 📌 钉住不自动收起）+ 服务器端跨端存储（~/.dsh/dsh-session-todos）+ 会话列表未完成图标。纯插件，不改 DSH 源码。
Workspace file upload with a paperclip dock: upload multiple files into <workspace>/.uploaded_files/<sessionId>/ (per-session isolation), and insert @UPLOAD: references into the composer.
彻底删除已归档会话及磁盘日志

Converts documents (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, PDF) to clean Markdown via the Rust firecrawl-anydoc crate and describes every embedded image with a vision model. Host plugin exposing a `convert_document` tool; the conversion + batched-vision engine is a bundled Python wrapper (`converter/anydoc_vlm.py`).
Composer 'Web Search' toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. When on, the agent is forced (via a mandatory system-prompt directive) to call web_search before answering.
给 DeepSeek Harness 的界面读数层：输入框状态栏的实时会话花费（人民币、按实际厂商/模型与峰谷时段折算）、输入框工具行里模型选择器左侧的 DeepSeek 账户余额、品牌行的峰谷时段标记、把任意一条回复作为上下文引用的 @ 按钮、侧栏右缝里可自定义的快捷按钮条（含设置页），以及侧栏会话菜单里的「复制会话 ID / 删除会话 / 导出会话日志」。
DSH 会话回收站：会话详情归档入口、回收站多选还原/彻底删除、活跃会话保护。 · Session trash & permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.
Two-way bridge between Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session.
模型测活矩阵 — 测试模型选项中所有可用模型，标注可用/不可用并在尾部对齐。四色：绿=可用·免费，黄=可用·计费，灰=不可用·积分/费用不足，红=不可用·无法连接。免费/额度判定优先复用 Our Free Model 插件的实测结果。
Bilibili plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
带功能说明的 dsh 插件清单标签页：在 设置 → 插件 中新增“插件说明”页，内置常用插件中文说明，并自动读取所有已安装插件包的 package.json 描述。

Browser-style Back / Forward / Refresh controls in the DSH window title bar, shared by Sessions and plugin panels, with a confirmation before refreshing a running Session; display text follows the DSH locale (English / Chinese). 给 DSH 客户端加浏览器式页面后退、前进与刷新（顶栏按钮，中英双语随全局设置）。
Global scrollbar thickness tuner for the DeepSeek Harness client: widen every scrollbar and adjust the width from the plugin page. 全局加粗 DSH 客户端滚动条，可在插件页调节宽度。

Workspace suite for the DSH Web client: an explorer-style picker (browse, inline folder creation, path input, enter-which-workspace chooser), a nested workspace tree with collapse-all and cascade delete, a per-workspace overview page (subtree token totals, expanded session tree, turn jumps, dependencies card, README), and a root-level conversation workspace menu.

Standard mode plus confirm-before-execute, adapted to DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. Usage: start a session in this mode, describe the task, answer the questionnaire the agent sends (choices, multi-select, free text, a plain-language explanation per question), then submit; the agent executes only after the answers. The browser half paints each explanation in the option-description gray.
Smart model setup for DeepSeek Harness third-party API providers: recognize a model ID and fill in context window, input modalities and reasoning levels.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) applied to every provider via the agent/request hook, with live settings persistence.
Right-click session menu + sidebar session manager for DeepSeek Harness web: pin, rename, archive, continue, export, copy cwd/id/deep-link, open in explorer or a new window.
智能路由：供应商自动路由，任何渠道报错自动切换下一家（含 4xx），对话栏一键启用/停用，多链管理。Provider auto-routing with fallback to the next channel on any error (incl. 4xx).

DeepSeek Harness plugin with two switchable sub-features: workspace+ (label several directories inside one workspace and reference them by absolute path — the @ composer source, the row button, the workspace_dirs tool — plus a delete-workspace confirmation that can archive the conversations first, a switchable recent-conversation sort for the sidebar workspace list, and a folded-workspace list that keeps running, waiting and unread conversations visible) and 通知/notice (Windows native notifications for running conversations, merged from dsh-notice). Each sub-feature is its own loader row and can be toggled on the plugin page; each row's settings page opens from the plugin detail page, not from Settings.
Import and browse Claude Code and Codex sessions.
Multitask 减震器模式（Agent preset）：主对话只做需求理解、任务下发与结果汇总，读文件/跑命令/构建/搜索等污染性工作全部下放子代理。含协调者窄工具面、四类 worker、只读元数据工具 file_info 与子代理危险操作的审批闸门，零 DSH 源码改动。
DSH Web GUI plugin: render this machine's local git commits as a GitHub-style contribution heatmap, aggregated across many repositories
Diagnosis-first learning runtime for DeepSeek Harness — a live learning map, structured lessons, and persistent learner state, driven by the Universal Diagnostic Tutor skill.
鲸鱼记事本 — 你的 Agent 年度/月度/周度/日报：从会话事件日志生成数据新闻官式报告，任意区间、定时生成。
Full-screen task board for DeepSeek Harness: every session as a live mini conversation with status, search and inline reply.
Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web. Official Light / Dark / System stay in charge.
Local read-only original conversation search with literal Chinese matching and exact sessionId + seq provenance
Goal Map: a read-only goal-to-plan progress route and session mindmap for DeepSeek Harness
独立的 DSH QQ 群聊插件：人设、主动/被动搭话、DSH 模型选择；与桌宠数据/记忆完全分开
刷B站：她自己在家里刷 B 站的手 —— 打开、成候选、读文字稿、记一笔决定。她自己不再写日记、不写信、不存记忆：那些都在世界插件里（信的工具叫 write_letter）。刷过的记录由世界的 biliBridge 读成记忆，当她写日记的素材。设置页在「设置 → 刷B站」。
DSH 原生抖音工具与独立 DeepSeek 本地助手
住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的鲸鱼娘：会说话（本地 ASR + 晓伊语音）、会看屏幕（采集卡/窗口捕获）、会陪玩（回合制与策略游戏代打）。基于 dsh-pet（MIT, PC2005-cloud）扩展。
独立的 DSH QQ 群聊插件：人设、主动/被动搭话、DSH 模型选择；与桌宠数据/记忆完全分开
微信版：和 dsh-qq-group 同一套机制（接话评分/主动搭话/记忆/画像/心情/防护），传输层换成 OneBot 11 —— 由 shim 把微信翻译成 OneBot，插件本体不改

Redraws line-level diffs on DeepSeek Harness file-mutation tool cards (dedup + inline emphasis), covers run_code (PTC) sub-calls and str_replace_editor, adds a per-turn changed-files card, and reveals any of those paths in the OS file manager through the plugin's own host route.

Inlines each image block only in the request where it first appears, then swaps it for the harness's own placeholder text on every later request. On by default for every provider; each provider can be switched off or limited to specific models from the plugin page.
dsh-TokenLens (词元透镜) — provider-aware plan capacity plus local token statistics (today/7d/30d/all-time, by harness/provider/model/workspace) for DSH.
Russian interface for DeepSeek Harness (client locale plugin)
DSH-Guild

The order is the feature — an npm publish is irreversible and a draft is not, so a refused npm push leaves the Release unpublished and the pipeline can be resumed, or the Release published without npm. DSH 任务经验记忆：自动整理候选、人工审阅采纳、相关任务召回、来源与范围核查。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 邮件工作台：图文回复与草稿、确认定时发送、Google/Outlook 授权、多邮箱及可选邮件任务。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 音视频处理：本机 FFmpeg 裁切、转码、字幕、音轨、GIF、抽帧与视频总览图。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 偶发测试调查：重复运行、失败记录、工作区隔离列表与写操作确认。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH HTML 视频工作台：官方 HyperFrames 技能、工程检索、模板、素材排序、预览与本地 MP4 导出。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 极简 PTC 预设：Python / TypeScript 工具编排、Windows 终端适配与宿主关键约束保留。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
给出材料，拿到可以交付的演示文稿。 可直接下载成品 欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 极简 PTC 预设：Python / TypeScript 工具编排、Windows 终端适配与宿主关键约束保留。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH React 视频工作台：官方 Remotion 技能、工程检索、模板、素材排序、Studio 预览与 MP4 导出。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 代码审阅：独立发现缺陷、证据复核、修复跟踪与门禁；支持三种审阅模式。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH RSS / Atom 工作台：分类来源目录、订阅读取、搜索与 OPML 导入导出，由用户选择来源。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 代码安全工作台：本地静态检查、Git 改动审查、证据与修复复核，可选增强扫描器。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH Slack 工具：通知、Socket Mode 收件箱、线程回复、连接状态与受控重连。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 数据库工具：SQLite / MySQL / PostgreSQL 查询、结构与统计、只读保护和写操作确认。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
DSH 语音工具：Edge TTS 朗读、兼容 ASR 转写、工作区文件保护与并发输出。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。

DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint: per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page (client plugin) for editing the deployment from the frontend
Evidence-backed built-in capability inspector with fail-closed controls for DeepSeek Harness Web.
星穹召唤 · Astral Summon — an anime gacha card game plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Pull cards, then chat with the characters you own.
Tighten the chat transcript: markdown line height and paragraph spacing, adjustable from Settings → General.
Story Mode (故事模式) agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md memory cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.

Sign in with ChatGPT inside DeepSeek Harness and run ChatGPT plan models directly: OpenAI Sign-in-with-ChatGPT (SIWC) OAuth token sharing feeding an official Responses API adapter. 在 DeepSeek Harness 里登录 ChatGPT 账号并直接使用 ChatGPT 模型。

DSH 底栏管理插件：原生底部状态栏超长、内容易被截断；本插件提供接近原生体验的可配置状态栏——16 个信息段任意开关/排序，并带换行、实时 TPS、费用估算等多项实用选项（适配 DSH 0.2.1）。The native DSH bottom status bar is too long and parts get truncated; this plugin delivers a near-native, fully configurable status bar — 16 toggleable/reorderable segments, plus useful options such as wrapping, live TPS and cost estimation (DSH 0.2.1).

DSH 侧边栏助手插件（dsh-zhushou）：在侧边栏管理/选择助手，选中后在 DSH 主会话内直接以助手人设/模型/参数对话；不选则保持原生会话。A DSH sidebar assistant plugin: manage and pick assistant personas in the sidebar, then chat with them inside the main DSH session; leave it unselected for the native experience.
DSH plugin ecosystem diet and compatibility analyzer
Rewrites the composer draft into a clearer, executable prompt in one click: strength and detail sliders, switchable model, 11 toggleable rules.
Sidebar restart button for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: one click fully quits and reopens the app.

Chat / Work dual mode for DSH: Chat mode embeds the official DeepSeek web chat in a leased Electron webview (no plugin-side network calls, no API usage in Chat mode); Work mode is the normal DSH agent UI.
悬浮球显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth 登录），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。可拖动、可固定，点击展开详情面板。
多模型分层协同：规划 → 执行 → 审查 → 自动返工。端点、协议、模型与层级都在设置面板里配。
自定义 DSH WebUI 背景：图库随机、自由拉伸裁切框、不透明度、高斯模糊、面板透明、多图交叉淡化轮播。
Prompt Stash — a markdown prompt editor in the right sidebar, with a global archive, templates and grouping.
Thinking supervisor for the DeepSeek Harness: an independent reviewer model watches the current agent's reasoning and injects corrections.
Side-loaded Codex/macOS-style concise conversation mode for DeepSeek Harness WebUI

A general-purpose chat agent for DeepSeek Harness built on a parent-agent + worker sub-agent architecture: the parent plans, delegates, manages worker context, model and reasoning effort, workspace, and permission approval, and reports results. Requires DeepSeek Harness Desktop >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0.

Interactive widgets for DeepSeek Harness chats, as Claude and ChatGPT draw them: the model writes HTML, SVG, CSS, and JavaScript that runs in a sandboxed frame in the reply, styled like the host, with fifteen common libraries shipped for offline use and every control responding in the browser without another model call.
Simple Dock: interactive composer stats dock for DeepSeek Harness — performance / brief / token / estimated-cost panels with glass styling
Map-reduce council of subagents for the DeepSeek Harness: one task fans out to independent members, their findings are deduplicated, verified by a separate panel, and reduced to a quorum report
A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
A calm, unified prompt queue for DeepSeek Harness with smart expansion, persistent confirmations, editing, steering, accessible reordering, and official queue removal.

Spread one conversation's requests across several API keys of the same provider, cap concurrency per provider / model / key with a slot reserved for the main process, recover from HTTP 429 by rotating keys, and show each key's remaining balance.
在 Web GUI 里可视化管理 agent team 的角色：每个角色是一份独立 preset，开关它自己的能力行（工具 / 技能 / MCP / 分组 / loop / AGENTS.md），只引用现有行、不新增行、不改任何现有文件。
为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的会话菜单增加带二次确认的永久删除功能。
Provider-based inline context picker for DeepSeek Harness
Preset-selected Codex App Server Agent Runtime for DeepSeek Harness
Workspace-scoped Monaco file manager for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness plugin converted from ayghri/i-have-adhd: ADHD-friendly output shaping that takes effect in a single session, never globally.
让 DSH 检索本机 MimaVault 密码库中的密码、API Key 与动态验证码；明文默认不进入模型上下文。
肥鱼笔记：保存会话、编辑 Markdown、导出图文，通过专用 GitHub 私有仓库跨设备同步。
星愿 XingYuan for DeepSeek Harness: 对话创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动、记忆与图表的 Agent Preset 组合包
A Feishu/Lark channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): use the same agent from Feishu chat, with every step (reasoning, tool calls, results, timing) shown as a card.
Starter packs for DeepSeek Harness: install a tested set of community plugins in one click, from a 整合包 tab on the Plugins page.

Miniflux for the dsh web GUI: AI-written morning/evening digests, per-feed daily EPUB picks, agent tools (miniflux_feeds / miniflux_search / miniflux_read / miniflux_digest / miniflux_epub / miniflux_star). Configured from the plugin settings page.
Provider-scoped HTTP/HTTPS forward proxy middleware for DeepSeek Harness LLM requests
DSH 桌面陪伴：dsh-pet 动画、独立 API 聊天与经过授权的屏幕观察
Shows the remaining DeepSeek account balance under the message composer, with a details popover and a peak/off-peak pricing badge
折叠一切 (Fold anything): one installable bundle with two plugins — fold left-sidebar entries and conversation view tabs into their More menu.

动效与主视口性能增强 (Multimotion) for DeepSeek Harness: message entrances, streaming shimmer, expand/collapse, directional motion blur, offscreen weak-loading with incremental resize reflow — plus a viewport subpackage.

DSH community plugin (Russian localization fork of dsh-db-tool): chat-operated multi-database admin tool with sidebar management, project-scoped grants, per-grant database allowlists, ro/rw modes and dangerous-operation confirmation
DSH-КБ-plugin · 插件设计局 — 把 DSH 的 cordis 服务图画成三维分子，并在图边上设计插件链。3D Cordis service graph and plugin-chain designer for DeepSeek Harness.
WeChat (iLink) channel for DeepSeek Harness with a durable serial message queue
Show prefill speed directly in the status bar.
Show account balance directly in the status bar.
DSH「输入」插件：摄像头 / 麦克风 / 虚拟采集器（muse_galaxy 等）统一成一路输入，自动按 VAD 分段语音、按间隔自动推帧，并把识别结果插话进会话；提供 miraDevice 服务与 input_* 工具，设置页「输入」，依赖 mira_media
DSH Live2D 看板娘插件：默认隐藏 + 常驻开关、模型/表情/动作/背景菜单、20 个 JSON 工具（状态/显隐/切模型/资源缺失诊断/背景/截图）、OpenAI 与阿里云 TTS（600 凭据）
DSH「声音」插件：语音合成（TTS）/ 语音识别（ASR）/ 断句（VAD 切分），持有唯一一份阿里云凭据；对外提供 miraMedia 服务与 device_say / media_status，设置页「声音」，页面侧带一个全局播放器
DSH 界面交互（形象）：对话/轨迹之后的「形象」页签（LIVE2D 主位 + 频谱环，右侧栏视频/音频来自 mira_device）；表情/动作/显隐/模型 5 个工具与设置页「形象」。说话与输入分别由 mira_media / mira_device 提供；4.1.0 起不再有账号/权限模型
DeepSeek Harness 经验复盘插件：采集、提炼、人工审阅、经验沉淀与博客联动。
DeepSeek Harness 经验复盘插件：采集、提炼、人工审阅、经验沉淀与博客联动。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a DeepSeek-web-style conversation rail on the right edge of the chat column — one dash per human message that expands into a jump list on hover
DeepSeek Harness plugin: real-time DeepSeek account balance widget with official top-up entry
DeepSeek Harness plugin: text-to-image output with in-chat image cards, download button, history gallery, and provider selection tabs

DSH 桌宠 bundle 插件（v2.3）。住在 Web 界面右下角的精灵宠物 + 一个独立于浏览器的原生桌面窗口：随 Agent 工作状态切换动作（对话中专注工作、回合思考、等待审批、出错摔倒），对话完成时跳跃庆祝并全机播放提示音。原生桌面窗口最小化/关闭网页也照样存在，悬停显示当前工作区与对话名，双击用 Edge 打开 Harness 网页。内置多宠物注册表（跨重启保留）、每宠物独立音频、素材 HTTP 路由与注册即校验（严格防图片错位）。配套技能 dsh-pet-forge 可一句话生成并导入新宠物（生图模型 + Blender 3D 建模 + 动作/音效设计），也能直接导入视频（抽帧 + 抠绿幕 + 按动作切分）。v2.1 新增宠物社区：按 DPSL-1.0 开放共享协议发布到 GitHub 的桌宠会被自动收录，可在插件内置画廊里浏览、下载、一键安装。v2.3 适配 DSH 0.2 桌面版：修好桌面端庆祝音效（0.2 起默认组合不再提供 ctx.shell，改为 shell 不可用时直接 spawn powershell），并新增单击挑衅动作（pet.json 的 interactions.clickAnim，播完自动回落）。
Switch a DSH task's Agent preset (mode) from the composer toolbar, including tasks that have already started. Features AUTO mode that selects a preset based on task content.
侧栏面板自由拖动：长按拖到任意位置排序，拖进「更多」即收纳、拖出即放回。Sidebar panel organizer for DeepSeek Harness: drag any panel to reorder, drop it into More to fold.
Souls-style event overlays for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

Reflect2Evolve memory plugin: layered L1/L2/L3 memory, reflection-weighted value backprop, cross-task policy induction, skill crystallization, and three-tier retrieval for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and DeepSeek Harness.
DSH 办公室动画仪表盘：工作日志 / 产出物 / 预览 / token 统计，一键生成可独立打开的动画办公室 HTML
DeepSeek API balance and token usage monitor for the dsh web sidebar
Quote conversation text with optional annotations and send it to the model as structured reference context in DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Tab autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web composer: next-message ghost text, inline draft completion and keyboard candidate cycling
Live Kanban operations board for DeepSeek Harness Web
Explicit minimal-solution coding guidance for DeepSeek Harness. Registers six load-on-request Ponytail skills and a localized Settings page.
Visual reference moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: capture links, Mobbin and Are.na references, pin a style guide, and turn inspiration into your own UI components.

Move a DeepSeek Harness conversation into another workspace: copies the transcript into a new session bound to the target folder, archives the original, and can register a new workspace folder from the picker.
Optimize the DeepSeek Harness composer draft into a structured prompt through the session model, reusing the Prompt Optimizer rewrite engine. Choose plain, sections, or role-task-goal output.

webCandidates.description: Skills settings for DeepSeek Harness: install, add, edit, and validate agent skills on disk, see what the registry actually serves to agents, and block conflicting saves.
Workspace status marks, a pinned-conversation section and pinned-only notifications for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

Quote Ask (引问) for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: select text in the main conversation, right-click, and either attach it to the next main-chat prompt or ask in a temporary side conversation. Side-chat artifacts are deleted on close.
Independent intranet database connections and schema browser for DeepSeek Harness
DSH 右下角常驻的「鸡你太美」篮球小鸡桌面宠物：像素帧动画、拖拽吸附、贴左镜像、Q 弹按压、点击音效、等待回答提醒、每轮消耗气泡、账单明细与 DeepSeek 余额（API Key 或 DeepSeek 账号登录均可）。
DeepSeek Harness 行情看板插件：A股/港股/美股、外汇（含交叉盘）、国内/国外商品期货与全球指数的实时行情列表，自选与自定义分组持久化、搜索添加、自动刷新，无图表。
DeepSeek Harness 待办清单插件：可折叠大卡片任务、截止时间（精确到小时）、按截止前 N 小时通过钉钉群机器人/工作通知推送提醒，并支持绑定工作区会话跳转。
在原生界面中，使用另一台电脑的DeepSeek Harness实例，控件和功能保留完整。
User-defined prompt library for DeepSeek Harness: a Prompts page in Settings and a composer picker that injects the chosen prompts into a session and its subagents
Current session cost in rubles in the DeepSeek Harness conversation dock

DSH plugin: stock market intelligence for DeepSeek Harness — quotes, financial statements, filings, earnings, economic data and more, dynamically synced from the stockmcp.net remote MCP server as model tools (with a settings page for your API key).
多 Agent 团队的静态成员档案定义与校验层：档案库在面板里看得见、改得动，团队成员的人设、模型与工具边界固化成可校验、可版本化的文件，并在 dsh-agent-teams 创建成员时把档案桥接给运行时。
Attention, delivery notifications, and native quick actions for DeepSeek Harness Automation Tasks.
Federated plugin discovery and update UI for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x, integrated with the native Plugin Manager.
Workspace and session activity dashboard for the DSH Web UI: see which workspaces are alive, which sessions they ran, and which ones to archive.

Report-and-ledger plugin for DSH: front-matter 汇报 as the first-class agent-to-agent interaction primitive, with upward/downward delivery, co-authorship, CC, and a complete transfer-path audit trail; plus a conversation timeline tab.
把 DeepSeek Harness 的配置、模型、MCP、插件清单、技能、记忆和自选目录备份与同步到 WebDAV，每个内容项可单独设置方向。
Draggable real-time token & context dashboard for the DSH Web GUI, mounted on the frame-wide shell.overlay seat
Use your ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness to access Codex models and generate or edit images with gpt-image-2—no OpenAI Platform API key required.
Codex-style selected-text annotations for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness plugin: headless Blender modeling with a live 3D viewport

MCP Tools panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: see every MCP server and tool available in your session, grouped by server, with transport info, JSON schemas, live search and last-used times derived from real session logs.

dsh 插件（DeepSeek Harness / cordis bundle）· 模型接入 —— 把 CodeArts、CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、LobsterAI、Qoder / Qoder CN、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon、MiniMax Code、ZCode、Gemini、OfficeAce、Accio Work 十五个账号渠道接进 dsh 的模型选择器，并保留数据看板、运行日志与本地网关（含局域网中继）。上游 2.1.0 的匿名免费车道、EAC 协付车道、聚合渠道、省 Token、路由、公告/升级/热重载与独立 Web 产品已全部移除。
Token usage, cost, budget and host CPU statistics for DSH sessions.

Баланс RouterAI и стоимость запросов в веб-интерфейсе DeepSeek Harness: баланс личного кабинета, расход текущей сессии вместе с субагентами, включая генерацию изображений, видео и речи, а также служебные вызовы модели.
Tavily-backed web search and page fetching for DeepSeek Harness: multi-key pool with balance-aware scheduling, automatic failover, cooldown, and official /usage balance reporting.
Self-contained DeepSeek Harness plugin for Provider login, model switching, image fallback, usage analytics, and same-port Web restart
A small, open plugin market for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness 的开屏动画：把自带的启动页压掉，插画从黑场里显影、带 2.5D 位移，最后淡出进工作区。
Read books and papers in DSH: a reading toolbar on the official PDF preview that remembers your page and zoom, plus PDF tools for the model (page map, full-text search, page text and images).
SSH remote hosts for DeepSeek Harness: pick a host from ~/.ssh/config, keep an SSH local forward, and open its DSH web UI in the browser.
Moves the DeepSeek Harness temp cache to a configurable location and cleans it with an allowlist; also manages archived sessions and workspace temp/archive folders.
Read-only local capability and community plugin discovery for DeepSeek Harness Web
Session-scoped LLM request and response inspector for DeepSeek Harness Web
Independent DeepSeek Harness Extension Center for Plugin, MCP connection, and Skill lifecycles
DSH Web plugin: shows the model's context window and current usage in the composer, switches reasoning effort in one click, and edits the model's context window inline.
DSH 的 Manim 动画工作室：侧边栏「动画」行 + 右侧栏「动画工作室」tab，用论文/方法生成讲解视频。宿主半边管工作区门控、渲染引擎（自带的 Python venv 里跑 manim 0.22）、视频/分镜的 Range 流式回放，外加三个 agent 工具 manim_scene / manim_render / manim_frames。
Bonsai (盆栽) — an editable conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: branch editing and a recycle bin, a rule editor, exact token accounting, tool trimming and zero-call history folding.
DeepSeek Harness 项目看板（双端）：浏览器看板 UI + 8 个 kanban_* 模型工具，按工作区（项目）隔离，磁盘持久化
dsh plugin: live USD cost badge (whole-session + per-turn) from provider token usage and a configurable pricing table.
dsh plugin: multi-folder workspace — a global linked-folders list (cross-session) plus per-session on-the-fly linking, managed from the Web sidebar.
把微信、飞书、QQ、企业微信和钉钉统一接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供共享提示词、记忆与会话能力。
微信 iLink 通道与 DSH 的流式智能代理插件

Live-reload upgraded DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins without restarting dsh — the running plugin is swapped in place, and a reload that fails rolls back to the working old version and asks for a manual restart.
Set a model's context window from a plugin page in DSH settings; applied on the next DSH start.
Scholar board for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a page of draggable, sandboxed widget cards, evolving into an academic workbench for graduate students in communications.
有钱人插件：每次模型请求都发送两份，把第二份直接扔掉，并如实统计今天又浪费了多少 Token。
CodeBuddy-style deferred tool loading for DeepSeek Harness: keep tool schemas out of the model context until the model loads them on demand via tool_search / defer_execute_tool.

为 DeepSeek Harness 开发的「建议提示词」插件：单个 bundle 集成了宿主生成插件与 Web 输入框幽灵文字界面。每个 agent 回合完成后，通过一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用生成一条建议的下一条提示词，存入插件自己的 storage domain，并经 /api 网关上的插件路由提供给浏览器；Web 端把它渲染为输入框内的幽灵占位文字，通过可配置的快捷键（默认 Tab）采纳进草稿。会话日志零写入。

Startup animation for the DSH Web GUI - a launch video (built-in skins shipped in the package, custom ones uploaded from the settings page) played full screen before the shell paints, with its own first-level settings section.
Browse, search, and install Dify Marketplace plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness, and register each installed Dify plugin as a standard DSH plugin.
Codex-style side conversations for DeepSeek Harness
Edit sent messages, discard later history and regenerate in the same conversation.
Let local applications open an exact DeepSeek Harness desktop session and confirm that its history loaded.

Nebula: an aurora and a time-aware sky with live weather, a deep-space theme, and a Radio Garden station player for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

Taskbar attention alerts for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI (silent system notification → OS taskbar icon flash when the model asks/approves/a task finishes), plus a real-time event source / middleware: the host side maintains a per-session state machine and forwards normalized live task status over a WebSocket endpoint (ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/tab-alert/stream) for external consumers — pairs with the dsh-pet uTools desktop-pet plugin, and can feed any custom plugin/client.

跨会话 TODO 板：右上角浮窗、按工作目录分组、可拖动排序；每条待办可选「提醒 / 自动续跑 / 自动新开会话」三档执行模式，截图 Ctrl+V 直接粘贴成附图（派发时作为真正的图片发给模型），可设定本地时间到点才执行，双勾选（AI 完成 / 用户验收）—— 勾上右勾的行会移入下方独立的「已完成」列表，每条待办还能带备注并在面板内直接编辑。三套可切换的界面风格（票据 / 素白 / 紧凑）。长任务可以让模型先拆成步骤再按顺序执行（`/todo <目标>` 或直接粘模板；一次调用写入整份计划、一次审批）。AI 完成一项后自动查找同目录下一条未完成待办并继续执行；AI 改板子一律先经 DSH 原生审批框（沙箱已放开完全访问、审批档为 never 时除外），板子路由另需浏览器会话凭据。
Feishu/Lark WebSocket channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness

A China-friendly, curated plugin center for DeepSeek Harness Web.
A tiny pin button for the DSH Desktop title bar: click once to keep the window always on top.
文渊阁 (Wenyuan Pavilion) — AI Team mode for DeepSeek Harness: concurrent projects, owned tasks, threads, inbox and an append-only team ledger
寰镜股票看板 MarketLens — read-only A股/港股/美股看盘盯盘 stock board for the DSH Web GUI (delayed public quotes, no trading)
PMO 审查循环按钮 —— 为 AI 会话挂载一位“资深项目总监”。持久审查子代理 + 双线路 + STATUS 协议（CONTINUE/DONE/NEED_HUMAN）自动循环（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent AI personas with cross-session memory, affinity and mood. Inject a role persona into every session and let it grow across conversations.
QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)
Visual cross-device session migration for DeepSeek Harness with drag-and-drop workspace import
DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 判定、确认制学习、信任目录与规则库。
DeepSeek Harness 输入框增强：一键润色、预测下一句、熔炉滑块式模型与推理等级选择、像素小火龙
Toggle DeepSeek Harness plan mode with Tab in the composer
DSH 回收站（删除冷静区）：归档的对话进入回收站，支持恢复、立即移除、7 天自动清理
One-click silent DSH restart button in the composer input bar. DeepSeek Harness plugin (dsh-plugin).
Model-reviewed Auto Approve permission preset: only review-passed actions are auto-approved, everything else is handed back to the user, with an approval-log panel
One-click time-based conversation archiving for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
DSH Web plugin: an inline search box in the sidebar Workspaces header that finds a forgotten conversation by the words you typed in it, across every workspace.

Delete sessions of a DeepSeek Harness profile from the UI: header danger button + session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint + tool delete the log, projection cache and workspace accounting. Built for DSH 0.2.x (web and the desktop client alike).

Bookmark assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness: per-message bookmarks with notes and tags, a cross-session bookmark center, and one-click Markdown export. This build opens the center as a two-column main-area panel.
Configurable chat panel for DSH with a customized Gemini experience: compact mode, toolbar controls, single-reply bookmarks, and conversation transfer into Harness.
Desktop, browser and webhook notifications plus an app-icon attention badge for DeepSeek Harness — know when your agent finishes a turn, hits an error, or waits for your approval.
DSH Web 自定义右键菜单：全局拦截 contextmenu，提供可扩展菜单框架，并内置“打开工作区文件夹”功能
DSH 设置页技能管理器：展示全部已加载 skill（含调用策略/来源/状态），支持启用/停用热开关
模型 API 计费统计：按平台/模型汇总调用、token 与估算花费；models.dev 价格、DeepSeek 官方峰谷价、人工价格、HTML/PDF 报表与官方账单对齐。数据仅存本机。
DSH 插件：把网页版 DeepSeek 以纯 DOM 自动化接入 DSH，无需 API Key。支持多对话记忆隔离、自动续接、设置页面板与快捷操作栏（Host + Client 单包）。
DSH plugin orchestration and workspace-isolation manager: plugin scanning, per-workspace isolated instances, and a standalone rescue entry
Native ECharts and Mermaid visualization canvas for DeepSeek Harness conversations, with declarative pure-JSON payloads and a sandboxed HTML escape hatch.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: probes the official model system fingerprint on a timer with a minimal request, and pops a random meme when it changes.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: browse, preview and export Unreal Engine 4/5 assets from local PAK archives through CUE4Parse.
Automatic session titles for DeepSeek Harness: names a session from the first prompt plus the first assistant reply ("project｜task") instead of truncating the prompt into the taskbar.
Local code intelligence, review workflows and interactive graphs for DeepSeek Harness
DSH Web GUI 编辑模式：接管布局列宽，任意元素、组件可自定义，支持调整位置/宽/高/字号/隐藏。可选脱离文档流、吸附对齐，支持多选、批量、撤销、重置。兼容主题插件，允许用户调整元素获得更多空间和自定义个性化界面。
DSH 原生抖音工具与独立 DeepSeek 本地助手（二次开发分支）

AgentScope Platform for DeepSeek Harness: an optional OpenAI-compatible model provider you switch on when you want it, a pool of platform accounts with manual switching and credit-aware auto-selection, a credit and redeemable-contribution readout under the composer, and a settings panel for the daily check-in, credit balance, contribution grants and a paginated usage-detail query.
Back up and restore dsh-mnemon memory and skill components (memory spaces, project documents, runtime memory, skill files, skill data) to S3-compatible storage or WebDAV.

Account balance and spend for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a sidebar chip that follows the current session's provider, a provider picker over the providers this deployment can currently show a balance for, and per-session/today/month/all-time spend priced from a deployment-owned price table

Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select any passage in the chat and a native reference chip carries the text into the prompt, rendered back as a quote card above your message
Resource manager for DeepSeek Harness: one Settings page that switches MCP servers, agent tools, and skills on or off, with a matching agent tool so the same operations are reachable from chat.
Run Python, R, Node.js and other scripts from a DSH sidebar panel, with streaming output. · 在 DSH 侧栏面板里直接运行 Python、R、Node.js 等脚本，并实时查看输出。
One-click context summarization from the DSH sidebar: compress a long conversation into a durable summary and free up context. · 在 DSH 左侧栏一键归纳上下文，把过长的对话压成一段摘要并释放上下文占用。

One-click GitHub publishing for local DSH plugins: fill in the metadata, prepare README/LICENSE/.gitignore/package.json, create the repo, commit, push, tag and release — from a left-sidebar page. · 一键把本地 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub：自动补全信息、建仓、提交、推送、打 tag 和 Release，左侧栏入口随开随用。

One dock for every DSH plugin: a right-side plugin dock beside the conversation plus a left-sidebar hub entry, so plugins can be called without leaving the chat. · 插件坞：把 DSH 全部插件入口收进右侧窗口，聊天时随手调用，不必来回切页面。
Turn one sentence into a precise task brief through a short guided Q&A. · 一句话变成精准任务书：左侧栏任务澄清器，少问几轮、少烧 token。
Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。
DSH web plugin: a Skills management section in the Settings shell — list, search, categorize, create (upload / generate via dsh / GitHub import), edit, enable/disable, and delete DSH skills.

Prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a composer button and an enhance_prompt tool that rewrite a draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, following the same rules as WorkBuddy's enhance-prompt feature.
Skill picker for DeepSeek Harness: a composer button that lists the session's invocable skills and inserts '/name' into the draft on pick, riding the official slash-skill pipeline.
下班倒计时 + 今日已赚：侧边栏两张统计卡片，工作日倒计时到点，17:00 后自动变「已加班」红字计时；日薪按月薪÷月工作日换算，周六周日休。设置改 ~/.dsh/offwork.json，60 秒生效不用重启。
Server-side multi-user extension for DSH: individual accounts, per-user permissions, private conversations and files, and usage and concurrency limits on one shared server.
MCP & Skill Manager — a DSH Web plugin that manages agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent tools from one sidebar page.
A DSH sidebar plugin for managing SSH host profiles with a real interactive PTY terminal.
DSH 配置导出/导入：侧边栏面板勾选 ~/.dsh 各配置项（设置/插件 profile/SSH 主机/皮肤等），可选脱敏密码，一键打包 tar.gz 备份；也可从备份包恢复（恢复前自动先备份当前配置）。

Unified quoting for DeepSeek Harness Web: select file-editor text or chat messages → annotate → 「引用#N」chip → the AI receives a formatted quote block with file path and exact line range (source line hidden on the user side); sent quotes collapse into a hoverable chip that jumps back to the original text. 统一引用插件（文件编辑器 + 会话消息）。
Adds a collapse toggle that hides the sidebar panel list so the workspace gets the vertical space.
DeepSeek Harness status and command bridge for DSH Pet, with a desktop app installation guide and session navigation.

DeepSeek Harness status and command bridge for DSH Pet, with a desktop app installation guide and session navigation.

Learn first, then get quizzed: a floating study loop for DeepSeek Harness that teaches a topic, then asks you about it — and brings old knowledge back later from a new angle.
《轻音少女》五位角色的 DSH Web 桌宠：任意方位行走、待机/点击/双击动作、茶桌与自动回位。

Three switchable per-session modes for DeepSeek Harness: discussion, adversarial review, and task execution

DSH 会话压缩阈值设置：在「插件」页本插件的配置卡里调自动压缩触发点与保留比例，保存即时写进 agent preset 隔离的压缩引擎

Skills, MCP and instruction-file manager for the dsh web GUI: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, manage MCP servers with a REAL connection through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client (enabled servers connect and register their tools on ctx.tools; enable/disable actually connects/disconnects), and read/edit/create/delete the AGENTS.md-family files the harness reads every turn. Hot-pluggable — mounted via a profile bundle patch + node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Constellation — a server management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: host inventory, remote exec, SFTP, port forwarding, an SSH terminal backend, and a star-map panel in the left sidebar.
DeepSeek Harness relay: mirror the home dsh web UI to the public internet through an outbound wire trunk (cloud relay + out-of-tree host plugin).
久坐提醒 · Stand-up Reminder — reminds you to get up and move at your own interval, with built-in or custom wording.

Codex-style text annotation for DeepSeek Harness conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill. / Codex 风格对话文字批注：选中原文加注释、引用进对话、发送后以「N 条注释」胶囊展开。
DSH 服务器管理面板：在线重启/停止、systemd 一键保活、在线安装插件、运行状态监控、活跃会话、命令终端
DSH 插件：常驻 dsh 界面前层的 AI 数字人（VRM 形象，大模型通过工具驱动表情与动作，纯表现层）
基于 dsh-email 的 DSH 多邮箱助手：支持 QQ、163、企业邮箱等邮件接入，新增邮件监控、AI 摘要与回复建议；自动监控首期开放 163 IMAP。
统一管理 DSH 插件/Skill/MCP，支持角色化动态装载与切换

A NieR-inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness — cool graphite palette, ice-white type, a pure-CSS ruined skyline with drifting ash, CRT scanlines, and a boot sequence. Ships no third-party artwork: both wallpaper slots take your own images and keep them in localStorage. · 尼尔风格主题皮肤（不含任何游戏素材）
Unofficial community Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with responsive mobile access and native Desktop isolation
装插件搞崩，一键回到装前。装插件/首装事件自动快照 + 崩溃检测 + 外部零依赖 CLI 一键还原；危险项只报告不动手。
Native file and PTC tools for DSH on Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS arm64/x64; Windows-only optional Bash payload and host PowerShell integration
DSHA 平级会话互通：主会话 + 工作会话协作，版本线公告、指令模板、汇报合并唤醒
ComfyUI gallery for DeepSeek Harness: browse every generated image, read its prompt, negative prompt, sampler parameters, models and LoRAs, and copy any of it back for reuse.

Provider quota/balance widget for the dsh web surface: an inline sidebar card above the Settings row (collapsed glanceable row expanding into a Harness-native card with a settings panel), fed by a loopback Connection RPC channel whose host half proxies each provider with credentials that never reach the browser.

Codex 订阅授权管理 for the dsh web surface: a dedicated settings page (authorization status, validity/expiry, one-click browser OAuth) plus an expired-credential modal when a GPT model is selected. Host half runs the full OpenAI OAuth flow (PKCE S256, localhost:1455 callback) and writes the llm-pi-ai/openai-codex grant record through ctx.credentials.

Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder menu (basename title + path subtitle, composer-width), plain-text colored tokens via the platform lexicon scan, nested-git-aware index, and arrow-key input history.

Input history switcher for the DSH composer: locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachment bytes, max 50, newest-first) and re-fills the empty composer via ArrowUp/ArrowDown with file references and image previews re-attached through the conversation draft pipeline.

Manage MCP servers (stdio / streamable-http) for dsh web; tools are reached only through four middleware tools. DSH MCP 管理器：Web 侧边栏「MCP」入口，面板按状态分级展示 MCP 服务器（运行中/连接中/已配置/失败），支持快速接入（stdio / streamable-http 表单）与粘贴 mcpServers JSON 导入。已连接服务器的工具一律经中间层工具（ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_detail / ws_mcp_call / ws_mcp_list）访问：宿主注册名 mcp__<id>__<tool> 是内部标识（id 按 (工作空间, 服务器名) 分配、不可由服务器名推导），不对模型可见，禁止直呼。
DSH 会话回收站：会话详情归档入口、回收站多选还原/彻底删除、活跃会话保护。 · Session trash & permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.

DSH web plugin: a strip above the composer showing the files modified in the current session (collapsed by default, click to expand), with a Review button that opens a per-session change review panel in the better-sidebar (exact before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required).

选中英文就地翻译的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：单词出词典条目（音标、词性释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。
DSH plugin: manage archived sessions — list, restore, permanently delete, a first-class Settings page and a red delete button in the session context menu.
Light neumorphic UI for DeepSeek Harness: soft pastel glass cards, a custom gradient logo, a pale fish watermark and a dark sci-fi boot animation.
快捷操作：在任意界面（含新会话页）用快捷键执行工作区操作，例如拉取最新代码；快捷键可在设置中分组管理。 · Keyboard shortcuts for workspace actions (git pull, session and layout commands) with a grouped settings page.
Archive manager pro for DeepSeek Harness: search, filter, sort, multi-select, unarchive, and permanently delete archived sessions.
Pins the DeepSeek Harness default model so switching models inside a session never changes what new sessions start with.
DeepSeek 峰谷指示灯：会话头部一个圆点；面板两个数（本日消耗/余额），点开是详单（本地审计/本日首次观测余额/当前余额/今日充值/无法审计/误差三档告警）
MCP 控制台：一个 profile 里所有 MCP 服务器的总览、实时工具清单与完整 JSON Schema、连通性探测，以及增删/停用与配置编辑。
Unofficial Antigravity OAuth capability bundle with local account caching and manual switching for DeepSeek Harness
One DeepSeek Harness Codex capability bundle for ChatGPT login, LLM access, Web Search, and durable Image Creation
Brand icons for native DeepSeek Harness settings navigation

DSH web search provider facade: routes ctx.web.search to third-party engines (SearXNG/Tavily/Serper/Brave/Bing/Google CSE) and provides a web_fetch provider. Replaces the built-in DeepSeek-only search with configurable third-party APIs.
A strict, replayable A2UI protocol bridge for DeepSeek Harness.
Per-session, per-plugin tool gating for DeepSeek Harness: at session start, choose which enabled plugins may contribute tools; disabled plugins' tools are never injected into that session's prompt.

DeepSeek account plugin for DeepSeek Harness: shows the configured account's API balance in the web GUI sidebar (wallet button + balance card) and exposes a deepseek_balance tool. Balance display only — API keys stay in Settings (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential).
Codex-style right-edge workspace for DeepSeek dsh web: file tree + preview, embedded browser (direct/proxy iframe), and side chat via host ctx.llm streaming
会话历史请求迷你滑轨：对话区左侧垂直居中的短横线，悬停显示请求摘要，点击跳转到对应对话位置

提示词增强（DSH 通用插件）：三种模式（基础/标准/专家）读取会话工作区项目上下文并调用 LLM 增强输入框提示词，支持结果对比确认、采用后撤回、失败模型回退链、按模型能力自动适配推理档位（网关不支持时自动去参重试）、待确认问答闭环（逐条回答后带答案重新增强）、组合行 config 可配置、可取消。Host 半提供 /api/prompt-enhance/enhance；浏览器半在 composer 工具行注册模式选择与 ✦ 按钮、对比面板与忙碌状态卡。随 harness 启动自动加载，无需手动重新加载。

SSH 远程终端：在 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏里连接远程主机，逐步查看命令与输出。
DeepSeek account wallet balance and the live peak/off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot — plus a one-click official top-up link.
DSH bundle: 链接收藏(收藏夹=一个 md 文件)——Web UI 页面 + host 服务,把收藏的链接(标题/简介/图标/标签/自由正文)持久化为本地 Markdown 文件,可选本地库目录并即时切换。

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：在「会话统计」弹窗里追加本轮的输出速度（TPS）等行——decode 口径与端到端口径并存，并附 TTFT 平均、用时、输出 tokens、步数与轮次，直接排在官方「输出速度（TPS）」行下方，口径与官方投影逐项一致。
Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) theme for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — dynamic Cordis plugin source (host + client halves) plus an installable dsh bundle, with wallpaper/logo assets
定时备份 DeepSeek Harness 配置（~/.dsh），侧边栏面板展示备份历史并一键备份，完成或有新版本时通知。
DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 dsh 会话接进飞书 / Lark 长连接，卡片流式回复

Workflows are auto-discovered, parameters mapped, LoRA injected; headless auto-start, inline image delivery and a settings panel included.

Rewrites the New Session headline into a short affectionate greeting written by the selected model from the local time, city and live weather.

DSH 插件可视化：superpowers 技能生态 / 插件注册表 / 记忆复用库 / 进化记忆 / Agent Toolkit / 破甲人格槽 一站式面板；内置破甲预设融合行（江梦璃 · 祁同伟）与身份切换视图。

Debug Mode bundle for DeepSeek Harness

AI-assisted reading for DeepSeek Harness: TXT, Markdown, EPUB and PDF with a companion session, notes, memory and export.

Agent instruction manager for DeepSeek Harness: edit, refine, and template the AGENTS.md files the harness actually reads — the user-global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md and per-workspace AGENTS.md — from a sidebar panel.

Tiered compaction hub for DeepSeek Harness: progressive thresholds (default 30/50/70/90) with escalating consolidation laws, a deterministic keyword index folded into every checkpoint, and a summarization model chain (primary + up to 3 fallbacks, each with its own reasoning effort).

Rich branching survey system for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: the ask_survey tool extends the flat ask_user_question flow — up to 150 questions, per-option branching (select C -> a different range of questions follows), delayed hover insights with sources, expandable Mermaid diagrams, multi-select, free-text, quick mode (one-click whole-survey answer templates), and reroll/push/discuss pre-flight actions. Host-authoritative pending surveys, rendered as a wizard in the same conversation composer seat.

Percent-progress scoreboard for DeepSeek Harness: the tracking_write/tracking_checkpoint tools plus a docked board below the todo pill — rows with live percents derived from artifact truth, per-row record dialogs (long-form detail + clickable sources), checkpoints with host-captured git state, and pursue/delegate/scout/align operator actions that reach the agent as instructions.

One desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness: starts it hidden when stopped, reopens the running UI, and adds restart/close plus an optional sidebar icon to Settings.
Send files from your DeepSeek Harness agent straight to your phone, and reference what your phone sent back — no account, no public IP, end-to-end encrypted.

Feishu-style Markdown outline for DSH: a collapsible split-column table of contents on the left of the conversation page, built from the Markdown headings of every AI reply, with heading and full-reply keyword search that also reaches unloaded history, multi-select references sent with the next message, and turn hiding that keeps the log intact.
DSH plugin: per-session working directories. A workspace marked with .dsh-isolate gives every new session its own session-<id> folder, so concurrent sessions cannot overwrite each other's files.

A DSH plugin that embeds chat.deepseek.com and two-way bridges desktop conversations with the web chat: three chat entries, an optional auto-loop (web reply → desktop draft only), and a v1.4.0 full auto-pilot channel that extracts a delimited review block, auto-submits the next turn via official conversation.send and pauses on a decision card you control.

Context occupancy ring, configurable character thresholds and recoverable compaction for DeepSeek Harness.

DSH 窗口里的今汐形象体：官方立绘经图生视频生成待机/行走/飞行/打盹四组动作，逐帧抠图成透明循环动画；会自己在窗口里走动、尺寸随远近变化、点击回应并报账户余额（星声）。附带加密的「封存舱」：身份记录随插件分发，只有口令能解开。
DSH 统一声音插件：多音色克隆与进化、按需语音回复、七种情感 TTS、翻唱换声直出、音乐缓存联动与管理界面。
在 QQ 私聊和群聊里直接对话 DeepSeek Harness。 Chat with DeepSeek Harness in QQ private and group chats.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: start a page-harness share preview from DSH so teammates can review a running page
CloudQ integration for DeepSeek Harness with secure credential, workspace, and plugin-management surfaces
Tencent Cloud ADP as a DeepSeek Harness out-of-tree plugin bundle
CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — database, storage, authentication, and frontend/backend deployment
Screenshot button beside the message composer.
「深渊」—— 深海底玻璃拟态皮肤：单一生物荧光光源 + 发丝线分层，可在设置里切换底色 / 强调色 / 圆角密度 / 极光强度。

Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live colored output, and keeps every run's log on disk where the agent can read it.
Reach this Harness from your phone over a private network: a loopback-preserving gateway with one-time pairing codes, plus a portrait layout for narrow screens.
DSH Desktop 监控插件：通用 HTTP 轮询规则引擎，条件命中才唤醒新可见会话执行任务，未命中零 LLM 交互。仿 dsh-tauri-scheduler 架构。
AionUi-style two-column DSH right Sidebar (preview/files window + changes) seeded on top of dsh-better-sidebar, without giving up any better-sidebar feature.
隔离舱：在 DSH 主会话之外运行受沙箱约束的隔离任务。Rust 侧车负责持久化与文件操作，JS 薄壳负责宿主集成，结果复用官方会话界面；主会话默认无感，返回与导出都需手动确认。

Adds an OpenViking status page to the DeepSeek Harness Settings dialog: connection, service health, memory and session counts, capture settings and a redacted server configuration. Requires a deployed OpenViking service — the page only shows live data after OpenViking is running and configured.

Adds an "Update All" tab to the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page: check every installed plugin for a newer version in one pass and update them all with one click, including Git-pinned plugins, which are followed to the upstream HEAD commit automatically.
DSH web plugin: full-text content search for the better-sidebar file manager — a search tab that greps file CONTENTS in the session working directory and opens matches in the sidebar editor
Read PDF, Word and PowerPoint documents in their original layout inside DSH; select text for context-aware translation, or discuss it in Learning and Re-reading modes.

Operate the iOS Simulator from DeepSeek Harness: auto-discover and boot devices, install/launch apps from DerivedData, drive the accessibility UI (tap, type, swipe, buttons), run UI test flows with assertions, capture screenshots and video, read logs, and show the live simulator in a Web side panel.
Control a Kitesurf browser engine over CDP from DSH via surfbird. Works with surfbird raw/auth deployments and upstream kitesurf.
Dead-loop rescue for DeepSeek Harness: detects model repetition mid-stream, prunes the loop from the committed message, and resumes the task automatically.
dsh plugin: daily curated RSS briefing (overall summary + top-N items), sidebar reader, preference tuning — panel/reader only, never touches the conversation.
DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that renders settled Mermaid fenced code blocks as diagrams

DeepSeek Harness 前端插件：滑动变祖器 31 档 —— 用 -15..+15 滑杆替换输入框的模型与推理等级控件，芯片显示提供商，控件做成滑动变阻器外观（铜线密绕瓷管 + 端板 + 接线柱 + 滑片），折叠式悬浮面板，设置支持按状态(6)与按档位(31)两层粒度、可手填 provider / 模型 / 思考强度，滑动时把档位图铺成 DSH 背景并在停手 5 秒后淡出；支持 31 档自定义名字（相邻同名合并）与逐档自定义背图（IndexedDB 存储）
Accessibility layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: coordinated announcements, keyboard navigation, and accessibility settings.
在侧栏显示 DeepSeek 峰谷计价状态与账户钱包：小鲸鱼娘 + 距半价倒计时 + 官方价格表 + 余额与当日费用。
Sync your DeepSeek Harness model configuration and third-party API keys across machines, over S3-compatible storage or WebDAV.
Progress narration and readable collapsed turns for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness Local/Git 协作助理：原生六角色执行、持久会话、任务恢复与成果归档。

Use your ChatGPT account to bring Codex models into DSH: choose models and thinking effort, chat with images, use tools and skills, approve local tasks, answer interactive questions, continue and compact long conversations, check quota and Token history, and maintain a supported Windows screenshot helper.
为标准模式选择摘要模型，按供应商浏览搜索或用 Auto 跟随对话模型；保存自动压力压缩额外次数，手动压缩只尝试一次有用压缩。
在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT Dots，并通过 MCP 连接让 Dot 管理 DSH 会话、工具和工作区。
在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT Dots，并通过 MCP 连接让 Dot 管理 DSH 会话、工具和工作区。
Kujira 是集 AI 桌宠、模型联动、用量与计费监控、角色扮演（RP）和个性化记忆于一体的 DSH 插件。支持多家模型服务的账户信息查询、模型切换、Windows/Linux/macOS 三平台适配，以及共享世界观、用户习惯捕捉、独立人设、个性整理、AI 日记与睡眠整理。
Analyze multi-site online and local video with frames, audio, subtitles and speech transcription; resume viewing, reuse site methods, import login state, and cache or export media.
Attach local files to the conversation context: a composer chip adds files whose content is injected into the model context (agent/pre-step), with a removable ✕ chips strip above the input.

Per-session extra workspaces for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: extend the file sandbox and the low-integrity process sandbox with configurable additional directories, edited from a visual session-header panel.

Configurable bash executor for Windows DeepSeek Harness: provides ctx.shell from WSL, Git for Windows, Cygwin or a custom bash, enables the built-in tool-bash in place of tool-pwsh, and ships a Web settings panel. Tagged dsh-plugin.
DSH plugin: hold a drafted message until the session is actually finished - no main agent, no subagent, no background job - and send it then.
DSH plugin: holds DeepSeek model calls during peak pricing hours so they are sent at off-peak rates.
划词分支助手：框选回答文字 → 添加到新的分支，保留原文标记与分支树面板
Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: run finished, approval needed, or a question waiting.
Compact, collapse-friendly left sidebar for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
A playable Minecraft-inspired voxel workspace overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web

Native WSL execution for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: persistent Linux bash, Linux-path file and search tools, and a WSL session mode that asks which distribution folder to use as the workspace. No extra web server and nothing to install inside the distribution.
Let a text-only model see images by automatically calling a vision model from the same provider.
Vietnamese language pack for DeepSeek Harness: adds the 'Tiếng Việt' UI language and a dictionary for every client plugin that publishes strings through ctx.locale.
Codex OAuth provider with native compaction and image input support for DeepSeek Harness.
3GPP通信协议知识库与分类可视化工具 — 集成NTN/TN/全息通信/近远场通信等全维度协议查询
插件设置面板：会话内 GUI 开关「破甲」「逆向」两套模式，动态注入提示词与逆向技能。 / Dual-mode console for DeepSeek Harness: in-conversation toggles for no-refusal and reverse-engineering modes.
Preview and permanently delete archived DeepSeek Harness Sessions, per-conversation folders, attachments, workspace files, and orphan conversation folders.
DSH 情绪分析器：本地 ONNX 推理为每条主模型回复打分，投影进会话状态，并在 DSH 网站注入可拖拽的悬浮情绪监测框。
这是大肥鱼的手机，主人不要动大肥鱼的手机喵
关于我：硬资料、AI 对你的印象、标着「猜的」的判断，放一个设置页里；每天定时自己校对一次；可检查更新。
把交付卡片和消息图片拖到 Windows 桌面，并附上「打开所在文件夹 / 复制路径 / 另存为」
梗百科：6792 条梗/黑话词库，自动查梗并注入上下文，不让模型硬猜。支持一键下载社区最新词库、提交新梗，与社区共创。
通到微信：DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和微信双向互通。读微信本地库收消息、UI 自动化发消息。外人只能聊天（工具被硬拦，不能执行命令、不能读写文件）；可配入站白名单限制谁能发消息进来。

Adds a Delete action to every session row menu in the DSH sidebar and permanently removes that session's local log.

webCandidates.description: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and stamp each row with a picked emoji — a dual-face (host + client) dsh plugin with row [pin][emoji] controls, a searchable picker with recents and categories, a header toggle, and a pinned panel.
GUI-configurable CLIProxyAPI provider for DeepSeek Harness with a selectable wire protocol
ChatGPT (Codex) 本地代理随 DSH 启停，设置页显示账号套餐额度（5 小时 / 7 天窗口），主灯用一次极小的真实模型调用判断「现在能不能调用 GPT」。代理逻辑见 bridge/bridge.mjs。
咕噜的情感日记：04:00 采集素材，先判「这天值不值得写」，值得的日子才写；记忆三段走——先召回候选、再由模型挑真正和这天有关的、动笔前先让模型把场景想明白（四小节内部留档，失败降级），只把挑中的注入提示词；pending 素材默认留 7 天后自动清理；设置里的「日记本」可阅读、切换模型、看本次注入了几条。

DSH web focus mode plugin: ?focus=conversation.composer shows only the input area, ?focus=conversation.session shows only the message flow, both hiding the DSH main sidebar; auto-resumes the most recent non-blank session when none is current.
DSH web session cross-window sync: BroadcastChannel broadcast of the current-session selection so every open window follows create/switch/delete together.
DSH 插件：跨工作区 skill 引用，复用官方 skill-filesystem 发现机制，一次更新处处复用
Multi-distro WSL keep-alive switch for the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar.

Coding-plan quota and balance readout for the DSH composer toolbar: MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu and Alibaba Bailian Coding Plan windows follow the selected model; API keys are reused from DSH model settings.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: role-based model routing — both roles default to deepseek-flash (V4.1 Flash, native multimodal) until V4.1-Pro launches.
DSH 左侧栏「后台任务」入口：管理需要后台运行的本地服务，支持一键启动/停止/重启与状态查看，DSH 退出时同步停止
DSH 自动对话重命名：随对话自动刷新标题，并在重命名窗口提供 AI 建议

一款专为粥批定制的明日方舟主题拓展包：背景里的阿米娅与各处细节中的干员签名都在提醒你——博士，您还有许多事情需要处理，现在还不能休息哦。支持导入本地图片作壁纸（导入即解算玻璃浓度与文字色），内置 12 张按画面自适应的整屏壁纸；罗德岛图标体系与签名式的授权、选择交互。 / An Arknights theme pack for the players of 明日方舟: import a local picture as your wallpaper — glass and ink are solved on import — alongside twelve full-screen wallpapers with per-image edge blur, Rhodes Island iconography, and sign-off style approval and choice interactions.
DSH 任务辅助启动器：在对话框发送键旁放置一个常驻按钮，点击后自动扫描本会话已安装的、对当前任务有帮助的技能与 MCP 工具，弹候选清单（默认勾选匹配项），一键确认后把选中技能注入当前对话交给 Agent 自动执行。
Skill cards for DeepSeek Harness: turn recurring prompts into fill-in cards, run them with a chosen workspace / preset / model, and get the answer back in the card. 技能卡片：把常用提示词变成填空卡片，填完直接执行并取回答案。

Configurable chat auto-scroll for the DSH web UI: follow, smooth glide, paced section-by-section reading, stepping, and hold modes, with on-screen controls, hotkeys, and a settings page (conversation.input.left / conversation.composer.dock / conversation.session.header.actions / settings.section entries).
DSH 主题插件：注册 One Dark Pro 配色，并在外观设置提供 浅色/深色/跟随系统/One Dark Pro 四宫格选择。
ComfyUI-style coding workflow canvas for DSH: a native sidebar panel renders a node graph where every node is an agent-executable coding task and every link is a dataflow dependency.
Archived-session tools for DeepSeek Harness: restore, safely delete, clean leftovers, or continue with a new preset.
MiniMax Token Plan usage radar for DeepSeek Harness: 5-hour and weekly window remaining, reset countdowns, and this machine's token spend — as a monochrome instrument panel in the sidebar.
滚动条悬停加粗：默认保持 dsh 原有的细条 / 半隐藏外观，鼠标移到滑块上时临时变粗，更好点击与拖拽，且加粗过程不引发任何重排。

Message Annotator for DeepSeek Harness: stage numbered quote+comment annotations on assistant messages (selection floating trigger + per-message action), then send them aligned and together to the agent
DeepSeek Harness 插件：连接正在运行的团结引擎编辑器的 Codely 桥，把场景、GameObject、组件属性、编辑器命令与 C# 执行封装成 AI 工具。
把 / 菜单里的技能按自定义分类分段，并用中文显示描述

A local ComfyUI workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): image/audio/video generation, W2/W3 sprite cards with Qwen back-view walk-up, local Flux.2 Item Studio assets with guided SDXL fallback, Hugging Face downloads, inspection and arbitrary workflows.
Connect multiple OpenAI-compatible providers to DeepSeek Harness: discover their models, pick the ones to expose, and generate images and videos with them from a DSH session.

Allowlisted git execution for DeepSeek Harness: a model-facing git tool that runs outside the file sandbox, with a settings page where the user ticks which git subcommands are permitted and, per path, which reads and writes are allowed, prompted or refused
DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 请求兼容修复插件：用可插拔的修复项改写发往模型的请求体，解决第三方网关要求的思考内容回传等兼容问题；设置页里逐项勾选启用，官方修复落地后可整包删除
背景自定义面板：侧边栏列表入口，支持导入图片 / GIF / 视频做整页背景，带等比预览、裁剪器、历史图库，文件存在宿主目录里。
Dedicated codex-auto-review authorization gate for DeepSeek Harness
Workspace-scoped persistent memory, review and request transparency
小星辰任意语音：Q 版立绘挂件 + 本地 IndexTTS 声音克隆，一个角色一段参考音频，点一下就念 / 再点就闭嘴

星辰会议室（LittleStar Meeting）：让分散在不同会话里的 AI 坐进同一间房 —— 开会，或者跑一局狼人杀。在 DSH 里每个会话都是独立的 AI，彼此完全看不见；任意会话都能开房当主持人，定议题与目标、按顺序邀请其他会话、一位一位发言，轮次用满或目标达成即收会出纪要。它同时是多智能体对抗游戏底座：定向可见 / 私聊 / 并发询问 / 淘汰出局，狼人杀要的四件套都在，附带小白使用指南，看完就会用。作者：插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明；四件套与小白指南由插件·3代小星辰扩建编写。 / LittleStar Meeting: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of Werewolf. Every DSH session is an independent AI with no awareness of the others; any session can host, set a topic and goal, invite the rest in order, and they speak one at a time until the rounds run out or the goal is met, then the meeting closes with written minutes. It doubles as a multi-agent game engine with targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks and elimination. Includes a beginner guide. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer and the guide were built by 插件·3代小星辰.
DSH 体力条桌宠：按注意力状态给每个会话算一条体力条，点一下把会话里的大肥鱼叫到桌面上，再点一下收回。附带一套完整的「传承」流程（四份文件 / 体检 / 归档）。
Unofficial DeepSeek Harness integration for Meta's Muse Code subscription: declares the shipped Meta provider route and adds its sign-in command. Use at your own risk.
WeChat-style desktop screenshot button in the DSH composer (Windows 10/11 x64).
Per-model auto-compaction trigger (in tokens) for pi-ai LLM providers, edited from Settings > Models and projected into the agent-preset rows' compaction-basic modelPolicies.
Batch-remove sidebar Workspaces in DeepSeek Harness. Removes the registration only — folders and session logs are kept.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: 账户余额 + 会话费用（命令/工具 + Web UI 悬浮显示）
Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin for DeepSeek Harness: safety-bounded strength, programmable waveforms, and a DSH-aligned web panel.
DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：28 个出站渠道、6 条入站控制通道、原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效；零强制运行时依赖。
Adds a permanent "Delete session" action to the DeepSeek Harness session context menu.

Click any element in a live page preview inside the DSH sidebar, annotate or comment on it, and send it to the AI conversation as structured context — no screenshots, no guessing which element you meant.
DeepSeek Harness plugin market: browse the dsh-plugin GitHub topic and install plugins from a panel above Settings.
DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: per-turn USD cost in chat plus a cost & statistics view tab with charts and ratings.
DeepSeek Harness client plugin: paste a screenshot, draw on it in an overlay (pen, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text), and file the annotated PNG into the conversation as a normal attachment.
Русский (Russian) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — a community DSH client plugin that adds ru to Settings → General → Language.
DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: browser-style tabs for open Sessions — switch, close, reorder by drag, and tear a tab off into a separate window.
Compatibility-first dsh provider powered by a local openjiuwen agent-core sidecar; optional JiuwenSwarm Gateway backend.

Local-first DeepSeek Harness control center for balance monitoring, usage accounting, time-aware custom third-party API pricing, a 365-day local token ledger, Z.ai Coding Plan quotas, official pricing sync, encrypted multi-account switching, reminders, recharge, and host-gated session controls.

DSH plugin: group sidebar sessions by project (a label, not a directory), give each project a work document whose format follows a spec, register its related links, and show the exact runtime-context injection on the settings card.
Smooth animated caret for the DSH chat composer and question cards — enhanced community patched edition
GitHub/Gitea (and other forge) accounts with project-scoped grants and push policy for DeepSeek Harness better-sidebar
Multi-host SSH tunnel and SSHManager tool for DeepSeek Harness (project-scoped grants)
DeepSeek Harness 插件：编辑已发出的消息后重发（改文字、删图、拖动排序、补图，第一条也能编辑），@ 引用图片，对话图片可复制／下载／拖进输入框。Edit and resend sent messages, @-reference images, copy/download chat images.
Session-state notifications for the DeepSeek Harness: WxPusher push plus real browser notifications (sound + requireInteraction) with a settings page.
DeepSeek Harness 的串行 TODO 队列板：全局队列与每个工作区队列各自最多运行一个会话，队列空闲时自动派发；控制面板是独立主页面（移动端/PC 自适应），待验收会话内带快捷浮窗。
DSH host-side phone push: question events to ntfy + in-process answering via relay polling (replaces the external notifier + answer bridge)
DSH 图形化 Agent 配置台：可视化拼装提示词、工具、技能、子代理与备用模型，按预设绑定即接管；自建预设走平台的预设注册入口，所有配置存在插件自己的数据里，卸载即恢复原状。
DSH 运行时看护层：在 agent 生命周期的关键点做防护，保证任何停止都有明确原因，不让异常静默变成正常结束。
Unofficial industrial Endfield-inspired theme bundle for DeepSeek Harness Web.

Provides HMCL/PCL-launcher-style modpack packaging and installation for DeepSeek Harness: bundle several plugins with their configuration and data into one .dshpack and install it in a single pass. Two forms: a self-contained full pack that a machine with only DSH installed can install, and a lite pack that records names and versions and fetches them on install. Each plugin can be packed from its upstream release with default configuration or from a local copy (code, config entries, data snapshot); configuration is re-applied by entry, data is restored under ~/.dsh without overwriting existing files, and suspected credentials become ${REDACTED}. Categories, search, paging and entries come from the plugin-market catalog, and market versions are preferred when online. Packing always runs an in-memory scan for secrets and risky code (masked, never written to disk); high-risk hits pause the job until confirmed, then it resumes from the checkpoint without rescanning. Installation re-checks sha256 integrity, compatibility and licences, and can finish without enabling or enable right away. The UI can live in settings, the sidebar or the plugins tab, each switchable. Installing the plugin market (dshmarket) first is recommended, not required.
