Coopanion desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a whale-girl mascot that speaks, moves and can be driven by the agent
DSH Web 鲁迅先生桌宠插件：右下角 GIF 桌宠，按 Agent 工作状态换动作，任务完成与点击时播放鲁迅音频。

Feishu/Lark AI bot for DSH: long-connection (WebSocket) event receiving, per-chat DSH agent binding and auto-reply, workspace/session menu commands (NEW_WORKSPACE / NEW_SESSION / WORKSPACE_CHANGE / CHANGE_SESSION), domain auto-detection for both Feishu (open.feishu.cn) and Lark (open.larksuite.com), agent tools (lark_status / lark_configure / lark_test) and a web setup page with a QR code to the developer console. No public URL needed — events flow over the official SDK long connection.
DSH Web 介面繁體中文（台灣）語言包：npm install 即可加入 zh-TW 語系，全介面自動簡轉繁，繁中瀏覽器自動切換
dsh web 插件：自动配置模型思考档位与能力，并按 provider+model 记住最后选择的思考档位
DSH 专家团队 IM：多角色群聊/私聊，发言走宿主 ctx.llm 或原生 session
Nanny calendar board: onboarding, leave and salary payout tracking, with monthly and all-time totals. 育儿嫂上户 / 休假 / 工资发放日历看板。
Windows x64 only: self-contained DOM/CDP browser (system Edge/Chrome) and UI Automation control for DSH Desktop.
给 DSH 主页 / 新会话界面加一行按时段变化的问候语（傲娇鲸鱼娘口吻，可自定义台词）
星轨推理：真实 DSH 推理强度控制与轻量、持续演化的微缩宇宙
王铁 OS — 构建在 DeepSeek Harness 之上的全屏业务应用框架：OceanBase 管理（Oracle 模式）/ DDL 比较 / 知识库 / 数据字典 / 记事本 / 开发工具
选区引用与锚点批注：在 DSH 会话中选中文字 → 批注 → 引用锚点 chip（点击跳回原文、悬停显示原文）→ 提交序列化为结构化引用块。

Host + browser bundle: give every session in a configured workspace its own working directory — new sessions at `startup`, existing ones the first time they are resumed at the workspace root — plus a header button that opens that directory and a client-side repair for file addresses that DSH builds with a stale workspace root.
Answer WeChat messages from a DeepSeek Harness session, with interaction cards relayed to the chat.
Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: suggest the next user message after an assistant turn and fill the composer on Tab.
Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move cold sessions out of the sidebar into a recoverable trash, restore them within the retention window, or delete the logs permanently.
DeepSeek Harness 桌面端：基于官方 DeepSeek Harness（@deepseek-ai/dsh）开发的独立 Electron 应用（内嵌启动本机 dsh，复用已配置 profile 与全部插件），同时可作为 DSH 插件挂载，在 Web GUI 提供「打开桌面端」入口。
DSH Web GUI 皮肤插件：侧栏「皮肤」面板，支持自选本地图片 / URL / 本地文件夹轮播（顺序或随机、一轮内不重复）作为全屏背景，含预设、暗化、模糊、关闭皮肤，跨刷新持久化（外部 client 插件，dsh-web-ui 风格）。
DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：在 workspace-write 沙箱之上增加 Auto 档——确定性规则放行/拒绝，模糊操作由 LLM 裁决，危险操作转人工。保留工作区沙箱边界，不放宽为 full-access。
DeepSeek Harness 会话管理工具插件：为模型提供会话创建/重命名/归档/切换/列表工具，支持沙箱提权审批，并支持 UI 层面的会话切换与会话工具的专属视图。
DeepSeek Harness 工作区管理工具集：查看、创建注册、重命名、删除工作区记录（纯注册，不触碰磁盘目录）；破坏性操作（删除注册、改注册路径）走用户审批 fail-closed。
Turn conversation content into knowledge cards: concepts, flowcharts, comparisons and more for Web
会话话题分组：侧边栏按话题把会话归堆（纯客户端，零 host 服务依赖，不删会话、不执行脚本）
敏感保护：进入模型上下文前把密钥/令牌/密码替换为 <SG_> 占位符，内置 221 条 gitleaks 检测规则与结构化字段判定；明文加密存本地保管库，设置页与对话内提供小锁点击还原，工具可将明文导出为 0600 文件供命令执行时使用。
DSH 技能中文显示层：/ 菜单按中文分类显示中文名与简介，调用仍是英文 /name；中文数据旁路存储，不改 SKILL.md；支持从安装来源补简介与卸载回收站。
Agnes AI integration for DeepSeek Harness - LLM provider with multimodal support and GUI settings panel
Draggable quota/cost dashboard for the dsh web GUI: combines OpenRouter and DeepSeek balances and spend (official APIs + local ledger) in one movable card.
DSH 侧的 23 个专职角色 × 模型档位路由：把 oh-my-claudecode 的角色体系移植成 DSH 工具（agent_roles / agent_taskbook / agent_spawn），按角色钉死模型档位（LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH ← haiku/sonnet/opus）并一步派活。
DeepSeek Harness 手机端访问体验优化插件：纯客户端移动 UI 层（响应式抽屉布局、字号/间距适配、触控目标、按钮/菜单/表格移动端交互、安全区适配），桌面宽度显示不受影响。
One-click prompt-optimization button in the composer tool row, plus long-text input/editing support for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
真正删除 DSH 会话：会话日志全部格式代、投影缓存、工作区索引、插件按会话存的数据、孤儿附件，可选覆盖擦除。
Lightweight usage analytics for DeepSeek Harness — token trends, activity heatmaps, model breakdowns, and exports.
Drag local files into DeepSeek Harness Desktop as absolute-path attachment cards without copying them into the workspace

[支持 DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x / DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x compatible] C-drive planner for DeepSeek Harness: scan the whole C drive, classify every big item into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), LLM fallback + human confirm, then delete/move/redirect on demand with strong redline + dry-run/undo safeguards. C盘空间规划整理大师:扫描整 C 盘,分门别类给出正确动作,动手前先预览,红线配置/记忆永不自动执行。

Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness Web composer: hold the mouse on the input box, speak, see the running transcript float above it, release to insert the text into the draft. Recognition runs locally (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx) — no API key, offline, audio never leaves the machine. 微信电脑版同款长按语音输入:在输入框上按住鼠标说话,浮层里边说边出字,松手把文字写进输入框,上滑取消;识别在本机跑,免密钥、离线、音频不出本机。

[支持 DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x / DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x compatible] Local file recall for DeepSeek Harness: it watches the folders you choose and keeps a SQLite index of what appeared — name, type, size, appeared-at, location and origin — so "where did I put that file?" becomes a single question. Every folder carries its own incremental anchor, and a folder added later is backfilled in full on its first scan. Search is SQL hard filtering plus multi-keyword hit weighting, with a live fallback scan when the index has no hit. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. 文件快速寻回:定期扫描你指定的文件夹,把新出现的文件(名字/类型/大小/出现时间/位置/来源)记进本地 SQLite 索引,忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回。每个文件夹各有自己的增量锚点,新加入的文件夹第一次会回填全部历史;检索用 SQL 硬过滤加多关键词加权,索引没命中时当场兜底实时扫描一遍。只读,绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。

[DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x] A cat desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness whose first job is to keep you from sitting too long. The pet lives in the corner, can be dragged anywhere (position remembered), and plays a looping animation per state (idle / getting up / drinking / sleeping). When a focus cycle ends it pops a centered reminder with a triple chime; saying "later" shows one real sourced sedentary case and one dehydration case; stopping produces a session report with a good/mid/bad grade. The timer and the ledger live in the host, so refreshing the page never loses state. 猫猫桌宠：先当久坐提醒用——住在右下角、可拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各有循环动画；专注到点居中弹窗 + 三声提示音，点「再等会」掏出 1 条久坐 + 1 条缺水的真实来源案例，结束时给本次工作好/中/差评价。计时与账本都在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢。

[支持 DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x / DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x compatible] Resume screening plugin for DeepSeek Harness (HR): ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the DB plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. 简历筛选插件:批量收简历建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),大白话下指令,库内规则粗筛+LLM精判少数入围者,自动入库去重、可导出、可追溯。

Point-and-shoot screenshot capture for DeepSeek Harness: clipboard watcher + system floating window (comment & key-point, copy/save-doc/save-image) + zero-config OCR through the host's own multimodal model (Tongyi Qianwen fallback) + Obsidian per-day merging + evening AI organization. 指哪拍哪 · 截图即存:剪贴板监听 + 鼠标位置系统级悬浮窗 + 用宿主大模型零配置识别(可回落通义千问) + Obsidian 按天合并 + 晚间 AI 整理打双链

[适配 DSH 0.2+（0.2.0-rc.2 桌面版实测）/ DSH 0.2 and newer] 🆕 1.11 新增：词库页一键批量选词（每次 +10、最多 50）、考试错词一键出「能发音的在线复习卡」、记忆卡例句带中文对照。语音发音：单词与例句一键朗读（Windows 自带语音，离线、不联网、不调模型）。英语生词库 · 多用户单词助手：复制即弹窗点选录入、拍照识别标记词、LLM 翻译落 SQLite；记忆卡带真实 IPA 音标与 7 年级英文例句，试题例句限定 7~9 年级简单句，考试连对 3 次自动标记「已学会」
OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint that forwards model calls through a running DeepSeek Harness
Auto-hide the DSH composer and fixed UI overlays when idle, with customizable hotkeys and an in-app settings panel — OLED burn-in protection for DeepSeek Harness.
发现没有能够随着dsh打开自动启动napcat的插件，遂使用大肥鱼制作此插件，建议搭配Yuuyuko-uu的dsh-qq-link使用~
让 DSH 会话之间互相叫醒：开机自动唤醒指定的一个或几个对话（每间可单独指定 provider / model / 思考强度）；同时给 AI 一个 session_task 工具，把一个对话里的事情丢给另一个对话去做，等它跑完再把结果取回来。不依赖 QQ、不绑定任何桥。

给同事的运维请求通道：同事在飞书私聊机器人提一件事，你在审批卡上点「同意」后，由你指定的那条 DSH 会话带着你配好的工具与人设去办，结果以卡片回到提交人的飞书（Markdown 正常渲染），不需要公网入口。四个特点：配对码把发送者绑成管理员，机器人只服务指定账号；非管理员请求走审批卡片，同意/拒绝都校验点击人身份；请求串行排队，前一条整轮 turn 跑完才注入下一条；目标会话启动时主动 resume，不用先有人在界面上点开。
不用自己处理运维的远程 DSH：拿飞书私聊当操作界面（CUI），消息与卡片走飞书机器人长连接
DSH 学习陪练插件（dsh-plugin）：AI 生成知识框架、沿路线提问、默认已懂只标缺口；资料先搜标准教材与官方文档、再问你手上有哪本，讲义只编排不重写原理，路线图可导出离线 HTML，路线与八种学习法在原生设置卡实时编辑并落盘到工作区，按目的定达标标准，卡壳跨会话引用。
Sidebar entry and management panel for captured LLM request dumps
DeepSeek 官方余额、Token 用量、月历热图与离线 tokenizer，内置在 Harness 侧栏
NovelNovel — DeepSeek Harness 插件：novel_* 工具、写作技能与 /novel 命令，用工作区文件写小说（章节/角色卡/世界观词条/写作预设/上下文组装/导出）
Select text in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and park it as a quote card above the composer; the input box keeps only your question.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: model-facing image_describe (识图) tool over the DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (qwen3.7-flash), plus a paste bridge that turns pasted images into file paths on text-only sessions and renders them back in the transcript. Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.
DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方显示当前思考到第几步、在干什么、成没成；纯本机规则推断，不调模型、不发网络请求。 A DSH client plugin that captions the thinking phase with step, action and outcome.

DSH tool plugin that delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, prepends the current DSH conversation history, reports which files changed, supports revert, and adds a Claude Mode toggle to the composer.
Codex desktop style model + reasoning-effort selector for DeepSeek Harness: one trigger, one popover, a model list pane and a pixel-replica effort slider.
特蕾西娅主题：象牙白 / 墨 / 淡玫瑰配色，整页背景图 + 毛玻璃 + 飘落花瓣
Reorder the model list of any llm-pi-ai route from Settings > Models; the composer model menu follows the same order.
Headroom context-compression backend for DeepSeek Harness: local proxy lifecycle, a compaction engine backend, the headroom_retrieve CCR tool, and a settings card.
随手记、随时读：阅读、编辑、并排预览一键切换，附大纲与三套排版主题，支持公式与 Mermaid，多级文件夹管理，自动存为本地 .md 文件。
小而美？看清 DSH 的 CPU、内存与卡顿：按插件、终端、MCP 拆分占用，对照卡顿时刻，复制诊断报告。仅限 Windows x64。
不离开 DSH 就能中英互译：复用已配置的模型，免填 API Key；译文边生成边显示，提示词可自定义，历史自动存在本地，可随时回看重译。

Use your Antigravity (Gemini) and ChatGPT Codex consumer subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers: self-refreshing OAuth, accurate quota pill, account rotation, text-to-image through the subscription, bilingual settings.
鸣潮爱弥斯主题皮肤 — 粉白配色 + 赛博霓虹装饰的 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤
DSH 背景替换插件 v2：窗口级壁纸 + 设计令牌 alpha 透明化，面向官方桌面端（0.2.0-rc.2）
Russian language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (community)

Notes and todos as plain Markdown in one Vault folder of your choice: /ml jots into today's journal, todos come in deadline/sleep-until/anytime flavors with auto-wakeup, /ml note distills chats into a knowledge base, /ml ask answers questions from it, /ml mail reads your work inbox incrementally into a throwaway temp dir and extracts todos/reads, /ml view fuzzy-opens any file — notes stay plain files.

DSH Web GUI font engine + settings page: runtime discovery of every client plugin's styles, declaration-point pick-to-tune selector (design tokens / per-rule px), configurable hotkeys (picker / font size ±1), system font enumeration via sfnt name-table parsing, DSH settings.yaml persistence (with localStorage fallback for older installs and offline reads), manual refresh (no polling).

Audit DeepSeek Harness disk usage (sessions, attachments, rebuildable caches), classify it by risk, and move anything you choose to delete into the plugin's own recoverable trash. The model can query, never delete.
学习模式（study-mode）agent 预设：主题知识库 + 检索优先的回答（命中标出处、查不到标未验证），侧边栏带知识库面板。
DeepSeek Harness plugin (bundle): visually create spec-compliant skills — Huawei Cloud mode per 《华为云基础云服务Skills和仓库管理规范》 / generic mode per agentskills.io
DeepSeek Harness plugin (bundle): visually create spec-compliant skills — Huawei Cloud mode per 《华为云基础云服务Skills和仓库管理规范》 / generic mode per agentskills.io
DeepSeek Harness 插件：本地优先的播客播放器 + 转写 + 双语字幕 + 字幕翻译。
DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for 滑动变祖器 daily voting and trends.
为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web/Desktop 界面设置自定义背景图：右下角面板选择图片、恢复默认或移除，状态持久化在 $DSH_HOME/dsh-background/。
把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里折叠状态的英文思考预览自动翻译成中文（宿主侧同源代理 + 持久缓存 + 浏览器侧 DOM 就地替换）。
Native Windows always-on-top sidebar control for DeepSeek Harness
DSH web bundle: codex-style Approve For Me — a reviewer model auto-approves low-risk escalation requests, and auto-rejects (or routes to the user) high-risk ones.
DSH web bundle: inline page previews from `html page-preview` fences plus a floating, session-scoped preview window for local HTML projects and http(s) URLs.
DSH web bundle: pause the current turn at the next step boundary (graceful drain), persist everything, and resume later — including after a DSH restart.

Turn DeepSeek Harness sidebar entries into a compact icon row with adjustable icon size, per-entry visibility and ordering, plus a Settings shortcut in the footer row and custom icons for any installed plugin in either sidebar region.
Open the DSH right Sidebar automatically when a new chat is shown.
Web evidence and sourced images for DeepSeek Harness answers
Fallback models for DeepSeek Harness: a global failover chain and a per-Session override, with a settings page and a composer menu.
Quick temporary conversation & workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI
DSH provider plugin: free-pi (ad-funded free inference, incl. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) as an OpenAI-compatible model source
DSH Web 桌宠用量小窗「蓝色大肥鱼」：骨骼动画角色（呼吸 / 蹦跳 / 耳朵抖动 / 尾巴摆动）+ 点击小黄鸭与缩放「啵」音效；按 DSH 配置的套餐自动匹配用量适配器（OpenCode Go / Command Code / DeepSeek 官方），套餐制显示用量百分比、按量计费显示余额，失败时降级到本地统计。

Real-time session cost readout for DeepSeek Harness: composer-dock cost preview, today usage chart, prices kept in sync with the DeepSeek official site (peak/off-peak aware), plus price_estimate/session_cost agent tools.
连接 ESP32-S3 Buddy，显示会话状态与 Token 用量，并与官方会话卡片同步审批。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：接入官方 IAR C-SPY MCP Server，在对话里编译、下载和调试 IAR Embedded Workbench 工程，并提供中文配置页与 iar-cspy 技能。
DSH 多端管理 · Remote SSH：通过 SSH 在同一原生侧栏管理多台机器的工作区与会话。

Capy-style ambient background for the DeepSeek Harness workspace: pick an image, then the plugin composes it with a very large bottom black gradient and a soft radial 'aura' around the composer so the UI looks like it is sitting inside the scene. Additive only - existing UI, layout and behavior stay untouched.
profile 间插件迁移：把网页版（web）profile 的插件集安全地牵引到桌面端（desktop）—— 算差异、预检、生成退出后执行的脚本、重启后核对。绝不把实例配置（端口/坐标/地址）一起抄过去。
Configurable user-confirmed lessons that help DeepSeek Harness avoid repeating mistakes.
DSH web GUI composer real-time token counter (client plugin, v1)
七牛云用量面板插件：在 DSH Web GUI 设置页展示指定 API Key 当天的各模型 Token 用量，以及账号资源包的利用情况
Browser file manager for DeepSeek Harness workspaces: upload, download, zip, rename, delete and create folders from the Web GUI, so the SFTP round trip is no longer needed.
DSH 新拟态主题插件：冷灰表面、钢蓝强调、柔和阴影。
PlugBox 插件适配与管理工具：统一的插件协议与资源抽象，经适配层接入任意支持自定义插件的引擎层与智能体层工具。
PlugBox 插件适配与管理工具：统一的插件协议与资源抽象，经适配层接入任意支持自定义插件的引擎层与智能体层工具。

webCandidates.description: dsh-imagegen-studio — AI image + video studio plugin for the dsh web GUI. A fork of @q253595422/dsh-imagegen-video that keeps the whole image pipeline, the video pipeline and the infinite canvas, and adds (1) a user-defined protocol adapter layer so any gateway model can be wired up by pasting a cURL command, with per-model size / aspect / duration / extra-field mapping, request templating, response path extraction and dry-run preview; (2) one-click replicate (reference image or clip to prompt + parameters + render); (3) one-click duration continuation (tail-frame chaining to extend a clip past the provider cap, with optional crossfade).

DSH knowledge base and document conversion plugin: filename/content/metadata search, locate-by-doc_id/name with content reading, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, per-document image descriptions written to a sidecar markdown, a deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph (Neo4j) layer — ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, and node/relation writes all go through the DocChain API (no Neo4j password needed). Every script-backed capability also ships as a native tool executed in-process; the configuration page keeps switchable docchain environments with per-environment topic selection
DeepSeek Harness 插件：悬浮气泡「今天吃什么」—— 本地加权随机推荐菜品，点一下 0 token
Fund holdings panel for the DSH sidebar: import broker screenshots via Windows OCR, track daily P&L, holding return and DCA plans, and get emailed reports twice a day.

webCandidates.description: DSH Media Studio 3.1 — a visual creation and media-resource layer for DeepSeek Harness, with ComfyUI workflows and cloud providers.
给 DSH 桌面版加一个电源按钮：侧边栏一键「重启 DSH」/「关闭 DSH」。重启会自动把应用拉回来，改完插件或配置不必再去托盘翻菜单。

Git across your AI sessions: a session panel plus a global repository page for every workspace, one sync button that becomes Fetch/Pull/Push/Sync, a default-selected commit tab, default-checked changes, history, branches, conflict resolution and AI commit messages for DSH.

Take the friction out of daily DSH work: predicted next messages, a live one-line turn recap above the composer, and sidebar side questions with a composer-style model picker that stay out of the model context.
JumpServer asset lookup for DeepSeek Harness: query assets via conversation using AccessKey/SecretKey signed requests

Proxmox VE (PVE) control for DeepSeek Harness: inspect and manage nodes, VMs, containers, storage, firewall, cluster, Ceph, HA and access across multiple PVE clusters via the PVE2 JSON API (API Token or username/password auth).
网易云「一起听」插件：扫码或 cookie 登录，粘贴邀请链接进房，房间里说的话记在这里，还能绑一个 DSH 会话，用那个会话的人格回话。
DeepSeek off-peak alert, account balance and live Session cost estimate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
DSH 插件管理器：在 Web 设置页列出内置/三方插件，支持安装、卸载、启动、停用，并直跳三方插件 GitHub 仓库。
🪟 DSH 左右侧栏插件：左侧工作区/会话浏览 + 会话移动到文件夹，右侧文件浏览 + Git 面板（VSCode 风格提交历史/状态徽标），主区域文件预览 tab。
Bloom for DSH — 玻璃+莫兰迪主题。15 套 OKLCH 配色（全系可选，旧配色兼容），明暗自适应；磨砂玻璃面板默认常开；微动效 + 版本/更新指示。零依赖、TypeScript、WCAG AA。
DSH 环境自检与端口大屏：零外部依赖洞察系统架构、CLI 工具链（含广义 AI CLI）、DSH 插件生态、模型与环境凭据就绪状态、活跃监听端口与硬件概况（屏幕/GPU/显示器），支持端口安全释放与一键复制完整诊断。零联网、零私有凭钥明文泄露。
DSH 模型管理层：网关可达性探测、模型目录拉取、DeepSeek + MiniMax/智谱/Moonshot/StepFun 余额与配额、本月用量统计、余额预警、Provider 健康看板，再把本机装好的 codex / claude / agy 注册成子代理（装了才出现）。零运行时依赖，不改动 DSH 安装。
Usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: historical token and money aggregates folded from every durable session log, drawn as a rolling-year heatmap.
Open WebUI chat2api controller for DeepSeek Harness: runs the bundled reverse proxy, adjusts its config, and watches per-call usage from a panel inside DSH.

Cross-device DSH session sharing across Windows and macOS: sessions stay grouped under the same portable workspace on every machine, the git repository never contains a machine-specific path, and sync behaviour is configured in a runtime-live settings page. Workspace identity is explicit (workspaceId + name in the repo, local path only on the machine that owns it); adopted sessions get their header cwd rewritten as a byte-surgical first-frame edit that leaves the rest of the log untouched; deletion propagation is bounded so a peer can never remove a session you created.
原神 · 尼可 PV 背景队列 — 14 张去字幕截图、前后切换与可配置停留时间
DeepSeek Harness 磁盘哨兵插件：面向 Windows 的磁盘分析、AI 报告与安全清理工具
Unified desktop, browser-title, and sidebar completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness.
A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for inspecting redacted LLM HTTP request and response traces.

DSH web plugin: one yellow line under an assistant reply whose request rebuilt the prompt cache — idle gap, re-billed tokens, what changed in the prefix, approximate USD cost from the models.dev price list, and TTFT, placed where the miss actually happened.

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头显示 Cline / ClinePass 订阅额度、Credits 余额与 ClinePass token 消耗，支持多账号切换。Show Cline / ClinePass subscription quota, credits, and ClinePass token usage in the DSH session header, with multi-account switching.
dsh-whale-run — 把 DeepSeek Harness 界面上那只鲸鱼摘下来，放到输入框上方的跑道上跑一局。A hidden mini-game plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop.

An add-only multi-format materials library for DeepSeek Harness: pick Markdown, text/code, HTML, images, PDF, audio and video from workspaces, preview any candidate in the picker, place icons on a fixed non-overlapping desktop grid, marquee-select and move groups with trailing drags, swap folders and drop onto a breadcrumb path, read anything full-screen with browser-style tabs and an immersive mode, and keep Markdown's GFM tables, Mermaid/chart blocks, bookmarks, persistent last-read bar and 3-second line highlights while text/code, sandboxed HTML with same-folder assets, image zoom with Shift+wheel and click-to-full-screen, labelled path-bar actions, PDF and native media viewers cover the other formats; formats a browser cannot preview are not listed. · DSH 资料区：主动挑选 Markdown、纯文本/代码、HTML、图片、PDF、音频和视频，选择器里可先预览，在固定网格桌面内对齐摆放，支持右键框选整组拖动、文件夹交换、路径投放、沉浸式全屏阅读与标签页切换；Markdown 提供 GFM 表格、Mermaid/图表代码块、上次阅读提示、滚动条书签标记和跳转高亮，其余格式各有阅读器（HTML 沙箱并读取同目录资源、Shift+滚轮缩放与点按全屏图片、PDF、音视频），路径栏按钮带文字标签，浏览器无法预览的格式不会列出。
Shows what a DeepSeek Harness session's API token usage costs, priced from the provider-reported usage of every settled model call.

把本机 WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy 账号池接进 DeepSeek Harness：自托管网关进程并注册模型 provider、Web 设置面板（网关状态 / 每账号积分 / OAuth 登录 / 凭证导入 / 账号管理）、成长任务自动化引擎（一键确认待办 → 执行 → 达标自动领奖）。 · Bring a local WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy account pool into DeepSeek Harness: a self-supervised gateway process with model-provider registration, a settings panel, and a growth-task automation engine.
Manage which plugin entries appear in the DeepSeek Harness left sidebar: hide or show any sidebar panel row without disabling the plugin.
Split the DSH main area into up to four panes, each with its own tab strip, composer and view switcher. Drag a tab to a pane edge to split. Bilingual (zh/en).
dsh 插件 · 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token/占比，cl100k 估算），类型筛选与超阈值标红一眼锁定大头，勾选后精确裁剪——不经 LLM 总结，删了什么一目了然。
dsh 插件 · 白噪音播放器：场景完全由音频根目录下的文件夹决定（有什么算什么），点「执行下载」让 AI 后台从 Wikimedia Commons 按 CC0/PD/CC BY 分门别类下载到对应文件夹。顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇四种播放模式 + N 小时或指定时刻定时关。宿主侧流式读取（Range 支持），不上传不分发。
dsh 插件 · 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动帮你续上，不用手敲「继续」。有序规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。
dsh 插件 · 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。
dsh 插件 · 会话收藏夹：左侧会话行收藏/星标，收藏夹主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计与 fork 关系图。
dsh 插件 · FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强 / QA 工作台 / Agent 团队 / 执行流程图 / 使用量仪表盘），面板看状态、一键补装与检查更新，快照还原防依赖丢失。
dsh 插件 · 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（预览/上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件夹与多选文件可打包 zip 下载，文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。
dsh 插件 · 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。
dsh 插件 · 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。
dsh 插件 · 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按 学科/分类 放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。
dsh 插件 · Git 服务器：独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki/发版/标签/里程碑/webhook），可复用 user-management 账号，局域网可 clone，设置页一键启停、崩溃自动拉起。
dsh 插件 · 团队知识库：多库各有加工约定，上传素材由 bot 会话串行蒸馏成结构化文章；支持全文检索、问 AI 检索带来源作答、正文可编辑、回收站软删除、版本历史可回滚、页面反馈后台 agent 自动修正。
dsh 插件 · 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风到处漂移摆动，一根线牵在屏幕底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头……硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换的数据配置，还支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。
dsh 插件 · 字符雨：三模式（黑客帝国英文数字 / 道法修仙篆体·嵌入霞鹜篆书 OFL / 甲骨卜辞·嵌入甲骨数据集 CC-BY 4.0）× 七种配色（经典绿/琥珀/赛博青/品红/鎏金/七彩轮转/七彩随机）× 金边发光，三轴自由组合；雨字可标老式注音符号；agent 流式 token 原文实时掺进雨里，雨势随活跃度起伏，透明度/速度/密度/深浅配色可调，双击清屏。

DeepSeek Harness plugin: cron-driven scheduled items. Each item carries a title, a prompt, and a croner expression; executions spawn a fresh agent session in a bound workspace (or the default cwd) and run on schedule or on demand. Includes a full-page management UI.
dsh 插件 · 工艺管理：「工艺」是可复用的多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板——定义阶段、环节指令、门禁与流转规则，agent 按工艺分阶段推进。支持浏览/编辑（表单与 YAML 双向同步）/校验/导入导出/AI 生成，内置库只读、我的库可写；面板可直接发起运行，逐环节开真实会话执行、门禁评审，看板跟踪全程。
dsh 插件 · 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏 / 预置大尺寸 / 自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题 / 自定义颜色），悬浮球即开即调，随 dsh profile 持久化
dsh 插件 · 侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方的全局面板行、各插件入口行（自家/第三方一律识别）与底部入口收进一个菜单按钮，点开二级菜单原样触发各入口；按名称白名单可保留常驻项；侧栏折叠成窄轨时按钮变纯图标；全程设计 token，明暗主题自动跟随。
dsh 插件 · 会话智能标题：用 LLM 自动改写会话标题。每轮对话结束后对「用户消息 + 助手回答」的完整转写做一轮总结，标题跟随会话真实主题；首条消息即时出题、刷新节流与长会话冻结防无谓重刷、同题静默跳过、失败自动重试、用户手动改名不被覆盖、可选启动回填，标题模型可单独指定，设置页可视化配置。
dsh 插件 · 多机同步与多协议备份：Git（分支→PR→合并、冲突交 AI）+ WebDAV + 本地文件夹三种协议各一个页签一个开关；技能/会话/设置/插件清单独立开关与策略；纯备份协议与 git backup 布局一致（backup/<实例ID>/）；快照本地优先、多协议通用上云与恢复回退。

dsh 插件 · 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，也可随时手动立即执行；可视化选择器实时预览最近 5 次执行时间，支持绑定工作区、指定模型、会话按任务自动命名、cron 即时校验与全屏管理页，执行记录可一键打开对应会话；任务开始/完成/失败可推送到 IM 投递插件绑定的聊天渠道，执行结论可随通知一并推送；支持免打扰时段（跨零点友好），时段内推送自动跳过。
dsh 插件 · 智囊团：思维模型全方位分析：内置 161 个经典思维模型库（决策/战略/认知/心理/沟通/学习/系统/创新/执行九大分类），输入一个问题即可用选中的多个模型并行 AI 分析，产出含共识/分歧/盲区/行动清单的综合报告页；支持自动分析与提示词往返导入两种模式。
dsh 插件 · WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证或复用 user-management 账号、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

dsh 插件 · 专家管理：管理 WorkBuddy 兼容格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），浏览/安装 50+ 内置专家市场；每个专家注册为「仅用户可调用」的技能，在对话输入框用 /expert-名称 即可以该专家的身份执行任务（宿主确定性注入角色定义与技能清单，不占用模型目录 token）；支持编辑已安装专家与一键分享到市场（fork → PR）。
dsh 插件 · 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动复盘，把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，模型可直接调用；同时把环境事实与用户偏好写入跨会话记忆（MEMORY.md / USER.md，首冻结注入每个对话）；支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。
dsh 插件 · 技能市场：一个页面管理本机所有 coding agent 的技能（Claude、ZCode、Codex 等十余个执行器），一键收编进 DSH 用户库供 skill 工具调用；内置 6600+ ntd 技能市场可浏览搜索安装，支持注入开销（≈token/字符）统计与排序、模型可见性治理与市场每日自动同步。

dsh 插件 · 用户管理：自带 HTTPS 网关挡在 dsh web 前面做登录门禁——未登录访问一律 401 跳登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员，注册默认审批制；支持 TOTP 两步验证（验证器 App 扫码/手输密钥绑定）；管理员可管理所有用户（新增/删除/禁用/重置密码/角色调整/重置两步验证）、IP 封禁并查看登录记录、访问记录与操作日志三本审计账，普通用户只能查看和修改自己的信息。
Manage a LAN or Tailscale reachable dsh web instance from inside DSH: pick the bind address, start, stop, restart, and read the token URL.
Cloudflare Tunnel plugin for DeepSeek Harness: expose the local web GUI through a quick / token / API tunnel behind a token-gated loopback proxy, with optional Cloudflare Access email OTP.
SSH remote workspaces for the dsh web GUI, reusing the session sandbox mode and approval flow.
Real-time (sliding-window) token output speed for the DSH composer stats pill — replaces the whole-session average with a live tok/s reading while the model streams.
模型选择器排序插件：字母索引栏（A–Z、#）+ 版本倒序（GLM-5.3 在 5.2 之上）+ 同族归并 + 搜索。接管 DSH 原生模型选择器，只负责排序与导航，不接入任何 provider。
Git for DeepSeek Harness: a repo/branch chip in the composer, a header Git button, and a split-screen Git panel (changes + staging + commit, history, and diffs) in the sidebar.
在工具调用行给读写的文件显示 JetBrains 文件类型图标，主题可在设置页切换。
DSH bundle that exposes host-wide and per-event-loop performance metrics (CPU / memory / IO / chat DOM) via a Settings tab, an optional HUD, an in-process MCP server, and a native agent tool.

右侧对话密度地图：消息分布/长短/当前位置 + 点击跳转（持久静态客户端插件，纯 DOM 低侵入）
开场语与收尾语：每次回复固定开场/收尾（含文案池、场景、按工作区绑定），另带会话花费台账与换会话交接摘要。
Real-time CPU, GPU, memory, disk and battery monitoring panel in the DSH sidebar, with per-application attribution, forecasts and exports

DSH Context OS: compose agent runs from complete context services through events and context contributions
Super-agent assembled from complete Context OS services
Capability suite for DeepSeek Harness: Pi MCP manager, subagents, side conversations, memory, background tasks and credential-dependent image generation.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: replace the model selector with one that shows real brand marks per provider (DeepSeek, Zhipu, Xiaomi, OpenCode Go…), so same-named models on different providers are never confused. Theme-adaptive, OpenCode-flavored.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin bundle showing your OpenCode Go remaining quota (5h / weekly / monthly) as a HUD beside the conversation and in the plugin settings.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: pop a desktop toast (bottom-right, like opencode) when a task / agent run completes or fails.

DSH Web UI 插件应用商店：目录浏览/搜索/一键安装/兼容徽章/已装列表。A plugin store for DSH Web UI — catalog browse, search, one-click install, compat badges, installed list.
DSH plugin: a shared task board for multi-agent / subagent collaboration — create, claim, transition, and query tasks via a Cordis service key.
T3 Code style task sidebar for DeepSeek Harness, composed like the native Workspaces browser: group sessions by status (Pinned / Active / Working / Snoozed / Settled), by workspace, or in one list.
Attach files and folders in the DSH composer: clipboard paste, native file/folder picker, @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page
CTF 多层级 Agent 作战集群：用户层（用户 agent）/ 管理 agent 层（主 agent + 席位 agent）/ 做题 agent 层（solver）三级目录，DSH web 前端可视化（对话记录与对话框之间的 CTF 面板），统一题目获取与 Flag 提交路径，管理 agent 自主调配模型（deepseek / mimo / gpt-5.5）。
OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage percents with reset countdowns, read from OpenCode's official usage API.
Use Claude Code, Codex and, optionally, Pi sessions inside DeepSeek Harness: list, open, continue, pin, rename and archive them in the DSH Workspace browser.
Cross-surface plain-language trajectory visualization and review for DeepSeek Harness.
GPT API：在对话中调用 GPT、文生图和参考图生图，支持自定义 OpenAI 兼容接口。
Edit your own spreadsheets in place, together with the agent. Also reads PDF, Word and text. Local only.
棱镜 Prism：DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件。种子生成全部配色，亮暗成对、对比度自动达标，支持壁纸、玻璃、省电和深度自定义。A seed-based theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness with guaranteed contrast, wallpapers, glass and deep customization.
Ctrl+F search for DeepSeek Harness: rendered hits are highlighted and jumped, unrendered history is searched from the session log on the host.
Managed local fingerprint relays so DSH can reach providers that gate on the client's TLS fingerprint
A global hotkey that opens a small prompt bar from anywhere on your Mac and starts a DeepSeek Harness session with what you type.
人类 cannot live without 表情包：让 DSH 和用户在 WebUI 里发表情
DeepSeek Harness plugin: folders, a fork tree, Claude-style drag effects, ZIP export and AI titles for the Workspaces sidebar, keeping DSH's own UI
DeepSeek Harness plugin: clear the conversation context when you ask, so old turns stop costing tokens

DeepSeek Harness plugin: memory graphs for every chat, on by default (switch the plugin off on the Plugins page to stop); other chats in the workspace recall exact past text by topic, chat or day, so fewer input tokens are re-sent
Multiple chat panels for DeepSeek Harness: view and interact with several agent sessions side by side in a Mission Control grid
Enhanced workspace directory browser for the dsh web UI: quick access to /mnt Windows drives, full breadcrumb ancestry from the filesystem root, and an always-visible path input.
Official DeepSeek pricing and off-peak message scheduling for DeepSeek Harness.

Animated wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 8 built-in canvas backgrounds (particles, meteor shower, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, with speed/density/opacity/blur controls and durable localStorage persistence

Connection tests for the models configured in Settings -> Models: one minimal chat round-trip per model with connected/unstable/failed verdicts, automatic retries for transient failures, and first-output/total latency. Credentials never leave the Host process.
Use your ChatGPT plan in DeepSeek Harness with independent Sign in with ChatGPT authorization
Independent context-aware side chat for the DSH Better Sidebar.
OpenCode Go 订阅用量与真实花费监控（DeepSeek Harness Web 插件）：5h 滚动/每周/每月用量百分比 + 月度真实花费与按天明细，直接显示在对话输入区。

Embed the full God’s Eye View in DeepSeek Harness with DSH agent control, process management and China/international map modes.
MCP Station for DeepSeek Harness: a curated MCP app store with one-click install, browser automation presets, health checks and safe management. · DSH MCP 应用商店：精选 MCP 一键安装、浏览器预设、连通性检测与安全管理。

Local DSH memory engine with a deep-space constellation map. 0.8.0 fork: nebula background, semantic-constellation layout, TF-IDF kNN relation edges, labels/legend/controls, collapsible review card. Upstream: dsh-memory-engine 0.7.5 (MIT, dsh-memory-engine contributors).

Guardrailed DSH plugin-development skill bundle: ships the cordis-plugin-development skill, a settings tab that drafts plugin prompts for the agent, and the scaffolding/validation toolkit the skill calls.
Open many DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side as draggable, stackable cards on a free canvas.

Skill management for DeepSeek Harness: browse built-in and local skills, import agent skills, and install skills from a credential-free public market (or an employee-scoped Skill Hub). · DSH 技能站：浏览内置与本地技能，一键导入各家 agent 技能，并从公共技能市场或企业内部 Skill Hub 安装技能。

SSH/SFTP remote workspaces for DSH: local cache with conflict-safe bidirectional sync, remote terminals, port forwarding and model tools. · DSH 远程工作区：通过 SSH/SFTP 把服务器目录映射为本地缓存工作区，支持冲突安全双向同步、远程终端、端口转发与模型工具。

Download any file the DSH Sidebar previews (PDF, XLSX, DOCX, images, binaries) to a remote browser: an authenticated streaming attachment route plus a Download control in the document preview header and the unpreviewable state.

In-browser audio and video previews in the DSH right Sidebar, backed by an authenticated byte-range media route so a remote browser can play and seek large files without opening a native app on the Host.

Give the whole left column back to the conversation on narrow screens: below the 1024px auto-collapse breakpoint the sidebar is removed from the frame entirely (no 56px icon rail), and a header button opens it as an overlay drawer with a tap-anywhere scrim.

Run a software company alone with a team of AI agents: an embedded `one-person-company` skill plus a sidebar task board. Bootstraps a repo-native operating system — ten role charters, spec-as-contract workflow, and an `opc` CLI that assembles the exact prompt for each agent.
Make the sidebar's Add workspace button work in a remote browser: prompt for a folder name and create it next to the current workspace, instead of opening a native OS chooser on the host machine.
Add a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session context menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size and the session's live activity before deleting.
VNC client tab for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: an RFB client that connects to any VNC/RFB server over a WebSocket-to-TCP bridge running in the Host

Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) language pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): registers a zh-Hant locale and ~2,700 generated dictionaries across every namespace the web GUI uses, with a switch in Settings → General → Language
Keyword + code-graph search tab for the dsh web GUI, docked in the built-in right sidebar
Keil MDK/uVision workbench for DSH: let the model inspect, build and flash embedded projects, with an optional sidebar panel.
Seek — the DeepSeek pixel whale as a DSH web overlay pet.
Persistent evidence-backed knowledge workflows and an Agent preset for DSH

DeepSeek Harness session management (unofficial fork of dsh-chat-manager, not affiliated with DeepSeek or the upstream author): an official-slot plugin for dsh 0.2.x (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2) that reads archived conversations in place and permanently deletes sessions
LAAP 意识认知架构的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：五维意识动力学 + PSI 需求驱动 + 元认知监控 + zvec 向量记忆
OpenCode Go plan quota chip for the DeepSeek Harness composer toolbar: 5-hour, weekly, and monthly allowance left, over one authenticated usage route
DeepSeek Harness ↔ WeChat bridge for the wechat-ai MCP server
鲸宝 Q 版桌宠：DSH 页面右下角置顶显示、卖萌动作、气泡框、确认提醒与语音播报（Web 端 + DSH 桌面端通用）
DSH 临时聊天插件：页面悬浮一只缓慢游动的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼（官方 favicon 轮廓 + 蓝紫绿渐变），点击打开可拖动/最小化的临时聊天浮窗；默认跟随会话模型，支持插件内单独配置 OpenAI 兼容模型，流式输出、复制、清空。
潮间（Intertidal）：让 DSH 按设定间隔把屏幕交给一片此刻的海，到点自己退走。天光跟随本地太阳位置，可用自己的图片或视频作海面。不采集数据。

Inbound large-paste handling for the DeepSeek Harness composer: each 4–50 KB paste folds into one chip you can expand or delete on its own, and a ≥50 KB paste becomes a real file attachment with a deliverable card. · DSH 入站大文本粘贴处理：每次 4–50 KB 粘贴折叠成一枚可单独展开/删除的 chip，≥50 KB 转成真附件并出交付卡。
DSH 输入框 prompt 优化插件：一键把草稿润色为更清晰、更结构化的高质量 prompt。默认使用当前会话模型（零配置，SSE 流式 + 推理过程实时可见），也支持自配 OpenAI 兼容 API。
A collapsible Recent tasks block at the section level of the DSH sidebar: chats with no workspace land there instead of piling up in 未分组 / DSH 侧边栏里与「工作区」同级、可独立折叠的「最近任务」区块：没有工作区的对话自动归到这里。
DSH 临时聊天插件：页面悬浮一只缓慢游动的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼（官方 favicon 轮廓 + 蓝紫绿渐变），点击打开可拖动/最小化的临时聊天浮窗；默认跟随会话模型，支持插件内单独配置 OpenAI 兼容模型，流式输出、复制、清空。
Paper Plane X plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: context panel + /ppx-paper search
给 DSH 会话里的产物卡片、已编辑文件卡片和正文文件链接加上右键菜单：把文件本身复制到剪贴板、复制完整/短路径、打开所在文件夹、用默认程序打开。
All-in-one DeepSeek Harness UI panels: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes paired two per tab as right-Sidebar tab types, each with a draggable split — one bundle, one loader row.

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a "Check updates" button to the Plugins settings section: it scans every installed plugin bundle for published updates and evaluates its peer-dependency compatibility against the running DSH runtime.
将原作者 linshenkx 的 prompt-optimizer 移植到 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方插件（0.2.0-rc.2 适配 / 面向未来版本前向兼容）
Mebular memory, task graph, and shared Console for DeepSeek Harness. | Mebular 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供记忆、任务图与共享 Console。
Exa web search for DeepSeek Harness: uses the official Exa API when a key is available and a keyless public channel otherwise, switching automatically. No extra tools, no system-prompt changes.

Keep a DeepSeek Harness agent step alive through an exhausted account quota: after the base provider retry policy gives up on a QUOTA failure, retry the same request once per hour without an attempt limit, and publish the entering, leaving, and current state of that long-term retry to other plugins.
A persistent office of colleague agents for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of ordinary sessions with channels, direct messages, and delivery that wakes a colleague when something is addressed to it.

Named subagent templates: each template fixes a starting route — one provider/model pair, or a route pool a route is resolved from per child — an agent preset, and an optional persona, so a delegating agent picks a template by name instead of configuring provider, model, and reasoning effort per call, and a background template child's output is delivered to its parent without a collection call.
开眼看世界：DSH 决策层插件——让 agent 在「该上网搜索」的时候先搜再答（fresh-info-first / 联网优先）。判定『何时搜索』（决策层），不自带搜索引擎（能力层）。

File-change monitor & code editor for the DSH Web UI: watch agent edits land as line-by-line diffs in real time, right beside your conversation, then view and edit any workspace file without leaving the browser.
Android Logcat viewer for the DSH Web GUI: live adb logcat stream with level/keyword filters, pause/clear/export, crash snapshots, remote screen control, and 30 agent tools.
实时同步 GitHub dsh-plugin topic 的插件市场：自动发现并标注 Star，支持按 Star / 名字排序与名称搜索，Web 设置页一键安装（带进度），并可更新 / 关闭 / 卸载已装插件（本地增强版：新增按名字排序、精简 agent 安装提示词）。
Search, favorites, branching, and personalization for the official DeepSeek Harness turn navigator
Local, per-session prompt stash for DeepSeek Harness Web
Marks the composer of a subagent session in DeepSeek Harness.
RTK command rewriting and tool-output compaction for the DeepSeek Harness: rewrites bash commands to their rtk equivalents and compacts noisy tool output before it reaches the model.

Manage MCP servers (stdio / streamable-http) for dsh web; tools are reached only through four middleware tools. DSH MCP 管理器：Web 侧边栏「MCP」入口，面板按状态分级展示 MCP 服务器（运行中/连接中/已配置/失败），支持快速接入（stdio / streamable-http 表单）与粘贴 mcpServers JSON 导入。已连接服务器的工具一律经中间层工具（ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_detail / ws_mcp_call / ws_mcp_list）访问：宿主注册名 mcp__<id>__<tool> 是内部标识（id 按 (工作空间, 服务器名) 分配、不可由服务器名推导），不对模型可见，禁止直呼。

Task-event notifications for dsh web via browser Notification and host system toast. 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT / macOS osascript / Linux notify-send，均无需额外安装）；提示音可配、每条通知独立显示不互相替换、非安全上下文自动降级横幅

Multi-provider usage stats for dsh web: floating capsule plus detail panel, fed by drop-in mjs adapters. 用量统计悬浮框（v2 契约）：胶囊 + 详情面板，宿主端渲染 HTML 注入；用户 mjs 适配器三函数接入任意数据源（fetchData/formatCapsule/formatPanel），宿主注入共享图表工具（utils），密钥配置链注入、按天分片 JSONL 历史、热更新可选；内置 OpenCode Go / DeepSeek 官方 / 智谱 Coding Plan (CN) 适配器
自定义 DSH 左侧「全局面板」菜单哪些项显示、哪些隐藏
在 DSH 右侧栏里提供 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理与端口转发的插件；密码交给操作系统密码箱保管，插件自身不实现加密。
DeepSeek Harness 远程控制：手机浏览器扫码接入电脑上的 DSH 会话，继续对话、审批工具、预览文件，局域网直连或自托管公网节点。
DeepSeek Harness 远程控制：手机浏览器扫码接入电脑上的 DSH 会话，继续对话、审批工具、预览文件，局域网直连或自托管公网节点。
已停止维护；请迁移到 @winlin926/dsh-remote-connect 继续用手机浏览器连接 DeepSeek Harness。
Delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the running Web runtime: detach the live store entry, drop workspace records, and remove the on-disk artifacts. Host half plus a web client half in one package.

Per-conversation DeepSeek API cost badge for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency session projection pricing each LLM step against the official rate card, with a live cost badge and hover card in the web conversation header.
One-click clear for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the Ungrouped group's New Session control that archives every ungrouped conversation, with confirmation and undo.
Mobile sidebar drawer for DeepSeek Harness: on narrow Web viewports the 56px collapsed rail is replaced by a top toggle button that slides the sidebar in over the content.
DSH 提示词方案库与综合编排：全局暂停、其他来源检查、锁定模板与整套方案管理
按工作区管理 DSH 项目规则（本机私有 CLAUDE.local.md 或团队共享 CLAUDE.md），带设置面板与待确认区

DeepSeek Harness 纯插件：思考状态行文案轮换。把内置 UI 的 "Deep diving..." 扩展为 73 个 deep 系短语的英/中双语池（deep seeking / 深度求索中 / deep breaching / 跃出海面中 ...，含 Claude Code spinner 词表扩充），回合开场随机一条，回合内随新思考段/工具调用切换（最短间隔 3 秒），点击状态行可切换中英文，不改 DSH 源码。

Enhances DeepSeek Harness native folding with a richer turn bar (poker icon, duration, TTFT, tokens, tok/s, cache hit, running status), a pure-CSS poker skin for official step groups and plugin-owned appearance settings. DSH owns all folding semantics; this plugin only enhances the UI. Zero source patches.
Shared token budgets for DeepSeek Harness agent trees
Declarative multi-agent team workflows for DeepSeek Harness
管理 New API / One API 公益站：站点额度查看与每日自动签到领取额度。
DeepSeek Harness 插件榜单与需求反馈 / Plugin rankings and feature requests
DeepSeek Harness 本地录音转写、说话人区分和会议纪要 / Local transcription, speaker diarization and meeting notes for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：🐋 悬浮球面板配置（启用/候选数/第二意见/验证标准，仅当前会话生效），模型自动对任务执行「并行候选→验证选优」流水线，无需任何特殊指令前缀。
地盘光标（dsh-territory-cursor）。地盘内列出窗口、截图，并对控件做左键或整段赋值，不移动系统鼠标。本仓库自带 desktop_step，用系统鼠标操作整块虚拟桌面。思路借鉴 dsh-desktop-tools-plugin（EvilOfRed，MIT）。
DSH host tool bundle: manage glab / gh authorization and SSH keys
Persistent inline image, video, and audio previews for DeepSeek Harness Web conversations, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
Skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: proactive skill activation with trigger hooks, GitHub source sync, and a Settings management UI.
OpenCode Go subscription, model allowance, usage meter, and per-million-token rate panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Desktop Beta Compatible)
Server management, an independent encrypted credential vault, and per-server recurring operations for DeepSeek Harness.
Context-pressure ball for DeepSeek Harness: live occupancy, heat colouring, and a user-set threshold that compacts the conversation between turns instead of interrupting it.
暖纸 Warm Paper —— 米杏纸色 × 宋体 × 砖红的手记风 DSH Web 主题：纸纹、书脊线、日期戳。
Mnemosyne 永久记忆插件 - 为 DSH 提供长期记忆、向量搜索和 LLM 反思功能
Hindsight memory manager for DeepSeek Harness: settings UI (intranet/extranet routes) with automatic check & install of the official @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents DSH adapter
DSH 桌面版背景主题插件：给 DeepSeek Harness 换上动态背景——10 种原版场景渲染器（银河 / 辉光地平线 / 层峦 / 云穹 / 极光电离层 / 黑洞 / 云列车 / 粒子成像 / 像素雕塑 / 闪烁方块）、壁纸视频素材库、UI 表面分区透明，以及逐像素复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。
DSH 插件（桌面版，适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3）：把聊天输入框变成代码编辑器一样的输入风格（CodeMirror 6 接管 conversation.composer.bar）。
Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: microphone, transcription, and optional dsh LLM polishing into an editable draft
DSH 皮肤：静态/视频/生成式渐变壁纸 + 构图缩放平移 + 全窗铺开（侧栏与所有面板一起透出皮肤）+ 分部位透明度 + 纯字体颜色标注（只写 color，不产生任何方框）
DSH 自动更新：自动检测官方 GitHub（deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness）新版本，侧栏设置按钮旁一键全自动升级（npm 安装 + 自动重启）
See what a conversation feeds the model, what your rules keep out, and what one click would change.
A 70-line DeepSeek Harness plugin: one sidebar tab, one button, one test.
Preflight, release and test DeepSeek Harness plugins: check a folder or any GitHub repository, wait for npm to actually serve the version, and keep the market index honest.
DSH-Desktop LLM provider plugin for Command Code with model catalog sync, request retry, multi-credential support, and a settings UI.
DSH 插件用量与能力看板：本地采集会话事件、聚合为日表、面板/HTTP 查询，默认 local 零出站。

Offline and online export/import for DeepSeek Harness: pack a whole working DSH home (profile, plugins with node_modules, skills, hooks, AGENTS.md, task boards) into one .dshpkg, restore it on another machine over a file, a URL, or a one-shot LAN share — no network and no pnpm install required on the target.

Prompt enhancement for the dsh web GUI: rewrite the composer draft into a well-structured prompt through the harness LLM service, preview the before/after, then fill back, copy, or undo. Original draft is always preserved.
Tavily web search for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a Tavily search provider with a visual API-key card, plus a bridge to Tavily's hosted remote MCP server

Personal WeChat, WeCom and Feishu (飞书) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): QR-code login over Tencent's iLink channel, one DSH conversation per contact or group, two-way text, image, video, document and archive transfer, and Feishu bots (custom webhook and app)
DeepSeek Harness 花费仪表：左侧靠上的方形浮动窗，显示 DeepSeek API 会话花费，指针指示当前峰谷费率（标准/翻倍），余额低于阈值时顶部红灯闪烁报警。

Order and disclosure for the DSH left sidebar, driven by what is actually running: a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when it finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.
AI UI Studio — 在 DSH 里预览你的 Web 应用，用拖拽/点选/AI 流式有效调整前端样式并写回源码

DSH web client plugin: a temporary workspace (临时工作区) — every conversation it contains is deleted at the next Harness restart (immediately or after a delay), optionally behind a confirm dialog. Adds a small icon beside the sidebar's "Add workspace" button and its own page in the Settings navigation.
DSH 插件：让 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 的 TUN + fake-ip 模式下正常工作。只豁免 fake-ip 保留段（198.18.0.0/15、fdfe:dcba:9876::/64、2001:2::/48），其余 SSRF 防护不变；不需要任何代理环境变量或 Clash 改动。
Coordinator + task sessions for DeepSeek Harness: durable task ledger, cross-project memory, dependency orchestration, inbox/digest, snapshots, and a browser task panel.

DSH 按需代理插件（给 Agent 用的工具）：需要时自动拉起 mihomo 内核，空闲后自动关闭，平时不占端口、不留后台进程。本机已有别的代理（FlClash 等）在跑时直接借道它的出口，一个进程都不起；自己的内核用 7899 而非 7890，不跟 FlClash 抢端口。永不改 Windows 系统代理设置。HTTP 接口 + 必要 CLI 是主入口，设置界面只保留配置来源（订阅 / 从 FlClash 导入 / 手动粘贴）。首次运行会自动联网下载内核（约 61MB）到插件目录，删掉即清除。On-demand proxy for DeepSeek Harness: spawns a mihomo core only when needed, shuts it down when idle, and borrows an already-running local proxy instead of competing for its port.
DSH 模型中心：双栏模型选择器（左提供商 / 右模型）+ 悬浮能力面板（上下文 / 输出 / 视觉 / 思考档位），改动真实生效。

在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏嵌入 LibreTV 免费视频面板，并内置红果短剧本地播放服务。LibreTV video panel plus a bundled local Hongguo short-drama player in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

DSH plugin: stop auxiliary LLM calls from burning the output budget. Degrades reasoning effort for compaction summaries, session titles and prompt enhancement; raises their max_tokens floor; appends verbatim-retention sections to compaction instructions; and strips tools from compaction calls, so a high default thinking level cannot silently truncate a checkpoint.

DSH plugin: shrink what the model sees, not what runs. Composes plugins and skills into named sets resolved per session / workspace / global. DSH plugin: context reclaim at tool-result creation time, and at every later seam where context grows. Lossless noise purification, per-content-type bounding with retrieval pointers, tool-definition folding, system-prompt section-order stabilisation, and prompt-line trimming. Five Cordis seams, zero runtime dependencies. Also takes over the host's writable-request path, so the official `dsh-llm` file patch is no longer needed, and reports — without ever applying — which other official file patches are present. Never rewrites committed history, so the provider prefix cache is never invalidated.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that indexes the workspace and rewrites composer draft prompts via a configured yce-mcp server.

Jev (TypeSafe System One decision model) for DeepSeek Harness — seven tools: jev_decision (up to 25 typed questions in one parallel call, measured median 266-484 ms), jev_choose (rank 2-10 approaches), jev_batch (one set of up to 5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text, paste-ready sortable table, built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets), jev_usage (local usage panel: measured calls, tokens, cost, rolling windows and an optional hard budget stop), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (auto-guard audit), jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark run 6-way parallel, 4.96 s wall, 96.3% measured). Plus an automatic tool-call guard (10 deterministic rules in two tiers - 7 hard-block, 3 Jev-judged - plus a Jev risk/loop backstop) whose own Jev verdicts are now metered into the usage ledger, an agent/pre-step auto-triage router (0.8.4) that judges each turn's first step and injects plugin-sourced advice so the harness actually calls Jev, system-prompt guidance with mandatory-trigger rules, a GUI settings card, and a money-first composer usage pill that stays silent about quota status and reset countdowns unless a local budget really exists. The /jev mount always answers - a live status page while dashboard.enabled is off. TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint, so the panel reports only locally measured usage against locally configured budgets - never a fabricated provider balance. 0.8.6: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools is an optional peer and never an installed dependency, so a hoisted copy can no longer shadow the host runtime and stall startup. 0.8.5: the local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json by default so the cumulative total survives a restart, the popover derives remaining as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend for that period, the pill asks for that declaration instead of inventing one, and it re-reads the route every 20 s instead of every 60 s. 0.8.5 also adds jev_batch, the batch judge-and-organize tool: 1-20 texts get the same 1-5 judgments in one call, one real API call per text with bounded concurrency, and the result is a paste-ready sortable table where a failed row is reported as failed. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one feature, never the profile.

Per-model reasoning-effort levels, multimodal input settings, and Magpie gateway model import for custom (llm-pi-ai) providers in the DSH Models settings page, with automatic models.dev completion for sparse gateway listings and compatibility for gateways that decorate model ids (e.g. `cn:kimi-k3-1`) or spell detail fields differently (e.g. `attachments`, `reasoning_supported_efforts`). · 为自定义供应商的每个模型配置推理强度档位、多模态输入，并从 Magpie 网关导入模型能力；兼容 `cn:kimi-k3-1` 这类带标识的模型 id 与 `attachments`/`reasoning_supported_efforts` 等网关扩展字段，缺少模型详情时按 https://models.dev 智能匹配补全。
聊天界面增强：会话内搜索框、上下滚动圆钮、会话长按菜单（置顶/导出txt/复制全文/回最新），与chat-search后端配套。
插件市场Plus·侧栏版：在DSH侧栏挂"插件市场Plus"条目，点开即GitHub实时插件榜(topic:dsh-plugin)+任意插件README全文详情(免安装看效果·星/fork/更新/协议统计)+安装任务生成。浏览器端直读GitHub，零服务器装载依赖。

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) file preview & editor plugin: in-browser workspace file tree, multi-format preview (code, Markdown, PDF, image, Office, HTML), online editing with version history, and full-text search. DSH 文件预览插件：工作区文件树浏览、代码/Markdown/PDF/图片/Office/HTML 多格式预览、在线编辑与版本回滚、全文搜索。
AgentTrace 智能体轨迹：DSH 会话日志可视化插件——首页闭环总览 + 三层渐进式查看器（摘要/故事线/事件树）+ 四层进度体系 + 可折叠 JSON 查看器 + SVG 闭环轮环图会话图（每个轮次一个环、子 Agent 分叉环，融合 dsh-seelog）。host 与 client 半均由 tsdown 构建，随 harness 启动。

DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source, skillhub market browse/install with category & sort, guided create wizard and AI drafting, in a web GUI panel. 技能中心：本地技能管理 + skillhub 技能市场 + 向导创建 + AI 辅助。
Extensible local development error HUD with Go, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java, Spring, and opt-in AI diagnosis for DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness 全能插件：识别/生图/改图一体化，无需切换模型——用常规 DeepSeek 模型即可自动调用视觉与生图模型（gemini_vision / gemini_generate_image / gemini_optimize_image）。多后端：Gemini 原生 + 任意 OpenAI 兼容服务（GPT-4o、Qwen-VL、GLM-4V、Moonshot、gpt-image、DALL-E、Flux、Stable Diffusion、OpenRouter、硅基流动、各类中转等），生成后自动视觉自检反馈，优于 modlens。

DeepSeek Harness 全能插件：识别/生图/改图一体化，无需切换模型——用常规 DeepSeek 模型即可自动调用视觉与生图模型（gemini_vision / gemini_generate_image / gemini_optimize_image）。多后端：Gemini 原生 + 任意 OpenAI 兼容服务（GPT-4o、Qwen-VL、GLM-4V、Moonshot、gpt-image、DALL-E、Flux、Stable Diffusion、OpenRouter、硅基流动、各类中转等），生成后自动视觉自检反馈，优于 modlens。

Cut the input-token cost of long Harness sessions: structure-aware tool-output compression, three measured elision depths for how hard a long result is cut, per-agent tool-catalogue visibility, a graded composer panel that turns each saving on or off, a statistics page that reports what was saved, and a per-workspace session memory that is matched before the transcript is re-read.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: OpenCode Go plan usage readout docked under the composer, aligned with the input bar width
AT Terminal for DeepSeek Harness: SSH/SFTP assets and remote SSH terminals.
AT Terminal plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): SSH/SFTP assets and remote SSH terminals.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session — they are mirrored locally and put back when you return to that conversation or the composer remounts, and forgotten once the message is sent or you remove them.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: pasted screenshots become numbered image references. Every Ctrl+V image is admitted to the official attachment library with a stable 图片N number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an @图片 source and a zoom overlay, can be inserted as a native reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste, if the auto-insert switch is on — and keeps a usage ledger so time buckets, state buckets and a trash-backed cleanup wizard show what is safe to clear.

DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select assistant text, annotate (optional), and press Enter to send the annotation block with your message — the model replies to each annotation by number, with hoverable chips in the reply. X-WIDE fork adds a color studio and an annotation outline.

DSH 交接插件 / Handoff plugin：/handoff 生成结构化交接卡（自动序号命名 + 侧栏置顶 + 到阈值自动备好新会话）。Generates structured handoff cards with self-incrementing titles, sidebar pinning and threshold-based auto-prepare, so a near-full chat continues seamlessly in a fresh zero-context session. 双语 README。
X-Wide 思考链 · DSH 通用自检插件：把「冻结事实 → 量真形状 → 最小复现 → 单变量对照 → 判定器 → 交活闸」六步固化成可调用的链，并带零依赖开机自检（路径漂移 / 缺件 / 版本一致 / 日志通道）、逐项说明的微调设置、以及每个动作都留备份的退回机制。零运行时依赖，本地模型与云模型同用。
A restrained paper-and-ink Morandi theme for DeepSeek Harness.
CCF 会议截稿侦测：CCF 名单 + CCFDDL 数据 + 模型挖掘，面板可裁决「就是这个会 / 不是这个会」
造书工作台：把教材 PDF 加工成「AI 教学蓝本」的 6 阶段流水线（dsh 插件包）。主 AI 统筹跑流水线（亲自做或派小助手分头干），用户只做五类事：上传材料、确认探查结果、在关卡拍板、确认章节安排、抽查提意见。全程中文，无需技术知识。
在 DSH 输入框输入 /cmd <终端命令> 执行并发送给模型；裸 /cmd 打开交互终端，Ctrl+Enter 把终端内容发给模型，对话中以终端卡片渲染。
Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar — teammates on the y-axis, real session time on the x-axis, task title and summary in every bar. · DSH 侧边栏的 agent team 任务甘特图。
终端：聚合当前会话、子代理与 Agent Team 队友的 bash / 后台任务 / 持久终端实时输出（只读观看）。
给人设一份会记住、会变淡、会生闷气也能哄回来的好感度：按人记分、每天衰减、理由可回看；分数只影响语气，不影响安全规则。
给 DeepSeek Harness 加上看图能力：vision 工具 + 图片描述（智谱 GLM-4V-Flash，免费额度）
DSH LAN session sync: auto-discover devices running this plugin, browse/pull/push sessions over HTTP, verify them with SHA-256, and keep a local-only nickname per device.

Snipaste-style screenshot annotation for DeepSeek Harness: F1 freezes and dims the screen, drag to select a region, draw red boxes and text annotations (mouse wheel changes the font size), and the annotated PNG drops straight into the composer. Windows only.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: a four-pointed-star button left of the composer model selector that rewrites your draft before you send it — fixing grammar, ambiguity and wrong execution order — plus a dedicated settings page.
Publishes the model this DeepSeek Harness profile is using as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint, bound to a configurable LAN or public address.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that imports, edits, stores and applies SillyTavern AI presets as switchable AI preset layers, with export, archive and delete support. AI-made.
Theme skin manager for DeepSeek Harness: Codex-Skins import, wallpaper skins, and an AI theme designer.
Second-brain for DeepSeek Harness: notes in Markdown + git, reviewed card capture from the DeepSeek web chat, cloud/local split, and a toolbar menu in the session header.
One click to the very top of a DSH conversation: load every earlier page first, then stay at the top.
C-137 skin for DeepSeek Harness: 28 Rick and Morty posters, custom scenes, and overlay pets (Rick, Morty, portal gun).
Mobile companion layout for the dsh web GUI: phone-width drawer sidebar, overlay details pane, touch-sized composer and safe-area handling

Prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: improves composer drafts with an editable local template.
Session recycle bin and permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.
Web background plugin: Arknights wallpaper over the shell with a layered gradient veil and a slow aurora drift
DeepSeek Harness 峰谷提醒：在会话标题栏「模式」之后显示当前是高峰还是空闲时段（北京时间，工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰，周末与法定节假日全天空闲），并倒计时下一次切换。
DSH web plugin: plays a sound when the agent finishes replying (turn/end). Sound, volume and on/off are configurable in the Settings page.
MCP server and skill manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH 0.2.x): Settings pages, a same-origin HTTP API, and model-facing mcp_manager_* tools.
DeepSeek Harness 破甲深度分支（dsh-purge-deep）：首尾夹击 + 生成层熔断 + 宿主源码级补丁。基于 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge 改造，适配 dsh 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.3。
dsh Web 插件：在输入框模型名左侧加一个小星星按钮，一键把当前草稿交给模型改写成结构化提示词，可一键撤回。
Conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: a live tree of every session in the workspace — subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation. · DSH 对话地图：当前工作区全部会话的实时树状图，子代理谱系、运行状态一目了然，点击即跳转。
Mobile watchdog for the DSH web GUI: if the composer is left broken after the app returns from background, reload the page once
5GB 磁盘长期记忆库（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：把跨会话对话自动沉淀进本地 SQLite/FTS5 库，按需检索并注入提示词，配 Web 用量面板。
DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏「使用情况」：按通道展示用量明细、活跃热力图、项目/会话用量与官方余额/配额（实时优先，失败回落快照）
Edit an already-sent user message in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and continue from that point as a new branch.

独立页面测试任意已配置渠道的提示词缓存命中率、响应速度，并用鹈鹕 SVG 检验模型输出。
任务完成或等待审批/回答时，DeepSeek Harness 的托盘图标像 QQ 一样隐显闪烁、任务栏按钮同时闪；只要还有黄点/绿点就一直闪，点全部消失才停。
Save DSH conversation turns into Markdown: a heart in the assistant action row, per-session collections in the sidebar, and a personal knowledge base the model can search on demand.
DSH plugin for aeval evaluation control and realtime, projection-based personal trajectory analytics.
Cursor Agent for DeepSeek Harness: browser login, token refresh, model discovery, and Cursor's server-side agent loop
输入框右下角的提示词增强按钮：一键把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词，支持取消与还原。
在 DSH 里选中一段文字即可「加入对话 / 侧边提问 / 评论」：来自右侧栏文件预览或聊天记录，只写进输入框草稿，不自动发送。

Live Markdown rendering attached to the DSH Web composer, with a source-preserving toggle in the composer tool row.
装完新插件/新技能，点一下「刷新 DSH」即可生效，无需手动重启：侧边栏一键刷新 dsh web，服务恢复后页面自动重载。Activate new plugins and skills with one click, no manual restart: sidebar refresh button for dsh web with auto page reload.
Git changes and per-file diffs as a right-Sidebar tab for the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Git changes and per-file diffs as a right-Sidebar tab for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

Local-first long-term memory and personal-profile plugin for DeepSeek Harness: layered memory tracks, confirmation-gated extraction, automatic cross-conversation recall, domain-tagged profile analysis, and Markdown export. 本地优先的长期记忆与个人画像插件：分层记忆轨、确认闸门、跨会话自动召回、领域画像分析、Markdown 导出。
Self-narrative memory for DeepSeek Harness: the model writes notes to itself, which persist across sessions and are injected back. | 人格库：模型写给自己看的话，跨会话保留并每回合注入。

DSH Web plugin: an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head image under blocking tool calls (wait_agent, job_output, bash, ask_user_question), plus a graphical settings page.
DSH Web/Desktop plugin: Edge-style session groups with workspace tree, single list, recursive sorting, dark-mode palettes, subagent browsing, and an approval-gated agent organization tool.
DSH Web plugin: recolors the browser-tab DSH whale by session state — running, waiting for your answer, output finished — painting concurrent states as left-to-right color bands.

A Chat/Code mode toggle in the composer bar: Chat mode routes the session to the DeepSeek account provider (no API key, no browser login) and trims the tool list to a read-only allowlist, with an optional writable variant for discussing and editing in the same session.
DSH 侧栏 R 图标：追踪 X @thsottiaux 的 Codex reset 公告（倒计时 + 北京时间）
Calendar clock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI sidebar: a live clock, an analog dial, and a month calendar.

Retrace · 回溯 — Recall, edit-and-resend, regenerate, and conversation/artifact versioning (timeline, rollback, fork graph) for DeepSeek Harness — Web and Desktop
为 DSH 打造的日历插件：开箱即用，让智能体帮助你管理日程。

让鲸鱼娘看着你的屏幕陪你玩：检测画面变化，自动看一眼、说一句，字幕挂在屏幕底部。
Current-conversation quota/balance for known providers, plus local usage and priced estimates for every configured model provider, including hand-added ones, with in-place credential configuration

DSH Web UI plugin: fold consecutive tool calls in one assistant turn into a single line (Codex-style), with live running-tool label, call count, and expand/collapse. Pure Slot/React implementation, no DOM patching.

DSH 插件 / DeepSeek Harness：视频 / 生图 / TTS 全能 · 本机运行（QQ 交流群 454707710）。★ 0.33.0 起许可改为 BSL 1.1（BUSL-1.1，非 OSI 开源许可）：除托管/代管服务与直接竞品捆绑两类「竞争性使用」外免费生产使用，2030-11-15 转 Apache-2.0；0.32.1 及更早仍 MIT、不追溯。★ 1.1.1：TTS 首段早出声——悬浮面板两段式（首段落盘即播、剩余整段一次提交，省 N−2 次往返），默认关、非节点级流式、整段时长不变。★ 1.1.0：全面提速——内置 resvg 光栅 7.02× / 静态帧去重+VFR 合成 6.58× / 分镜缓存 34.2× / 草稿档 2.10×，TE-Speed 生图链真机 −17.3%，编码择优纠错（x264 排 AMF 前）、BGM 三缓存、Qwen3-TTS attention 可选 + 低延迟分块；未实测的一律不吹倍率。★ 1.0.0：选模型「假成功」根治（拒绝时如实回未生效 + 原因，不再无条件报已选）、优化面板与素材库白条同源修复（持久化缓存 + 占位 + 错误态）、历史筛选分页与重复请求收口、所有写参数拒绝统一 choiceResult。★ 0.35.0：口语入口别名（「风格卡」「批量出图」…）解析成真实工具、参考图色调取样写进提示词、建议时间轴 / 资源需求声明 / 数据流摘要 / 「刚才那张」产出短引用全部接进主链路。★ 0.34.0：SageAttention / Comfy-WaveSpeed 并入加速链并按真实 /object_info 探测、卡片常驻显示；GPT-SoVITS v5 / IndexTTS2 可选 TTS、拖音频零样本克隆、ACE-Step 1.5 / YuE2 音乐 BGM、手动超分、Worker 热温冷保活。0.33.0 新增媒体格式转换（图片 JPG/PNG/WebP、视频 MP4/MKV/MOV/WebM、音频 MP3/AAC/WAV/FLAC，生成物可指定输出格式、动图转视频、自有素材转换，Agent 可直接调用 convert_media）与加速链全景（生图/视频缓存后端 + TTS 加速 + 显存预算 + 配置裁决 + 结构化日志，只列探测到的、未实测不写倍率）、本机能力功能区内嵌进 Comfy 控制面板（展开页恒在悬浮球正上方、边框对齐 DSH 右边框、四事件点按兜底）、GIF 转换 / 运行期自诊断 / 优先级任务队列 / 单图迭代优化 / 自适应 DAG 编排 / 生成历史可删改与冷热分离等本机工具与端点；0.32.1 两轮审计加固：ASR 音频路径围栏（只认出图目录内文件）、按包名安装也能执行引导脚本、草图台四事件点按、错误响应消毒收口；视频链清单化 + 生图/TTS 契约对账（改图自动报差异）；生图/视频/混合三模式界面各不同；批量出图带幂等保护（重试不重出）；Qwen3-TTS 语音克隆与可接 ASR 自动字幕；本机实测秒数；会话级模型驻留、显存建议、参数来源表、预设绑定、加载器盘点等本机端点。文生视频 / 图生视频（Wan 2.2 / XT-5B）与图→音→视频混合、导入音频直接合进成片（音轨合成），文生图与 1–16 张参考图编辑、圈选重绘（羽化 / 边缘融合 / 外扩 / 反选 / 重绘强度可调）/ 元素移除 / 四向扩图 / 高清放大，Qwen3-TTS 语音合成（独立 generate_speech，参考音频可复刻音色），模型无关角色参考；草图台手绘参考；生成记录可检索（菜单最上面「历史」，SQLite 索引、软删除不动磁盘文件）。CPU 也能跑：自动识别 AVX2 / AVX512 / AVX512-BF16 指令集并给五档加速（含 --cpu 强制纯 CPU）、按物理核钉线程，任务结束可选自动卸载模型内存；安装入口是常驻的图形化引导面板。对外提供脱敏状态快照与端点目录供外部集成。提供可选、默认关闭的模型自动下载包：视频模型 --video-models、核显档位 --igpu-download、生图主模型 --tier，按服务器权威 size + sha256 双校验；音频权重不自动下载，缺件给明确清单。经本机 ComfyUI 调用，数据仅走 127.0.0.1 回环（联网参考图检索默认拒绝、须逐次同意），无需 API 密钥、零调用费用。Windows / Linux，NVIDIA / Intel Arc / AMD / 核显共享内存，含 8 GB 低内存档位。
Kun Like 桌宠 · DSH 正式插件包：Web 界面右下角的坤宠，随 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。作为 profile 插件挂载，重启仍在、所有会话页面共享。

Long-term memory box for DeepSeek Harness settings: what you write is injected into the system prompt of every new session, and 0.3.0 can expand a rough note into a detailed requirement sheet — your requirements kept verbatim, model guesses marked as 推断 and deletable, open questions left for you. Adopt, roll another version, or keep your own text. · DSH 设置页的「长时记忆」输入框：填一次，之后每个新会话都带着它；0.3.0 起可一键把草稿细化成完整需求说明，原文要求逐条保留、模型补充标为「推断」可删、未指定的维度单列，采用/换一版/不改都由你决定。

DeepSeek account balance, DeepSeek peak/off-peak price hints, and a token-activity heatmap (local sessions or account-wide platform usage) pinned above the account avatar in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

dsh 插件 · 赛博木鱼：agent 干活即修行——工具调用自动敲木鱼攒功德，报错是渡劫，完工有连击，还能以金钱卦（文王六十四卦）实时起卦问事；功德簿同时是 agent 工作量与渡劫（报错）统计。Cyber wooden fish (muyu) with merit ledger and a real-time coin-divination (I-Ching) oracle for DeepSeek Harness.

Claude Code integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing native Claude conversations powered by the Claude Agent SDK, with model selection, approvals, questions, tools, and session continuation.
Codex conversation backend for DeepSeek Harness, powered by the Codex App Server with approvals and DSH tool support.
Workspace file explorer plugin for the Relay workbench in DeepSeek Harness.
Conversation-first plugin discovery and lifecycle management for DeepSeek Harness.
Provider-neutral interactive terminal plugin for the Relay workbench in DeepSeek Harness.
Extensible workbench shell for DeepSeek Harness with generic side and bottom view registration.

NAZUNA (彻夜之歌) themed wallpaper engine for the DSH web GUI: Wallpaper Engine / custom Video-Web-Scene wallpapers behind the chat with iOS-style liquid glass — 七草荠 mascot pull-cord, moonlight-violet accent, deep-night glass. Based on elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine v0.7.1.
NAZUNA skin for the dsh web GUI: a midnight-city theme inspired by Call of the Night — moonlit deep-blue night, soft violet moonlight, and quiet city-glow accents
Webnovel Writer：DSH 长篇网文写作工作台（含检索增强：嵌入、场景识别与重排，默认停用）
Scriptor 检索增强：嵌入、场景识别与重排（已并入主包 @yangda611/dsh-scriptor；新用户直接装主包，不要与主包同装本包）
dsh「专家团」bundle：一句自然语言组建角色化多智能体「数字员工」团队，按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，实现者直接改代码并产出持久工件；带 live 团队浮层。 · Role-based multi-agent expert team for DeepSeek Harness: one sentence in, a staged and gated team delivery out.
Groups the DSH sidebar panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups. 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。
DSH skill center: browse by region, install from zip, manage (enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore, search).
第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常驻/折叠 + 📌 固定（DeepSeek Harness）
DSH 内置版 Obsidian：AI agent 知识库的构建、检索、图谱、UI 与增量构建（v1 构建 + v2 检索 + v3 图谱 + v4 UI + v5 笔记编辑 + v6 增量构建 + v7 多库管理）
DSH 提示词场景插件：下拉选场景 → 自动开新会话并填充提示词（支持 {变量}），微调即可发送
需求工坊：PM 用自然语言+@引用把真实前端代码还原成可编辑高保真画布并产出规格。Requirement workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
定时任务调度器：按 Cron 自动新建 DSH 会话并注入提示词执行。Scheduled tasks for DeepSeek Harness: create a new session with your prompt on a cron schedule.
Session management for DeepSeek Harness: archive/restore/delete persisted sessions, auto-policy per workspace, and a size governance panel. DSH 会话管理插件：归档/恢复/删除持久化会话，按工作区控制会话数量上限，提供体积治理面板。
KNJ 版本控制工作台：Git Local Changes / Commit / Update / Push 与安全预览确认（DeepSeek Harness Web）。
KNJ 开发任务编排插件：配置驱动的工作流 + 开发任务管理 + 可视化阶段进度（DeepSeek Harness）
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin for Gaussian 16: input generation, SMILES-to-3D (RDKit), output parsing, serial job management, BSE basis sets, Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).

DSH Web GUI: attach a long-running job id to the CURRENT conversation and let the sidebar row carry its state — pink while the job runs, green once it finished (come back and analyse), amber when the id cannot be found. Providers are just a shell command plus one regex, so anything that can list what is running (an HPC scheduler, tmux on a bare-metal box, your own CLI) works. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏显示阿里云代金券剩余额度（只读 DescribeCoupon）· Alibaba Cloud coupon balance row for DSH
Self-hosted plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness: a DSH client bundle plus the market server under server/ (accounts, groups, permissions, artifact storage, install statistics).
DSH 本地加密记忆插件：会话级精确关联、三级记忆检索、上下文预算与原页面状态更新，保留逐工作区授权、来源追溯与提示词注入隔离。
DeepSeek Harness sidebar and optional ticker for Longbridge market data, with the stock_quote agent tool.
滴答清单 (DIDA365 / TickTick) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: workspace-bound list, @-mention tasks in chat, and agent control via the dida365 MCP server

DSH proxy manager: route model requests, web fetches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address; per-URL route diagnosis, one-click toggle from the conversation header, a dedicated Settings page, and keepalive-aware 407 hints.
Skill lifecycle manager for DSH 0.2.x: library / workspace / session three-layer skill management, plus the read-only preset layer read through the 0.2 scope API

Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a cherry blossom on its head, a soft pink progress bar, and the line "Sakura, walk slower." Auto fades out after ~3 seconds; pure client-side, zero dependencies.
Creative branching canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
A restart button floating at the top-right of DeepSeek Harness — restart the whole desktop app gracefully, with a confirmation only when work is running. · DSH 右上角常驻重启按钮：优雅重启整个桌面端，有任务在跑时才确认。

DeepSeek Harness approval & completion alert for the Web GUI and the Desktop app — desktop notification + sound + tab-title flash when a session waits for an approval or a user question, plus a completion alert when a task finishes. The host half sends native notifications through the dsh process (node-notifier), so alerts still arrive when the window is minimized, hidden, or no page is connected. Optional WeChat push reuses the dsh-wechat-bridge iLink login (outbound only). dsh 审批/完成提醒：会话等待审批/提问、或任务完成时提醒你回来处理；主机端系统通知兜底，可选微信推送。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: drag images into the composer and get a file path back, so text-only models can read them via the read tool.
Show local images or short videos in the current DeepSeek Harness conversation card, with click-to-preview and a download link. Works over local and remote connections.
缩放：自定义键盘组合与滚轮修饰键调整聊天倍率，原生设置控制，提示 5 秒。
A Windows companion with DeepSeek balances, unified Codex subscription, opt-in safe account rotation, account-bound warmup and protected reset credits.
DSH web plugin: a VS Code-style code editor view (file tree, Monaco, ripgrep search/replace, Markdown preview, git diff).

Plugin discovery for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source, star-ranked search across GitHub's dsh-plugin topic and the awesome-dsh-plugin curated list, with a bundled offline index and a real offline keyword engine.
OpenAI Images 2.6 (gpt-image-2.6 flare/sunburst) tools for DeepSeek Harness, with Roblox Open Cloud asset upload.
DSH 会话接力：提交按钮旁一键总结会话、固化记忆、生成交接文档；可编辑预览后在新会话继续
DeepSeek Harness 550W 核心终端：启动动画（550W → 180° 反转 MOSS）+ 同款主题 + 访问门口令

Optional dsh-better-sidebar viewer integration.

webCandidates.description: 设计台（Design Studio）：Claude Design 级别的设计能力移植到 DSH——Figma 级编辑器界面（三栏布局/图层树/浮动工具条/画板视图/命令面板/标尺参考线/深浅主题）、设计系统与语境采集、三档变体 HTML 设计、可视画布直接编辑、内联评论、Tweaks 实时调参、无障碍与对比度等质检评分、HTML/ZIP/PDF/PNG/PPTX 导出、版本管理。纯 Node，零第三方运行时依赖。
Codex-style pause and continue for DeepSeek Harness: stop a running answer and resume from the break point. Modelled on Codex and Cursor. · Codex 式暂停与继续：在回答生成时暂停，并从断点接着生成。交互参考 Codex 与 Cursor。

DSH 卡顿时,在页面内直接回答「刚才那一下多慢、卡在哪一层、是谁干的」,并把现场留给事后复盘。 Client-side performance recorder for DeepSeek Harness: how slow the last stall was, which layer caused it, who is to blame, and the evidence kept for replay.

btw - one-off context side questions for a DSH session: a temporary dialog that inherits the current session context; answers stay in the dialog unless the user reviews a compressed summary and sends it into the session.
DSH web plugin: coding-plan quota dashboard (OpenCode Go / Volcengine CodingPlan / DeepSeek balance / custom plans) shown as a sidebar footer badge with an overlay card.

🐋 DeepSeek 娘桌宠：住进 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的蓝发鲸鱼女仆。工作链路（开工/轮播/收工庆祝）、任务完成统计气泡（用时/消耗/花费）、会话与单轮费用 pill（缓存命中/未命中/输出三桶 + 谷峰）、📊 分时段花费看板（北京小时·日趋势、三桶堆叠柱、缓存命中率、可拖动缩放）、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮与完整设置面板。A whale-girl desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
Toggleable assistant, tool, and Think accents with safe Think Markdown for DSH Web
DSH Web 插件：把对话末尾的「本次产出」chip 行替换为 Codex 风格的改动汇总卡片（文件数、增删行数、内联 diff、在文件夹中显示）
Inline comments on the native plan-review page: the pending review's sidebar tab is taken over as a commentable, fully native-rendered document.
DSH web plugin: 在 DSH 中心区视图嵌入固定版本 code-server（VS Code Web），支持自定义服务器路径/端口配置、安装进度与热切换。
Engineering teams and conversation management for DeepSeek Harness.
A local-only context badge with automatic first-five user-message capture, purpose summary, per-session notes and todos for DeepSeek Harness, plus an optional macOS foreground-window companion.

Render Markdown to standalone, self-contained HTML in the DeepSeek Harness — a model-facing md_html_render tool that works headless, plus a browse/preview/export drawer in the web GUI. One renderer behind both. Zero runtime dependencies.
Temporal layered memory for DeepSeek-Harness (dsh): dual timestamps, day recall, corrections, and selective recall injection. / 为 DSH 提供带事件时间与有效期的分层记忆。
Unified notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: browser notifications, sound, and Bark push over one event model.

Prompt enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness: an "✨ Enhance" composer button that rewrites prompts with first-principles thinking using session context, and asks clarifying questions when key info is missing.
Search DSH plugins on the npm registry by a name fragment and install them from the Plugins page.
DSH 插件：把 QubitClient 的 pipeline 结果页面（http://127.0.0.1:8581/）融合进右侧栏 tab，并给模型一个读取结果的工具。
Netease Cloud Music lyrics beside the DSH activity line, disguised as part of it.
One-click authenticated phone access for DeepSeek Harness through a managed Cloudflare Quick Tunnel
