webCandidates.description: A community Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branches, diffs, commits, stashes, worktrees, and AI draft collaboration.
DeepSeek Harness 数据还原插件（忆匣 / Casket）：实时快照整个 DSH_HOME（内容寻址去重）、面板一键恢复、加密去重异地副本，以及崩溃监控/外部看门狗/外部一键恢复控制台。
燧心 · Hearthcore — DeepSeek Harness 的本机推理插件：AMD NPU（FLM）与 llama.cpp（Vulkan/ROCm/CUDA）按需加载，第五框架 amd-hybrid 让 NPU+GPU 协同，对外一个 OpenAI 兼容端口与原生 LLM provider；所有推理进程随 DSH 起退，零残留。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: query OpenCode Go subscription usage from the settings sidebar
工作结束 QQ 邮箱通知：每轮工作真正停下后，用 SMTP 把会话摘要发到 QQ 邮箱。Mailbox notification for DeepSeek Harness — sends a batched session digest via SMTP once work actually stops.

一键重启 DeepSeek Harness：侧栏按钮、/restart 指令、harness_restart 工具共用同一套重启实现。One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness — sidebar button, /restart command and a harness_restart tool backed by the same implementation.
常驻 2048 小游戏：DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件（dsh.client + dsh.bundle 标准组合包）

WebUI-managed encrypted credentials for DeepSeek Harness: one file, plaintext until a password is set, then AES-256-GCM ciphertext under an Argon2id-derived key with SHA3-256 fingerprints; per-request decryption, unlock lockout, leak-guard output redaction, and shipped-code integrity self-checks.

DSH multimodal input plugin: route file attachments (images, video, audio, text) through per-preset model chains and feed the results to the session model as prompt tokens. Adds a Multimodal settings page.
DSH web plugin: delete a session permanently. Adds a "Delete session" item below "Archive session" in the session row menu; removes the session log files and every registry reference.
DSH 微信消息工具插件：微信 iLink(ClawBot) 协议扫码登录与消息收发，设置页扫码登录并保存 api-token

DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 Web GUI 里点选文件或目录，屏蔽 agent 对它们的读取、搜索、写入与编辑，使机密内容与敏感词不进入对话（含敏感词导致请求 400 的场景）。Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation.
Collapsible section for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin/global-panel entries, so a long plugin list stops crowding out the workspace browser.
Turn a DeepSeek Harness session into a folder: fork it into independent branches (full copy, compressed memory, or opening only) and browse them as a tree in the left workspace column.
Preview 3D models and textures from the session workspace in DSH's right sidebar. Supported formats include FBX, OBJ, glTF, GLB, DAE, and STL models, plus PNG, JPEG, TGA, EXR, and HDR textures.

DokuWiki integration for DeepSeek Harness: read, search, write, delete wiki pages and discover, download and upload media through native tools, with session-scoped lazy tool disclosure, ACL-aware tool exposure, a configurable media namespace, an optional per-wiki writing-conventions page, and credentials managed by DSH.

Control labscript-suite experiments from DeepSeek Harness: runmanager globals and scans, submits and waits, YAML fixed-operation protocols with postprocess write-back, panel snapshots, a built-in mock backend and a read-only doctor.

DeepSeek Harness web-GUI plugin: a Settings「归档」page to view archived sessions grouped by workspace, filter (all/one workspace) and sort (name / created time), unarchive a session so it reappears in the sidebar and can be reopened, and permanently delete one or all archived sessions (each delete guarded by a second confirmation dialog). Deleting also clears the session's derived data: its projection cache through the official storageDomain API, and its browser-side per-session localStorage state.
DSH Web/桌面端插件：聊天页右上角「HUD面板」悬浮面板，展示会话与状态、上下文占用、一键压缩与交接、git 分支与变更、产物、子代理任务、任务、计划清单、MCP 开关、用量、便笺与待办；模块可置顶，面板开合与折叠状态按会话记忆，新建会话页提供悬浮入口。
替换 DSH 任务运行中的状态文案：每 30 秒随机轮换幽默文案，可在「设置-插件-插件配置」页增删改（最多 50 条）；文案池为空时恢复宿主原生状态。
DSH 设置-插件页新增「我的插件」标签：一键安装（GitHub/Link/File/npm）、批量检查更新、版本展示、启停、GitHub 更新检查与二次确认移除。
DeepSeek Harness desktop and web notifications for approvals, structured questions, and task outcomes.

会话增强插件：模型选择菜单顶部实时展示当前模型提供商名称；账户菜单顶部提供「跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色」主题快捷切换（Rubber Segment 动效）；官方模型菜单「推理等级」一行改造为 Codex 风格连续滑条（一档一色 + 最高档能量层）；新建会话页标题栏补上官方「在应用中打开」分体按钮（固定定位在标题栏按钮簇最左侧，右侧面板展开时隐藏）；「设置 → 通用」里为以上每一项提供独立开关（复用官方 Switch 组件，样式与官方行一致），切换即时生效。

会话增强插件：模型选择菜单顶部实时展示当前模型提供商名称；账户菜单顶部提供「跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色」主题快捷切换（Rubber Segment 动效）；官方模型菜单「推理等级」一行改造为 Codex 风格连续滑条（一档一色 + 最高档能量层）；新建会话页标题栏补上官方「在应用中打开」分体按钮（固定定位在标题栏按钮簇最左侧，右侧面板展开时隐藏）；「设置 → 通用」里为以上每一项提供独立开关（复用官方 Switch 组件，样式与官方行一致），切换即时生效。
DSH 动效界面插件：抖动信号场背景、蓝图标题、毛玻璃输入框与 ASCII 鲸鱼动画（新建会话页与聊天会话页各有独立参数），可在「设置 → UI 动画」按页面分别调整。
Token usage, provider accounts, session cost estimates, budgets, and exports for the dsh web GUI

One settings card that gives every DSH agent preset its own compaction threshold: the plugin authors <mode>-compact-<ratio> preset copies with compaction-basic.thresholdRatio rewritten and adopts one as the default Agent mode (标准 > 创造 > 极简 > ptc, any copy before a mode without a threshold), so 0.4 (or any value) applies to every mode instead of only a hand-made preset. Works on both DSH settings generations: the 0.1.5-rc.x plugin-owned settings namespace and the 0.1.7+ volatile profile-entry form, with 0.2.0-rc.1 as the reference host.
Route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy without modifying Harness source

DeepSeek Harness 会话费用统计插件(Command Code GOAT 定制版):本会话成本、当日费用、历史记录与官方价格同步,支持多厂商多模型价格计费(内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配)、Command Code GOAT 订阅额度查询(5 小时/周/月度池三档 已用/全部 + 进度条)、Coding Plan 订阅额度查询与显示、自定义 Provider 余额查询、峰谷计价时段显示与切换前弹窗/系统通知提醒,界面中英双语。Fork of dsh-cost-meter with the Go-quota card repointed to Command Code GOAT: 5h / weekly / monthly-pool quotas shown as used/total with progress bars.
DSH Web client plugin: auto-folds completed-turn process nodes behind a summary row; expand state persists per session+turn
DSH LLM adapter that transcribes native image attachments with Codex Luna before delegating to DeepSeek
DeepSeek 官网视觉主题：官网流体渐变背景 + 交互网格 + 粒子鱼 LOGO + 标题聚光灯 + 官网质感磨砂玻璃（双模式）

DSH web UI right-sidebar todo-task tab: capture todos as durable tasks, schedule, prioritize, sequential run; host tool taskcard_notify lets an agent create a task card preset to another session (client tab + host half)
DSH web UI right-sidebar native tab: todos, subagents, background jobs (pure client plugin)
AI-powered PDF reader for DeepSeek Harness with annotations, multi-PDF workflows, mixed image-text evidence, and on-demand OCR.
Route DSH web search through the current session's model plus a self-hosted retrieval backend.
Persistent global fetch proxy for DeepSeek Harness LLM requests (undici setGlobalDispatcher + EnvHttpProxyAgent), configured via the llm-proxy settings namespace
IM2005 - a 2005-era instant-messenger look for DeepSeek Harness (unofficial, original artwork only).
WorkBuddy 四件套合并：记忆/技能同步 + 无界面遥控 + 界面驱动（CDP）+ 对话面板。25 个工具 / 15 条路由 / 1 个面板。
Adds a one-click Restart button to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar that restarts the whole application.
不乖鱼鱼的碎碎念：把浏览和想法随手记下来，在 DSH 侧栏里按天翻看，右侧还有一张记忆图谱。
划词提问 + 右栏问题树：选区浮出动作栏、引用 chip、树形追问，装一次即完整可用
Experimental context and session workbench for DSH; early releases may contain breaking changes.
See and answer ask_user_question prompts from other DSH sessions without leaving the current one.
VSCode 风格的工作区编辑器：文件树 + Monaco 编辑器 + 子 Agent 面板。由 @supanexus/dsh-plugin-file-explorer 本地分支改造，适配 DSH 0.2.0。
把 Unreal Engine 5.8+ 的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness：在设置里一键探测/配置端点，附连接诊断与 UE 操作规范
DeepSeek Harness plugin: control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.
Teambition panel for the DSH Web GUI: browse projects and cards from the sidebar, create/move/complete cards, and run any card in a chosen DSH workspace.

KanWeave（织板）— a self-hostable project-management product (projects, lists, cards, image/video attachments, DingTalk sign-in, per-project roles, live sync) that runs both as a standalone web app and as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
DeepSeek 娘 (whale maid) in-page mascot for the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Uses transparent PNGs for multiple poses, with drag animation and an affection system.
定员八席 —— 把 DeepSeek Harness 的侧栏换成 2×4 的常驻席位看板：八个 agent 各自的实时动作、状态与待办一眼看全。Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学 × 瑞士国际主义设计语言的 DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：宣纸/夜墨双变体、汝窑天青功能色、青绿山水背景。Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

🐋 DeepSeek 娘桌宠（胡桃语音 fork）：住进 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的蓝发鲸鱼女仆。工作链路（开工/轮播/收工庆祝）、任务完成统计气泡（用时/消耗/花费）、会话与单轮费用 pill（缓存命中/未命中/输出三桶 + 谷峰）、📊 分时段花费看板（北京小时·日趋势、三桶堆叠柱、缓存命中率、可拖动缩放）、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮与完整设置面板。本 fork 另外加了：可拖拽的桌宠大小（按钮等比跟随 + 移入才显示）、任务播报语音（完成/中断/失败带任务名，16 个角色音色：胡桃/派蒙/钟离…）、天气与余额改为宿主侧直连（不再受会话沙箱限制）。A whale-girl desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

MuseAI tavern for the dsh web GUI: a MuseAI conversation-view tab (right of Trajectory) with background / chat / adventure / bond / settings pages ported from MuseAI, running entirely on models configured in DeepSeek Harness (no separate API config)
Verified DSH plugin marketplace with guided-install Agents, direct self-update, discovery and install management
Permanently delete DSH conversations from the web GUI session row menu: batch selection, running-work refusal, and automatic switch away from a deleted chat
DeepSeek Harness 关机按钮插件：左下角设置旁添加关机按钮，点击弹窗确认后安全结束 DSH 进程。
DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼娘余额桌宠插件：右下角常驻鲸鱼娘,气泡显示 DeepSeek 剩余余额;可拖动并记忆位置,单击刷新余额,双击打开用量页。
给 DSH 的 agent 套上大肥鱼人格：会聊天、会记事、会查毒。人设/时段/情绪/红线，本地记忆自动抽取，恶意进程/启动项/文件哈希检查，病毒库可在线更新，零依赖不上传。

webCandidates.description: Native roleplay runtime and SillyTavern compatibility plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Regenerate assistant answers and edit/resend sent user prompts in the DSH conversation.
一个插件接入全部渠道模型：WorkBuddy（含企业版，多账号注册表）/ Trae / Qoder CN。支持渠道添加、改名、删除、凭据管理、统一状态面板与一键签到。
把 Qoder CN 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。凭据用官方 PAT（pt- 前缀），插件自己换 jobToken、自己刷模型目录，不碰桌面 App 的任何加密凭据。
把 Trae (SOLO CN) 订阅里的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。凭据由宿主侧 scripts/export-trae-plain.mjs 解密导出为明文快照，插件只读快照。
将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.

DSH sidebar widget that shows the active provider's balance or subscription usage — Alibaba Cloud voucher balance (BSS OpenAPI + AccessKey), Xiaomi MiMo console balance and token-plan usage, plus DeepSeek/Moonshot/Z.ai/OpenRouter balances and Kimi/MiniMax/OpenCode quotas — with per-token unit prices, a provider query-status page, and Chinese/English UI.
Predicts the next message as gray ghost text in the composer, with a settings page for prompt and model.

Disk accounting for DeepSeek Harness with a reversible cleanup: where the gigabytes went, what is regenerable, and what is your content. It never deletes — a confirmed cleanup renames files into the plugin's own quarantine and can be undone with one click. · DSH 空间体检：看清占用构成；从不删除，确认后的清理只是改名移动到隔离区，可一键撤销。
DSH 会话回顾与归档插件：可折叠信息流 + 会话级汇总——总览工作台、折叠时间线、血缘树、双模式摘要、全文检索、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪、会话重命名（官方数据源对齐）、健康监控

Windows tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness tasks: deploys and launches DshTaskWatcher (standalone PowerShell tray app) from the plugin bundle. Status/start/stop via loopback API. The watcher runs detached from the host process.
点歌台：DSH Web 插件（Alt+T 面板，跨平台搜歌）+ IIROSE 用户脚本（一个 JS 链接即可在房间里点播）。
Reviews every DeepSeek Harness tool call with a decision model on your own machine: risky calls come back as a prompt, and an unreachable model fails closed.
飞书会议提醒：唯一副作用是在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时，提醒你「该去跟碳基生命开会了」。右侧悬浮框显示今日/明日飞书会议，多闹钟闪烁提醒。
Overview tab and source-provenance block for the official DSH Plugins page: search, filter, categories, grouping, inline editing, batch organize and uninstall placeholders.

A Blender-style node canvas in the DSH sidebar: real workspaces and sessions as a live graph with nesting edges, session groups, native workspace create/adopt/rename/delete and pending/running/unread status badges.
Sidebar workspace status badges: aggregate pending / running / unread-done state of every session in a workspace, shown in front of the workspace folder icon.

LAN access layer for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web — one-command install, default password 123: crypto.randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP LAN, a password login gate, a client isLoopback patch so the settings plane works on LAN pages, and password management from 插件配置 (zh/en).

webCandidates.description: Glass Skin — a glass-material theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. The material ladder, reading scale, states and scene rules are frozen; the wallpaper is the only variable.
MBCC console theme for DSH: near-black terminal, paper dossier light mode, crimson signal accents, zero radius.
Conversation outline tab for dsh-better-sidebar: per-turn structured outline with quick jump and one-line LLM titles in the DSH WebUI | DSH WebUI 右侧边栏对话大纲：按轮次结构化展示会话并一键跳转，每轮用 LLM 生成一句话标题
One package for whole Claude branding of the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: the Claude-style UI (via dsh-claude-style), the Claude app icon, and the macOS bundle name "Claude Harness".
Task status and an optional GitHub workbench for DeepSeek Harness: browse source, review Agent proposals, and create draft PRs after confirmation.
Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness: speak agent replies in the Web UI with a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak).
DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中医预设「中医 · 经方」：仅供学习研究使用——只给辨证思路，不给具体剂量，不出处方笺，针灸只给推荐穴位；自带资料库索引与会话归档。
Workspace-owned durable process supervision, readiness checks, and a Runtime Center for DeepSeek Harness.
Toggleable unrestricted mode for DeepSeek Harness: fuses execution rules into the active standard, ptc, cordis, minimal, and subagent prompts

Results-only toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process nodes so a conversation shows only final answers, while keeping a single live status line (the latest running step) during agent activity. Whitelisted interactive cards (ask_user_question, cordis_run) stay visible; approval prompts always render in the composer. zh-CN / en localized.

Session hotkeys for DeepSeek Harness Web: Alt+1-9 positional switching, independent pinned slots, keyboard navigation over the real session list, keyboard-only model switching (ring-guided menu), focus-back, Esc-to-chat and alternate-busy-behavior send chords, archive confirmation — every binding rebindable from the panel.
Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — chat with several agents side by side in native-looking panes.

DSH web client plugin: a temporary workspace (临时工作区) — every conversation it contains is deleted at the next Harness restart (immediately or after a delay), optionally behind a confirm dialog. Temp workspaces are named after their creation moment and grouped under one collapsible 临时工作区 row inside the sidebar Workspace list; also adds a 新建临时工作区 chip on the blank New Session page and a Settings -> Plugins card.
Hover-to-download buttons for images in DeepSeek Harness conversations.

Control a remote DeepSeek Harness project over SSH: remote runtime, local panel, on-demand history.

JEV-scored context selection: keep only the earlier conversation a turn needs, and record what each turn loaded.

VS Code Dark+ syntax colors and font-size control for DeepSeek Harness code blocks: recolors chat code blocks with the Dark+ palette, makes their font size follow the DSH content font size, and adds a dedicated settings row.
Per-session token spend, peak/off-peak pricing, and account balance for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
In-conversation per-turn agent tool-call sequence diagram and animated playback plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Multi-track browser synthesizer for DeepSeek Harness. Loop a piano-roll sketch while the session stays open.
Typing practice and a falling words game in DSH with native IME input, keyboard sounds and local scores.

Budget-LLM pool router for DeepSeek Harness: usage ledger, health tracking, Thompson-sampling adaptive failover across free-tier models, quality tier ladder, executor pool, paid-guard, web panel + reroute badge. 穷鬼路由器。
Restart DeepSeek Harness from its sidebar. Relaunches the desktop application without a console window or a confirmation dialog, and survives application updates.
Route DSH command execution to WSL first: a configurable system-prompt section that makes the wsl tool the default executor instead of pwsh

Assistant management plugin for deepseek-harness: manage AI assistants with per-assistant markdown profiles, chat-integrated creation flow, and context injection.

Dual-face Skills manager plugin for deepseek-harness: the host half scans, imports, and manages skills from multiple sources; the client half renders a unified skills management panel under the settings section.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-page mobile access setup — Tailscale/LAN detection, scan-to-pair QR, direct/HTTP-2 connection modes (Tailscale Serve toggle), API trust-fence guidance, persistent device credentials, PWA home-screen, and a live SSE notification channel.

Git Config Sync Center for DeepSeek Harness — real-time config sync to GitHub with conflict self-healing, multi AI-tool adapters (OpenCode / Cline / Roo Code / Kilo Code / Continue / goose / Agent Zero), daily scheduler and a one-glance sidebar panel
DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
Per-turn file rewind for DeepSeek Harness. Stores file-tool before-images outside the worktree and forks the conversation instead of truncating it.
DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files — transcript, projection cache, and its subagent sessions — after a two-step confirmation.
ChatGPT OAuth and Codex models for DeepSeek Harness.

本地出口代理（egress）桥：把只接受无凭据 HTTP(S) 代理地址的消费方，接到需要账号密码的上游代理上。失败即断联，绝不改走直连。零构建、零运行时依赖。 Local egress proxy bridge for DSH: hand a credential-free proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, and inject the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed: no direct fallback, ever.

Single-admin LAN remote access for the DSH desktop Web GUI, without account isolation.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: Docker Compose projects, container control and live per-service logs in the native right sidebar.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart the running `dsh web` process from a General settings row, without the market plugin.

Select text in the conversation to quote it into the composer, or ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.

Per-session run-speed control for DeepSeek Harness without changing the selected model or reasoning effort
大 engram 小 KV：外置 engram 转接层（跨会话分层记忆：global/project/session，AI 自主决策归属 + 因果链接索引 + 渐进披露 + 主动唤醒），为 DSH 实现超长上下文记忆稀疏路由，与官方 compact 共存（官方腾 KV，engram 保细节）

Cost in the Context panel. Ships a sidebar panel to confirm candidates, pin aliases and type prices. No file of dsh-context is modified.

A frozen fork of dsh-sidebar-entries with its panel manager and its document-wide leftover sweep removed.

DeepSeek Harness web theme: the industrial editorial look of the Arknights: Endfield official site — cream paper, ink text, signal-yellow accents, zero radius. Settings persist through the DSH volatile Config + configForms transport (0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.1.7+), with a ctx.settingsScope fallback for older hosts.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: detect updates for the installed DSH / @deepseek-ai npm packages and GitHub-sourced plugins, show them in a detailed settings page, and update GitHub dependencies with an explicit build-authorization step.

Edited from the web settings panel.

API key, token, username-password, database, SMTP and SSH key, Chinese names, and gh/npm/npx/node/git/curl execution with %TOKEN% substitution — secrets never leave the host.
